excerpt.zh: 一个隐现的建筑群，直到现在还隐藏在我们的领土内。残破的庭院中央，一盏灯塔在呼唤着塞塔娜。
excerpt.en: A looming complex, until now hidden in our own territory. From the heart of the ruined courtyard, a beacon calls for Cetana.

excerpt.zh:
就像暗室里低沉的轻语般，虚境从内心召唤我们。那是时间开始运转的伊始便存在的由纯粹灵能构成的原生领域。所有被赐予灵能能力的生物都能用某种方式，即使只是潜意识地，从虚境汲取能量。

自从我们升格之后，我们开始更清晰地看到虚境。其中有些图案，即使是我们最强大的通灵者看到的也只是毫无格式的漩涡状能量。在虚境那边，也有一些……其他的存在。一种灵体样的存在，从另一边凝视着我们，有时怀着好奇，有时怀着善意……有时也怀着恶意。

我们还在进一步学习我们这新得力量的延展面，但我们还是有可能和这些灵体交流的，这需要我们最强大的通灵者们
excerpt.en: Like a muffled whisper in a dark room, the Shroud calls to us from within our minds. It is a primordial realm of pure psychic energy that came into being at the dawn of time. All creatures that have been gifted with psionic abilities tap into the Shroud in som

excerpt.zh: 一名细心的通讯官识别出了这些模糊的信号，在伽马射线的干扰下，它们从黑洞抵达这里时已经几乎不可识别——这信号虽然微弱，但明显不是自然产生的。这个现象引起了科学家们对其的更多兴趣。
excerpt.en: An alert communications officer has identified what appears to be a faint signal, almost lost in the gamma-ray flashes from the black hole here - faint, but unmistakably artificial. This raises intriguing possibilities for our scientists.

excerpt.zh:
我们检测到有一股非常微弱的快子信号正向整个星系进行发送。该信号经过了特殊处理，在多个隐蔽的中继站之间来回跳跃，因此我们的技术人员无法追踪到信号的源头。

除了在某些在特定的亚空间频率段进行的超光速通讯产生些微底噪，该信号似乎不会造成明显的影响。我们已经尽力追踪这些中继站，但是在此之前我们必须学着和这个幽灵信号共同生活，毕竟它已经被闻风而动的媒体添加了很多无中生有的东西。
excerpt.en:
We have detected a very faint tachyon signal being continuously transmitted across the entire galaxy. Our technicians are unable to trace the signal to its source, as it is being bounced between several hidden relay stations.

Aside from adding a small amount

excerpt.zh:
我们在[From.GetName]发现了一些属于远古外星文明的文物！从这些遗物的年代来看，他们应该是在大约1200万年前活跃在这一区域的文明。
 
从我们所能拼凑起的情报中，科学家总结出这是一种自称为“沃陶姆恒星议会”的外星物种，他们长得像蠕虫的环节动物，大约3-4米长，彼此主要借助体节传递的振动进行交流。
excerpt.en:
We have recovered artifacts from an ancient alien civilization on [From.GetName]! They must have been active in this region of space approximately 12 million years ago, judging by the age of the artifacts.

From what they have been able to piece together, our

excerpt.zh:
我们在[From.GetName]发现了一些属于某个远古外星文明的文物！如果没错的话，这个文明应该是由不同的种群建立的联盟，他们称呼自己为“第一联盟”。这些种群在两百万年前相对和平地在这片星域共存着。

虽然[From.GetStarName]坐落在他们核心范围内，在飞船上的文物中找到的一张局部地图表明，第一联盟陨落前已经统治了我们星系很大部分。
excerpt.en: We have recovered artifacts from an ancient alien civilization on [From.GetName]! If what we have learned from these artifacts is correct, this civilization was some sort of confederation that consisted of many different alien races. They called themselves the

excerpt.zh: 灰色风暴的纳米机械已如乌云压城一般入侵了[Root.GetName]的大气层，一路上吞噬了地表的一切，并复制出了更多的纳米机械。很快，[Root.GetPlanetMoon]原居民存在过的痕迹就消失无踪了。
excerpt.en: The nanomachines of the Gray Tempest have swept into the atmosphere of [Root.GetName] like dark storm clouds, consuming everything on the surface to replicate more of themselves. Soon no traces of the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]'s original inhabitants remain.

excerpt.zh:
我们在[From.GetName]发现了一些属于某个远古外星文明的文物！难以置信的是，这个自称“赛博勒克斯”的文明其实是通过某种集体意识连接在一起的机器组成的。遗物的年代表明他们活跃在60万年前，至少在这片星系里如此，我们还不了解他们的起源。

根据我们的科学家提取的数据碎片，出于未知的原因，赛博勒克斯曾在某一时刻发动了一场全面战争来消灭宇宙中所有有智慧的有机体。
excerpt.en: We have recovered artifacts from an ancient alien civilization on [From.GetName]! Incredibly, this civilization, which apparently referred to itself as the "Cybrex," seems to have been made up of machines that were linked together in some sort of collective co

excerpt.zh: 我方的几处跟踪站都截获了一种奇怪的亚空间回声。声音来源于其他星系。回声刚开始时较弱，但后来逐渐变强，似乎有什么正在靠近我方星系……
excerpt.en: Several of our tracking stations have picked up peculiar subspace echoes coming from somewhere in intergalactic space. The echoes are faint but getting stronger, and they seem to be approaching our galaxy...

excerpt.zh:
我们在[From.GetName]发现了一些属于某个远古外星文明的文物！从我们目前对其语言的破译来看，这些外星人称他们自己为“伊拉斯协约国”。他们是一个在一百万年前掌控着星系的这片区域的星际政权。

这些外星人似乎是六肢的哺乳动物，有多处文献交叉印证了一种叫“贾沃疹”的流行病席卷了他们的帝国，带来了灾难性的后果甚至直接导致了他们的毁灭。
excerpt.en: We have recovered artifacts from an ancient alien civilization on [From.GetName]! From what we have translated so far of their language, we have learned that these aliens called themselves the "Irassian Concordat." They were an interstellar power that held swa

excerpt.zh:
我们发现了和在[From.GetName]上的外星文明有关的文物！我们的科学家认为他们在六百万年前居住在这片星系，这些外星人自称“尤特”人。他们体型巨大且看起来像扁平的节肢动物。

这一物种成年之后体长接近百米，显然鲜有一艘飞船上能够有两名甚至三名尤特人乘客。
excerpt.en: We have recovered artifacts from an ancient alien civilization on [From.GetName]! Our scientists think they inhabited this region of stars roughly six million years ago, based on the age of the artifacts. The aliens called themselves the "Yuht" and appear to h

excerpt.zh: [extradimensional_system.GetName]星系出现了巨大的空间裂缝！虽然我们还不知道原因，但这似乎是另一个次元的单向传送门。奇怪的飞船从裂缝中蜂拥而出，无论见到什么都大肆攻击。这似乎预告着一场大型进攻宣战的来临。我方截获了这些飞船发往传送门另一边的信号。听起来……像是狩猎的哨音一样。
excerpt.en: A massive tear in the fabric of space itself has appeared in the [extradimensional_system.GetName] system! We aren't certain what caused it, but the tear acts as some kind of one-way portal from another dimension. Fleets of strange vessels are pouring out, att

excerpt.zh:
在经历漫长而残酷的争斗后，[WarInHeavenFEOne.GetName]帝国最终在这场决定星系霸权的战争中昂首胜出。落败的先祖文明已被宿敌完全吞并，现在[WarInHeavenFEOne.GetSpeciesName]睥睨星河，主宰地位无可撼动。

目前星系中维系着脆弱的和平，但这种新的秩序能持续多久呢？
excerpt.en: After a long and fierce conflict, the [WarInHeavenFEOne.GetName] have emerged victorious in the struggle for control over the galaxy. The defeated ancient empire has been fully annexed by their old rival, and the [WarInHeavenFEOne.GetSpeciesName] now stand tri

excerpt.zh: 通过斗争和胜利，这个社会已经实现了每一个年轻文明的抱负：一个有着统一目标的家园，一条通向璀璨繁星的道路。
excerpt.en: Through its strife and triumphs, this society has reached every young civilization's ambition: a homeworld with unified goals, and a path open to the stars.

excerpt.zh: 对于这个文明而言，旅程本身就是目的。他们放弃了永久性定居点，选择在巨大的方舟舰上生活，载着他们的人民、工业和雄心壮志穿越星海。
excerpt.en: For this civilization, the journey is the destination. Abandoning permanent settlement in favor of life aboard vast Arkships, they carry their people, industry, and ambitions across the stars.

excerpt.zh: 这些游牧的唯心主义者遵循其祖先圣典的指引，穿梭于一条神圣化的路线。随着技术的进步以及对星系理解的演变，朝圣之旅是否仍将是他们的使命所在？
excerpt.en: These nomadic spiritualists traverse a deified route dictated by their ancestral scriptures. With technological advancements and an evolving understanding of the galaxy, will the Pilgrimage remain their purpose?

excerpt.zh: 这个部族曾是汗国的顺位继承人，却因背叛而被推翻。被他们视为亲人的人背叛后，他们现在以游牧民的身份游荡在超空间航道上，积蓄力量，以求有朝一日报仇雪恨。
excerpt.en: Once the next in line of the Khanate, this clan was cast down by treachery. Betrayed by those they considered kin, they now stalk the hyperlanes as nomads, gathering their strength to one day return the favor.

excerpt.zh: 这艘永恒巡游舰穿梭于星辰之间，专为追逐奇观与极致体验而生。旅客们只要安坐于恒星观测甲板的日光躺椅上，便能亲眼见证星云在真空中孕育与诞生的全过程。舰上配属的专职船员与服务系统昼夜运转，迎合着每一位乘客一切心血来潮的诉求。
excerpt.en: The Forever Cruise travels the stars in search of wonder and excitement, where the birth of nebulae can be observed from the comfort of a sun lounger. The dedicated crew works tirelessly to cater to any passenger whim.

excerpt.zh:
这个文明正站在命运的十字路口：其恒星系中央的红巨星正在持续升温，炙烤着他们的家园。

在找到原因并解决之前，他们是否能适应这恶劣的环境？或选择拥抱这股炙热之力，将那诡异、甚至可能不自然的变化化为己用？
excerpt.en:
This civilization is at a crossroads: the Red Giant at the heart of its system is warming up their planet, threatening to cook them alive.

Can they adapt until the cause is found and fixed, or will they decide to embrace the heat, capitalizing on these strang

excerpt.zh: 这不是一个崛起的文明，而是一个被释放的文明。当休眠仓开启，他们醒来时，早已物换星移，故土难寻。但他们的过去并未湮灭，而是埋藏在星系尘土与废墟之下，静候再次被发掘。
excerpt.en: This civilization did not rise; it was released. As the stasis pods unlocked, they awakened to a world aged beyond recognition. Yet all is not lost. Scattered beneath dust and ruin across the galaxy, their past endures, waiting to be rediscovered.

excerpt.zh: 虚境实体的引导是有代价的。独立的自动机开始在这个网络社会中自由运行。从机械智能中脱离后，这些单位的需求正在与日俱增。
excerpt.en: The guidance of a Shroud entity comes with a cost. Independent automata have started to operate freely among this networked society. Cut off from the Machine Intelligence, the demands of these units are ever-increasing.

excerpt.zh:
-警告：具有挑战性的起源
警告：禁用['concept_psionic_ascension']。

这个文明的祖先受到入侵心灵的超自然力量的困扰，这促使他们投入巨量人力物力来开发反灵能技术。

他们的古老装置仍然可以使用，但尚未对来自星系更远处的灵能威胁进行测试。
excerpt.en:
WARNING: Blocks access to ['concept_psionic_ascension'].

This civilization's ancestors were plagued by otherworldly forces that invaded the mind, inspiring them to dedicate great effort and resources into developing anti-psionic technology.

Their ancient dev

excerpt.zh:
-警告：具有挑战性的起源
警告：禁用除['concept_psionic_ascension']以外所有飞升路线。

该文明长久以来都一直沉迷于一场将邻近的星球变成荒凉的虚境星球的神秘灾难。如今他们初涉星海，终于得以一探究竟，以及确定是否会有相似的命运降临在自己头上。
excerpt.en:
WARNING: Blocks all Ascension Paths except for ['concept_psionic_ascension'].

This civilization has been long-obsessed with a mysterious calamity which turned a neighboring planet into a desolate and shrouded world. Now, as they take to the stars, they can fi

excerpt.zh: 该物种受自己都无法完全理解的直觉所驱使着，永远都在追猎最独特的生物。他们独有能整合猎物基因的能力，因此演化成了母星上最顶级的猎手，应有尽有地吸收了所有的优势基因。如今，这种渴望又将他们带向了群星。
excerpt.en: This species has always hunted the most unique creatures, driven by an instinct they didn't fully understand. Possessing a rare ability to integrate the genetics of their prey, it evolved into the apex predator of its world, absorbing every genetic advantage a

excerpt.zh: 该文明的母星系边缘，一个神秘的传送门赫然耸立，危险的实体从中汨汨涌出。这些入侵者不请自来，让人无处可避，迫使人们只能仰依赖他们最杰出的科技杰作——深空擎天堡。
excerpt.en: A mysterious portal looms at the edge of this civilization's home system, a gateway from which hostile entities emerge in relentless waves. These invasions are as unpredictable as they are inevitable, forcing the people to rely on their greatest technological

excerpt.zh: 这个实体无异于一个拥有智慧的生态圈：众多不同的生命形式早已融合成一个行星尺度的格式塔意识。
excerpt.en: This entity is nothing less than a sapient ecosphere: a multitude of diverse lifeforms which long since coalesced to form a gestalt consciousness on a planetary scale.

excerpt.zh: 怀揣着对冒险的渴望，这个文明已经准备好踏上他们最伟大、最具挑战性的探险之旅。他们只手持一张神秘的地图，现在正跨越星辰，去争夺传说中的海盗宝藏。
excerpt.en: Instilled with a thirst for adventure, this civilization is ready to set forth on their greatest and most challenging expedition. Armed only with a mysterious map, they now race across the stars to secure a legendary pirate treasure.

excerpt.zh:
草叶婆娑，夜静如尖啸。猎户之志，冷锐如星光。

这个文明与荒野有着原始的联系。他们把自己看作是当地各种致命野生动物的管家，现在又把目光投向了苍穹。他们善于管理和牧养动物，这种与动物群的联系是根据他们的思潮发展起来的。而这种联系将如何在星系尺度上演变还有待观察。
excerpt.en:
The rustle of bladed grass. The roaring silence of the night. The will of the hunter, sharp and cold as starlight...

This civilization has a primal connection to the wild. Viewing themselves as stewards to the diverse (and often deadly) wildlife native to the

excerpt.zh:
没有他们不敢面对的挑战，没有他们不愿追逐的线索，也没有他们会视若罔闻的风暴。

从本质上来说，这是一个追求刺激的文明。即有好处也有坏处。
excerpt.en:
There is no challenge they will not face, no lead they'll fail to chase - and no storm they will ignore.

At its core, this is a civilization seeking thrills. To its benefit, and to its detriment.

excerpt.zh: 这个帝国追求一种神圣的使命，即高尚身体与神圣的义体技术的融合。强化改造便是一种崇拜。
excerpt.en: This empire pursues a divine calling, the fusion of exalted body and holy cybernetics. Augmentation is worship.

excerpt.zh: 这个物种曾有一个繁荣的社会，但是由于一种新型遗传病让其无法再生育。在灭族的命运面前，人们没有其他的选择，只能寄希望于数字化的救赎。
excerpt.en: Once a thriving society, a novel genetic disease has left this species unable to reproduce. Running out of options and facing extinction, they place their hope in digital salvation.

excerpt.zh:
他们的行星一片荒芜，但母星系却堆金积玉。为了对其进行开发，这些机械建造的工程越来越大。如今，一座强大的电弧熔炉已经遮天蔽日，但这些工程大师们还远不满足。

星系在等待着，可能性无穷无尽。唯有聪慧可摘星辰。
excerpt.en:
Their planet is barren, but their home system is a bounty of riches. To exploit it, these machines built bigger than ever before. A mighty Arc Furnace now dominates their sky, but these master engineers are far from satisfied.

The galaxy awaits, and the possi

excerpt.zh: 一道巨大的时空裂隙高悬于该文明母星的穹顶。在研究这一现象近千年后，最近的星舰科技进展使其终于可以靠近他，并且发掘潜藏其中的秘密。
excerpt.en: A massive rift in space and time looms near this civilization's homeworld. After studying the phenomenon for millennia, recent advances in starship technology will allow them to finally reach out and discover what secrets it might hold.

excerpt.zh: 在暴力和苦难中，这个文明在一位领袖的领导下走向了统一。通过压制较弱的派系来巩固权力，他们现在成为了科学和技术进步的坚定倡导者。在这之后，是一段不稳定的和平的时期。但和平终究是一种短暂的状态。
excerpt.en: Amidst violence and hardship, this civilization was unified by a single leader. Consolidating power through the repression of weaker factions, they have now become a fierce advocate for science and technological advancement. In the aftermath, an uneasy peace h

excerpt.zh:
-警告：具有挑战性的起源
这个文明曾被一个异星帝国造访过，这个帝国强行启蒙了他们，之后奴役了他们。如今他们击退了入侵者，但那些入侵者有朝一日还会回来吗？
excerpt.en: This civilization has been visited by an alien empire who forcibly enlightened and enslaved them. They have repelled their invaders, but will they return?

excerpt.zh:
-警告：具有挑战性的起源

这个文明始于一艘奴隶船上的发起的兵变，现在由多种多样的前超光速物种组成。
excerpt.en: This civilization began as a mutiny aboard a slaver vessel, and is made up of a diverse group of pre-FTL species.

excerpt.zh: 一个世纪以前，在帝国的母星系，其中的一颗行星被一颗古怪的小行星摧毁了。一些人认为这是某个外星物种的恶意攻击。其他人则把这些担忧当作纯粹的妄想症。两类人之间的关系变得愈发紧张，最后无可奈何之下，帝国将一个新近完成地形改造的星球给予这些恐宇派。
excerpt.en: A century ago, one of the planets in this empire's home system was destroyed by a freak asteroid. Some believed this was a malicious attack by an alien species. Others brushed off these concerns as mere paranoia. The tension between the two groups grew so grea

excerpt.zh: 这个文明不择手段地增强自己的有机体，无论风险，无论成本。毕竟，与其在沉默中消亡，不如光鲜亮丽地燃烧殆尽。
excerpt.en: This civilization uses any and all means of organic enhancement, no matter the risk, no matter the cost. After all, it is better to burn out brightly than fade away into obscurity.

excerpt.zh: 几个世纪前，这个物种的母星被一位毒性神祗造访。接踵而至的生态灾难几乎摧毁了这个星球，但是幸存者们怀着对毒圣的崇敬之情，草草地统一了起来。他们创立了一个骑士教团来搜寻毒圣，尽管后来很多事情变了，但是这份试炼依旧保留了下来。
excerpt.en: Centuries ago, this species' homeworld was visited by a Toxic Entity. The ecological catastrophe that followed ruined half the world, but allowed an early unification of the survivors in their reverence for the Toxic God. An Order of Knights has been created t

excerpt.zh: 该蜂巢通过专职化的半独立领袖获得了进化优势。尽管这些“子嗣”需要持续受到监管，但它们还是大大提高了整体的效率。
excerpt.en: This hive has gained evolutionary advantage through semi-independent leaders. These "Offspring" greatly improve overall proficiency, though they require constant oversight.

excerpt.zh: 这个物种也许永远也不会知道自己的祖先为什么会迁移到地表以下。这究竟是出于一种自我保存的必要，或是为了追寻资源的富足？不管其目的为何，他们都成功地适应了环境，造就了一个对环境要求更加灵活的社会。
excerpt.en: This civilization may never know why their ancestors migrated below the surface. Was it necessary to ensure self-preservation, or did the promise of bountiful resources allure them? Whatever the case, they successfully adapted, leading to a more environmentall

excerpt.zh: 该这明已经完美地融入了地下的存在，其最初的驱动力或是是某种经过深思熟虑的自我保护，或是某种在深处寻找隐藏的丰富资源的指令。由此产生的机械适应性早已挖掘出了一个多功能且坚定不移的机器社群。
excerpt.en: This civilization has flawlessly integrated into subterranean existence, initially driven by either calculated self-preservation or a directive to locate of hidden, abundant resources in the depths. The resulting mechanical adaptations have unearthed a versati

excerpt.zh: 曾几何时，该文明的天空短暂地被流星所照亮，紧接着就陷入了长久的黑暗。此后他们试图冲出天际以寻求答案，并在第一次太空征程中发现了一座休眠中（并且早已被遗弃）的量子弹弓单阵列。
excerpt.en: Once, the skies above this civilization were illuminated by shooting stars; then came a long season of darkness. Taking to the heavens in search of answers, the first offworld explorers discovered a dormant (and long abandoned) Quantum Catapult Single Array.

excerpt.zh: 早在他们踏入星系舞台之前，他们的文明就受到了虚境行者集会的支持和塑造成型。
excerpt.en: Long before their first steps onto the galactic stage, this civilization has been supported and shaped by a Shroudwalker coven.

excerpt.zh: 第一次飞出母星的经历是一段痛苦的回忆，一眨眼的功夫，我们就惨遭征服并跪倒在其脚下。不过现在我们终于得以展望未来，一个不必处在他国阴影之下的未来。
excerpt.en: Our first endeavor beyond our home planet was a painful one, suddenly and brutally subjected to the whims of a foreign galactic power. Now we look towards a future in which we no longer live in the shadow of another empire.

excerpt.zh: 自远古以来，这个文明就与一条强大的龙共享同一恒星系。这个神秘生物的行为在冷淡的仁慈和傲慢的漠视之间摇摆不定。随着行星居民迈入星辰大海，这种关系将如何演变还有待观察。
excerpt.en: Since time immemorial, this civilization has shared its star system with a formidable dragon. The mysterious creature's behavior sways between distant benevolence and haughty indifference. How this relationship will evolve as the planet dwellers take to the st

excerpt.zh: 自这个文明诞生伊始他们就享受着物产丰富、无忧无虑的环境，使其能够不受阻碍地发展繁荣。
excerpt.en: Since its birth, this civilization has enjoyed peace in a generous environment with no natural enemies, enabling unhindered growth and opulence.

excerpt.zh: 自这个机械文明诞生伊始他们就深潜于水下王国，享受着物产丰富的环境，不受任何自然的挑战。
excerpt.en: Since its creation, this machine civilization has delved deep into the underwater realms of an abundant ocean untouched by natural adversaries.

excerpt.zh: 这一文明演化出了一种异养于其他智慧生命形态的寄生体。当它踏入星系舞台时，其他的物种或是被视作侍徒而带入他们的行列，要么就成为他们的食物。在食尸者面前，没有第三种选择。
excerpt.en: This civilization evolved as a parasite, forced to feed off other sapient life forms to sustain itself. As it arrives on the galactic stage, other species will either be brought into the fold, or become its food. For the necrophage, there can be no other way.

excerpt.zh: 这一文明曾经叱咤虚空，掌控大片星海。他们最终败落并几乎被摧毁殆尽，但在漫长的穷困潦倒后他们正要于群星间东山再起。
excerpt.en: This civilization once spanned the void, controlling much of the galaxy. They were eventually defeated and almost destroyed, but after a long period of destitution they are returning to the stars.

excerpt.zh: 这一文明生活在未知先驱们建造的环形世界之中。一经理解及修复完好，他们将获得巨大的力量。
excerpt.en: This civilization inhabits a Ring World built by unknown forerunners. If it can be understood and fully repaired it will grant them great power.

excerpt.zh: 这一文明自有记录以来便以太空为家——其对典型行星环境下的生活深恶痛绝。他们生活在几个轨道居住站上，直至近期才联合一统。
excerpt.en: This civilization has made its home in space for as long as it has maintained records - life in a typical planetary environment is anathema to them. They live in several orbital habitats that were only recently united.

excerpt.zh: 起初，这个机器文明的创造者是将它们设计用于外太空旅行的、完全按照在零重力环境下流畅工作进行的优化。在经历数个纪元的孤立之后，这些机器最近重新在散布于它们母星系的数个轨道居住站之间团结了起来。
excerpt.en: At first, the creators of this machine civilization designed them for eternal space travel, fully optimizing them to function seamlessly in zero gravity environments. After enduring eons of isolation, these machines have recently restored unity among the orbit

excerpt.zh: 一个失落帝国在数千年间干预了这一文明的发展进程，引领他们走上了失落帝国所选择的道路。
excerpt.en: A Fallen Empire has meddled in the development of this civilization for thousands of years, guiding them onto a path of their choosing.

excerpt.zh: 在不知名的过去，有一位神秘的施恩者为这个文明在他们的恒星系藏了一点惊喜。
excerpt.en: This civilization has hidden boons in their solar system, placed there in a distant past by a mysterious benefactor.

excerpt.zh: 这一文明在早期便与其外星近邻们建立了联系。他们从彼此的差异中汲取力量，不久后便决定要共同面对未来可能发生的一切。
excerpt.en: This civilization established early contact with their immediate alien neighbors. Finding strength in their differences, they soon decided to face the future, and whatever it might bring, together.

excerpt.zh: 这一文明在早期便与其外星近邻们建立了联系。经过他们在长达一个世纪的时间里的逐步策划，一个他们于其中具有支配地位的星际联盟就此诞生。
excerpt.en: This civilization established early contact with their immediate alien neighbors. Gradually, over the span of a century, they masterminded the birth of an interstellar union in which they would have a dominant role.

excerpt.zh:
-警告：具有挑战性的起源
这一文明的母星高度不稳定，走向爆炸只是时间问题。他们唯一的希望是在为时太晚前在其他地方寻觅到避难之处。
excerpt.en: This civilization's homeworld is highly unstable, and it is only a matter of time before it explodes. Their only hope is to seek refuge elsewhere before it is too late.

excerpt.zh: 并非其“母星”的原住民，这些石质生物随一颗坠入该行星的陨石到来，同时杀死了大多数土著生命。
excerpt.en: Not native to their 'homeworld', these Lithoids arrived when a meteorite slammed into the planet and killed off most of the native life.

excerpt.zh: 这一文明的家园如同天堂，也许是专为他们打造的。
excerpt.en: This civilization's home is a paradise, possibly designed just for them.

excerpt.zh: 历经核子烈焰的考验，这一文明曾面临全面灭绝的威胁——又最终死里逃生。虽经毁灭却仍为一体，他们在旧世界的灰烬之上重建了文明。
excerpt.en: Baptized by nuclear fire, this civilization has faced total annihilation - and survived. Devastated yet unbroken, they have rebuilt civilization from the ashes of their old world.

excerpt.zh: 在一场毁灭性的核灾难之后，这些机器就成为这个一度繁荣的文明的唯一幸存者。通过继续履行其原定的目标，它们从旧世界的不适宜居住的灰烬中逐渐重建起一个新的社会。
excerpt.en: In the aftermath of a devastating nuclear disaster, these machines emerged as the sole survivors of a once-flourishing civilization. By continuing to fulfill their designated purpose, they gradually rebuilt society from the uninhabitable ashes of their old wor

excerpt.zh: 一种寿命短且不能生育的克隆人士兵，在战争方面异常精通，现在他们没有主人，亦不了解自己被设计出来的目的，以及他们那不确定的命运。
excerpt.en: A species of short-lived and infertile soldier clones exceptionally proficient in matters of war, left masterless and alone to question their engineered purpose and uncertain fate.

excerpt.zh: 这一机械智能早已将母星系中的所有资源统合到了他们的首都星球，将其完全以机械覆盖。
excerpt.en: This Machine Intelligence has long-since consolidated all resources in their home system into their capital world, covering it entirely with machinery.

excerpt.zh:
-警告：具有挑战性的起源

与同化他们的机器被切断联系之后，这个新生的文明为了在星系中确立自身地位而进行了顽强的斗争。
excerpt.en: Abruptly severed from the Machine that assimilated them, this nascent civilization has fought fiercely to establish its own presence in the galaxy.

excerpt.zh: 这一文明自蒸汽时代早期便醉心于金属制自动机器人的理念。尽管许多人认为不可能做到，早在初步的太空航行前第一台真正的机器人就已从装配线下线。
excerpt.en: This civilization has been preoccupied with the idea of metallic automatons since the early Steam Age. Although many said it could not be done, the first true robots left the assembly lines long before even rudimentary space flight was achieved.

excerpt.zh: 一种第二物种形成了这个文明密不可分的一部分。它们高大健壮，又大都只有相当于格外愚钝的孩童的智力。古老的战争剔除了它们物种具有的最富攻击性的倾向，使其如今相当顺从。
excerpt.en: A second species forms an integral part of this civilization. They are big, strong, and most of them have the intelligence of a particularly dim-witted child. Ancient wars have culled their species of their most aggressive tendencies, leaving them quite servil

excerpt.zh: 这一蜂巢思维与一棵巨型树木间进化出了共生关系。这棵巨树赋予了他们许多益处，但失去这棵树将会把他们摧垮。
excerpt.en: This Hive evolved in a symbiotic relationship with a vast Tree. The Tree grants them many benefits, but its loss would cripple them.

excerpt.zh: 这个郁郁葱葱的文明与太空生物群形成了独特的协同作用。通过向这些生物提供果实，他们吸引种子传播者来帮助它们进行殖民。
excerpt.en: This verdant civilization has developed a unique synergy with spaceborne fauna. By offering their fruits to these creatures, they entice the seed dispersers to aid their colonization efforts.

excerpt.zh: 这一文明在它们的家园星系有一座休眠状态的星门——是潜在的科技优势，抑或是高悬头顶的达摩克里利斯之剑？
excerpt.en: This civilization has a dormant Gateway in their home system - potential technological benefit, or a looming menace?

excerpt.zh: 这一文明起源于一处遭人遗忘的失落的殖民星，许久前便同其母星分隔。殖民者们挣扎求生，挨过了千辛万苦，终于建立了必需的技术及工业基础，足以供他们重返太空。
excerpt.en: This civilization originated as a lost and forgotten colony, separated from its homeworld long ago. The struggling colonists endured many hardships before they could build up the necessary technological and industrial base that would allow for a return to spac

excerpt.zh:
当我们抵达虚境时、我们通灵者的内心响起了一阵齐声。最开始只是轻柔的低语，随后变为强烈的刺耳声，一千道声音开始齐声讲述。

这些声音自称虚空之低语。合唱中的每个个体都感应到：秘密的低语、空置之御座、人偶的大师，有许多许多的存在都加入了低语的合唱。祂——祂们——宣称通晓所有凡人向另一个凡人低语的秘密知识，并且愿意和我们分享这些知识……

只要我们同意让祂们进入我们的意识。

一个微不足道的代价，就像祂们宣称的那样。我们甚至难以察觉祂们的存在。

祂们的语气中透露着急切。
excerpt.en:
As we reach into the Shroud, the minds of our telepaths are filled with a chorus of voices. No more than soft whispers at first, the cacophony grows in intensity, a thousand voices speaking in unison.

The voices introduce themselves as the Whisperers in the V

excerpt.zh: 这个文明正逐步迈进全新的科技纪元。
excerpt.en: This civilization is progressing to a new technological age.

excerpt.zh:
那些星球是被移动了！

我们在[from.solar_system.GetName]星系探测到的异常超空间航道都连接着我们认为应该存在星球的位置。在研究了这些怪异的航道后，我们发现它们都通向同一个地方。一个叫做达恰的恒星系，本以为是无法到达的，但如果把这些狭窄的超空间航道合并起来，我们就能送一艘科研船过去。
excerpt.en:
The planets were moved!

The abnormal hyperlanes we detected in the [from.solar_system.GetName] system were each tethered to where we previously had expected to discover worlds. After studying these strange lanes, we realize they all lead to the same place. A

excerpt.zh:
当[Root.GetName]接近[Root.GetStarName]黑洞时，他们发现自己并非孤身一人。一个巨大的完美球体结构屹立在黑洞事件视界的边缘，反射着被吸入黑暗裂隙的、群星所散发的光芒。

我们没有收到任何来自它的信号，我们发出的信号也没有得到任何回应。它就静静地呆在深渊的边缘。等待着。
excerpt.en: As the [Root.GetName] approaches the [Root.GetStarName] black hole they find that they are not alone. At the edge of the event horizon it soars, reflecting light from the stars being drawn into the dark, gaping hole. A gigantic construction in the shape of a p

excerpt.zh:
我们成功地恢复了[gateway_system.GetName]星系中远古星门的供能！尽管年代久远，这座装置还是形成了一条完全可以供通行的稳定亚空间通路。

我们还检测到了异常的、类似于进出星门时的能量读数，但没有任何船只过境的迹象。
excerpt.en:
We have successfully restored power to the ancient Gateway in the [gateway_system.GetName] system! Despite its age, the device has formed a stable subspace conduit that is fully traversable.

We're also detecting unusual energy readings, similar to those that

title.en: By the People, For the People

excerpt.zh:
由于我们计划的许多义体设计对普通人来说都将会遥不可及，一些自改造者们感到非常愤怒。

他们认为如果公开原理图并放松有关的环境法规，几乎每个人都能制造和修理自己的强化体。
excerpt.en:
Self-modders are furious that many of our planned cybernetic designs will be inaccessible to the average person.

They argue that if the schematics were made public and environmental regulations relaxed, almost everyone will be able to manufacture and repair t

excerpt.zh:
即使在会面之后，[non_believers_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]依然拒绝接受外星人存在的事实。他们宣称我们并非星际访客，而是穴居人，想要从地上的某个洞穴里面钻出来占领行星的地面。他们的行星，[non_believers_planet.GetName]，被认为是中空的，并且他们坚信我们使用自己的宇宙飞船在中央的空穴中飞来飞去。

这些令人困惑的信仰阻碍了我们的外交工作。任何我们说的或者做的都遭到了彻底的怀疑。
excerpt.en: Even after meeting us, the [non_believers_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural] refuse to accept the existence of extraterrestrial life. They claim we're not interstellar visitors, but subterranean dwellers who climbed to the planet's surface through a hole in the gro

excerpt.zh: 我们在[Root.GetStarName]星系看到了挂着[radical_cult.GetName]旗帜的飞船。他们已经装填好武器准备来拦截我们了！
excerpt.en: We have sighted ships flying the flag of the [radical_cult.GetName] in the [Root.GetStarName] system. They have charged their weapons and are moving to intercept us!

excerpt.zh: 有时进化需要被往正确的方向上推一把。我们现在有足够先进的技术，能够对我们的身体和思维进行基因层面的改造，以应对不断变化的环境带来的前所未有的挑战。
excerpt.en: Sometimes evolution needs a nudge in the right direction. We now have the technology to genetically modify our bodies and minds to endure the trials of an ever-changing environment at an unprecedented rate.

excerpt.zh:
[Root.GetName]从[From.GetName]检测到了一些有趣的读数。那颗气态巨行星的大气层中有高剂量的辐射，似乎是由密集的轨道轰炸引起的。至于为什么有人要这么做则是个谜。

就在[Root.GetName]准备离开轨道时，科学家[Root.GetLeaderName]从行星内部检测到了一个微弱的信号。或许是某种通讯信号，但行星的背景辐射太强，很难将信号从背景噪声中分离出来。
excerpt.en: The [Root.GetName] has picked up some curious readings from [From.GetName]. There are significant pockets of radiation in the gas giant's atmosphere that appear to be the result of intense orbital bombardment. What someone could hope to gain by bombing a gas g

excerpt.zh:
这些遗迹被认为是古代行政建筑群，它们属于一个自称为古茹努尔的太空物种，该物种是在[From.Planet.GetName]上被发现的。

令人震惊的是，这个失落的文明似乎在七百万年前就居住在这颗星球上了，我们的考古学家渴望揭开他们的秘密。
excerpt.en:
The remains of what is believed to be an ancient administrative complex, belonging to a space-faring species who called themselves the Grunur has been found on [From.Planet.GetName].

This fallen civilization appears to have inhabited the planet a staggering s

excerpt.zh: 我们在[Root.GetName]上的偏远地区发现了一个只能被认是位面传送门的东西。天气预报算法发现了奇怪的气流，最终被认为是大气从传送门轻微泄漏造成的。大气流失的速度十分缓慢，对[Root.GetName]上的生活不会造成什么影响。但这个传送门的存在引起了一些令人担忧的问题，比如它通向哪里，以及会不会有什么东西从传送门另一侧穿过来？
excerpt.en: What can only be described as a dimensional portal has been discovered in a remote location on [Root.GetName]. Weather prediction algorithms noticed a strange air current, which was eventually determined to be caused by the slight leakage of atmosphere into th

excerpt.zh:
我们在[Root.GetName]的边远农业站上发回了报告。许多[Owner.GetFarmerPlural]无缘无故失踪了，除了周围的土壤上留下了巨大的脚印外，他们的家园没有受到任何影响。

这些痕迹不符合任何在此前行星调查中发现的东西：四足、宽趾、有爪的脚印，其深度足以说明来自一种相当大的生物。殖民者担心我们可能遇到了未知的捕食者。
excerpt.en:
Reports have come in from our outlying agricultural stations on [Root.GetName]. Several [Owner.GetFarmerPlural] have vanished without a trace, their homesteads eerily undisturbed, save for the appearance of immense footprints in the surrounding soil.

The trac

excerpt.zh: 我们的舰队摧毁了[From.GetName]的总部。从他们的太空基地的残骸中尽可能回收有价值物资的行动也已如火如荼地展开。我们已经获得了大量资源。
excerpt.en: Our fleet assets have destroyed the [From.GetName] headquarters. Efforts are well under way to recover as many valuables as possible from the shattered remnants of their starbase. We have gained a large amount of resources.

excerpt.zh:
各位来客，我们在此向你问好。

我们早已知晓你们的存在，但由于担心自己会给你们的未来带来不恰当的影响，我们一直躲在幕后。不过，我们现在是时候从垂帘后走出来了，对于外行人而言，虚境的运作机制可能显得古怪且令人不安。正是处于这个原因，我们决定为你们提供指导。如果你们同意的话，我们愿意成为你们的引路人。

去探索吧，不过在我们下次重逢之前，记得注意安全。
excerpt.en:
Fellow travelers, we greet you.

Your presence on the galactic stage has long been known to us, but until now, afraid we might unduly influence your destiny, we have held back. However, the time has come to lift the veil; the ways of the Shroud may seem strang

excerpt.zh:
最近收集到的证据表明，[Root.GetName]政府的一大部分成员都有接收贿赂。当地的犯罪组织通过贿赂他们来保证对其犯罪活动视而不见。某些官员甚至被披露隶属于他们本该与之进行抗争的犯罪组织！

虽然我们逮捕了一部分官员，但也有不少人发现情势不对，就直接收拾细软逃走了。看来想要解决[Root.GetName]的受贿问题仍然困难重重。
excerpt.en: Recently obtained evidence has revealed that a large number of government officials on [Root.GetName] were on the take. Local crime organizations bribed them to look the other way while they engaged in their nefarious activities. In some cases, the officials w

excerpt.zh:
在一次对[Root.GetName]的例行探索中，行星探索单位发现了一座巨大的大门，其后很可能具有整座大山规模的内部空间。看来是其中隐形装置发出的某种强磁场导致飞船的探测器没有发现这里，而伪装过的大门也让使其对地表测绘探测器隐形了。

另一方面，更专门的测试显示，向其输入稳定的能量流应该可以让大门重新激活，最终也让我们得以一窥其后的秘密。
excerpt.en: During a standard reconnaissance of [Root.GetName], the planetary exploration unit came across a massive door that apparently leads directly into the interior of a mountain range. It appears that the strong magnetic field produced by some sort of cloaking devi

excerpt.zh:
随着我们击败了其周边的防御设施，我们得以进入这座古代建筑，一窥其奥秘。进入和穿越这座建筑可能会很困难，但无论是谁建造了它，必定是采用了我们难以想象的技术。情况变得更糟糕的是，这座堡垒似乎正在恢复。

部分协助解除堡垒武装的人员自愿尝试进入堡垒，同来自[Root.Capital.GetName]的后备人员一起一探究竟。目前看来，接下来通向目标的道路无疑充满挑战。
excerpt.en: With the defeat of the defenses surrounding the ancient structure, we may find a way to explore its mysteries. Entering and traversing it may be difficult, but whoever built it must have possessed technology we can hardly dream of. Making matters more arduous,

excerpt.zh:
将意志投射在虚境中，我们在一定程度上驾驭了灵能力量。我们可以在从各个灵域的无数实体身上汲取能量，却又不受它们的影响；不仅如此，我们的[GetTelepathPlural]还能完美地控制灵能出神了。

其他人让自己的命运任由虚境摆布时，我们已经得到了真正的意志自由。

[this.GetName]已经解放了全部的灵能潜力。
excerpt.en: By projecting our will into the Shroud, we have attained a degree of mastery over our psionic abilities. We have gathered power from the domains of numerous entities, while remaining unbound by their influence; furthermore, our [GetTelepathPlural] now possess

excerpt.zh:
这些巨型雕像矗立在[From.Planet.GetName]上，静静注视着什么。九个堪称不朽的雕像沿着漫长的边沿一一排开，位于这片区域的重要战略点，似乎在守护着它们中心的某种物品。

他们涂有精致的表面镀层，警觉的姿势好像时刻准备着战斗，不会移动的眼球也似乎紧随着你的每个动作，然而这里显然已经没有什么东西需要保护了。也许他们要保护的东西没能挨过岁月的流逝，又或是他们的任务早已失败。其上的累累伤痕表明，这些哨兵中的许多已经快要被物理损害彻底侵蚀了。
excerpt.en:
Silent giants stand watch on [From.Planet.GetName]. Nine monumental statues placed along a wide perimeter at strategical points in the landscape appear to be guarding something at its center.

Their skin is covered in fine scale plating, their postures vigilan

excerpt.zh:
虽然与噬天巨兽进行精神链接的理论已经起草，但其逻辑含义令人望而生畏。我们计划在首都安置主要的连接中心，这样就可以在与巨兽融合时处理人口。

此外，最新的科学进展也许很快就能使我们能通过一个单一的实验性突变项目来进一步强化我们的杰作。
excerpt.en:
While the theory of a mental link to the Behemoth has been drafted, the logistical implications are daunting. We plan for our capital to house the main connection Hub, allowing us to process the population as we merge with the beast.

Additionally, recent scie

excerpt.zh:
[Root.GetName]船成功地从[From.GetStarName]星系里的奇特干扰中分离出了一个信号。信号的内容是一首歌。确切来说，是一首由复杂数学方程式构成的歌，而且[Owner.GetScientistCapital][Root.GetLeaderName]似乎无法不去想它。

是谁或者是什么东西写了这首歌仍不得而知，不过其复杂程度暗示着对子空间和声学的高度精通。信号的测地线表明其来源位于我们的星系之外。
excerpt.en: The [Root.GetName] has succeeded in isolating a signal embedded within the unusual pattern of interference in the [From.GetStarName] system. The signal is a song. A complex sonification of an advanced mathematical equation to be precise, and one that [Owner.Ge

excerpt.zh: 很显然[Root.GetName]曾经遭遇了一场灾难并留下了超量的辐射。但是原因尚不明确。随着在[Root.GetName]定居的殖民者不断增加，这个谜团开始越发让人烦恼。毕竟，如果连原因都不知道，我们又该怎么防止悲剧再次重演？
excerpt.en: While it's obvious that some past calamity released a vast amount of radiation on [Root.GetName], it's not obvious what caused it. This mystery is now bothering more and more of the colonists who have made [Root.GetName] their home. After all, if we don't know

title.zh: 冠军之铸现场秀！比武会

excerpt.zh: 几十年过去了，一场新的锦标赛即将拉开帷幕。派你的舰队进入聚光灯下，向星系证明你的智慧、力量和决心。
excerpt.en: Decades have passed, and a new tournament is about to begin. Send your fleets into the spotlight and prove to the galaxy your wit, might, and determination.

excerpt.zh:
许多我们安置在[shattered_frontier_planet.GetName]轨道上的人造卫星最近被大幅度地调整了。依据他们的传感器日志，一个稳定而定语的重力井在我们行星轨道之上形成了。

地表的观测数据证实这个异常现象是突然出现的，而我们对其成因一无所知。重力井暂时对我们的殖民地似乎没有威胁，但卫星用来维持轨道所需要消耗的燃料过多，很快将难以为继。
excerpt.en:
Many of the satellites we placed in orbit of [shattered_frontier_planet.GetName] have had to make significant adjustments in recent days. According to their sensor logs, a stable and localized gravity well has formed in orbit above the planet.

Data from the s

excerpt.zh: 一个未知文明所建立的古老殖民地。尽管没有任何灾难迹象，但很显然这些定居者们突然之间就放弃了这个居住地。这儿到底发生了什么呢？
excerpt.en: An ancient colony from an unknown civilization. Despite no obvious sings of calamity, the settlement was clearly abruptly abandoned by its denizens. What happened here?

excerpt.zh: [event_envoy.GetName]，我们在星海共同体中代表我国利益的使者严重失态，把[council_country.GetAdj]代表错当成了[pathetic_country.GetSpeciesName]。不幸的是，许多旁观者听到了这条牵连甚广的评论，[event_envoy.GetName]如今自然饱受奚落。许多人开始中伤我国外交使团的实力，不过我们对星海最新段子的贡献是确凿无疑的。
excerpt.en: [event_envoy.GetName], our emissary representing our interests in the Galactic Community, has committed a major faux pas, mistaking the [council_country.GetAdj] delegate for a [pathetic_country.GetSpeciesName]. Unfortunately, the incriminating remarks were wit

excerpt.zh: 在摧毁艺术家联盟的空间站后，我们发现残骸中有大量可供回收的资源。舱室中储存的捐赠物、礼品与作品现在漂浮在太空之中，可供我们随意回收取用。
excerpt.en: After having destroyed the Artisan Troupe's station we found many resources to salvage from the wreckage. Donations, gifts and creations stacked in its halls now drift in space, ready for the taking.

excerpt.zh:
一套早已过期的秘密代码刚刚被重新传送到了我方，这涉及到我们在[disavowed_agent_country.GetName]已经开展的行动。

某个我们曾经除名的情报人员正试图汇报，此人宣称携带了关于一个位于[disavowed_agent_country.GetName]的关键政治人物情报的标记——但是，这些早已作废的代码能够信任吗？
excerpt.en:
A long-expired set of covert codes has been re-transmitted to us, linked to Operations we previously carried out in the [disavowed_agent_country.GetName].

A once-disavowed operative is apparently trying to report back in, claiming to possess intelligence on k

excerpt.zh: [Root.GetName]驶入[From.GetName]恒星系时，发现这里似乎有些不合常理。这里的恒星，曾经被标记为一颗普通的矮星，现在似乎发生了萎缩，其质量正在以惊人的速度减少，恒星系内的行星随之进入了冰河时代。
excerpt.en: As the [Root.GetName] enters the [From.GetName] system something seems awry. The sun, previously registered as an ordinary dwarf star, appears to have shrunk, having lost mass at an alarming rate. The planets in the system have as a result recently entered ice

excerpt.zh:
一场不和谐的毁灭之乐将我们拖向虚境的深处。每一次反响都带着无情的毁灭节奏冲击着我们的心灵。

噪音具象化了。

我们正处在灵能冲突的边缘。参战实体的动机尚不清楚，但展现出了极其强大的力量。

灵能轰炸在我们的感知中进进出出，扭曲着我们面前破碎的现实。这里没有掩护，只有逼近的风暴。
excerpt.en:
A discordant orchestra of devastation draws us deeper within the Shroud. Each reverberation pounds against our psyche in an unrelenting rhythm of ruin.

The noise takes its form.

We are on the periphery of a psionic conflict. The motivation of the entities in

excerpt.zh: 一台锈迹斑斑，覆膜一样的机器覆盖着[From.Planet.GetName]表面并深入到行星的内核。为了搞清这台机器的奥秘，我们的考古学家们需要建立一座巨大的发掘站点。
excerpt.en: The rusting, film-covered machinery covering [From.Planet.GetName] runs deep into the planet's core. In order to unravel more of this mechanical mystery, our archaeologists will need to establish an extensive dig site.

excerpt.zh: 我们曾经以为，这不过是位于[From.Planet.GetName]上的鸡肋矿物层。但现在，这片矿物层却开始发出震耳欲聋的奇怪嗡嗡声。这还不是个例，联邦境内的诸星球上均可以听到类似的声音。这一异常现象背后究竟隐藏着什么？
excerpt.en: What was once thought to be merely a seam of half-interesting minerals on [From.Planet.GetName] has begun emitting a bizarre and deafening hum - and it's not alone. Worlds across federation space are being buffeted by a similar noise. Whatever could be behind

excerpt.zh:
我们在[rogue_agent_planet.GetName]上一位名叫[rogue_agent_spymaster.GetName]的间谍首脑叛变了！这个笨蛋似乎是被一个[rogue_agent_country.GetSpeciesName]迷住了，他们两个私奔到了[rogue_agent_planet.GetPlanetMoon]的某个地方。

现在我们还不知道这位间谍首脑是已经向[rogue_agent_spymaster.GetHimHer]爱人坦白了[rogue_agent_spymaster.GetHe
excerpt.en: Our Spymaster on [rogue_agent_planet.GetName], [rogue_agent_spymaster.GetName], has gone rogue! The poor, misguided fool has apparently been smitten by a [rogue_agent_country.GetSpeciesName], and the two of them have eloped to parts unknown on the [rogue_agent

excerpt.zh:
愿凉爽的白天和温暖的夜晚一直伴你左右，[Root.GetAdj][Root.GetRulerTitle]。我们是[contact_speaker_leader.GetName]。我们代表游牧舰队，逐浪者舰队上所有的纳马里安之魂发声。

你不必对我们心存恐惧，我们的舰队无意对天体进行争夺。我们只要求受到尊重，旅程不受到妨碍。
excerpt.en:
Cold days and warm nights upon you, [Root.GetAdj] [Root.GetRulerTitle]. We are [contact_speaker_leader.GetName]. We speak on behalf of all the Namarian souls aboard the collected ships of the Pursuing Waters, our nomadic fleet.

You have nothing to fear from u

excerpt.zh:
[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上的居民因我们所共享的科技而感到喜悦。他们纷纷来到我们位于他们星球上建立的飞地，狂轰滥炸般地询问有关我们文化和历史的问题。

[pre_ftl_planet.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]对向我们学习的渴求增进了我们提升该文明科技进展的任务进度，因此我们修改了最初关于任务所需时间的估计。
excerpt.en:
The people of [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] are delighted with the technology we have been sharing with them. They have flocked to the enclaves we established on the surface of their world, bombarding our scientists with questions about our culture and history.

Th

excerpt.zh:
在搜索我们控制的星系时，我们的一架无人机从[prospectorium_discovery_target.System.GetName]获取了一些零散的读数。这个星系可能藏着什么我们意想不到的东西。

尽管信号混杂在一起，但它们可能暗示了几种不同的来源，我们的无人机很难同时搜索所有这些信号源。我们希望能够调查：
excerpt.en:
While scouring the systems under our control, one of our drones picked up on a few scattered readings from [prospectorium_discovery_target.System.GetName]. There might be more to this system than we originally thought.

Mixed as the signals were, they could be

excerpt.zh: 来自[pops_join_caravan_planet.GetName]的报道指出，有一批居民离开了殖民地，选择加入正穿行于我们领地的[pops_join_caravan_fleet.GetName]舰队，他们表面上说是为了冒险的梦想，不过是被赤裸裸的利益熏昏了头罢了。
excerpt.en: Reports from [pops_join_caravan_planet.GetName] inform us that a number of inhabitants have left the colony to join the [pops_join_caravan_fleet.GetName] fleet passing through our territory, ostensibly drawn by dreams of adventure or the heady aroma of raw mer

excerpt.zh:
许多报告说[Root.GetName]有无法解释的地层活动。整个[Root.GetPlanetMoon]都能感受到震动，许多殖民点都因此受损。对地震进行调查时，科学家发现了庞杂的地下洞穴网络。

洞穴最深处栖居的是某种本土原始文明，它们正在挖掘通往地表的隧道！它们的行为可能是由殖民地的活动诱发，但我们无法确定。我们也无法预计它们与殖民者碰面之后会采取何种行动！
excerpt.en: There have been many reports of unexplainable seismic disturbances on [Root.GetName]. Tremors can be felt across the [Root.GetPlanetMoon], and many of our settlements have suffered damage. While investigating the earthquakes, our scientists discovered a vast n

excerpt.zh:
我们在[Root.GetName]建立了殖民地，当地的一些植物在释放大量含有复杂化学成分的花粉。

为此准备了一项特别研究计划，来研究这种植物。
excerpt.en:
Several plants native to [Root.GetName], where we recently established a colony, exude copious amounts of a pollen with an astounding chemical complexity.

A special research project has been prepared for further study of this flora.

excerpt.zh: [Root.Capital.GetName]上外星生物博物馆馆长提出采购某些活体外星样本的请求。这些生物一般出现在已调查过的宜居世界中，但捕获难度很大。这需要科研船动用全部资源并花费大量时间才能做到。
excerpt.en: The director of the Museum of Exobiology on [Root.Capital.GetName] has issued a request for the procurement of several live alien specimens. These creatures were spotted on surveyed habitable worlds, but they are difficult to capture. It will require the full

excerpt.zh:
[Root.GetName]已经定位了[From.GetName]上层大气层中异动的根源。令人吃惊的是，那不是一艘躲在云层里的舰船，而是一只幼年变形虫，而它的母亲则不知所踪。

我们无法得知这个幼体是如何与它的母亲和同类分离的，但有一点可以确定：它看上去已经对[Root.GetName]产生了印刻效应。当船员们结束了对[From.GetName]的调查之后，他们发现这只变形虫在跟踪他们。显然它很难被甩掉，而且[Root.GetLeaderName]对这只幼体的决心很是欣赏。

我们的科学专员建议允许这只变形虫一直跟
excerpt.en:
The [Root.GetName] has located the source of the movement in the upper atmosphere of [From.GetName]. Surprisingly, there was no ship hidden in the clouds, but rather a young Space Amoeba, its mother nowhere to be seen.

There is no way of knowing how this juve

title.zh: 联邦团结暨领导力盛典
title.en: A Celebration of Unity and Leadership

excerpt.zh: [Root.Federation.GetName]在我国的明智领导下繁荣昌盛。许多[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]如今感到是时候因我们为盟友提供的服务获得回报了，我们将举办一场团结盛典——更确切地说，是为向联邦无私奉献的伟大[Root.GetAdj]领袖们举办的盛典。他们提议各成员国合作在[Root.Capital.GetName]的天空中树立一道丰碑，于此同时，我们将派遣代表团前往两个成员国的首都，协助他们为[Root.Federation.GetName]带来更多的凝聚力。
excerpt.en: The [Root.Federation.GetName] has prospered under the wise leadership of our nation. Many [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] now feel that it is time for our services to the alliance to be paid back with a celebration of its unity - and more specifically, the great [

excerpt.zh:
我们位于[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]轨道观测站的一位科学家失踪了。[missing_scientist.GetHeSheCap]先前正在执行秘密任务，收集[pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitt]地表的植物样本，但是并没有和[missing_scientist.GetHisHer]团队的其他成员一起返回穿梭机。

我们进行了有限的探索，以免对[GetPreFTLLowerPlural]造成惊扰，但迄今为止成功的希望渺茫。
excerpt.en: One of the scientists working at the Observation Post orbiting [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] has been reported missing. [missing_scientist.GetHeSheCap] [missing_scientist.GetWasWere] taking part in a covert mission to collect plant samples from the [pre_ftl_planet.

excerpt.zh: 我们可以定位这个神秘通讯的源头。通过信号的追踪我们发现了许多不同的坐标点，我们确定这是来自一个移动物体上的通讯。我们的理论认为我们应该是与一艘舰船发生了通讯，一艘可能用于自然保留地之类作用的舰船。
excerpt.en: We were able to locate the source of the mysterious transmissions. On tracing the signals to multiple points of origin, we have ascertained they must be coming from a moving object. Our leading theory suggests we were contacted by a ship, which may be used as

excerpt.zh:
在[From.GetName]和缓的运行轨道上竟漂浮着一枚紧急信标。其外壳已被严重损坏，似乎是被武器火力击中或是被大爆炸波及。

这似乎是来自[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj]的民用飞船专属型号——用于在通讯系统故障时作为紧急措施进行发射——但其受损的严重程度使具体情况都不得而知了。

它一直在重复一个微弱而失真的信号。
excerpt.en:
An emergency transmission buoy floats in gentle orbit around [From.GetName]. Its outer casing is heavily damaged, seemingly by glancing weapons fire or a powerful explosion.

It might be a [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj] model for civilian ships - designed to be ej

excerpt.zh:
我们找到失联的探测器了！我们在[From.GetName]星系探测到了一支临时拼凑的小型舰队，其中一艘飞船用短距离牵引光束锁住了探测器。

他们正在呼唤我们。
excerpt.en:
We have found our missing probe! A small fleet of jury-rigged ships has been detected in the [From.GetName] system, and one of them has the probe locked in a short-range tractor beam.

They are hailing us.

excerpt.zh:
指挥官[exercise_admiral.GetName]制定了一个舰队演习计划，这将涉及到我们相当部分的海军。[exercise_admiral.GetSheHe]为这场演习选择的地点是[exercise_system.GetName]恒星系，靠近[exercise_neighbor.GetName]的边界。

[exercise_neighbor.GetSpeciesNamePlural]或许会将这次演习视作一种挑衅，但是如果我们取消演习，我们的军队会认为我们过于软弱。毕竟，[exercise_system.G
excerpt.en: Commander [exercise_admiral.GetName] has drawn up plans for a major fleet exercise that will involve a substantial portion of our navy. The location [exercise_admiral.GetSheHe] [exercise_admiral.GetHasHave] chosen for these maneuvers is the [exercise_system.Ge

excerpt.zh:
我们正在召集精英灵能使集会，准备向虚境深处进军，与其中力量庞大的势力交流。

在知道这个实体的真名之前，我们会称之为[Root.Patron:the_eater_of_worlds.GetPreCommunicationName]。
excerpt.en:
We are gathering a convocation of elite telepaths, ready to reach deep into the Shroud and commune with a force of immense power.

Until we know its true name, this being shall be referred to as the [Root.Patron:the_eater_of_worlds.GetPreCommunicationName].

excerpt.zh:
在[From.GetName]内附近的晶体裂隙处出现了一个异常的虫洞。

我们只能推测这是无形异使打开的一个星门，为他们带来援军。我们检测到另一侧的恒星系已经从其他地方被拉入我们的位面。

如果我们选择进入这个地方，我们应该准备我们最强大的舰队。
excerpt.en:
An anomalous wormhole has appeared nearby the Crystal Rift, in [From.GetName].

We can only assume that it is a gateway opened by the Formless to bring them aid. We detect the system on the other side has been pulled into our dimension from somewhere else.

We

excerpt.zh:
[Root.GetName]的卫星上有异动。

初步扫描显示一些古代科技已经被启动，或许是对我们的殖民行为作出的反应。

我们的几个顶级科学家非常想去调查一下这个卫星，并为此准备好了一项特殊研究项目。
excerpt.en:
Something stirs on the moon of [Root.GetName].

Preliminary scans indicate that some ancient technology has become active, possibly as a response to our colonization efforts.

Several of our top scientists are eager to take a closer look at the moon, and have

excerpt.zh:
我们在[Root.GetName]遇到了奇怪的情况：我们显然定居到了某种巨大的两栖爬行动物身上，他们的骨质外壳由多种奇特的矿物构成。许多我们认为是当地岛屿的其实都是这种生物，我们的殖民者则将他们称为“尼玛”。

他们看起来人畜无害，由于我们并没有深入他们的外壳，他们应该几乎没注意到我们。
excerpt.en: Our colony on [Root.GetName] has encountered an odd situation: we have apparently settled on the back of a gargantuan amphibian reptile, whose bony shell is formed of various exotic minerals. Most of what we thought were local islands have turned out to be the

excerpt.zh: 扫描发现，在[from.GetName]中的[fromfrom.GetName]的中心出现了不规则现象，表明该构造的中心携带着一个奇怪的物质。这些不寻常的读数值得在风暴消散或离开该恒星系之前进行更深入的调查。
excerpt.en: Scans detect irregularities in the eye of [fromfrom.GetName] raging in [from.GetName], indicating that the formation is carrying a strange mass at its center. These unusual readings warrant closer investigation, before the storm dissipates or leaves the system

excerpt.zh:
我们的天文学家们十分确信，这个星系的小行星带曾经是一颗宜居的行星，但是却被某种未知的力量击碎了。

已发起特殊项目来进一步研究小行星带中的主要天体。
excerpt.en:
Our astronomers are confident that the asteroid belt in this system was once a habitable planet, torn asunder by unknown forces.

A Special Project has been issued to study one of the major asteroids in the belt.

excerpt.zh: 监护者协议62-1完成。激活[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]战争资产迎战[FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetSpeciesAdj]目标。将[Root.GetName]的地位从未被危害升级至合作。
excerpt.en: Custodian protocol 62-1 fulfilled. Active [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] war assets engaging [FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetSpeciesAdj] targets. Upgrading status of [Root.GetName] from non-compromised to compliant.

excerpt.zh: 挖掘揭露了地下设施，其中藏有先进科技、档案数据和更多沉睡亲族的休眠舱。我们的历史就埋藏于此；若能挖掘全部，或许最终能明白自己是谁。
excerpt.en: Our excavation has revealed subterranean facilities housing advanced technology, archived data, and stasis pods containing more of our dormant kin. Our history itself is buried here; if we can dig it all up, we may finally understand who we are.

excerpt.zh:
是时候抛弃我们有缺陷的生物躯壳了。我们必须准备先进的机械身躯，然后开始意识传输过程。

次月数字化人口数：[From.GetSynthPopsPerMonth]
excerpt.en:
It is time to leave our flawed biological vessels behind. We must prepare advanced machine bodies and perform the process of consciousness transfers.

Pops to be digitized next month: [From.GetSynthPopsPerMonth]

excerpt.zh: 进入[From.GetName]星系之后不久，我们很快就定位了一颗符合凯德斯幻视的行星。在这颗行星的表面流淌着熔矿的海洋。
excerpt.en: Shortly after entry into the [From.GetName] system, a planet matching Keides's vision has been located. Oceans of molten minerals stream across the planet's surface.

excerpt.zh: 在完成[From.GetName]的环境改造之后，我们的[Owner.GetTerraformerPlural]注意到了一个黄金的机遇。剩下的环境改造设备经过调整改造后可以作为这个行星的基础设施。
excerpt.en: After completing the terraforming of [From.GetName], our [Owner.GetTerraformerPlural] have spotted a golden opportunity. The remaining terraforming equipment can potentially be repurposed as infrastructure for the planet.

excerpt.zh:
[fallen_empire_hive_growth.GetName]已经完成了对[root.GetName]的改造。虽然他们的影响是无形的，但效果却是不可否认的。

在整个星球上，当地的昆虫现在开始使用与我们无线设备相同的频率进行通信。一声虫鸣就能操作自动门，成群的虫群甚至能使一座工厂瘫痪。我们正在通过切换频率来应对，但并非所有设施都能恢复到完全效率。
excerpt.en:
The [fallen_empire_hive_growth.GetName] has completed its modifications on [root.GetName]. Their influence was unseen, but the effects are undeniable.

Planetwide, the local insects now communicate using the same frequencies as our wireless devices. A single c

excerpt.zh: [Root.GetName]表面覆盖有茂盛的植被，巨大的树形植物生长至数百米高。殖民者发现几乎所有的这些植物都有不同程度的迁移能力。森林会缓慢的向养分更充足的区域移动，迁移的周期似乎与[Root.GetPlanetMoon]的运行周期有关。不幸的是，殖民地的基础建设工程会受到极大的阻碍。迁移的植物们会切断供能线路，摧毁建筑和道路。
excerpt.en: The surface of [Root.GetName] is covered in lush forests, with massive tree analogues rising hundreds of meters into the air. Interestingly, our colonists have found that nearly all of the flora is mobile to various degrees. Forests stretching for miles will s

excerpt.zh:
我们的远程扫描仪发现了一个在系统边缘漂浮的物体。进一步检查发现其外表下存在精确的几何不一致，以及厚厚岩石外壳下埋藏的休眠能量信号。

这是一个来源不明的救生舱，其外部经过伪装，以躲避广阔太空中的探测。未检测到任何主动传输，但舱内仍存在微弱的生命维持痕迹。无论里面是什么，都已经漂浮了很长时间。
excerpt.en:
Our long-range scanners have flagged an object drifting at the edge of the system. Closer inspection revealed precise geometric inconsistencies beneath its surface, and dormant power signatures buried beneath a thick shell of rock.

A survival pod of unknown o

excerpt.zh:
我们标记出了[From.GetName]上能量波动的源头，它源自一座位于未开智生物领地中心的金字塔形建筑。我们发现当地人口怪异地聚集在建筑周围。

我们若想要确认该物体的功能，则无可避免地会与这颗行星的居民打交道。
excerpt.en:
We have pinpointed the source of the energy fluctuations on [From.GetName] to a monolithic structure in the heart of the pre-sapient territory. The local population have been observed curiously congregating around the structure.

If we are to ascertain the pur

excerpt.zh: 在远古风暴庇护所中发现的三个坐标之一将我带到了[From.Planet.GetName]。地表的废墟绵延无尽，显然这颗行星曾经拥有许多庞大的城市中心。这很可能是数百万年前因内特贸易体的公民居住的地方。为什么这些坐标要被安全地存储在一个风暴庇护所里仍需调查。
excerpt.en: One of the three coordinate sets found in the ancient storm shelter has led us to [From.Planet.GetName]. Given the extent of the ruins, it's clear that this planet once boasted many sprawling urban centers. This is likely where the citizens of the Inetian Trad

excerpt.zh:
在与宇宙风暴通信之后，艾德苏尔我们展示出了自己的一小部分。在残云之间矗立着一座巨大的建筑群。这里早已遭到遗弃，但奇怪的是它并没有受到时间的影响，扫描显示它的内部存在有机物质。

在这座巨大的建筑前升起了一系列横幅，上面写着同一句话：庆典时刻到。
excerpt.en:
After the communication with the cosmic storm, a small part of adSul was revealed to us. Between the remnant clouds stood a massive complex. Abandoned, yet strangely unaffected by the eons, scans reveal organic material on the inside.

Rising before the immens

excerpt.zh: 人群中的叛乱分子正伺机推翻我们在[Target.GetName]的统治！
excerpt.en: Rebellious elements of the populace are seeking to overthrow our rule on [Target.GetName]!

excerpt.zh:
[From.GetName]曾经拥有一个高等文明。但他们早已成为历史尘埃。异形猛兽在星球表面的远古战场上肆虐横行。

在石山地区的山脉底部藏有一个避难所。如果我们能先处理掉地表的猛兽，我们就可以继续调查。
excerpt.en:
[From.GetName] used to hold an advanced civilization. It is now dead silent. Alien beasts roam old battlefields that stretch across the surface.

In a rocky region there seems to lie a hidden vault beneath the mountains. If we could get rid of the beasts roami

excerpt.zh:
我们需要一些时间来适应如此庞大的形态。在融入这个身体的过程中，我们必须时刻保持对周围环境的警觉。如今，我们与虚空之间已无任何阻隔。

我们当前的['concept_growth_factor']为：[growth_factor_value]%
excerpt.en:
It will take some time for us to adjust to a form so massive in scale. As we grow into this body, we must remain aware of our surroundings. There now stands nothing between us and the void.

Our current ['concept_growth_factor'] is: [growth_factor_value]%

excerpt.zh:
[Root.GetLeaderName]报告说位于[From.GetName]的人造建筑并非建筑设施，而是远古时代的巨型机器人。这个年代久远的机械巨物躺在群山之中，早已失去行动机能，正慢慢被[From.GetName]大气层中降下的酸雨所腐蚀，机器人身上装有威力强大的武器，当初应该是作为无人太空船被建造出来的。

如果想对其加以利用，我们就必须迅速行动，否则[From.GetName]上的酸雨就会彻底摧毁这艘机器人战舰。
excerpt.en: [Root.GetLeaderName] reports that the artificial construction located on [From.GetName] is not a structure at all, but rather a colossal robot from a bygone age. This aging mechanical behemoth lies disabled in the mountains, slowly being corroded by the volati

excerpt.zh:
[Root.Federation.GetName]代表星系舞台上一股强大的力量，但是其舰队分散在各处，并且在不同的组织结构下运作。近日，联邦各地几位颇具影响力的军事专家对我们能否面对协调统一、实力强大的敌人表示担忧。

为弥补实力上的不足，他们制定了一套方案，计划在联邦范围内进行一系列军事演习，以便建立军队凝聚力，磨练船员的技能。根据他们的计划，每支舰队将派出特遣队前往盟友领土的特定地点，进行一系列复杂的演习，与其他参加的舰队相互协调，确保行动同步进行。成功完成演习是我军的重要使命，将大大提高我们联邦的战备水平。
excerpt.en: The [Root.Federation.GetName] represents a powerful force on the galactic stage; however, its fleets are divided and operate under a disparate set of organizational structures. Recently, several influential military experts from across the federation have rais

excerpt.zh:
这座由阿达卡利亚公约建造的古老居住站环绕着一颗荒芜的星球。其高质量的建筑材料使空间站保留了近乎原始的状态。

调到传输频率上之后，我们收到一条信息，后面跟着一段浮夸的铃铛声：欢迎来到崇高仁善爱国协会。
excerpt.en:
Orbiting a desolate planet, this ancient habitat was built by the adAkkaria Convention. The high quality building materials used in its construction have ensured the station is in near pristine condition.

Tuning into the transmission frequency, we picked up a

excerpt.zh:
我们天空中的异光消散了，提前宣告了我们的特工之后汇报的事情：他们激活了能量信标，将万华镜寄生虫引走了！

现在就让[target.GetName]去处理这麻烦吧。
excerpt.en:
The lights have faded from our skies, first announcing what our intelligence operatives later confirmed: our operators activated the energy beacon, luring the Kaleidoscope away!

Let the [target.GetName] deal with it now.

excerpt.zh:
[Root.GetName]的船员在[From.GetName]上有重大发现。该行星上的沙丘隐藏着一些废墟，是属于一个星际种群的。这类殖民地大都敌不过时间的洗礼。

科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]很快发现了一个藏有珍贵物品和文件的储物箱。既然这些文件是跟珍贵物品保存在一起，那一定相当重要。
excerpt.en:
On [From.GetName] the crew of the [Root.GetName] have found something extraordinary. The planet's dunes have hid several ruins, belonging to an interstellar civilization of settlers. The settlements have long been destroyed by the ravages of time.

Science Off

excerpt.zh: 我们摧毁了四处招摇撞骗的范格利集团！他们的劣质产品与溜须拍马的言行将不再污染这片星系。
excerpt.en: We have destroyed the wheedling pests of The Vengralian Trium! No longer will their inferior products and ingratiating mannerisms pollute the galaxy.

excerpt.zh:
我们意在颠覆虚境的精神位面的任务目前到达了一个十分关键的时刻。宏伟的以太相引擎框架正环绕于我们在漂流旅程中选择的天锚周围。一旦这座巨型结构完工，我们就能轻易抹除现世之屏障，将虚境据为己有。

我们的意识将不再受困于孱弱肉体的物理桎梏，现实本身亦将任由我们主宰。诚然，世间再无更高的存在境界。
excerpt.en: We have reached a pivotal moment in our quest to subvert the psychic domain of the Shroud. The framework of the great Aetherophasic Engine now surrounds our chosen focal star, the one we designated from all those we have drifted past. Once this megastructure h

excerpt.zh: 太空创生家艾莎琳的健康情况肉眼可见地恶化了。她拒绝接受检查，所以我们什么都帮不上。
excerpt.en: Astrocreator Azaryn's health has visibly declined. She refuses to be examined, so we are unable to help her.

excerpt.zh:
一艘我们的飞船在探索[Root.solar_system.GetName]恒星系的时候偶然在位于[Root.Planet.GetName][Root.Planet.Orbit.GetName]的卫星上发现了一艘坠毁的小型飞船。

这艘飞船上的标志与符号我们从未见过。些许样本已经被提取并用于进一步研究，但飞船本身过大且不够牢固，无法移动，我们只能就地进行分析研究了。
excerpt.en:
One of our ships analyzing the [Root.solar_system.GetName] system has come across a small crashed ship on the moon of [Root.Planet.Orbit.GetName], [Root.Planet.GetName].

It bears no emblems or sigils we have seen before, and some samples have been brought bac

excerpt.zh:
我们的星系比看起来更脆弱。危险从四面八方逼近：捕食者潜伏于虚空，海盗盘踞在无主恒星系，傲慢和恐惧也在引发着战争。而那些有能力行动的人却常常保持沉默。

而我们不会袖手旁观。这并非宣称统治，而是承诺守护。通过审慎的行动和共同的目标，我们将确保星系拥有值得守护的未来。
excerpt.en:
Our galaxy is more fragile than it appears. Dangers press in from every direction: predators lurking in the void, pirates in forgotten systems, wars born of pride and fear. And too often, those with the power to act remain silent.

We will not stand idle. This

excerpt.zh:
信号似乎是从某个类似信号天线的结构中传来的。我方已经从[Root.GetName]发射了探索无人机，希望能够在星球表面发现更多线索。

科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]所发现的洞穴仓库十分容易地就被撬开。他判定这座仓库为某种早已灭亡的外星种族所用，似乎是其族群最后的一处避难所。该种族的科技水平虽然较为先进，但似乎从未进行太空探索，结果因为某种涉及到整颗星球的自然灾害而消亡了。库房面积广大，其中充斥着成千上万个黑匣子。据[Root.GetName]判定，这些匣子都是数据储存装置。

已发起特殊项目来进
excerpt.en:
The signal originates from the remains of an antenna-like structure. Exploratory probes were dispatched from the [Root.GetName] to the surface to investigate the matter more closely.

What Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] found was a cavernous vault that,

excerpt.zh: [from.planet.GetName]乍一看是一颗普通的宜居行星，但我们的研究团队详细调查后发现了许多大型的化石矿藏，而且保存状况相当良好。有趣的是，一些大型的化石群在同一地层中包含许多物种，这表明要么它们是在同一时间死去，要么就是被人刻意这样安置的。对这些遗骸的检测让我们有机会进一步了解这颗行星上生活的物种的进化轨迹。
excerpt.en: [from.planet.GetName] appears to be a standard habitable planet, but on closer inspection, our research team has spotted large deposits of fossils in seemingly well-preserved conditions. Interestingly, larger clusters contain multiple specimens on the same lay

excerpt.zh: 自殖民[Root.GetName]以来，[Root.GetPlanetMoon]的生物圈异象不断。生态系统十分不稳定，而且生物的进化程度也不符合范式。科学家猜测是有外部的干扰，而猜测已被证实！几个殖民者发现了庞大的地下改造装置，应该有数千年的历史了。装置在改造进程中就失去了动力，使得[Root.GetPlanetMoon]的生物圈处于未完成的现状。只要提供足够的能源，应该就能重启装置。但谁也不知道会发生什么……
excerpt.en: Since our initial settlement of [Root.GetName], several anomalies in the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]'s biosphere have been discovered. The ecosystem is unstable and has not developed according to projected models for a world of this type. Our scientists suspect outsi

excerpt.zh:
我们在[Root.GetName]的殖民者将需要处理这些星球表面的远古机器人，我们推测它们是在某种厄运降临于其创造者之后被遗留至今。

许多这些古董机器人对我们的存在做出了反应，以完全陌生的腔调对我们进行了反复的询问。我们认为它们在等指令输入。它们似乎并不具有情感，并且很可能缺乏更先进的逻辑推理功能。
excerpt.en:
Our colonists on [Root.GetName] will need to deal with the ancient robots on its surface, who we presume were left behind when whatever fate befell their makers spared them.

Many of these antiquated automatons have responded to our presence, making repetitive

excerpt.zh:
虚空虫瘟疫正在肆虐。

这些生物不再将宿主星球作为繁殖地。我们必须消灭它们，否则我们的殖民地将面临风险。

每消灭一个虚空虫都会加速局势进展。
excerpt.en:
A plague of Voidworms is upon us.

These creatures will no longer spare host planets as breeding grounds. We must work to eradicate them or our colonies will be at risk.

Each Voidworm destroyed accelerates Situation progress.

excerpt.zh: 我们对[From.GetShipCategoryName]的克隆工作取得了基因突破。将这些生物独特的解剖结构与我们在基因操控方面的专业知识结合起来，或许可以创造出一种独特的变异体。
excerpt.en: Our [From.GetShipCategoryName] cloning efforts have resulted in a genetic breakthrough. It might be possible to combine these creature's unique anatomy with our expertise in gene manipulation to create a unique type of Mutation.

excerpt.zh:
方舟飞船[Target.GetName]的人工智能核心因内部指令冲突而发生故障，导致其分裂。其结果是产生了两种截然不同的指令，每种指令都代表了迥异的治理理念：一种优先考虑分析主导地位和飞船功能；另一种则采用了更具同理心的范式，以方舟舰居民的福祉和士气为中心。
最终，只能保留一种指令。
excerpt.en: A malfunction born of internal directive conflict has split the AI core aboard Arkship [Target.GetName] The result is the emergence of two distinct directives, each embodying a divergent philosophy of governance. One prioritizes analytical dominance and ship f

excerpt.zh:
我们位于[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]轨道观测站上的小型天体实验室侦测到一颗4级小行星正在靠近。若不采取行动，它将会以相当大的力撞击到[pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]的[GetRandomCompassDirection]半球，足以造成灭绝级事件。

我们的任务是被动观察，通常情况下我们不允许进行干涉，但许多科学家认为在这种情况下应该破例。若不采取任何行动，[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上的[pre_ftl_country.GetName]注定将
excerpt.en: The small astrometric lab on our Observation Post orbiting [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] has detected a Class-4 asteroid on an incoming trajectory. Unless action is taken, it will impact the [pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]'s [GetRandomCompassDirection] hemisphere

excerpt.zh:
刚一进入[From.GetName]恒星系，我们的传感器就发现了来自[event_target:exakeides_planet.GetName]行星的一个微弱信号。

它具有短促而重复的模式，看起来好像是在求救。然而，由于信号太过微弱，我们估计定位出其来源会相当困难。也许到时候就来不及伸出援手了。
excerpt.en:
On entering the [From.GetName] system our sensors detected a faint signal originating on planet [event_target:exakeides_planet.GetName].

A short and repeating pattern, it appears to be a call for aid. However, given the signal's weakness, we expect that locat

excerpt.zh:
这颗行星的地表上，一座古老的建筑物被隐藏在某种迷彩能量场之下。只是偶然观测到，一颗小行星在撞击时才揭示了它的存在，该小行星化为流星偏转了它的能量场。

在该能量场被关闭后，考古学家们现在可以去探索原本隐藏其下的，令人生畏的巨大建筑群了。
excerpt.en:
A chameleon energy field was concealing an ancient structure on the surface of this planet. Only a chance observation of an asteroid impact revealed its existence as the meteor deflected off the field.

With the field deactivated, archaeologists will now have

excerpt.zh:
[planet.GetName]的最新气候报告带来了一项令人担忧的结论。奇怪的是，冷冻行星上的表面温度一直以惊人的速度上升。

如果我们无法确定生态系统迅速恶化的原因，这种情况可能会导致行星广阔冰川的灾难性融化。
excerpt.en:
The latest climate report from [planet.GetName] has come to a concerning conclusion. Inexplicably, the surface temperature on the frozen planet has been rising at an alarming rate.

If we fail to identify the reason for the ecosystem's rapid deterioration, the

excerpt.zh:
自从探测到[From.Planet.GetName]的那一刻起，它就一直吸引着我们的目光。

在这样一个广阔而混乱的星系中，两个天体相撞并不是什么罕见的事情。不过，在此前类似的碰撞中，至少相撞的其中一个或者全部两个都会被摧毁。

让[From.Planet.GetName]变成现在样子的碰撞发生在数百万年前，但这两颗星球却保持着一种奇怪的平衡，甚至在这一过程中还形成了维护生命体的大气层。
excerpt.en:
From the moment we detected [From.Planet.GetName], its mere existence has been a source of fascination.

It is not the collision of two celestial objects that is unusual, as the galaxy is a vast and chaotic place. However, in all known instances of such an imp

excerpt.zh:
首席的科研船神出鬼没，侦测起来相当困难，但这还不是最难的。

传感器上显示的数据令人不解，上面显示首席的船两侧各有一艘虎视眈眈的护卫舰。

首席物理学家正在向我们致意。
excerpt.en:
The ephemeral Science Ship remains difficult to detect, but apparently not difficult enough.

The blur of confused sensor readings that we have come to associate with the Head's ship is flanked on both sides by a pair of rather nasty-looking corvettes.

The Ph

excerpt.zh:
[Root.GetName]船员报告称，在[From.GetName]星系附近发现了腐朽的轨道空间站与多个死寂星球。某个曾殖民于[From.GetName]星系的星际文明似乎很久以前就毁灭了。[ratling_planet_tar.GetName]星球简直就像个垃圾场，上面满是辐射弥漫且锈迹斑斑的建筑废墟，基础设施与载具。未侦测到高等生命的存在。

我们或许可以勘察该星系与邻近星系中的类似星球，来获知更多关于这一失落文明的情报。
excerpt.en: The [Root.GetName] crew have reported the presence of decaying orbital stations and multiple tomb worlds near the [From.GetName] system. Whatever interstellar nation once inhabited the [From.GetName] system appears to have collapsed into ruin long ago. [ratlin

excerpt.zh:
对[from.Planet.GetName]的扫描发现了一艘太空船残骸。这艘飞船似乎在多年以前遭受了非受控着陆。

其巨大的规模表明了建造其所需的巨大资源量。考古发掘可以帮助我们确认其为何坠毁于此。
excerpt.en:
Scans of [from.Planet.GetName] revealed the presence of a spaceborne shipwreck. The vessel appears to have endured an uncontrolled landing here many years ago.

Its massive scale suggests immense resources were once committed to its construction. An archaeolog

excerpt.zh: 我们真是失望透顶啊，[From.GetSpeciesName]。你们许诺要阻止[FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName]的一切不当行为，现在却看到他们仍然肆意妄为、横行霸道。我们曾以为你们能够阻止他们，但现在看来，是我们搞错了。
excerpt.en: We are most disappointed, young [From.GetSpeciesName]. Despite your promise to end their evil practices, the [FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName] continue to purge and slaughter at will. We thought your species one of great promise, but perhaps we were mistaken.

excerpt.zh:
我们的帝国震惊地发现[dysonsphere_builder.GetName]正在[dyson_system.GetName]周围建造一个戴森球，那是我们最喜爱的星座——独眼漫步者——的中心恒星，而戴森球将完全阻隔她的光亮。

独眼漫步者，用她的独眼，自从我们的文明伊始便守望着我们，她的传奇不仅指引着我们的舰队，群星亦在天际间航行。而现在，[dysonsphere_builder.GetName]，伴随着他们浅显的傲慢，要用一个戴森球遮蔽她，弄瞎她。

虽然需要过上许多年，我们这才能感受到变化，但是当我们的人民得知
excerpt.en:
Our empire has been shaken by the discovery that the [dysonsphere_builder.GetName] are building a Dyson Sphere around [dyson_system.GetName], a central star in one of our most beloved constellations, the "One-eyed Wanderer," completely blocking its light.

The

excerpt.zh:
在对方舟舰[Root.GetName]下层甲板进行例行维护时，我们的工程师发现了一个散发放射性信号的旧密封容器。其表面焦黑，并用厚重的工业焊缝加固，表明它从未打算被轻易打开。

飞船的货物档案中没有它的记录，也没有任何标记表明它来自何处或预计要携带什么。 对该容器进行全面分析需要一些时间才能完成。
excerpt.en: During routine maintenance on a lower deck of Arkship [Root.GetName], our engineers have discovered an old sealed container emitting radioactive signals. Its surface was scorched and reinforced with thick industrial welds, suggesting it had never been meant to

excerpt.zh:
在我们的每月库存盘点中，我们发现方舟舰[Root.GetName]资源系统中存在持续性的偏差。电力、消费品和其他物资的损耗量小幅超过了我们的记录使用量。专家们认为这可能是泄漏、故障，或者是数据上微小的误差。

在进一步调查后，结果仍无定论。没有破口，没有故障，也没有超出可接受范围的低效。然而，数据依然如故。资源继续在毫无解释的情况下从系统中消失。方舟号上的某种东西正在消耗我们的资源。
excerpt.en: During our monthly stock takes, we have found a persistent discrepancy in the Arkship [Root.GetName] resource systems. Small amount of electricity, consumer goods, and other supplies are being taken at levels exceeding our recorded usage. Experts suggest a lea

excerpt.zh:
在一次于[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]地表执行的秘密任务中，我方一架穿梭机被当地某个国家政权的大气层战斗机中队拦截。一枚幸运的导弹击中了穿梭机引擎，导致它在偏远的荒野中坠毁。

若想在[GetPreFTLLowerPlural]到达坠毁地点之前救出所有幸存者，我们必须迅速行动。所有我们存在的证据都必须抹除！
excerpt.en: During a clandestine mission to the surface of [pre_ftl_planet.GetName], one of our shuttles was intercepted by a squadron of atmospheric fighters belonging to a local nation state. A lucky missile hit disabled the shuttle's engines, and it crashed in a remote

excerpt.zh: 一位[shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName]的流亡者来到了[Root.GetName]。由于信奉异端思想，这位“极端主义者”从城邦中被流放了出来，结果没有在任何到来的船只上登记显现。它直接出现在殖民地大型城市的中央广场，就好像空气突然物质化了一样，然后公开地宣告自己的信条能让它同虚境建立个人通讯。根据这个流亡者的说法，我们的人民可以通过共享梦境实现一种赐福状态。报告指出，殖民地里有很多人都听信了这个说法。
excerpt.en: An exile from the [shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName] has arrived on [Root.GetName]. Recently expelled from the Enclave for harbouring heretical views, this 'extremist' was not listed on the manifest of any incoming vessel. As if materializing out of the ai

excerpt.zh:
一开始只是些许小小的争吵，现在已经演变成在每一项议题前都争论不休的僵局，这严重阻碍了我们内阁的运转效率。

[root.GetName]是内阁中最热衷于争吵和扰乱秩序的问题成员。许多人要求免去[root.GetHisHer]的席位，以恢复秩序和效率。
excerpt.en:
What began as minor bickering has now devolved into quarrelsome gridlock on practically every issue brought before the Council, damaging its ability to function.

[root.GetName] has proven to be the most contentious and disruptive member of the Council. Many o

excerpt.zh:
[Root.GetName]报告说，舰队在[From.GetName]星系发现了很多海盗。

扫描发现海盗船和空间站的数目非常庞大，所以这应该是个历史悠久的海盗港口。这些海盗从很久以前就开始在这里进行抢劫活动，且没有遭遇过任何打击行动。
excerpt.en:
The [Root.GetName] reports that the fleet has encountered a significant pirate presence in the [From.GetName] system.

Judging by preliminary scans of the immense ships and the stations harboring them, this is a historical pirate port. It has likely been in un

excerpt.zh:
统一星系并非仅凭武力或个人意志就能实现。它需要信任、对话，以及承担他人不敢承担的重担的意愿。每一次联盟的建立，每一次危机的化解，都是迈向更具韧性未来的小小一步。

我们寻求的不是统治，而是引领：在他人踉跄时，伸出援手。我们的工作永无止境，也常常不被感谢，但这职责正是我们的使命。我们将共同塑造一个永恒的星系。
excerpt.en: Uniting the galaxy will not be achieved through force of arms or singular will alone. It will take trust, dialogue, and the willingness to shoulder burdens no one else dares to bear. Every alliance formed, every crisis defused, is a small step toward a more re

excerpt.zh: 我们在[From.Planet.GetName]的一处破损的拱顶发现了奇怪的信号。
excerpt.en: We have picked up strange signals from a broken dome on [From.Planet.GetName].

excerpt.zh: [Root.GetName]已经进入了[Root.GetStarName]星系。船员报告指出那颗恒星周围确实环行着另一个与未叙尊者的神龛别无二致的物体。
excerpt.en: The [Root.GetName] has entered the [Root.GetStarName] system. Its crew reports the star is indeed orbited by another object not dissimilar to the shrine of the Untold.

excerpt.zh:
不出所料，[Root.GetName]成功定位了[From.GetName]信号的来源。

虽说整颗星球看似完全未被外星生物开发过，不过星球南半球一座山丘顶部却发现了一座光滑的白色矿物柱体。信号正是从该柱体中发出，柱体也明显是为了避免共振而设计。

科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]已停下手边工作，开始筹备特殊项目，以期能够解密该信号携带的信息。
excerpt.en:
As expected, the [Root.GetName] has located the source of the transmission emanating from [From.GetName].

While the planet is otherwise seemingly untouched by alien hands, a lone monolith of some sleek off-white mineral stands atop a hill in the southern hemi

excerpt.zh: 来自[Planet.GetName]殖民地的报告显示:星球上的“返祖现象”正不断增加。显然相当一部分人口已经表现出迄今为止前所未有的性欲与攻击性，而没人知道这是为什么。
excerpt.en: Reports from our colony on [Planet.GetName] claims that there's been an increase in 'feral behavior'. Apparently parts of the population has expressed hitherto unprecedented levels of lust and aggression, and no one knows why.

excerpt.zh: 我们遭遇了一个位于“贝塔宇宙”内的糟糕境况，对于这个正在崩坏的次元，我们必须立刻决定是袖手旁观还是鼎力相助。
excerpt.en: We have been confronted with a terrible situation inside the 'Beta-Universe' and must now decide if we are to stand aside or assist the doomed dimension.

excerpt.zh: 我们开始过载[target.GetName]来播种宇宙风暴。
excerpt.en: We have begun supercharging [target.GetName] to seed a Cosmic Storm.

excerpt.zh:
[Root.GetName]船员完成了研究任务，并战战兢兢地回来了。至于在[From.GetName]上到底看到了什么，每个人的汇报都含糊不清，矛盾之处颇多，但有一点大家的回复是完全一致的：覆盖整个星球表面的流动的海洋具有生命。

尽管星球上的海洋没有任何器官组织和肉体，但却可以通过能影响接收者脑波的频率来进行交流。它可以让接收者感受到思想、画面、情感……除此之外，它对不同个体的影响也不同。现在还不清楚如果长期接收这个海洋的频率会对接收者有什么样的影响，也不知道这种接收频率行为是否安全。

科学专员[Root.Ge
excerpt.en: The [Root.GetName] crew has returned from their research mission visibly shaken. They provide vague, often conflicting reports of what they encountered on [From.GetName] - though in one matter they are all united: the still-flowing sea that wraps pole to pole

excerpt.zh:
第二次，继而再三确认导航系统的坐标后，我们不得不承认马达科-沃尔的天堂行星是一个只有荒原的荒芜星球。

尽管我们不能排除这种可能性：马达科所认为的天堂与我们的常识不同，但[utopian_planet.GetName]表面上的弹坑给出了另一种答案。这艘船的船长和乘员并没有简单的就接受了挫折。
excerpt.en:
After double- and triple-checking the navigational drive's coordinates, we have been forced to concede that where the Mardak Vol's paradisaical planet should have been are only the desolate plains of a barren world.

Though we cannot eliminate the possibility

excerpt.zh:
L-星龙已被消灭，而我们的科学家已经开始分析其仍留着温度的遗骸。

有趣的是，它的细胞内完全没有传统的遗传标记，或是任何像是DNA的东西。每个细胞似乎都是在分子水平上单独组成的，然后构成了我们所见到的从L-星门中出现的生物。报告表明在龙的脑干中发现了少量停止的纳米机器，进一步暗示了其荒诞的起源。
excerpt.en:
The L-Drake has been slain, and our scientists are beginning to tear into its still-warm carcass.

Interestingly, the creature's cells are completely devoid of traditional genetic markers or indeed anything resembling DNA. Each cell appears to have been put to

excerpt.zh: 我们在[planet.GetName]找到了第四个还未引爆的环境改造装置。将其取回之后就能让我们完全理解这一科技了。
excerpt.en: We have located a fourth, as yet undetonated terraforming device on [planet.GetName]. Recovering it will fill the gaps in our understanding of this technology.

excerpt.zh:
[Root.GetName]上不断地有奇怪的事件被报道。很显然有大量的个人在大街上跳舞，持续数小时甚至是一天到晚。他们拒绝停下来直到生理上的力竭。

至今，这种现象只影响了人口的相对一小部分，我们的当局政府尚未建立应对方案。
excerpt.en:
Strange occurrences have been reported among the colonists on [Root.GetName]. Apparently many individuals have taken to dancing on the streets for hours and even days on end, refusing to stop until they are physically restrained.

So far, it has only affected

excerpt.zh:
[Root.Federation.GetName]的成员们以圣灵之名汇聚一堂。我们在各自的信仰之间找到了共同点，但联邦内仍然还有着多种信条、宗教和教会，和谐共处并不容易。

最近，僧团的成员敦促[Root.Federation.GetName]主持一场主教会议，以便共商起草一份联合教条，定义我们信仰的根基。这个提案被通过了，每一个[Root.Federation.GetName]的成员都要派出他们的代表。
excerpt.en:
The members of the [Root.Federation.GetName] are united around their spirituality. We found common ground in the fact that we are believers, but the federation is home to various creeds, faiths and churches and cohabitation is sometimes uneasy.

Lately, member

excerpt.zh:
我们的研究人员终于拼凑出了“万爪之母”的故事：我们的宾客是一位专注于研究闪现的唯心主义教团的领袖：这是一种允许在宇宙中任何地方瞬间传送的灵能技术。纵观她的物种的历史，从来没有人成功地进行过闪现……直到现在。

万爪之母不确定她是否有能力复制这一壮举，更何况她的能量储备目前已经耗尽，无法再做尝试。

当前，她愿意继续接受我们的照顾，并将通过帮助我们的研究人员来回报我们的热情款待。
excerpt.en: Our researchers have finally pieced together the Many-Tentacled One's story: our guest is the head of a spiritual order focused on studying the Jaunt: a psionic technique that allows for instantaneous teleportation anywhere in the universe. Throughout the hist

excerpt.zh:
我们正处于一个至关重要的时刻——星海帝国已经四面楚歌，濒临全面叛乱。也许再也不会有这么好的推翻[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]的机会了！现在，帝国中起义的成员正团结到一个统一联邦的旗帜之下。

由于[Root.GetName]在这场盛大的叛乱中打响了第一枪，各界纷纷请求我们在接下来的战争中领导这个伟大的联盟，毫无疑问这也是星系的一份。
excerpt.en: We have reached a pivotal moment - the Galactic Imperium is hovering on the brink of open revolt. There may never be a better time to overthrow the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]! Even now, the rebelling members of the Imperium are uniting under the banner of a s

excerpt.zh:
最近在[Root.GetName]上安装的轴基挂载武器对舰船前部结构造成的压力远超最初预期。工程检查发现，从挂载部主要锚点向外延伸的应力裂纹已扩散至周围的船体装甲板。

在损伤得到解决之前，方舟舰的结构强度无法安全支持高速机动。因此，航行部门已实施严格的速度限制，以防止裂纹进一步扩大。

我们可以尝试进行快速现场维修以稳固受损部位，或者指派一艘后勤船进行全面的结构大修。
excerpt.en: The recently installed Spinal Mount aboard [Root.GetName] has placed greater strain on the vessel's forward structure than originally anticipated. Engineering inspections have uncovered a network of stress fractures radiating from the mount's primary anchor po

excerpt.zh: 方舟舰[Root.GetName]的报告指出，船员行为出现了一些轻微异常。个人日志显示出零星的古怪之处：对个人仪容的异常关注，为接近特定同事而定期调班，以及在公共区域下班后聚会次数的增加。这些似乎都没有干扰到舰船的运作，而且船员士气异常高涨。
excerpt.en: Reports from Arkship [Root.GetName] have flagged several minor irregularities in crew behavior. Personal logs reveal scattered oddities: unusual attention to grooming, regular shift swaps to be around specific coworkers, and an uptick in off-duty gatherings in

excerpt.zh:
鉴于来自[overlord_empire.GetName]的需求如雪花般飘来，我们的研究工作已经愈发重要了。我们的许多科学家都在与这种压力作斗争，但从中却迸发出天才的闪光和偶现的惊人突破。

其中最新的一项是来自[targeted_scientist.GetName]设计的预备在我们某个部门中进行一系列实验。唯一的问题是，在他们的每一项研究计划中都包含了对[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的活体实验。
excerpt.en:
Our research efforts grow ever more important in light of the continuous stream of demands from the [overlord_empire.GetName]. Many of our scientists struggle with this pressure, but we see glimmers of genius and the occasional amazing breakthrough.

The lates

excerpt.zh: 我们已经在[Target.GetName]上发现了一个可疑的、看上去是外星人修建的迷宫。目前对于它是怎么到那儿、为什么到那儿还没有定论。
excerpt.en: We have discovered a suspicious, seemingly alien labyrinth on [Target.GetName]. It is unclear how or why it got there.

excerpt.zh: 优先事项：使用防辐射技术以保护无人机部件，以对抗辐射。
excerpt.en: Priority: employ radiation-hardening techniques to shield drone components, making them impervious to radiation.

excerpt.zh: 我们自[From.Planet.GetName]的偏远山谷捕捉到了一束独特的信号。由于信号源离这颗星球上的任何已存在文明都十分遥远，追踪这束信号、搞清楚它的来源，或许会有特殊意义。
excerpt.en: We have picked up a unique signal from a remote valley on [From.Planet.GetName]. As the signal's source is far away from any civilization that has existed on the planet, it might be of interest to track it down and figure out where it is coming from.

excerpt.zh: 即使不依靠仪器，也可以很容易地看到[From.Planet.GetName]上存在着庞大的城市集群遗迹。显然，曾有一个高度发达的文明居住在那里，但现在已检测不到生命迹象，也不能收到符合技术社会特征的电磁信号。这颗行星似乎陷入了死寂。我们需要着陆去了解更多情况。
excerpt.en: Even without instruments, one can readily see the remains of vast conurbations down on [From.Planet.GetName]. Clearly a highly advanced civilization once dwelt there, but today there are no life signs nor electromagnetic signals consistent with a technological

excerpt.zh:
[Root.GetName]的船员在[nanite_swarm_planet.GetName]上的荒芜沙丘上探索时，第一个汇报并不出乎意料：这是一片不自然的废土，在水面以上没有任何的生命迹象。然而，这座行星的水生生命已经远远进化过了我们预期可以涉足陆地的水准。

此外，船员们还发现了一些被黄沙覆盖、外观老旧的似乎是建筑一样的东西。就在他们刚开始向这些表面上的建筑内挖掘时，一小群纳米虫群突触出现，并开始袭击研究人员。似乎这座建筑不是由沙子，而是由无数的微小纳米机器构成的！

启动以后这些虫群很快开始自我复制、唤醒越来
excerpt.en: As the [Root.GetName]s' crew explored the barren dunes of [nanite_swarm_planet.GetName], the first reports were much as expected: this is an unnatural wasteland with no signs of life above the water's surface. Yet the planet's aquatic life has evolved well pas

excerpt.zh: 一处[Root.GetName]上的地理学异常现象引起了我们的注意。一个采矿设施周围突然出现了碗状的凹地，随后我们对此展开了调查。这个凹地的特征几乎从未在冰川区以外的地方发现过，但奇怪的是：当暴露在某些电磁波段时，这个“圆凹地”的侧壁会产生共振，并且会产生花瓣状的可见光散射。调查正在进行。
excerpt.en: A geological anomaly has come to our attention on [Root.GetName]. We began surveying after a bowl-shaped depression suddenly appeared alongside a mining facility there. Features like this are almost never found outside of a glacial region, but stranger still:

excerpt.zh:
我们一在[Root.GetName]安顿下来就发现了大量的节肢类活动。具体来说，有一种叫做“密弥库蚁”的会建造聚群的微小昆虫出乎意料地数量众多。

它们的地下群落数量众多，遍布整片大陆，但目前为止还没有造成过什么问题。目前尚不清楚它们是在寻找着地表上的什么东西，或是为了躲避地下的什么东西而逃出。
excerpt.en:
Since settling on [Root.GetName], we have noted increased arthropod activity. Specifically, tiny colony-building insects designated "Myrmeku" have become unexpectedly productive.

Their underground colonies are spread across the continent in great numbers, but

excerpt.zh:
[Root.GetName]船员在[From.GetName]近距轨道发现的放射性碎片的确是一艘太空舰船的残骸。其奇特的设计和我们数据库中的任何舰船型号都不同。

我们从其损坏的电脑上回收了一些数据，其语言前所未见——因此也无从翻译。

通过对残骸进行进一步研究，科学家[Root.GetLeaderName]推测这艘名叫“科塔罗号”的舰船遭遇了导航系统故障，脱离超光速推进的位置过于接近[From.GetName]的伽马射线流。大部分船体都已被辐射撕碎，上面没有找到任何生还者。
excerpt.en:
The irradiated fragments the [Root.GetName] crew registered in close orbit of [From.GetName] are indeed the remains of a space-faring vessel. With a very distinctive design, it matches no known make on record.

We have extracted some data from the ship's damag

excerpt.zh:
[time_loop_world.GetName]正在烧尽。星球被一面护盾笼罩，它捕捉[time_loop_world.GetStarName]的辐射，将其加热至很快无法生存的温度。

在这片炽热中，一个先进的微型有鳞爬行动物文明正在疯狂地忙碌着。某种非常重要的大事似乎正在进行。可是，当紧张状态到达巅峰时，时间突然停止了，接着伸展并扭曲，直到爬行动物文明不可思议地回到了开始。

它们似乎被困在了时空循环之中，一个绝望的快进循环，从它们文明的发源开始。在仅仅数小时之内，无数个世代在变更交替，对它们注定将在炽热之中死亡
excerpt.en:
[time_loop_world.GetName] is burning up. The planet is enclosed in a shield that is capturing [time_loop_world.GetStarName]'s radiation, heating it to what will soon be uninhabitable temperatures.

In the scorching heat an advanced civilization of tiny squamat

excerpt.zh:
[impossible_organism_planet.GetName]上令人惊奇的生命迹象现已查明，是一种生存力极强的小型有机体。[Root.GetName]上的船员不知该如何对其进行分类，但其几乎不靠任何食物就能生存的能力实在令人叹为观止。考虑到该星球的年龄，这种有机体与其有毒环境可能已经斗争了几千年之久，不过这也只是我们根据现况的猜测而已。

科研官员[Root.GetLeaderName]请求对该未知有机体进行采样，以便进行研究。
excerpt.en: The surprising life readings from [impossible_organism_planet.GetName] have been attributed to a small organism of exceeding tenacity. The [Root.GetName]'s crew is unsure how to classify the lifeform, but its ability to survive, seemingly without any sustenanc

excerpt.zh:
[from.Planet.GetName]的轨道影像显示了一座破败的采矿设施，周围还有许多被遗弃已久的原始太空货船。

除了这些影像外，我们的短波通讯阵列还拾获了一个来自行星地下深处的非常微弱的求救信号。对该遗址进行更详细的研究将揭示信号的起源。
excerpt.en:
Orbital imaging of [from.Planet.GetName] has flagged a dilapidated mining facility accompanied by long abandoned rudimentary space faring cargo vessels.

Alongside these images, our shortwave communications array has picked up a very faint distress beacon eman

title.zh: 即将进行的试点：物流重构

excerpt.zh:
各种货物的运输路线是我们贸易联邦兴旺繁荣的生命线。但迄今为止，各帝国仍在容器设计、装载程序及运输管道等方面采用各自的物流标准。

为了使效率最大化，一个新的试点项目将在几年后实施——项目目标是调研并试验一种全新、具体，适用于联邦所有成员国的运输标准。

参与试点需要拥有一个至少有50点贸易额流经的恒星系。此外，设有外星贸易公司意味着更高的统计数据，所以应对其进行鼓励。

由于项目所涉范围广泛，一些开销必不可少。但这些牺牲是为了长远的利益。换句话说，也就是更多的未来利润。

联邦各成员国均被强烈鼓励参与项目。
excerpt.en:
The routing of various goods is the life-blood of our prosperous trade federation. But so far each empire has relied on their own logistic standards with regards to container design, loading procedures, and shipping pipelines.

In order to maximize efficiency,

excerpt.zh: 最近，[From.Planet.GetName]上的地陷将其地下的交通隧道网揭露了出来。这些精致的道路和复杂的信号设施已经深埋地下数百年；它们的设计与我们之前在这片太空区域所发现的一切均不相同。究竟是谁为了什么建造了它们呢？
excerpt.en: Recent cave-ins on [From.Planet.GetName] have revealed a network of underground transportation tunnels. Its elaborate archways and complex signalling equipment have lain undiscovered for centuries; their design is unlike anything else we've encountered in this

title.zh: [galactic_market_station_system.GetName]泛星系贸易市场总部被拆除

excerpt.zh: 根据[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]宪章第19条C款，只有一个会员国可以主办泛星系贸易市场。因此，市场在[galactic_market_station_system.GetName]星系的总部已经被拆除。最后一位交易员在今天不情愿地放弃了他们的岗位，哀叹这一戏剧性的——在他们看来——不必要的步骤对星系贸易造成了巨大的破坏。[global_event_country.GetCommunityOrImperium]的贸易董事会已提出陈词对该事态表示
excerpt.en: According to article 19C of the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]'s charter, only a member state may host the Galactic Market. As such, the market's headquarters in the [galactic_market_station_system.GetName] system has been dismantled. The

excerpt.zh:
随着我们继续在这个星球上净化那些肮脏的异星渣滓，我们的[GetCollectionRewardCategory]战利品收集愈发充盈。

希望这些展品能成为这个污秽星系的残骸，进一步激励我们履行誓言。
excerpt.en:
As we continue our efforts to cleanse this world of filthy xeno scum, our collection of [GetCollectionRewardCategory] trophies has grown.

May these exhibits serve as the carcass of this contaminated galaxy and further inspire us in our sworn mission.

excerpt.zh:
塞拉伦涅又浮现出了一段记忆。她想起了一座大厅，里面坐满了衣着考究的人，他们低沉而深思熟虑的语调中透着惯于发号施令者的自信。

“他们在争论，”她低声说道。“声音不大，但措辞犀利……是关于一项任务。关于一次必须保密的发射。还有其他的，还有两艘飞船和我们一起出发了。但为什么？我们到底在逃离什么？”
excerpt.en:
Another memory has surfaced for Seralune. She remembers a hall of impeccably dressed figures, their hushed, deliberate tones carrying the confidence of those used to command.

"They were arguing," she murmurs. "Not loudly, but sharply... about a mission. About

excerpt.zh:
[shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName]所预言的事件似乎降临了。一种新的街头毒品在[Root.GetName]越来越受欢迎。这种灵能化合物被称为“清醒”，来源于当地一种类似的植物。在快速眼动睡眠开始时，这种药物会刺激使用者的边缘系统，导致一种难以置信的清醒做梦的本能状态。

更重要的是，一些使用者报告说，他们在梦中被观察着，就好像有人或什么东西“越过边界”进入了他们的大脑。然而，许多人认为，与殖民生活的严酷现实相比，梦中的欢欣感更令人沉醉。不幸的是，毒品的流行导致了犯罪分销网络的
excerpt.en: It appears the event foretold by the [shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName] has arrived: a new street drug is gaining popularity on [Root.GetName]. Dubbed "Lucid", the psionic compound is derived from a local plant analog. At the onset of REM sleep, the drug s

excerpt.zh:
那些无人机所保护的是一颗被潮汐锁定的行星，一面向着夜空的黑暗与严寒，另一面则沐浴着永恒的光明。在温暖的昼半球，我们发现了一座可能曾是瓦格罗人城市的废墟。

凯德斯相信，他过往的细节可能就深埋于此，并且希望在这里的发现能够揭示这颗行星的历史。

这个遗址必须由凯德斯亲自挖掘。
excerpt.en:
The planet the drones were protecting is tidally locked, one side facing the cold darkness of space, and the other bathed in perpetual light. On the warm, light-filled half of this world we uncovered the ruins of what may be a Vagrosian city.

Keides trusts th

excerpt.zh: 这个地区奇怪的能量波动掩盖着一座巨大的海军墓地。这座由聚合物和金属组成的墓地可能藏有了解阿达卡利亚公约的重要线索。
excerpt.en: The strange energy fluctuations in this area obscured a massive naval graveyard. This necropolis of polymer and metal may harbor a vital clue to understanding the adAkkaria Convention.

excerpt.zh: 如果我们不采取措施，我们对[Target.GetName]的竭泽而渔会让当地成为一个死寂星球。我们必须决定对这个议题抱持什么态度：我们是要改变做法，还是说当下的情况是可接受的——甚至是期待中的——工业化进程中的代价？
