excerpt.en: If we take no action, our exploitation of [Target.GetName] will rapidly render it a Tomb World. We must decide where we stand on this issue: will we have to change our ways, or is this an acceptable - or even desirable - price of industrial progress?

excerpt.zh: [From.Planet.System.GetName]恒星系中孤零零的这颗行星上住满了无人机。它们对我们毫不关心，各自匆匆忙忙做着自己的事情。如果关于这个奇怪的星系有什么线索的话一定能在那里找到。
excerpt.en: The sole planet in the [From.Planet.System.GetName] system is bustling with drones. Heedless of us, they continue to perform their tasks. If the answers to this curious system are to be found anywhere, it is here.

excerpt.zh:
我们在星球各地都发现了水的迹象。据我们所知，这些水应该还在这颗星球上。星球温度在液态水存在的正常范围内，并且星球仍然存在大气，尽管很脆弱。然而，这里的一切都是干燥的，存在的植被也枯死了。

此外，扫描还揭示了行星上另一个星际文明的踪迹。考古团队将有两个目标：找出水发生了什么，并了解其他星际旅者在这里做了什么。大多数假设已经将两者联系起来，团队中的一些人认为这可能是“偷水贼”干的。
excerpt.en: We have found signs of water all over this world. For all we know, it should still be here. The temperatures are within the normal range for liquid water to exist, and there is still an atmosphere, albeit tenuous. And yet, everything here is dry and what veget

excerpt.zh: 对巨型小行星[From.GetName]的扫描得出了有趣的结果。这块岩石的核心里含有携带微弱电流的导电晶体网络。[Root.GetName]上的成员辨认出这片晶体网络与原始神经网络具有相似性，认为就算该天体并不具有完全智能，也能进行某种程度的思考。他们请求将核心取出，并带到最近的轨道站以进行更仔细的研究。
excerpt.en: A scan of the particularly massive asteroid [From.GetName] yields fascinating results. The rock's core is shot through with a network of conductive crystals carrying a weak electric charge. The crew on the [Root.GetName] recognize this matrix as a primitive ne

excerpt.zh:
经过缜密研究之后，[Root.GetName]的成员探测到了一个“微弱”的回声正在从[From.GetName]的地底深处传来。

这种回声有点像是生命体发出的。可是我们与它的距离实在是太远了，很难分辨它是真的，还是只是一台发出随机信号的设备。科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]的手下一直在抱怨说自己得不到适当的休息，工作时间又太长，自己再也受不了了。
excerpt.en:
After rigorous research, the crew of [Root.GetName] has only been able to detect a faint "echo" emanating deep beneath the surface of [From.GetName].

The echo resembles a life signature, however it is so distant it is hard to tell if it is real or just the in

excerpt.zh:
我们在[desertling_planet.GetName]上发现了生命。没有智慧的小型哺乳动物群遍布在整个行星表面。

我们的科学家将它们标记为“沙生兽”，它们的数量正以惊人的速度增加。这个行星已经超出了它的承载能力，生态系统正在迅速恶化。
excerpt.en:
We have found life on [desertling_planet.GetName]. Vast non-sapient herds of small mammals roam across the entire planetary surface.

Their population, labeled 'desertlings' by our scientists, is increasing at an alarming rate. The planet is already beyond its

excerpt.zh: [from.planet.GetName]上辽阔的冰冻荒原曾一度遍布汪洋，水面之下处处是深海火山峡谷。尽管其环境已经无法继续支持生命，我们还是在一处靠近地表的冰封堑道内发现了一些年代久远的水下定居点。
excerpt.en: The vast, frozen wastelands of [from.planet.GetName] were once seas, spread atop an abundance of deep volcanic canyons. Though the environment is no longer capable of supporting life, we have detected the ruins of ancient submarine settlements in icebound tren

excerpt.zh:
我们在[Root.GetName]上的殖民地进行的例行生态研究中，偶然发现了一种奇怪的真菌生命形式。科学小组报告说，菌丝体的表面闪闪发光，色彩斑斓，但最让他们感兴趣的是，每当大范围内发生某些事情时，不同的蘑菇群似乎在相互交流。

此外，生物体的生物特征似乎与殖民地的生态系统明显不同。当地科学团队相当困惑，并要求提供专业支持，因为我们可能正在处理一种有感知力的物种。
excerpt.en: A routine ecological study of our colony on [Root.GetName] has stumbled upon a strange fungal lifeform. The science team reports that the surface of the mycelium is shimmering and colorful, but what was most intriguing to them was the fact that separate cluste

excerpt.zh:
[Root.GetName]上的神秘机器人对我们的殖民者从一落足于行星上起就非常欢迎。我们的许多定居者一开始不信任这个小机器人，但它对我们建立殖民地的过程难以置信地有帮助，并且在其中扮演了重要角色。

在头几年的殖民过程中，这个小东西在[Root.GetName]上的第一座城市诞生了衍生形象，并成为了整颗行星的吉祥物。
excerpt.en: The enigmatic creature on [Root.GetName] has been very welcoming to our colonists after they settled down on the planet. At first many of our settlers were distrustful of the small robot, but it has shown itself to be incredibly helpful and has played a key ro

excerpt.zh: 在[Root.GetName]上的地质勘探揭示了这颗行星远比我们之前预想的更加富有矿藏。在调节了我们的传感器以后它便可以扫描更深的地下，发现了许多大有前景的矿场。我们应该委派更多的人力物力进行勘探，或许可以发现更深处的有用矿脉。
excerpt.en: Geological surveys on [Root.GetName] have revealed that the planet is richer in minerals than we thought. After calibrating our sensors to penetrate deeper into the ground, we have discovered several promising mining sites. Should we direct additional resource

excerpt.zh: 在最近的一场降雨中，殖民者注意到了[Root.GetName]的表面出现了一些金属泥潭。这些泥潭具有很大的黏度，如同液态金属一般。
excerpt.en: After a recent rainfall, colonists have noticed metallic puddles appearing on the surface of [Root.GetName]. These puddles have a viscous consistency, like liquid metal.

excerpt.zh:
[planet.GetName]上传回的最新消息称我们对行星废弃物管理能力的计算发生了错误。大量的垃圾场融合在一起，形成了一片无法通行的废土，一直延伸到行星人口中心的边缘。

当地人开始大规模地将这些垃圾发射到轨道上，不过这也只是缓兵之计。
excerpt.en: The latest report from [planet.GetName] informs us that we have miscalculated the planet's waste management capabilities. Massive dumpsites have merged to form a single, impassable wasteland, one that stretches to the very edge of the planet's population cente

excerpt.zh: 日前，[Root.GetName]上涌现出大量的[Owner.GetColonistPlural]失踪事件。这些人唯一的共同点就是他们在失踪时都孤身一人。随着消息散播开来，人们对于失踪的恐惧随之降临。民众的惶恐不安对殖民地的日常运作带来了极大的麻烦。
excerpt.en: Recently, numerous [Owner.GetColonistPlural] have gone missing on [Root.GetName]. The only discernible pattern is that each was alone at the time of their disappearance. As news began to spread, a collective fear of going unescorted has gripped the colony. Thi

excerpt.zh:
现在，[planet.GetName]上重要的殖民工作已经完成，[Root.Owner.GetName][Owner.GetScientistPlural]开始将注意力转向这个行星上的高耸尖塔。

这些矿物构成的结构似乎完全中空，将行星地壳下方的气体一路传输到大气热层。并且由于某些未知的原因，这些气体还吸引着缇扬奇以及其他太空生物，让它们长途跋涉来到这颗星球。

我们如果能够对这种星球奇观开展一次彻底的研究，就能加深我们对于这些奇幻现象的了解。当然了，我们也可以想个方法来收集这些稀有的气体。
excerpt.en:
Now that crucial colonization efforts of [planet.GetName] have been completed, [Root.Owner.GetName] [Owner.GetScientistPlural] have turned their attention towards its lofty spires.

These mineral formations appear to be entirely hollow, transporting gaseous su

excerpt.zh:
我们从[This.GetName]星系接收到了一些奇怪的报告。显然，上一场在该星域肆虐的宇宙风暴把一艘不知来处的舰船卷了出来。这艘船没有呼号，它不知怎么地穿过了暴风雨，仿佛完全没受周围风暴的影响。

这艘船没有回应我们的呼叫，风暴消散后，它也消失得无影无踪了。这可能是由于风暴对仪器的干扰，但是肉眼观测却毋庸置疑地表明了真相。

这其中可能潜藏着极为先进的科技，还是说发生了某些不祥的事情？我们会时刻盯着这艘神秘舰船，直到它再次出现。
excerpt.en: We are receiving strange reports from the [This.GetName] system. Apparently, the last cosmic storm raging in that sector revealed a ship of unknown origin. Bearing no call sign, it somehow cruised through the tempest as if entirely unaffected by the surroundin

excerpt.zh:
[Root.GetName]在[From.GetName]的轨道上有了惊人的发现。该星球上每单位空间内的量子叠加态数量，超出了至今为止被认为是可能数量的上限。

科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]提议称[From.GetName]，这颗被[Root.Leader.GetSheHe]命名为面纱的星球，同时存在于两个维度：我们的维度，以及另一个未知维度。

不仅如此，星球周围粒子场中的量子态数量仍在稳定增长。目前没有确凿的理论可以解释这一现象。[Root.GetLeaderName]假设灵能——

通讯变
excerpt.en:
The [Root.GetName] has made an incredible discovery in orbit of [From.GetName]. The planet possesses a hitherto thought impossible number of superimposed quantum states per unit of space.

Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] suggests [From.GetName], which [Ro

excerpt.zh:
在对[From.GetName]周围的残骸场进行细致扫描后，我们发现了一颗气密胶囊，里面有一只计时无比精确的原子钟。

它的频率不确定性低到需要再花八亿七千九百万年才会增加一秒，而且正在朝一个四十二年零三天后的日期倒计时。胶囊里没有记载这个日期代表着什么，或者其主人是谁。不过似乎有人失去时间概念了……
excerpt.en:
A closer scan of the debris field around [From.GetName] has led to the discovery of an airtight capsule containing an atomic clock that measures time with unparalleled precision.

It has a frequency uncertainty so low that it will be another 879 million years

excerpt.zh: 对[From.Planet.GetName]详细的调查揭示了一些属于曾经遍布整个行星的文明的微弱信号。
excerpt.en: A closer look at [From.Planet.GetName] shows small signs of a civilization that once populated the planet.

excerpt.zh:
我们在[from.target.capital_scope.GetName]的特工以先进的知识武装头脑，已经渗透了当地的大学，凭借着开创性的理论确立了自己作为杰出思想家的地位。然而，此人不断取得的成功却遭到了当地学者的质疑：许多人拒绝与此人接触，指责其为骗子。

无休止的学术争吵阻碍了我们的特工传播新思想。我们的间谍首脑正在请求进一步的指示。
excerpt.en: Armed with our superior knowledge, our operatives on [from.target.capital_scope.GetName] have infiltrated local universities, establishing themselves as brilliant thinkers known for their ground-breaking theories. Their rising success, though, has been met wit

excerpt.zh: 从[This.ContactCountry.GetName]信号中读取的信息让我们的[Owner.GetLinguists]及其兴奋。尽管这其中没有一个音节是我们能够识别的，但不可否认的是，声音本身是有韵律的，而且听起来莫名地令人感到舒缓。虽然我们无法确定，但[Owner.GetLinguists]坚信这是一首诗歌，对方是在友善地回应我们。
excerpt.en: The readings from the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] signals have caused our [Owner.GetLinguists] a great deal of excitement. While not a single syllable is intelligible, the sounds themselves are undeniably rhythmical, and indeed curiously soothing. Although w

excerpt.zh:
数字产业正在蓬勃发展。从模拟第一人称冒险的刺激到在数字度假胜地的放松，虚拟娱乐从未如此引人入胜、令人上瘾。虽然这个新兴产业代表着一类关键的经济驱动力，但随着人们在数字乌托邦中花费的时间越来越多，现实世界的生产已经开始受到影响。有些人面临着与“真实”生活完全失去联系的危险，但仍然可以通过参与数字经济为社会做出贡献。

我们是应该禁止令人上瘾的虚拟世界，将其作为一种新的赚钱娱乐形式加以推广，还是通过监管找到一个折中方案？
excerpt.en: Digital industry is booming. From the thrill of simulating a first person adventure to relaxing on a digital resort, virtual entertainment has never been more engaging - or as addictive. While this burgeoning industry represents a key economic driver, producti

excerpt.zh:
完全虚拟化带来了诸多问题，尤其是基础设施调整所必需的能源需求激增。

这些问题也被一些好处所弥补，例如对实体住房需求的下降。无人机劳力的管理和效率会随着我们操作日益完善而走向完美。

在所有可行的选项中，虚拟化是最具有变革性的。

潜力：前所未有；无边无际；未知。
excerpt.en:
Complete virtualization entails a number of issues, notably a surge in energy demands necessitated by the infrastructural adjustments.

This is counterbalanced by several of advantages, including a decline in the demand for physical housing. Management and eff

excerpt.zh: 我们已经编纂了一份列表，上面包含对[root.target.GetName]友好的帝国。我们的特工会在这些帝国直接制造裂痕。
excerpt.en: We have compiled a list of those empires who appear friendliest to the [root.target.GetName]. Our operatives will drive a wedge between these empires.

excerpt.zh:
一群青少年在游荡于方舟舰人迹罕至的区域时，发现了一个松动的金属检修面板。打开面板后，他们进入了方舟舰[Root.GetName]中一个未被记录的次级甲板区域。在此后的几个小时里，内部追踪系统和环境监测系统均无法探测到这群青少年的踪迹。

当他们返回时，这些年轻的探险者表现出明显的心理和生理创伤迹象。有些人一直在胡言乱语与近乎木僵的状态之间反复切换。然而，尽管经过多次尝试，他们都拒绝提供任何关于此次事件经历的陈述。

专家认为，无论在那个次级甲板层区域发生了什么，其严重程度都足以使其被刻意从所有记录中抹除。
excerpt.en: While straying in one of the Arkship's less-frequented sections, a group of juveniles identified a dislodged metallic access panel. Opening it, they entered an undocumented sub-level of Arkship [Root.GetName]. For several hours thereafter, the group ceased to

excerpt.zh:
最近的报告显示，一种侵入性真菌物种已蔓延至方舟舰[Root.GetName]的整个水培甲板。该生物似乎在方舟舰农业系统受控的湿度和营养丰富的基质中茁壮成长，在多个生产层级形成了密集的菌丝网络。

遏制措施已被证明无效，因为该真菌对标准的除草处理没有产生可测量的反应。我们怀疑该物种可能已迅速适应了飞船的封闭生态系统。如果不加以控制，此次爆发可能会显著降低粮食产量，并对方舟舰有限的农业生产能力造成额外压力。
excerpt.en: Recent reports indicate that an invasive fungal species has spread throughout the hydroponics decks of Arkship [Root.GetName]. The organism appears to thrive in the controlled humidity and nutrient-rich substrates of the arkship's agricultural systems, forming

excerpt.zh:
发现了我们在他们的[GetPreFTLLower]星球上的行动后，[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上的许多[pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesName]国家暂时放下彼此间的争吵，共同组建了一个跨国界军事组织。

根据当地媒体报道，这个特遣组织的主要责任是保卫他们的[pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]免受“未知外星势力针对[pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesName]全体的敌对活动”。
excerpt.en:
In an apparent response to our operations on their [GetPreFTLLower] world, many of the [pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesName] nation states on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] have momentarily put aside their squabbling to form a new supranational military organization.

Ac

excerpt.zh:
我们对[From.GetName]社会价值的转变工作正在向着利于我们的方向发展，并取得了不错的成果。
[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的几大帝国在中心集权方面获得重大进展，行政力量集中在少数有实力的领袖手中。低效的狂躁大众统治正在渐渐淡出他们的社会。
excerpt.en:
Our efforts to shift the societal values of the [From.GetName] in a direction favored by us have produced favorable results.
The [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have made great strides in centralizing their various planetary governments, with political power redir

excerpt.zh:
一艘载满了来自[shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName]的流亡侍僧的运输船同我们进行了联络。他们称自己为“变革派”，要求在我们的某颗星球上进行难民庇护。

这一事件意味着虚境行者内部发生了前所未有的大分裂。看来，太空城邦也没有我们想象中的那么团结。
excerpt.en:
We have been contacted by a transport ship carrying a number of exiled acolytes from the [shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName]. Calling themselves 'Reformers', they are requesting refuge on one of our worlds.

This represents an unprecedented schism within th

excerpt.zh: 在一颗被风暴毁灭的星球中埋葬于废墟之下的庇护所：外部的残破使其难以调查，但内部似乎还是完好的。
excerpt.en: A shelter buried under the debris of a storm-ravaged world; the devastation is making it hard to investigate, but the interior appears intact.

excerpt.zh: 尽管宇宙风暴一般是破坏性的，但这场风暴却成为发现外星文明存在证据的契机。尽管这颗行星的大气极不稳定，然而登陆队可能会揭示这个古老文化的可怕命运。
excerpt.en: As destructive as cosmic storms can be, this one uncovered evidence an alien civilization. Though the planet's atmosphere is incredibly unstable, a landing party might reveal whatever horrible fate befell this ancient culture.

excerpt.zh:
在虚境内外，我们[GetFeelLoc]到了一种强大的力量共鸣。祂们的影响力弥漫到了整个灵能界。

我们可以光凭自己的行为向其调和靠近，但是还有一种资源可以利用。只要利用泽珞的力量，我们的[GetTelepathPlural]将能直接接触到这些实体。

我们只需要决定好寻求哪一位即可。
excerpt.en:
Throughout the Shroud, we can [GetFeelLoc] the resonance of vast powers. Their influence permeates the psionic realm.

Our actions alone can attune us closer to them, but there is another recourse. By tapping into the power of zro, our [GetTelepathPlural] can

title.en: Contact Report: Simple Forms of Life

excerpt.zh:
[Root.GetName]新闻满天飞，内容都是关于不久前发现的外星生物。

自从在[Root.Capital.GetName]之外发现了造物的奇迹，[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]神秘学家们不断举办神秘仪式，试图得到更多的答案。
excerpt.en:
The [Root.GetName] is abuzz with news of the alien organisms discovered some time ago.

[Root.GetSpeciesAdj] theologians have been partaking in arcane rites since this first sign that divine providence extends outside of [Root.Capital.GetName], attempting to f

excerpt.zh:
[Root.GetName]发现有个体型智慧生命居住在[from.GetName]。考虑到缺乏共生智能的指导，这种[presapient_species.GetSpeciesClass]物种已经达到了对环境的显著控制程度。

我们会继续密切关注这种生物的发展，也许有一天将其并入我们。这些生物的出现预示着[from.GetName]觉醒的潜质。
excerpt.en: The [Root.GetName] has discovered individualistic, presapient life dwelling on [from.GetName]. This [presapient_species.GetSpeciesClass] species has achieved a remarkable degree of mastery over its environment already, considering the lack of a Mutualistic Int

excerpt.zh:
[From.Planet.GetName]出土了一座埋藏了数千年的损坏空间站。这座精湛的建筑曾维持着数百万人的生存，他们的尸体现在就保存在空间站内，探索该建筑庞大的内部实在是一种令人毛骨悚然的工作。

虽然我们的科学家还没有确定这些人死亡的原因，但可以确定的是，他们在空间站损坏之前就已经死亡。有些人死相平静，死的时候手里抓着小型雕像；另一些人手里拿着武器，死前遭受了暴力伤害。
excerpt.en: A crashed alien space station has been unearthed on [From.Planet.GetName] after being buried for many millennia. The masterful construction previously held a self-contained arthropoid civilization of millions. Their dead bodies have been preserved within the s

excerpt.zh: [From.Planet.GetPlanetMoon]的表面在受到一艘星际飞船的猛烈撞击后，凹陷出一个小峡谷。这艘飞船的残骸仍然可以在峡谷底部找到。虽然撞击肯定发生在亿万年前，但残骸似乎相当完好。派遣一支考古探险队将能了解更多信息。
excerpt.en: A small canyon of sorts has been carved onto the surface of this [From.Planet.GetPlanetMoon] by the violent impact of a starship. What remains of the vessel can still be found on the canyon floor. Although the crash must have occurred eons ago, the wreckage ap

excerpt.zh: [From.Planet.GetName]行星的表面没有任何生命。然而，有迹象表明这里先前存在繁荣的生物圈，加之此处有趣的地壳活动，我们需要对其进行更深入的调查。
excerpt.en: The surface of [From.Planet.GetName] is devoid of all life. However, there are indications of a previously thriving biosphere, and some interesting tectonic activity which may warrant a closer look.

excerpt.zh: 我们的调查船扫描了[From.Planet.GetName]并探测到一些值得进一步观测的人造结构。令人不安的是，那里没有任何人口存在的迹象。
excerpt.en: Our survey ship has scanned [From.Planet.GetName] and detected some artificial structures worth a closer look. Unnervingly, there are no signs of any population down there.

title.en: Delve into the Secrets of the Vultaum

excerpt.zh: 我们的科学家将仔细地对我们收集到的数据进行筛选，探求沃陶姆的知识并为我们所用。
excerpt.en: Our scientists will carefully sift through all of the data we have collected, seeking to add the knowledge of the Vultaum to our own.

excerpt.zh: 一层厚厚的玻璃和金属覆盖在这颗原本贫瘠的行星上，或许暗示着它过去发生了某种灾难性事件。
excerpt.en: A thick layer of glass and metal covers this otherwise barren planet, perhaps hinting at some sort of cataclysmic event in its past.

excerpt.zh: 我们发现了一艘古老的外星人星舰，它被半掩埋在一个小行星撞击坑中间。冰晶布满了舰身的大部分，但我们还是很顺利地发现了气阀门……并开始搜索这艘船暗藏的秘密。
excerpt.en: We have discovered an ancient alien starship lying half-buried in an asteroid crater. Glacial ice has inexorably spread across most of the ship, but we can easily access the airlock... and search for any secrets hidden behind it.

excerpt.zh: 整个[From.Planet.GetName]的地表遍布死亡缇扬奇的遗骸。我们的传感器没有检测到生命的信号，然而这些尸体仍然在不停地蠕动，仿佛有什么看不见的力在驱动这些尸体一样。
excerpt.en: The surface of [From.Planet.GetName] is entirely covered in the remains of dead Tiyanki. Our sensors detect no signs of life, and yet the corpses still writhe and squirm, as if animated by some inscrutable force.

excerpt.zh:
我们的科学家在[From.Planet.GetName]发现了一些奇怪的东西。作为一颗热带星球，其表面大片区域被茂密的丛林覆盖：巨大的、寿达千年的古树从林冠中突兀而起，它们枝叶茂密的树冠俯瞰着其他陆上景观。

初看起来，这些参天大树的分布似乎杂乱无章。然而，更详细的分析表明这些树的分布具有数学精准性，也许是由某个消失已久的文明所种植的。不仅如此，团队领袖相信，树木的分布方式可能包含着一组坐标，指向丛林深处某个未被探索的区域。
excerpt.en:
Our scientists have discovered something unusual on [From.Planet.GetName]. A tropical world, much of the planet's surface is covered with dense jungle: massive, thousand year old trees erupt from the canopy, their leafy crowns towering over the landscape.

At

excerpt.zh: 一块铝板被发现于[From.GetName]周围漂浮的碎石中，它的阳极化表面使它从周围的金属残骸中脱颖而出。它上面绘有两只模样滑稽的哺乳动物，还有一些无趣的几何形状。
excerpt.en: An aluminum plaque is found drifting among the detritus around [From.GetName], its anodized surface standing out from the metal debris surrounding it. It depicts two ridiculous-looking mammalian figures and some rather tasteless geometric shapes.

excerpt.zh:
该轨道站似乎曾作为小行星的矿物开采与加工中心使用，设计上与我们的开采站有些许相似。

科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]认为派出几位工程师——最好是已经驻扎在飞船上的[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]——也许就可以使其恢复运转。
excerpt.en:
The orbital station appears to have once functioned as a mineral extraction and processing center for the asteroid, not wholly dissimilar from our own mining station designs.

Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] expects that a handful of engineers - ideally [

excerpt.zh:
我们对希洛士残骸场的扫描已经完成。其化学结构同时具备生物和非生物性质，我们从未见过类似的东西。

这片残骸与在此恒星系中巡逻的奇怪船只间有何关联仍然模糊不清。船上没有生命迹象。事实上，我们探测不到任何种类的能量特征。姑且来说就是，我们在幽灵船面前栽跟头了。
excerpt.en:
Our scans of the debris field in Hillos are complete. Possessing both organic and abiogenic properties, the chemical structure is unlike anything we've ever seen.

The connection between the debris and the strange vessel patrolling the system remains unclear.

excerpt.zh: 一座环绕着[From.Planet.MoonOf.GetName]的废弃观测站。从中可以一窥在这个行星上的前超光速的夏瑞诺伊文明的起源。
excerpt.en: An abandoned observation outpost orbits [From.Planet.MoonOf.GetName]. It may shed some light on the origins of the pre-FTL Charynoi civilization on the planet below.

excerpt.zh:
我们在[From.Planet.GetName]上发现了一座古城的废墟。通过它的大小和规模发现它很可能是一个星际文明的首都或主要空间居住地。

为了了解这座废墟的起源，我们需要全面挖掘。
excerpt.en:
We've discovered the ruins of an ancient city on [From.Planet.GetName]. Given its size and scale, this was likely the capital or central administrative hub of a major space-faring civilization.

A full excavation will be necessary to properly determine its ori

excerpt.zh: [Root.GetName]殖民者发起的地质勘探发现了位于山脉内部的巨型避难所。所有证据都指出这个辐射避难所的建造者就是在[Root.GetPlanetMoon]发起古代核战的种群。避难所已封闭了数个世纪，但勘探仪器显示内部发出了微弱的信号。科学家们迫不及待想打开避难所大门，看看后面藏着什么。
excerpt.en: Geological surveys conducted by our colonists on [Root.GetName] have revealed a massive vault buried deep inside a mountain range. All evidence points towards this being some kind of fallout shelter built by the same species that perished in the [Root.GetPlane

excerpt.zh:
这只生物自被发现以来就展现出极大的影响力，激发了我们的爱意和投喂欲。四只鼓起的泡泡般的眼睛展现着它的纯真，吸引所有人前来撸它那柔顺如云的毛发。它似乎很亲近[Root.GetLeaderName]，大部分时间都呆在[Leader.GetHisHer]的膝盖上，享受着[Leader.GetHisHer]的宠爱，没有展现出任何攻击或是危险动作，就好像是被特意设计成这副无害的模样。

尽管如此，一些人质疑，在未经事先批准的情况下，将一种以前未发现的生物留在船上是不负责任的。[Root.GetLeaderName]则保证它大
excerpt.en: From the moment the creature was discovered, its impact was undeniable, inspiring love and devotion among us almost instantaneously. Its four bulging eyes displayed innocence and invited anyone to stroke its soft, cloud-like fur. It seems particularly attached

excerpt.zh: 我们的扫描仪探测到该星球的一个区域不断发出一些有趣的信号。经分析，那里很有可能存在古代文明的遗迹正等着我们去发现。
excerpt.en: Our scanners picked up a series of intriguing signals coming from this area of the planet. Based on their composition, it's highly likely there is a remnant of an ancient civilization waiting to be uncovered there.

excerpt.zh:
通过进一步观察[molluscoid_miners_planet.GetName]我们发现，其表面的房屋状结构是一种软体动物的家园。这些房屋都处于十分原始的状态，由土壤混合类似分辨的分泌物建造而成。

这种软体动物具有半智能和有限的智力。除生存之外，其社会与生活主要以发掘矿物为主。发掘出的矿物则会进行展示，提升发掘者的社会地位。

然而，他们探测矿物位置的方式目前尚不明确，科研官员[Root.GetLeaderName]被他们探知大量矿藏的能力深深震撼。

虽然这些软体动物的科学技术与几乎全部其他方面均比我们落后许
excerpt.en:
A closer look at [molluscoid_miners_planet.GetName] has shown that its hut-like structures are home to a molluscoid species. The huts are crude shelters, built out of soil and quasi-fecal excretions.

The molluscoids appear semi-sapient with limited intelligen

excerpt.zh:
对[From.GetName]高空轨道的高速物体进行扫描的尝试失败了。物体很快便从视野中消失，而科研船的各项仪器根本无法跟上它的速度。

虽然[From.GetName]的引力强度很大，但该物体的移动速度依旧令人难以置信。要么是这个物体本身带有什么非凡属性，要么就是引力的奇迹造成了这一奇景。

物体的速度似乎正在逐渐增加，科研官员[Root.GetLeaderName]认为就算没有外界干预，该物体也很可能即将被抛出轨道。
excerpt.en:
Attempts to scan the object in high-speed orbit of [From.GetName] have been unsuccessful. The object quickly falls below [From.GetName]'s horizon and the [Root.GetName]'s instruments are simply unable to keep up.

While [From.GetName]'s gravitational pull is s

excerpt.zh: [from.Planet.GetName]的表面几乎完全被一些整齐排列的圆形小池塘覆盖。这种规整的网格表明它们可能是精心设计的而非自然形成。现场调查可能带来更多的解答。
excerpt.en: [from.Planet.GetName]'s surface is almost entirely covered by a lattice grid of small, circular, liquid-filled pools. Their neat alignment suggests deliberate engineering rather than natural formation. A field expedition may provide more answers.

excerpt.zh:
第一次与外星物种接触后，人民日益焦虑于社会可能将发生剧变，导致[this.GetName]各地爆发出了游行示威。示威者质疑长久以来的传统，挑战治理的基础，并要求适应这一启示重塑的未来。

尽管这些运动是非暴力的，但其规模却给公共服务带来了巨大压力，扰乱了日常生活。然而，许多公民并不认为这些抗议活动仅仅是骚乱而已。他们认为这是一种清算，表明我们正眼睁睁地见证自己的身份在被改写。
excerpt.en: Protests have erupted across [this.GetName], driven by a growing anxiety over the perceived transformation of our society following first contact with an alien species. Demonstrators question long-standing traditions, challenge the foundations of governance, a

excerpt.zh: 色彩鲜艳的卷须状云团聚集在我国首都星系周围。我们的盟友报告称在他们首都也出现了类似效应。是什么导致了这些现象？
excerpt.en: Brightly-colored tendrils of cloud have gathered around the starbase in our capital system. Our allies report similar effects at their capitals. What's causing these phenomena?

excerpt.zh:
我们发现[From.GetName]被完全包裹在某种能源屏障之中。[Root.GetName]所有用传感器穿透屏障的尝试都失败了——扫描光束被偏转回来，仿佛面对着一面镜子。

屏障的能源读数已经爆表，用纯粹的火力来突破是不可能的。科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]提出了一个特殊项目来研究清除屏障的方法……如果它是用来封锁内部而非阻拦外人的话，移除屏障倒是有相当大的危险。
excerpt.en: [From.GetName] has been found to be completely enveloped in some kind of energy barrier. All attempts by the [Root.GetName] to penetrate the barrier with its sensors have failed - the scanning beam is simply deflected back at the ship, as though it was looking

excerpt.zh:
[hiver_system.GetName]恒星系是一种具有独特性质的异常密集小行星环带的家乡。一些大型的小行星表面覆盖着突出的结晶，似乎是非常丰富的矿物矿藏。

然而，远程传感器正在追踪几个小型的、无法识别的可能是宇宙飞船的物体的零星运动，它们位于环带中的密度较大的区域。我们无法准确对其定位，但我们已经确定了至少两个被摧毁的采矿站的碎片，它们漂浮在一些较大小行星附近的太空中。
excerpt.en:
The [hiver_system.GetName] system is home to an unusually dense asteroid belt with unique properties. Several of the larger asteroids are covered in crystalline outcroppings that appear to be extremely rich mineral deposits.

However, long-range sensors are tr

excerpt.zh: 载有大量[marauder_neighbor_species.GetName]难民的运输船从[marauder_neighbor.GetName]方向进入了我们的领域。他们肯定是被人从一个个残破的空间站—那些他们曾称之为家园的地方赶出来了，大概是因为资源有限而采取的控制人口的措施。已经允许他们在[Root.GetName]安定下来。
excerpt.en: Transports carrying a large number of [marauder_neighbor_species.GetName] refugees have crossed into our space from the direction of the [marauder_neighbor.GetName]. These exiles have apparently been expelled from the decrepit space stations they once called h

excerpt.zh: 在环形世界施工管事出色的领导下，我们能将建造流程最优化，显著加快了建造速度。
excerpt.en: Under the skillful leadership of the ring world construction manager, we have been able to optimize the construction workflow, increasing the build speed significantly.

excerpt.zh:
终于，星海参议院投票通过授予[custodian.GetName]紧急监管权。在一个向全星系广播的官方典礼上，我们被任命为星海共同体监管人。

作为同侪之首，我们负责保卫星海共同体的安全，抵御一切来自内部或外部的潜在威胁。我们在整个共同体的各项事务上被赋予了极大的权力，并且可以提出特殊的议案。
excerpt.en:
At last, the Galactic Senate has voted to bestow emergency Custodianship powers upon the [custodian.GetName]. In an official ceremony broadcast across the galaxy, we were appointed Custodians of the Galactic Community.

As the first among equals, we have been

excerpt.zh:
这是崭新秩序的黎明。腐朽的星海共同体已经被解散，取而代之的是[Root.GetGalEmpireName]的崛起。在宣布我们对这一新的泛星系政权有无可置疑的地位之后，我们现在又被称为[Root.GetName]。

在一个面向全星系广播的极具奢华的加冕仪式上，在[Root.Capital.GetName]，[ruler.GetRegnalName]被加冕为[Root.GetRulerTitle]，于是一个新的帝国王朝开始了。

[Root.GetRulerTitle]万岁！帝国万岁！
excerpt.en:
It is the dawn of a New Order. The old Galactic Community has been dismantled, and in its place the [Root.GetGalEmpireName] has risen. After claiming our rightful place on the throne of this new pan galactic state, we are now known as the [Root.GetName].

In a

excerpt.zh:
在从[event_target:contract_issuer.GetName]装载物资时，我们检测到其中一个货舱发生了收容失效。据报告，安全门另一侧传来了低沉的轰鸣声，证实了舱室内存在潜在危险。

我们要冒险进行调查吗？
excerpt.en: While loading materials from the [event_target:contract_issuer.GetName], we detected a containment breach in one of the cargo bays. Deep rumbling noises were reported from the other side of the security doors, confirming the presence of a potential hazard with

excerpt.zh:
长程传感器检测到一个大体积的无法鉴别身份的中空残骸突然出现的[floating_shell_system.GetName]星系。尽管我们对其设计很陌生，这个物体的组成成分中含有稀有的矿物，显示其建造过程中使用了先进的科技。物体的内侧表面包含了几百个接口和附着点，显然是为缺失的部分预留的。

就如同这个物体是随机地出现在[floating_shell_system.GetName]星系一样，它的内部部分就好像单纯地消失了一样。
excerpt.en: Long-range sensors have detected the sudden appearance of an unidentified chunk of hollow debris in the [floating_shell_system.GetName] system. While alien in design, the object's rare-mineral composition suggests the use of advanced technology in its construc

excerpt.zh:
一个规模庞大的老兵代表团致信，要求离开当地前往位于[subject_empire.Capital.GetName]的殖民地——此地也是我们的附庸[subject_empire.GetName]的首都。随信件附上的还有一笔礼金，用于“使官僚的齿轮运转更为润滑”，他们这样委婉地表述道。

似乎在我们的老兵中间流传着许多这样的故事，讲述一个人前往这些恒星系是如何在冒险中发了大财——或是作为雇佣兵，或是作为海盗。无论是哪一种，很显然这些老兵掏出了自己的家底进行众筹，希望能够通过前往[subject_empire.Capit
excerpt.en: A large contingent of our veterans has sent a letter requesting leave to travel to the colony at [subject_empire.Capital.GetName], the capital of our vassal [subject_empire.GetName]. Included with the letter is a gift of credits to "grease the wheels of bureau

excerpt.zh:
多亏了我们与[overlord_empire.GetName]的许多交易，我们已经能够集中精力建立和改善帝国的内部工作。在我们的科学家和工程师们的努力工作下，我们看到我们的殖民地在过去几年里蓬勃发展。人们在几年前还以为是幻想的事情，突然之间不仅变成了现实，而且变得司空见惯。

我们收到消息，我们在[overlord_empire.GetName]的长官想亲自看看我们的最新进展，并有可能把其中一些带回他们的祖国。
excerpt.en: Thanks to our many deals with [overlord_empire.GetName], we have been able to focus much of our efforts on building and improving the internal workings of our empire. With our scientists and engineers hard at work, we have seen our colonies blossom these last

excerpt.zh:
随着巨像完成其毁天灭地的任务，[From.From.GetName]因受到[From.GetName]地壳破裂与磁层分解的猛烈冲击而产生的微微晃动也平息了下来。

我们很难理解一颗星球死亡时的那种壮烈，但[From.GetName]炽热的核心在冰冷宇宙中冷却时的那种死亡之美是无可争辩的。
excerpt.en:
The [From.From.GetName]'s gentle rocking - buffeted by [From.GetName]'s rupturing crust and unraveling magnetosphere - subsides as the Colossus completes its cataclysmic task.

The sheer violence of a dying planet is difficult to comprehend, but the funereal b

excerpt.zh: 在局部扰动抑制器的控制台中保存着一个数据信号。虽然有些难度，但我们能复制它的模式，并且在全星系中搜寻匹配。航迹引向了一颗不可宜居的星球。是时候弄明白因内特贸易体瞄准着什么，以及为什么瞄准了。
excerpt.en: Saved within the command console of the Sectoral Disturbance Depressors was a data signal. Though difficult, we were able to clone its pattern and search the galaxy for a match. The trail led to an uninhabited planet. It is time to discover what the Inetian Tr

excerpt.zh: 这座古老的通讯站仍可工作。登上这座站点并直接与其系统交互后，我们也许就能破译此前收到的广播。
excerpt.en: This ancient communication station is still active. By boarding the site and directly interfacing with its systems we might be able to decipher its previous broadcasts.

excerpt.zh: 我们失去了对[FromFrom.GetName]的控制，它被活雪夺走了！在[FromFrom.GetPlanetMoon]的生态系统中已经开始发生非常明显的变化。我们的[This.GetResearchers]提醒，除非我们能尽快夺回[FromFrom.GetPlanetMoon]，否则它的构造变化很快将使我们无法再继续居住。
excerpt.en: We have lost control of [FromFrom.GetName] - which has been seized by the Living Snow! Already, significant changes are happening to the [FromFrom.GetPlanetMoon]'s ecosystem. Our [This.GetResearchers] warn that, unless we can retake the [FromFrom.GetPlanetMoon

excerpt.zh: [From.Target.GetName]离开了自身的稳定轨道，呈螺旋轨迹进入恒星系的黑洞。尽管这一事件给予我们一个绝无仅有的攫取大量£sr_dark_matter£暗物质和£physics£物理学研究的契机，如果我们不迅速行动抵消黑洞的拖拽引力，这座空间站很快就会被黑洞吞没。
excerpt.en: The [From.Target.GetName] has left its stable orbit and is now spiraling into the system's black hole. While the incident offers us a never-before-seen opportunity to harvest £sr_dark_matter£Dark Matter and £physics£ Physics Research, if we don't act fast to c

excerpt.zh:
在[From.Planet.GetName]上的矿井的深处，是一处古老外星文明所遗留的痕迹。宏伟的装饰建筑和洞室告诉我们，一个有着丰富文化的文明已经能够巧妙地切割基岩和建设隧道系统，它们被厚实的闸门所保护，通往更加深入的山体之中。

由于山体中富集的，以爆炸性闻名的甲烷气体，继续探索下去会很危险。
excerpt.en: In the depths of [From.Planet.GetName]'s mines are traces of an ancient alien civilization. Magnificent ornamental structures and cavernous chambers telling of a rich culture have been cut expertly from the bedrock and a system of paved tunnels, protected by m

excerpt.zh:
在[From.Planet.GetName]上的一个大而与世隔绝的山谷中一些不同物种的化石被发现了，这些物种似乎不是来自该行星的。它们大体上都来自同一个时期，大约是360万年前，跨度为几个世纪的那段时间内。

这些物种中的每一个个体似乎都是在其所属的独特的生物圈中进化而来的，而且它们似乎都具有智慧。奇怪的是，到目前为止发现的每一个化石都显示出遭到暴力终结的迹象。
excerpt.en: Fossilized remains from several different species that do not appear to have been indigenous to [From.Planet.GetName] have been found in a large and secluded valley on the planet. They all date from roughly the same time period, within the span of a few centur

excerpt.zh: 从[From.Planet.GetName]的轨道上可以很容易地看到一座直径数千公里的人造建筑。形状表明在它的中间位置似乎有一片重要区域。从轨道上获得的探测数据显示没有任何异常，因此我们有必要进行进一步的探测。
excerpt.en: An artificial construct thousands of kilometers across is readily visible from [From.Planet.GetName]'s orbit. The shape seems to indicate a location of importance in the middle of it. Sensory readings from orbit indicate nothing out of the ordinary so closer i

excerpt.zh:
轨道遥测显示在[From.Planet.GetName]表面有一个巨大的坑洞。此坑洞并非陨石撞击坑，因为其深度令人咋舌，与直径完全不成比例。事实上，该坑洞的实际深度尚无法确定，因为坑道半路上就被岩屑堵塞，任何进一步的轨道扫描均被阻碍。

传统的开挖式考察看起来是确定坑洞下方究竟有何种物体的唯一途径。
excerpt.en: Orbital telemetry shows a massive impact crater on the surface of [From.Planet.GetName]. It was not caused by a meteorite strike, as the crater is surprisingly deep in proportion to its diameter. In fact, the actual depth cannot yet be determined, as the shaft

excerpt.zh:
在我们迄今的探索中，[From.Planet.GetName]表面的情况完全没有先例。从山脉到整个大陆般广袤的地质区域突然被切割成各种几何形状，其规整程度远非自然形成所能及。原本自然的环境被突然破坏，变成完全平坦的平面、完美的三角形和尖锐的锥形。

目前，对这一令人困惑的现象的任何解释都只是纯粹的猜测。
excerpt.en: The surface of [From.Planet.GetName] is utterly without precedent in all our exploration to date. Vast geological areas, from mountain ranges to entire continents, are suddenly cut by shapes far too geometrically regular to be natural in origin. The otherwise

excerpt.zh:
对[From.Planet.GetName]扫描揭示了地底深处的一间人工密室——其用途和来源未知。放大后发现了一座从地表通往地下拱顶的挖掘井。

欲进行进一步的分析，需派遣一支探险队前往[From.Planet.GetName]的表面。
excerpt.en:
Scans of [From.Planet.GetName] uncovered an artificial chamber deep beneath the surface - its purpose and origin unknown. Magnification revealed an excavated shaft leading from the surface to the subterranean vault.

Further analysis will require sending an ex

excerpt.zh: [From.Planet.GetName]的地表扫描结果表明了一种迹象：曾经可能有一个科技文明在这颗星球上活跃，但它现在已经灭绝了。我们需要组织一次地表考察以获得更多信息。
excerpt.en: Surface scans of [From.Planet.GetName] picked up signs that a technological civilization may have been active on the planet, but has since gone extinct. We will need to mount a surface expedition to learn more.

excerpt.zh: 从轨道中拍摄的[From.Planet.GetName]的影像清晰地展现了这个技术文明的基础设施。神秘的是，尽管庞大的城区被复杂的表面交通网络相连接，但这颗行星看起来似乎已完全废弃，没有任何尚存感性生物的迹象。此行星内核比大多数行星更活跃，但这里没有灾难性事件或其他任何足以直接解释这些人口失踪的原因的事件的迹象。他们都去哪里了呢？
excerpt.en: Orbital imagery of [From.Planet.GetName] clearly shows the infrastructure of a technological civilization. Mysteriously, despite massive urban areas linked by an extensive surface transport network, the planet seems totally abandoned, with no signs of extant s

excerpt.zh: 科学船在[From.Planet.GetName]轨道上进行的扫描显示了其海面下有着奇怪的构造，海水以难以解释的方式在流动。虽然该星球天气相对平静，风暴很少，但海面下的水受一些未知力量的影响，不断翻涌和搅动。建议进行详细调查。
excerpt.en: Scans made by the Science Ship in orbit of [From.Planet.GetName] shows some strange formations beneath the waves, and inexplicable water currents. The weather is relatively placid and storms are rare, yet the planetary seas seem to constantly roil and churn, d

excerpt.zh: 来自[From.Planet.GetName]的可见光传感器反馈的信号显示这个海洋星球的海床上有着极不寻常的构造。
excerpt.en: The visual sensor feed from [From.Planet.GetName] shows formations in the seabed of this ocean world that are highly unusual.

excerpt.zh: 在[From.Planet.GetName]轨道上的科学船已经探测到遍布这个海洋星球表面的圆形岛屿群。从地质的角度来看，它们非常不寻常：其表面看起来很自然，没有人造结构，但它们都呈圆形，且几乎是完美的圆。我们需要前往那里收集更多数据。
excerpt.en: The Science Ship in orbit around [From.Planet.GetName] has detected clusters of small, round islands dotting the ocean planet. From a geological standpoint they are highly unusual: the surface appears natural, with no artificial constructions, yet they all app

excerpt.zh:
一颗本应“正常”的熔岩星球，让科研船的传感器出现了无法控制的故障。

建议进行进一步研究。
excerpt.en:
What should be a "normal" molten planet is making the Science Ship's sensors glitch uncontrollably.

Further study is advised.

excerpt.zh:
漂浮在 [From.Planet.GetName] 行星残骸水晶的般清澈的海洋上，包裹在微小冰盖的，似乎是一个人造结构。

需要一个团队来挖掘这个结构。
excerpt.en:
Encapsulated in what remains of the planet's tiny ice cap, floating on the crystal clear oceans of [From.Planet.GetName], is what appears to be an artificial structure. 

A team is required to excavate this structure.

excerpt.zh: 我们找到了一艘设计独特的古代太空舰船的残骸。它使用的推进方式与现代舰船并不相同，而是依赖于在真空中展开的巨大的帆来进行。也许这艘船可以捕获恒星能量，并在星光和恒星风的推动下前进。我们的考古学家迫切希望揭开隐藏在这艘古老舰船中的秘密。
excerpt.en: We have found the wreckage of an archaic spaceship of unusual design. Instead of using propulsion similar to that of modern ships, the craft relied on large sails unfurled in the vacuum of space. Presumably, the ship harvested solar energy and drifted on the s

excerpt.zh:
我们先前以为[From.GetName]的南半球地区有一座山脉，其实这是一个巨型外星生物的庞大骨架。

这副骨架已经有三十四亿年的历史了，但我们的[Owner.GetScientistPlural]认为在这个[From.GetPlanetMoon]的任何历史节点上，[From.GetName]的环境都无法支持这么大体型生命体的生存。[Owner.GetScientistCapital][Root.GetLeaderName]正在准备新的研究计划，进一步探究其中的奥秘。
excerpt.en:
What was previously thought to be assorted mountains in the southern hemisphere of [From.GetName] have been identified as the massive skeletal remains of a single colossal alien life form.

The bones have been dated as 3.4 billion years old, but our [Owner.Get

excerpt.zh:
巨大的[From.GetName]周围的缓轨道上漂浮着一个可移动的数据库。[Root.GetName]将其打捞后发现其中似乎包含某种外星语言写就的内容。其词汇组成并非完全陌生，但其语法则是十分复杂。

科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]建议对其进行进一步研究，以便解密该文本的内容与起源。
excerpt.en:
In gentle orbit around the massive [From.GetName] floats a portable databank. Scooped up by the [Root.GetName], it is found to contain text in some alien language. The vocabulary is not wholly unfamiliar, but the syntax is disconcertingly complex.

Science Off

excerpt.zh: 我们接收到的信号来自于一艘围绕[From.GetName]旋转的舰船。这艘船现在没有任何热成像，似乎是在漂浮。我们已经制定了一个特殊项目来调查船员的遭遇。
excerpt.en: The signal we intercepted was a distress call from a ship in orbit around [From.GetName]. The ship is not giving off any heat signatures and seems to be drifting. A Special Project has been issued to investigate what has happened to the crew.

title.en: The Rulers of the Water Plains

excerpt.zh:
在[From.GetName]上，科学官[Root.GetLeaderName]发现了一种身体健壮、适应力极强的四足哺乳生物。他们可以徒步涉水，即使是高大的植物也仅仅达到它们的腿部。 这些生物的暗色鳞片非常坚硬，而且在陌生人靠近时极易受惊。

也许可以驯服这些猛兽，让它们协助我们将来的行星殖民活动。但先研究它们也许会有所收获。
excerpt.en: On [From.GetName], Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] has discovered a race of quadruped mammalians who appear very strong and physically resilient. They run across shallow plains of water, with lush plants reaching for their legs. The dark scales of the cre

excerpt.zh:
[this.GetName]的殖民者发展出了一种爱好，沉迷于星界裂隙 ，其位于行星南半球的可观测天空中。人们激烈地推测它的起源，以及它蕴含着怎样的危险或机遇。

来自[owner.GetName]各地的业余天文爱好者聚集到这颗行星，亲眼见证这番绝景。
excerpt.en:
Colonists on [this.GetName] have developed a fascination with the Astral Rift visible in the sky from the planet's southern hemisphere. Rampant speculation exists about its origins, as well as what dangers or opportunities it might present.

Amateur astronomer

excerpt.zh: 围绕着[Root.GetName]的轨道空间到处都是曾经居住在[Root.GetPlanetMoon]遗留的残骸，他们在文明被毁灭之前向太空射出了数千个原始的卫星和飞弹发射平台。许多都在[Root.GetPlanetMoon]可怕的使用核武的战争中被反卫星武器摧毁了，这样一来太空垃圾就更多了。我们在地表的殖民者认为这些残骸已经影响了基础设施的运作，因为这些残骸，我们只能在有限的条件下使用卫星和轨道飞行的技术。
excerpt.en: The orbital space around [Root.GetName] is cluttered with debris left behind by the alien civilization that once inhabited the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]. Before they wiped themselves out, their early space programs saw the launch of thousands of primitive satellite

excerpt.zh:
与我们的预期相符，小行星[From.GetName]内部含有大量金属，且藏有某种机械装置。

目前收集的数据清楚地表明其部件内贮藏着大量能源，但其存在的目的目前依旧未知。
excerpt.en:
As suspected, the asteroid [From.GetName] holds within it a great mass of metal and does indeed hide some manner of machinery.

The gathered data clearly shows that its constituent parts contain great quantities of stored energy, but its purpose remains unknow

excerpt.zh:
对[from.Planet.GetName]的地质扫描显示在一个特定的地下区域中，局部的极端温度接近绝对零度。

对内部更详尽的研究将会带来更多的答案。
excerpt.en:
Topographical scans of [from.Planet.GetName] show extreme temperatures approaching absolute zero localized in a particular subterranean region.

A more detailed study of the interior should yield more answers.

excerpt.zh: [from.Planet.GetName]表面居高不下的辐射水平指向了一座破旧的反应堆复合体。这座孤零零的设施似乎废弃已久，有待调查。
excerpt.en: Elevated radiation levels on the surface of [from.Planet.GetName] were traced to a dilapidated reactor complex. The isolated facility appears inactive and warrants investigation.

excerpt.zh: 显然，[From.Planet.GetName]曾是一个高度发达的文明的家园。该星球等距环绕着的六颗卫星就足以证明这一点。但是行星目前已经化作一片废墟，整个恒星系都有着各种各样争斗的痕迹。这里到底发生了什么？
excerpt.en: [From.Planet.GetName] was clearly once home to a highly-advanced civilization; its six moons with orbits at equidistant intervals are evidence enough of that. However, the planet is in ruins and the entire star system shows signs of an extraordinarily violent

excerpt.zh: 我们正在见证[From.Owner.Capital.GetName]的居民迈出他们走向启蒙的第一步。他们向上抬头，对宇宙的奥秘始终抱持开放的态度。随着艺术表达在他们文化中的发展，艺术力量捕捉社会的精神奋斗的一面也在发展。他们渴望有某种高于自我的信仰。
excerpt.en: We are witnessing the inhabitants of [From.Owner.Capital.GetName] taking their first steps towards enlightenment. They look upwards, opening themselves to the mysteries of the universe. As artistic expression develops within their culture, so does art's power

excerpt.zh: 所有[target.capital_scope.GetName]的[target.GetSpeciesName]重要领袖都被我们的密探调包了。现在渗透人员正在巩固我们在[target.capital_scope.GetPlanetHabitat]的进展。是时候采取行动了。
excerpt.en: All [target.GetSpeciesName] leaders of significance on [target.capital_scope.GetName] have been replaced by our own agents. Infiltration cells are now consolidating our efforts on the [target.capital_scope.GetPlanetHabitat]. The time to act is upon us.

excerpt.zh:
地质警报系统已发出预警[planet.GetName]主定居点附近一年内可能发生火山喷发。

我们可以投入资源进行控制性减压，利用熔岩流进行地热发电，同时安排人手待命，在喷发时采集岩浆以提炼贵金属；或者集中转移区域内平民与物资，尽可能降低风险。

鉴于预测可能存在误差，我们也可以暂不采取行动，继续观测。
excerpt.en:
Geological alert systems warn that a volcanic eruption near the main settlement on [planet.GetName] is likely to occur within the next year.

Investing in a controlled pressure release could allow the lava flow to be harnessed for energy production. Crews coul

excerpt.zh: 我们的一些情报机构发现了一些资料，这些资料指出[ringworld_builder.GetName]的环形世界可能是一个大规模杀伤武器的秘密发射平台。虽然这些资料的正确性有待确认，但这样的见解已经在国内定型，公众要求我们采取行动。可以确定的是如果[ringworld_builder.GetName]没有什么可隐瞒的话，他们会允许我们的武器专家检查平台的。
excerpt.en: Some of our intelligence assets have uncovered data suggesting that the [ringworld_builder.GetName]'s ring world could be hiding a secret launch platform for weapons of mass destruction. Though the validity of the source has yet to be confirmed, the notion has

excerpt.zh:
被分配到[from.target.GetName]开展工作的间谍首脑[from.leader.GetName]开始传来报告。这标志着我们在这个尚未意识到外星生命存在的星球里建立了首个间谍网。

若计划妥当，我们能够潜移默化地影响这个[root.GetPreFTLLower]社会，同时掩盖我们的存在。值得庆幸的是，我们物种和[from.target.species.GetName]有着惊人的生理相似性，这能让我们的特工很难被发现。
excerpt.en:
Reports have started coming in from Spymaster [from.leader.GetName], assigned to the [from.target.GetName]. This marks the foundation of our first Spy Network within a world which is still unaware of alien life.

With careful planning, we will be able to subtl

excerpt.zh: 一小队精挑细选的特工在经过严密伪装之后出发前往[target.owner.GetName]境内。每一个人都会装作一名求职者。一部分人将会携带推荐信，找和关键设施运营相关的工作；其他人则要在背地里试试运气。
excerpt.en: A small and select group of operatives has departed for the [target.owner.GetName] under tight aliases. Each will pose as a worker seeking employment. Some are carrying statements of recommendation and will seek work close to key facilities; others will try th

excerpt.zh: 我们的特工正在甄别并试图同[target.GetName]国内的犯罪团伙接触，他们很容易被我们的援助影响到。
excerpt.en: Our operatives are working to identify and make contact with criminal elements inside the [target.GetName] that would be susceptible to our assistance.

excerpt.zh: 该佣兵城邦正为其赞助者积攒贡品。
excerpt.en: This enclave is accumulating tribute for their patron.

excerpt.zh: 我们在[From.GetName]上获取了一些奇怪的读数，很有可能表明其上有生命存在。由于这些信号较为微弱，而且在我们试图与之联系时毫无反应，所以如果想弄清真相，我们需要派出一支研究团队。
excerpt.en: We have picked up some curious readings from [From.GetName], possibly indicating the presence of life. Given the weakness of these signals and the lack of response as we attempt to contact these lifeforms, we must send a research team if we are to figure out w

excerpt.zh:
我们注意到一些舰队指挥官和领袖之间的分歧和争论有所增加。如果[admiral_democracy.GetName]认为我们应该干点什么，可以肯定[admiral_oligarchy.GetName]将对着干。

起初，这似乎只是对手之间的良性竞争，但最近气氛变得越来越令人不快，充满火药味，我们看到他们的同僚也开始站队了。
excerpt.en: We have seen a rise in disagreements and arguing between some of our commanders and leaders. If [admiral_democracy.GetName] thinks we should go through with something, you can be sure that [admiral_oligarchy.GetName] will argue that we should do the opposite.

excerpt.zh:
遗物所生成的虫洞的另一端是瑟塞特星系。进入后不久，我们的传感器发现了一队有敌意的无人机。它们似乎在守护着这个星系唯一的一颗行星。初步的扫描结果显示，那些无人机上没有生命形式的信号，行星上同样也没有。

凯德斯非常确信那颗行星就是他们民族的起源地。毫无疑问答案就在那里。

随后，无人机群向我们发出了通讯要求。
excerpt.en: At the other end of the relic-spawned wormhole lies the Sursect system. Shortly after entry, our sensors picked up a fleet of hostile drones. They appear to be keeping vigil over the system's single planet. Initial scans suggest there are no life forms present

excerpt.zh:
在观察[event_target:pre_ftl_planet.GetName]当地人口时，我们的外派团队发现了件有趣的事情。

这里的首都大街小巷都在交头接耳着关于一位“天选之人”的事情，据说是从星间下凡实现一个古老预言，并将带领[event_target:pre_ftl_planet.Owner.GetSpeciesName]走入下一个黄金时期。

我们的所有人员都记录在岗，所以究竟是谁在访问这颗行星很值得进一步调查。
excerpt.en:
While observing the local population of [event_target:pre_ftl_planet.GetName], our away team have come across an interesting discovery.

The capital city is abuzz with talk of a "Chosen One" who has reportedly descended from the stars to fulfill an ancient pro

excerpt.zh:
随着决议的通过，圣武士倡议不再是一个理论构想，而是一个获得官方批准的项目。这标志着各成员国将开始协调努力，制定实现该倡议所需的理论、人员和物资标准。

虽然[global_event_country.GetCommunityOrImperium]的各个成员国将各自负责招募圣武士，但我们仍需监督开发一系列全新的顶级舰艇供他们使用。
excerpt.en: With the passage of the resolution, the Paladin Initiative is no longer a theoretical construct but an officially sanctioned project. This marks the beginning of a coordinated effort across member states to develop the doctrine, personnel, and material standar

excerpt.zh: 整个行星都被巨大的建筑物所覆盖着，这个遗落的大都会星肯定有秘密等待发掘。
excerpt.en: An entire planet covered in vast structures, this fallen megalopolis surely has secrets to be unearthed.

excerpt.zh:
乍一看，[From.Planet.GetName]上只有冰雪。雪白的大地、玻璃般晶莹的湖泊和锯齿状的松绿色冰川广袤无垠，火红的橘色天空映衬着地面，宛如裂开的伤口，将[From.Planet.Solar_System.GetName]中夕阳西下的红色光芒倾注在海面。如果世界有终结，那这里一定就是了。海面风平浪静，积雪一尘不染，唯一能听到的，只有冰层崩裂的咔嚓雷动和平原上呼啸的狂风。

然而，[From.Planet.GetName]曾经是某族的家园。在一片广阔而又贫瘠的旷野之中，一座黑色的金属尖塔从苍白的大地上突兀而
excerpt.en: At first sight there is only snow and ice on [From.Planet.GetName]. Vast expanses of impenetrable white, glass lakes and jagged turquoise glaciers against fiery orange skies torn open like a wound, pouring red into the seas as [From.Planet.Solar_System.GetName

excerpt.zh:
被[From.Planet.GetName]大气圈笼罩着的是一处鬼影幢幢的巨大居住站——埃克斯-柏楞居住区。这里曾是一处日喧夜嚣的太空城，居民们享受着科技带来的巨大便利，过着如同神仙一般的生活，如今此处已成为一座寂静的墓碑。软体类的外星人横七竖八地倒在走道上，腐败程度各不相同。验尸报告表明，这些外星人由于居住站的维生系统失效最后死于窒息。

他们的家里装备有模样奇怪的机械座椅，其顶端连接到了一个形状是蓝色巨大球状体的中央数据库——眠梦仪。
excerpt.en: Shrouded within [From.Planet.GetName]'s gaseous atmosphere is the dark looming form of an enormous habitat - the Ix Belèn Residence. Previously a bustling space city where the residents enjoyed a pampered lifestyle with a multitude of comforts made available t

excerpt.zh: 探测器在[From.Planet.GetName]的冰雪之下探测到了一座隐藏的设施。部分坍塌与阻塞的隧道似乎组成了连接各种地下结构的巨大网络
excerpt.en: Scanners detect a hidden complex buried beneath the ice and snow of [From.Planet.GetName]. A large network of partially-collapsed or blocked tunnels seems to connect the various underground structures.

excerpt.zh:
与一个较小小行星的碰撞在[From.Planet.GetName]表面露出一个略微伸出的类似小型防爆门或者气闸室的东西。它似乎有着数千年的历史，先前一直被岩石和尘土所掩盖。

由于未知原因，我们的扫描无法穿透到小行星的内部，并且常规切割工具也无法对防爆门造成影响。为了了解这扇门的背后有什么，我们的团队或许不得不从另一个方向向小行星的中心挖掘。
excerpt.en:
A collision with a smaller asteroid has revealed a small blast door or airlock extending slightly from the surface of [From.Planet.GetName]. It appears to be thousands of years old, and had previously been concealed by rocks and dust.

For unknown reasons, sca

excerpt.zh: 这个古老的遗落星球已经被囚禁在一道无法穿透的能量屏障里大约有75000年之久。它曾经是一颗充满活力的都市星球，居住着数以亿计的居民，但现在街道和建筑物都被遗弃了，星球上的原初居民也都销声匿迹了。
excerpt.en: This ancient Relic World was imprisoned behind an impenetrable energy barrier for roughly 75,000 years. It must once have been a vibrant ecumenopolis home to hundreds of billions of individuals, but the streets and buildings are deserted now. None of the plane

excerpt.zh:
一座大型废弃空间站被困在这颗气态巨行星的大气层内部，向着巨行星内部缓慢下坠。其自重很可能在下一个千年里彻底毁坏这个空间站。

好在该空间站飘入大气层还不太深，我们仍有可能对其开展考古行动。
excerpt.en:
A large derelict space station is trapped in a slow terminal orbit inside the atmosphere of this gas giant. The gravitational stresses will likely destroy it completely within the next thousand years.

It has not yet drifted deep enough into the atmosphere to

excerpt.zh: 即使用肉眼也很容易看出，[From.Planet.GetName]的地表上部分区域的地形极不规整。光滑的弧面上唐突地出现了一个巨大的球形凸起。也许在过去某一时刻，一颗卫星亦或是一颗巨大的小行星与这颗行星发生了碰撞，但碰撞的方式一定相当微妙，碰撞并未撕裂这颗行星，而仅仅是使不速之客寄宿在了行星地壳内部。
excerpt.en: Even with the naked eye it is easy to see something highly irregular in the shape of [From.Planet.GetName]. The smooth curvature of the surface is suddenly interrupted by a gigantic spherical bump. At some point a moon or large asteroid collided with the plane

excerpt.zh:
来自[From.Planet.GetName]的探测读数显示，这颗星球曾经郁郁葱葱，被繁茂的植被所覆盖。然而现在一切皆为过往云烟，它只不过是一块荒芜光秃的巨岩。

虽然缺乏任何值得注意的构造运动，但使用感应器对这颗行星进行扫描之后，设备记录了下令人困惑的数据。数据表明，有东西正在在地下移动，绝对是一个“庞然大物”。这个发现值得我们进行深入调查。
excerpt.en:
Readings from [From.Planet.GetName] reveal that it was once mostly covered in lush vegetation. Now the forlorn orb is little more than a barren rock.

Despite lacking any noteworthy tectonic activity, sensory scans of the planet have registered puzzling seismo

excerpt.zh:
[From.Planet.GetName]的整个表面如同伤疤般布满了又长又浅的运河。它们随意地交错穿插，布局上没有明显的逻辑。目前还不确定它们是否是一种不寻常的自然特征，又或是别的什么。

需要进行一次地面考察以查明更多的情况。
excerpt.en:
The entire surface of [From.Planet.GetName] is scarred by long, shallow canals. They cross and re-cross each other haphazardly, with no apparent logic to their layout. It is as yet uncertain if they are an unusual natural feature, or something else.

A surface

excerpt.zh: 传感器在一簇小行星内检测到了能量读数。建议进行更深入的调查。
excerpt.en: Sensors have detected energy readings in a cluster of asteroids. Further investigation is recommended.

excerpt.zh: 一个与中子星非常接近的大型空间站正在发出奇怪的读数。尽管其当前位置稳定，但显示出相当大的损坏。焦痕的扩散表明它在过去曾被几次大爆炸所摧毁。
excerpt.en: A large station orbiting in alarmingly close proximity to the neutron star is giving off strange readings. Although its current position is stable, it shows considerable wear and tear. A proliferation of scorch marks indicates that it was rocked by several lar

excerpt.zh:
[From.GetName]的地理构造的确是处在变动之中。科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]认为这是地壳活动造成的。这一地壳活动虽然有趣但是却极其深奥。不过[Root.Owner.GetName]所感兴趣的，是某种可以停止星球这一无尽且无序的自我变构的方法。简单来说，使用此方法转化星球不仅用时极短，而且理论上也有可能让星球变得更加易于居住。

[Root.GetLeaderName]需要额外的200能量币进行地理活动勘测，以证明科学专员所提出的外科手术刀式精准改造方案是否真的可行。当然，如果以后想要使
excerpt.en: The very geological structure of [From.GetName] is indeed in flux, driven by what Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] assures us is a tectonic process as fascinating as it is esoteric. What is of more interest to the [Root.Owner.GetName] is that we may be abl

excerpt.zh:
在[From.GetName]上曾经居住着某个智力较为发达的外星物种，或许再过几十年就能够研发出太空旅行，但在那之前他们就已经把自己终结了。虽然星球本身已经从毫无意义的大肆毁灭中恢复了过来，但表面上仍然有十分明显的伤疤。

地表上残存着几处遗迹，其中有座保存得较为良好的石碑。[Root.GetLeaderName]十分轻松地解读了上面的讯息，原来是世界末日的幸存者们为后来之人所刻下的一则警告。其种族灭亡的直接原因便是“终极武器”的发明。这个种族的某种心理学特征导致共同毁灭机制不再有效。

因为最终武器很难被摧毁，那
excerpt.en: [From.GetName] was once home to a race of reasonably intelligent beings who destroyed themselves when they were seemingly only decades away from space flight. The planet has recovered from what must have been immense acts of senseless destruction, but it still

excerpt.zh:
科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]报告称，我们犯了个愚蠢的错误，在[From.GetName]沙漠看到的沙海涟漪其实是启动的飞船推进器造成的。

有一艘外星飞船头朝下埋没在沙海中，其断断续续工作的推进系统在上方的沙丘激起了阵阵波涛。看来这玩意已经困在这里有段时间了，它在推进器的作用下渐渐插进了沙丘深处。[Root.GetName]没有能够将此船吊出的设备与方法，[Root.GetLeaderName]建议派遣一只飞船到[From.GetName]，以对其进行发掘。
excerpt.en:
Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] reports that the waves seen rippling across the sandy seas of [From.GetName] are, bizarrely enough, the result of active ship thrusters.

An alien vessel lies buried in the sand nose-down, its sputtering propulsion systems

excerpt.zh:
[Root.GetName]出大事了！研究结束后并无重大发现，船员便返回到船上，却发现[From.GetPlanetMoon]的某只猛兽竟然跑上了船！

该生物已经杀害了一位船员，并正在撕毁墙壁试图逼近其他的船员们。他们撑不了多久！已经发布一个特殊项目去救人了。
excerpt.en:
Catastrophe has struck the [Root.GetName]! After conducting their studies, with no interesting finds, the crew returned to the ship only to find it carrying a beast from the [From.GetPlanetMoon]! 

The creature has already killed a crew member and is trying to

excerpt.zh:
在[From.GetName]的地表之下生活着一种非常奇特的有机体。扫描和取样显示，它是一种散布着孢子的菌丝体。与我们母星上熟悉的孢子的尺寸相比，它们非常巨大。它们的表面闪烁迷人，千变万化，色调似乎随着环境而变化。

其中最奇怪的事情莫过于它们似乎形成了一种可以产生科学家相信是信号的东西的网络。现在的辐射还非常弱，但稍作努力，也许就能找到它们指向何方。
excerpt.en: Below the surface of [From.GetName] lives a most peculiar organism. Scans and samples show that it is some sort of mycelium littered with spores. Compared to the traditional size of spores on our homeworld, these are massive. Their surface is a shimmering kale

excerpt.zh: 以剑与火，燃异端之地。以彼之烬，沃泱泱星河。
excerpt.en: By sword and flame shall heretical worlds burn, and with their ashes shall the galaxy be salted.

excerpt.zh: 我们对[From.Planet.System.GetName]恒星系的扫描显示，它的小行星带是一种非同寻常的类型。与通常组成这类结构的岩石、冰块加太空垃圾的大杂烩不同，它看起来像是许多大型的人造居住站所形成的残骸。这显然是在过去几千年内的某个时间被难以想象的暴力所摧毁的。这片残骸场中必然潜藏着许多不为人知的秘密，但由于体量巨大，进行测绘就需要花费挺长的时间。
excerpt.en: Our scans of the [From.Planet.System.GetName] system show that its asteroid belt is of an unusual variety. Instead of the standard mix of rocks, ice and space rubble that usually make up such formations, it seems to be the remains of a number of large, artific

excerpt.zh:
经过仔细分析，我们确认[From.System.GetName]中的星界细缝异常不稳定，需要立即干预以防止该恒星系进一步坍缩为引力奇点。

可以考虑将大量喷射而出的星界丝缕进行重定向、重新利用，以便“缝合”裂痕。这将修复时空的撕裂，并可能留下大量的星界物质。

或者，我们可以投射大量军火来扩大这处裂痕。我们预测，这么做将有助于我们探索伤痕另一边可能存在的事物。
excerpt.en:
After careful analysis, we've confirmed that the Astral Scar in [From.System.GetName] is dangerously unstable and requires immediate intervention to prevent further gravitational singularities forming in this system.

The powerful ejection of Astral Threads co

excerpt.zh:
[From.Planet.GetName]抗拒着一切靠近者。指派到该项目的研究者开始编造借口拖延工作，而仪器则会出现类似拒绝接收数据一样的故障。

这里发生了一些事情——一些可怕的事情，它的回声至今仍在现实中回荡。
excerpt.en:
[From.Planet.GetName] repels all who approach. Researchers assigned to its study invent excuses to delay their work, while instruments glitch and fail as if rejecting the data itself.

Something happened here - something so horrific that its echoes still rever

excerpt.zh: [Root.GetName]的殖民者还会碰到分散在各地的残余变异生物，它们在[Root.GetPlanetMoon]中断已久的改造进程完工后又出现了。虽然大部分人畜无害，当地部队可轻松解决，但其中一只却在偏远的居住站肆虐。据说它会跟踪我们的殖民者，而近来又有多起不明失踪事件。前往调查的安保部队的残尸最近才被发现，殖民地的领袖急切地请求军团援助。
excerpt.en: Our colonists on [Root.GetName] are still encountering scattered survivors from the mutated creatures that spawned after we finished the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]'s aborted terraforming process. Most are relatively harmless and can be put out of their misery by loc

excerpt.zh:
为了改善日常生活，[Root.GetName]的殖民者开始定期探索星球上的资源。最近一次北极探索时，在深海发现了一个巨大物体：一艘外星战列巡洋舰。

深海的压强可能会造成困难，但仍有可能打捞这艘沉船。
excerpt.en:
The colonizers on [Root.GetName] regularly explore the planet in hopes of finding more resources to help with day-to-day life. A recent expedition to the north pole has now unveiled a large object on the bottom of the ocean: An alien battle cruiser.

The press

excerpt.zh:
当我们向这些沙生兽开放我们的殖民地时，没有人能够预料到这样的结果。这些小动物已经完美地适应了我们的生活方式，在我们的领土上，成为了家庭生活中的可爱伴侣。

它们的快速融入引发了一种猜测，即这些生物一定曾经被驯化过。无论是什么原因导致了它们与生俱来的友好，这个传言只增加了人们对这些非凡生物的更进一步兴趣。
excerpt.en:
When we opened our colonies to the desertlings, no one could have anticipated the results. The critters have adapted seamlessly into our way of life, becoming beloved companions in households all across our territory.

Their rapid integration has led to specul

excerpt.zh: 我们已经找到风信子号了！该船正以稳定的轨道围绕[hyacinth_planet.GetName]运行。舰体内没有探测到能源特征，并且没有收到任何遇险信标。我们会派出一支武装登船部队进入内部调查。
excerpt.en: We have located the Hyacinth! The great arkship is parked in a stable orbit over [hyacinth_planet.GetName]. No power signatures have been detected from within its hull, and we are not picking up any distress beacons. An armed boarding party should be sent to i

excerpt.zh:
在对[From.GetName]轨道上的平台进行研究后，我们发现它是一种复杂且有些古怪的外星设计。其防水机械与先进气候控制表明，它是由一种会分泌大量液体的物种制造的，很可能是软体动物。

在故障之前，它曾用微波束加热恒星大气层的一部分，诱发持续的大规模喷发，可以极大地增加太阳风的流出。这些能源随后由轨道空间站收集。

该平台是按某种非常实验性的概念设计的。
excerpt.en: Closer inspection of the platform orbiting [From.GetName] has revealed that it is of a complex, somewhat erratic, alien design. The waterproofed machinery and advanced climate control suggest it was built for a lifeform that secreted a rich amount of fluids, v

excerpt.zh: [From.GetName]的最新传感器读数显示恒星在有规律地悸动，但当[Root.GetName]的船员们抵达当地时，却没有发现支持这一数据的证据。尽管大多数船员都同意这是传感器故障引起的，[Root.GetLeaderName]却否认这一理论。[Root.GetLeaderName]宣称在别处发现了类似的悸动能源放射规律，并担心星系中的恒星正在遭遇怪事。[crazy_science_officer.GetSheHeCap]已安排了前往最近的受影响恒星的航线。
excerpt.en: The latest sensory readings from [From.GetName] showed the star pulsating regularly, but when the crew on [Root.GetName] arrived on site there was no evidence to support this data. While most of the crew are in agreement that the anomaly was caused by a sensor

excerpt.zh:
进一步扫描表明机械仍在运转，而其目的至今仍然毫无头绪。

科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]表示自己从未见过这样的东西。其中有些材料似乎有些眼熟，但绝大部分都是见所未见的外星产物，其部件与结构也是一样。

机器似乎具备一个控制台，台上有一样十分显眼的物品：一柄由不明材料制成的大而弯曲的拉杆。
excerpt.en:
Further scans suggest the machine is still operational, though its purpose remains entirely unclear.

Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] has never seen anything like it. Some of its materials look familiar, but most are strange and utterly alien as the desig

excerpt.zh:
根据目前观察，在[breathing_rift_object.GetName]发现的异常现象似乎是极为罕见的空间裂隙。很有可能是[breathing_rift_object.GetName]的巨大质量帮助其生成，但我们目前尚无法理解其性质。

裂隙不仅会折射和阻挡光线，而且似乎还会吸引光线后再将其吐出，如此往复——有如呼吸一般。

目前看来，裂隙巨大的引力很可能也拉入过其他东西。我们最好小心行事。
excerpt.en:
The anomaly found close by [breathing_rift_object.GetName], however unlikely, appears to be some type of rift in space. It's possible the great mass of [breathing_rift_object.GetName] somehow caused it, but its nature is beyond our understanding.

The rift not

excerpt.zh:
我们的传感器检测到一个从[from.Planet.GetName]的撞击坑深处发出的异常通讯信号。

震波拓扑扫描显示存在一个地下洞穴网络，其塌陷的洞口正在撞击坑中心。与此同时，我们的放射仪探测到从该地点发出的微弱的引力辐射痕迹，这带来的问题比答案更多。
excerpt.en:
Our sensors have detected an irregular communications signal emanating from deep within an impact crater on [from.Planet.GetName].

Seismic topology scans reveal a network of subterranean caverns with a collapsed entrance at the center of the crater. Alongside

excerpt.zh: 远古守护者给予我们的疫苗与我们的生理机能互不相容，产生了大量不可预知的突变。这导致了数起死亡，而我们的人民也竭力反对被集体强迫进行危险的接种。我们正在努力从人民中消灭诱变因素，但在那之前我们将会经历一段较为动荡的时期。
excerpt.en: The inoculations given to us by the Ancient Caretakers have proven incompatible with our physiology, resulting in a rash of unpredictable mutations. This has resulted in a number of deaths, and our population is up in arms about having dangerous inoculations f

excerpt.zh: 用以决出联邦领袖的黄金律挑战赛将在数日后举行。由当前的联邦领袖开始，联邦中的每个帝国都有机会进行投标，直至仅剩一个参与国为止。这一投标国就是被选出的联邦领袖。
excerpt.en: In a few days the Golden Rule challenge for federation leadership will commence. Starting with the current leader: each empire in the federation will have a chance to place bids, until only one participant remains. That bidder is then elected leader of the fed

excerpt.zh:
我们在[from.target.capital_scope.GetName]上的两名关键特工在一场意料之外的自然灾害中身受重伤，该灾害同样造成了许多[from.target.GetSpeciesNamePlural]伤亡。附近居民紧急驰援，那几名特工现在得到了基本的照料。

[from.target.GetSpeciesNamePlural]还没能开始质疑我们的特工，尽管他们伤势严重，但和当地的大量受灾者相比不算什么。用不了多久，[from.GetName]行动就会受到更严格的审查——尤其是在我们的两名关键特工身体
excerpt.en: Two of our key operatives on [from.target.capital_scope.GetName] have been seriously injured during an unexpected, natural disaster which also claimed the lives of several [from.target.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Local residents rushed to their aid; the operatives

excerpt.zh: 尽管我们尚未从位于[This.System.GetName]星系的神秘宇宙飞船处获取太多情报，当前最有力的假说——根据其自身的行为以及它发射的尚未破解的信号里暗含的模式——是这艘舰船属于某个未知的太空文明。我们正全力破解他们的语言，希望能够尽早建立沟通。
excerpt.en: Although we have been unable to discover much about the mysterious vessel in the [This.System.GetName] system, the most convincing current hypothesis - based upon its behavior and the patterns of the still undecipherable signals we have intercepted from it - i

excerpt.zh:
我们的[This.Owner.GetResearchers]已经完成了对这种在[This.System.GetName]恒星系发现的非凡的、自由漂浮的晶态物体的调查报告。他们的发现令人震惊。

这些飞船般大小的物体以及它们的较小型的晶体卫星初看之下是无生命迹象的，然而一旦我们飞船靠近，它们就会突然改变方向并且从晶体内散发出能源波动，这说明它们也许是以生命形式存在的——这样的现象毫无疑问令人好奇，但我们得要小心处理。

我们最杰出且聪敏的科学家们都准备好研究这些实体了。
excerpt.en:
Our [This.Owner.GetResearchers] have finished investigating the reports of extraordinary, free-floating crystal-like objects observed in the [This.System.GetName] system. Their findings are startling.

The ship-size objects and their slightly smaller but equal

excerpt.zh:
随着越来越多的太空文明彼此间建立了正式的关系，星系之中愈发生机盎然。为了避免国家间出现悲剧性的误解，越来越多的外交人士呼吁设立一个新的泛星系组织——如果愿意的话也可以称为共同体，在那里星系中的各帝国可以召开会议，共商星系大事。

[Root.GetName]应该承诺支持星海共同体的创立吗？
excerpt.en: As more and more spacefaring civilizations establish formal relations with one another, the galaxy is becoming a vibrant and lively place. To avoid tragic misunderstandings between nations, an increasing number of diplomats have called for the establishment of

excerpt.zh:
我们已经摧毁了[from.GetName]所拥有的位于[fromfrom.GetName]内的博物天枢

我们可以从中取回一些有价值的标本。

此外，我们似乎还释放出了一些关在生态园里的太空兽群。很有可能它们会因为刚刚释放而变得既困惑又富有攻击性。
excerpt.en:
We have destroyed the Grand Archive in [fromfrom.GetName] owned by the [from.GetName].

We were able to recover some of the valuable Specimens inside.

Additionally, we seem to have released some amount of captive Space Fauna from the Vivarium. It's possible t

excerpt.zh: [Planet.GetName]表面炙热，不适宜生物生存。行星上明显的人工遗迹影像引起了[GetScientistPlural]的注意。考古调查或可揭示这里的居民和曾发生在他们身上的故事。
excerpt.en: The surface of [Planet.GetName] is scorching hot, and hostile to biological life. Images of clearly artificial ruins have therefore caught the attention of [GetScientistPlural]. An archaeological investigation could reveal who was here, and what happened to th

excerpt.zh: 远离[Planet.GetName]人口中心的活跃火山山脉中，一座古庙破败残存。了解其历史或能更深入了解当地文化。
excerpt.en: Far from the population centers of [Planet.GetName], in a range of active volcanic mountains, an ancient temple lies in ruins and disrepair. Understanding its history may grant us further insights into the planet's local culture.

excerpt.zh:
结晶熵研究揭示惊天秘密：在高浓度下，该物质可被用于制造足以摧毁整颗行星的武器。若我方掌握此力量，整个星系或将归于我手。

但若追求军事应用，将破坏与邻邦脆弱信任。谁又能保证此武器不会反噬自身？

若望证我方意图，必须公然削弱星系熔炉核心，禁止生产此类武器。否则，终会有人将其用于杀戮，即我方或他人。

该抉择将解锁特殊项目。
excerpt.en:
Our continued research into Crystallized Entropy has unveiled a chilling possibility: when highly concentrated, they can power weapons of unimaginable scale, capable of devastating entire planets. With such power, the galaxy could fall under our mercy.

But ex

excerpt.zh:
我们对结晶熵的掌控即将开启星系激变。已开通连接星系核心6个恒星系的虫洞。
若在各恒星系建立导管群设施，并守护免受干涉，我们即可燃烧整个星系。
excerpt.en:
Our mastery of Crystallized Entropy will soon allow us to begin a radical transformation of the galaxy. We have opened wormholes to six systems around the galactic core.
If we establish Conduits in each of these, and defend them from anyone who would meddle wi

excerpt.zh:
在[From.GetName]的地壳深处，埋藏着一些不完整的化石残骸，似乎是曾居住在[From.GetStarName]星系之中的以太巨龙的近亲。

这位以太巨龙的表亲死后，经过漫长的岁月，其柔软的身体组织已经硬化成石头，其骨骼也变得坚硬无比，形成了矿物一样的内部结构。
excerpt.en:
Buried deep in the crust of [From.GetName] are the partial, fossilized remains of what appears to have been a close relative to the Ether Drake that once dwelled in the [From.GetStarName] system.

In the eons since this cousin-Drake's passing, its soft tissues

excerpt.zh: 在击溃了[conquered_planet.GetName]的守军后，[From.GetName]的地面部队以大可汗之名占领了[conquered_planet.GetPlanetMoon]！他们在[conquered_planet.GetPlanetMoon]地表上的主要定居点高高升起这个新兴帝国的旗帜。现在，[From.GetSpeciesName]的殖民者们被赶出了他们已被摧毁的居住地，装进了运输舰中。
excerpt.en: After defeating the brave defenders of [conquered_planet.GetName], ground forces from the [From.GetName] have claimed the [conquered_planet.GetPlanetMoon] in the name of their Great Khan! They have raised the banner of their new empire over every major settlem

excerpt.zh: 间谍首脑[spynetwork.leader.GetName]已经组建了一支训练有方的特工小组。所有人员都将作为独狼参与其中，并已经做好了单程票的准备。他们现在只等一个目标-一个值得将其引向[target.GetName]重大灾难。
excerpt.en: Spymaster [spynetwork.leader.GetName] has assembled a team of highly-trained operatives. Those involved will work alone, and are prepared for the fact this will almost certainly be a one-way trip. All they need now is a target - a worthy catastrophe to draw to

excerpt.zh:
方舟舰的高级官员之一，[event_target:diplomatic_envoy_leader.GetName]，对我们最近接触到的文明产生了一种超乎寻常的热情——如果一定要用语言形容的话。

无论是我们的仪器所能捕捉到的每一份文化记录，还是每一抹艺术或哲学的残片，都被其悉数吸收：

“我已经见识了足够多的东西，足以明白这里有着某种非凡的存在。让我去把剩下的补全吧。让我站在他们的世界里去学习。”
excerpt.en:
One of the Arkship's senior Officials, [event_target:diplomatic_envoy_leader.GetName], has developed what can only be described as a profound passion for the civilization we have recently encountered.

Every cultural record, every scrap of art or philosophy ou

excerpt.zh:
作为我们[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]观测计划的一部分，绑架小队通过外科手术的方式在一部分[pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesName]的脑内装入了植入体，以便追踪他们的位置，监视他们的行为。不幸的是，由于一些制造上的瑕疵，许多植入体失灵了，现在……我们的测试对象身上还出现了一些副作用。

有些测试对象自杀了，还有至少三个测试对象陷入了歇斯底里的暴力状态。我们观测站上的[root.GetResearcherPlural]请求协助，对剩余的测试对象进行管制，在更多事故发生之前移除他
excerpt.en: As part of our observation efforts on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName], abduction teams have surgically installed brain implants on a number of [pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesName] test subjects to track them and monitor their behavior. Unfortunately, due to a manufacturi

excerpt.zh: 我们的一艘舰船迷失于虚境之中。
excerpt.en: One of our vessels has been lost to the Shroud.

excerpt.zh: 虽然我们与[overlord_empire.GetName]的契约本质是军事上的，但我们没有想到它会对我们产生如此恶劣的影响。我们的人民因宗主国的不断要求而受苦，我们的一些顾问推测，如果这种情况继续下去，将对我们的长期计划产生永久性影响。
excerpt.en: Though our agreement with [overlord_empire.GetName] is militaristic in nature, we did not expect the atrocious effects it would have on us. Our people are suffering with the constant demands from our overlord, and some of our advisors speculate that if it cont

excerpt.zh: 因内特贸易体试图保护这个恒星系中的一座小小的空间站不受星尘沙暴的影响。而这个风暴则始料未及地发育增强并且摧毁了许多其他的恒星系。为什么他们要如此费尽心机地保护这座设施呢？
excerpt.en: The Inetian Traders tried to protect a space station within this system from a small celestial dust storm. As an unforeseen consequence, the storm grew so large several other of their systems were destroyed. Why were they so desperate to protect this facility?

excerpt.zh:
我们正在召集精英灵能使集会，准备向虚境深处进军，与其中具有力量的势力交流。

在知道这个实体的真名之前，我们会称之为雕刻之物。
excerpt.en:
We are gathering a convocation of elite telepaths, ready to reach deep into the Shroud and commune with a force of significant power.

Until we know its true name, this being shall be referred to as the Sculpting Presence.

excerpt.zh:
[Root.GetName]的地表正在对我们的建设活动表现出前所未有的反应。一种无法甄别的粘稠物质开始从关键设施的地基中渗出。

这种渗出物是一种深红色液体，外观呈胶状，摸起来极具粘性。

我们的[Owner.GetScientistPlural]迫切希望进一步研究这种排放物。虽然目前它仅仅带来些许不便，但为确保[Owner.GetColonistPlural]的安全，最好还是谨慎行事。
excerpt.en:
The surface of [Root.GetName] is exhibiting an unprecedented reaction to our construction efforts. An unidentified viscous substance is beginning to ooze out from the foundations of key installations.

The ooze is some kind of crimson liquid; gelatinous in app

excerpt.zh:
[Owner.GetColonistPlural]汇报了关于[Root.GetName]上的沙子的奇特现象。

本该是风和日丽的一天我们定居点附近却唐突刮起剧烈的沙尘暴。如洪水般的流沙凭空出现又霎时消失无踪。甚至还有人在风平浪静的一天看到沙丘在横向移动。

这些事件至今没有找到任何气象或地理学的解释。

这些怪异的沙子没有造成直接的伤害，但妨碍到了我们殖民地的运作。对这一独特自然现象的研究仍在进行当中。
excerpt.en:
Our [Owner.GetColonistPlural] are reporting strange phenomena with the sands on [Root.GetName].

Severe sandstorms materialize abruptly in close proximity to our colony on otherwise calm days. Rivers of fast-moving sand appear from nowhere before stopping as s

excerpt.zh: 在对[fromfrom.planet.GetName]的扫描中发现在这颗行星最难以靠近的区域有一座孤立的设施。这座结构似乎正在休眠或已被抛弃，其中没有任何能量迹象，看起来也饱经风霜。进行考古发掘可能会带来更深入的洞见。
excerpt.en: Scans of [fromfrom.planet.GetName] discovered an isolated facility in the planet's most inaccessible region. The structure appears to be dormant or abandoned, with no energy signature and signs of prolonged weathering. An archaeological expedition may yield fu

excerpt.zh: [Planet.GetName]上发现了一个硕大无朋的金属立方体。它的外表天衣无缝暗示了先进的技术能力，但我们还无从推测它的起源或功能。考古发掘也许能提供答案。
excerpt.en: A colossal metallic cube has been found on [Planet.GetName]. Its seamless form is suggestive of advanced technological capabilities, although we cannot begin to speculate upon its origin or function. An archaeological expedition may provide answers.

excerpt.zh: 废墟遍布[From.Planet.GetName]，但奇怪的是，从它们的爆炸模式来看，似乎是大量的地下核爆引发了这一切，而不是正常的大气层核爆或是轨道轰炸。这需要进一步调查，或许需要一次考古挖掘来揭露这里到底发生了什么。
excerpt.en: Ruins cover [From.Planet.GetName], but oddly the blast patterns seem to indicate that vast nuclear explosions occurred underneath the surface rather than from atmospheric or orbital bombardment. This warrants further investigation, but it will require an archa

excerpt.zh:
一个完全由不明骨头建造的原始城市废墟在经历这颗星球上的一场强力沙尘暴之后被发现。

我们的科学家渴望发掘这座可怕的古城。
excerpt.en:
The ruins of a primeval city built entirely out of bones of an unknown origin have been unearthed following a violent sandstorm on this planet.

Our archaeologists are eager to begin excavation on this grisly ancient city.

excerpt.zh:
我们在这颗星球上发现了有着令人惊异数量的严重异变化石，它们都属于同一种已灭绝的智慧物种。

究竟是什么导致了一个高等社会数百万成员的异变？我们的考古学家想进一步调查。
excerpt.en:
A surprising number of heavily-mutated fossils has been found on this planet, all belonging to the same species of extinct sapients.

What could have led to the mutation of millions of members of a once-advanced society? Our archaeologists would like to invest

excerpt.zh: 在这颗星球的地壳内，数量惊人的地下通道系统交错盘旋。究竟是什么造就了这一切呢？
excerpt.en: An extensive network of subterranean tunnels of truly astounding proportion make swirls in the crust of this planet. What could have created them?

excerpt.zh: 一艘印有精致外星徽章但严重受损的军舰正环绕着[From.From.GetName]。这艘舰船遭受了一次严重的高温侵袭，以至于它的船壳被融化，舰内也没有幸存者。我们现在已知的所有武器都不能产生能造成这样损伤的温度，也许船上的飞行日志能让我们对此次袭击略知一二。
excerpt.en: A badly damaged military vessel bearing elaborate alien insignia circles [From.From.GetName]. The ship has suffered a heavy incendiary attack which has melted its hull, leaving no survivors aboard. No weapons known to us today can produce temperatures high eno

excerpt.zh: 在这颗卫星上的一个大陨石坑内，可以找到一座大型基地建筑群的遗迹。它已经被遗弃了几千年之久。围绕着附近行星的能量屏障似乎是源于这个古老的基地正下方的一个能量源。
excerpt.en: Ruins of a large base complex of some kind can be found inside a large crater on this moon. It must have been abandoned thousands of years ago. The energy barrier that encompasses the nearby planet appears to originate from a source directly beneath this ancie

excerpt.zh: 这颗小行星的表面覆盖满了被其低重力束缚的机器人碎片。看起来它们都是由军事行动造成的。如果这些作战机器人没有被破坏到无法修复的话，本来是足够武装几只军队的。
excerpt.en: The entire surface of this small asteroid is covered in robot debris, trapped in its weak gravity field. All of it appears military in nature, and there are enough combat droids here to outfit several armies had they not be shattered beyond all repair.

excerpt.zh: 对[From.GetName]进行深度扫描显示，覆盖表层的冰幔下面有很多水暖阀口，这些阀口将一整片大洋加热。首席[Owner.GetScientist][Root.GetLeaderName]从[Root.GetName]派遣了探测器，这些探测器钻透了几里厚的冰层，发现了地下的水体里面充满了生命。我们需要更多的资源进行一次彻底的研究，探查居住在这片深洋里的诸多生命形式。
excerpt.en: Deep scans of [From.GetName] have revealed a large ocean heated by hydrothermal vents beneath the ice mantle covering the surface. Lead [Owner.GetScientist] [Root.GetLeaderName] dispatched probes from the [Root.GetName] that drilled through several miles of th

excerpt.zh: 五千年前的某段时间，[From.GetName]的近地轨道上发生了一次大规模的太空战役。[From.GetPlanetMoon]的一侧地表上到处都是武器打偏留下的打击坑。对[Root.GetName]的扫描显示地表存在一些遗骸。虽然这些破损飞船的保存状况都很差，但历经数千年这些飞船还能留下一些东西就足以证明了它们的设计是非常尖端的。科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]正在组织一次考察行动，考察的目的是通过盘查这些古老舰体来寻找一些有价值的科技。
excerpt.en: There is clear evidence that a massive space battle took place in close orbit of [From.GetName] at some point in the last 5,000 years. The surface on one side of the [From.GetPlanetMoon] is pockmarked with craters from stray weapons blasts, and scans from the

excerpt.zh: 在对[From.GetName]的地表进行扫描时，[Root.GetName]上的[Owner.GetScientistCapital][Root.GetLeaderName]发现了人工雕刻的石板，上面写着外星文字。[From.GetPlanetMoon]上没有侦测到其他的外星活动，这个壁画究竟是如何到这里来的仍然是个谜。我们接下来就准备着手进行破译工作。
excerpt.en: While conducting surface scans of [From.GetName], [Owner.GetScientistCapital] [Root.GetLeaderName] aboard the [Root.GetName] discovered what appears to be an artificially carved slab of rock covered in alien writing. No other signs of alien activity on the [Fr

excerpt.zh:
在对[From.GetName]进行调查时，[Root.GetName]检测到轨道中有一个自动化船坞的残骸。这个船坞至少有一千年的历史了，并且曾经被重型导弹轮番轰炸过，所幸的是其中一个船坞仍可以使用。

科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]确信能够恢复船坞的电力，但过程会比较复杂。
excerpt.en: While conducting their survey of [From.GetName], the [Root.GetName] detected the remains of an automated shipyard in orbit. It is at least a thousand years old and seems to have been subjected to a heavy missile barrage, but one of its manufacturing bays is st

excerpt.zh: 对[From.GetName]的深度扫描显示这颗气态巨行星的大气层中有一艘大型飞船。根据附近的碎片看，过去曾经有人试图回收它，但都失败了。任何足以抵挡如此强大引力的飞船都是非常珍贵的。科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]提出了自己的回收计划。
excerpt.en: Active scans of [From.GetName] have picked up what appears to be a large ship deep inside the atmosphere of the gas giant. Judging by the nearby debris, there have been several failed attempts to salvage this derelict in the past. Any ship strong enough to wit

excerpt.zh:
[From.GetName]是一颗生态丰富的热带星球。对其表面植被的近距离分析却表明其生物异常缺乏多样性，一种特殊的高大树木成为了生态系统的主体部分。

虽说这种树木本身并不会造成什么危害，但其单一的主导地位却会对该星球小型动物的生存带来不利影响，若要进行殖民，想在其表面有效率地培育农作物也会异常困难。

科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]作为享有盛誉的外星生物学专家，制定了重新平衡此星球生态系统的计划。
excerpt.en:
[From.GetName] is a tropical planet with a thriving biosphere. A close analysis of surface flora reveals an unexpected lack of diversity, as one particular family of tall trees dominate the ecosystem.

Though not harmful in and of themselves, their monocultura

excerpt.zh:
在[From.GetName]的沙丘下面，我们的科学团队找到了坠毁的战斗机舰队。虽然很古老，但是却保存的十分完好。它们早已经被遗弃，但是引擎和照明部件似乎还能运作。它们坠毁的原因目前尚不清楚。我们在旗舰的舰桥上面找到了舰队的人工智能，它能够在战斗中指挥这些船只，并且其仍在运作。我们靠近的时候，它拉响了警报。在入侵者靠近的时候它就会自动启动。
我们能够施行一个特殊项目在这个人工智能发疯之前回收它。我们也可以毁了它，避免未知的风险。
excerpt.en: Under the dunes of [From.GetName] the science team has found a fleet of crashed fighters. Ancient, yet well preserved. They are abandoned, but the lights and engines seem to function. Why they crashed is a mystery. On the main ship bridge we found a fleet AI,

excerpt.zh:
我们收到科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]的报告。据说有一个……陶瓷容器在围绕着[From.GetName]的恒星旋转。真奇怪。

这种东西不应该出现那儿，然而不管怎样它确实在近地轨道上。

可以发布特殊项目来研究该容器并找出它出现在那里的原因。
excerpt.en:
We have gotten a report from Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName]. It seems that a... ceramic container is circling the star [From.GetName]. Most peculiar.

It should obviously not be there, yet somehow it has managed to find its way into a close orbit.

A Spe

excerpt.zh:
在巨型小行星[From.GetName]的地表下，我们发现了让人叹为观止的东西。有一台采矿设备安置在岩体上，一直挖到小行星地核深处！看情况它是被遗弃了，没有任何痕迹显示是谁留下的。

如果我们能够把这部机器停下，我们也许能够从中学习到制造它的科技，但一定要趁早，免得它被岩屑什么的压碎。
excerpt.en:
Deep within a crevice of the giant asteroid [From.GetName] we have found something astonishing. There is mining gear attached to the rock, digging itself into the vast depth of the asteroid! It stands abandoned, with no sign of who placed it there.

If we can

excerpt.zh:
我们发现了一座传感阵列，孤零零的俯瞰着[From.GetName]。这颗[From.GetPlanetMoon]上没有任何值得一提的智慧生物，所以这一定是座被遗弃的哨站。它的年代不算久远，但却无法使用了。

我们需要修理并研究它才能让它恢复运作，不过要是拆毁它也许能够让我们学习到新的技术。
excerpt.en:
We have found a sensor array, solemnly standing watch on [From.GetName]. The [From.GetPlanetMoon] has no sapient life to speak of, so it must be an abandoned outpost. It was built recently, but is not functioning.

It would require both repairs and research to

excerpt.zh:
我们在围绕着[From.GetName]的小行星中发现了一艘外星飞船在那里漂泊。它对我们的联络新号毫无反应。它到底是无法解析我们的信号，还是可能因为其他原因无视我们，我们无从得知。

科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]建议我们派遣一艘工程船来，将其拖出碎片区。要是不管它的话，这艘外星飞船很可能会被小行星撞碎。

已发布一项特殊项目去拯救飞船并调查它。
excerpt.en:
We have discovered an alien ship adrift among the asteroids surrounding [From.GetName]. It is not responding to our hailing signals. Whether this is due to it being unable to interpret our signal, or perhaps some other reason, we do not know.

Science Officer

excerpt.zh: 我们的[Owner.GetScientistPlural]有了更加惊怖的发现。他们早前扫描到的山脉，实际上是某个巨型蛋的卵壳膜。我们也不知道究竟是什么巨兽诞下了这么一枚蛋，更不知道何等的怖兽会从中孵化出来。
excerpt.en: Our [Owner.GetScientistPlural] have discovered something rather monstrous. The mountain range they scanned earlier was in actuality the outer membrane of a gigantic egg. It's uncertain what behemoth could lay such an egg and what horror would hatch from it.

excerpt.zh:
[From.GetName]的异常能量读数的来源确定是一个蓝色的小球。[Owner.GetScientistPlural]汇报，传感器从中发现了相反极性的快子。

该物体周围的地面上刻着符号，也许是由某个更古老的文明留下的。目前不清楚是符号的含义是指引还是警示。

完整的文本还远不能翻译，但部分符号似乎与时间测量和[Solar_System.GetName]恒星系中天体相对位置有关。
excerpt.en:
The source of the unusual energy readings noted on [From.GetName] is confirmed to be a small, blue orb. The [Owner.GetScientistPlural] report that sensors pick up tachyons of reverse polarity.

Symbols are carved into the ground around the object, perhaps plac

excerpt.zh:
在[From.GetName]上正要着手开展钻取作业之后，[Root.GetLeaderName]产生了强烈的幻觉。虽然没有受到身体伤害，但他们报告说，他们起先是被破碎不连贯的视觉和嗅觉幻觉所淹没，这些幻觉展现了某种未知的外星物种。

已经准备了一项特殊项目来进一步调查这些怪异的晶体贮藏。
excerpt.en: After setting up to drill into the ice layer on [From.GetName], [Root.GetLeaderName] experienced intense sensations. While not physically harmed, they reported being initially overwhelmed by disjointed visual and olfactory hallucinations depicting an unknown a

excerpt.zh:
对[From.GetName]的进一步探索非但没解开多少谜题，反而让它更加疑点重重。这里的地表到处都散落着栩栩如生的雕塑，脸上无声地凝固着痛苦的神情。

科学家们的意见发生了分歧；有些认为这些东西曾经是生物，是被一种未知的力量变成了石头。而另一些则认为它们代表了一个失落已久的文明所崇拜的神灵。更谨慎的少数人认为，这些雕像不是一种致敬，而是一种警告：对任何胆敢骚扰这颗行星的人发出严厉的警告。
excerpt.en:
Continued exploration of [From.GetName] has yielded more questions than answers. The surface is littered with eerily lifelike statues, their expressions petrified in silent agony.

Our scientists are divided; some believe that these forms were once living bein

excerpt.zh: 在[From.GetName]冰壳之下的勘探，我们发现了一片广阔的地下洞穴。令人惊叹的是，这座隐蔽的温室中存在着一个郁郁葱葱的生态系统——茂密的动植物在隔绝环境中蓬勃生长，受到冰层保护而远离星球表面恶劣的环境。洞穴内保持着稳定的微气候，很可能是由地热喷口维持的。
excerpt.en: Excavation beneath the icy crust of [From.GetName] has revealed a vast subterranean cavern. Remarkably, this hidden greenhouses is a thriving ecosystem, a lush flora and fauna flourish in isolation, protected by the ice from the planet's surface otherwise host

title.en: The Greatest Show in the Multiverse

excerpt.zh:
我们在这颗小行星上发现的发光物体是一则广告。

这个巨大的展示装置由内部占据小行星的机械基础设施支持。小行星本身在空间中的某一点上异常地悬浮着，不受任何附近物体的引力影响。

广告本身是关于它所称之为“多重宇宙的最佳秀场”的内容。有一个终端可以接受能量币，使我们直接前往这个景点。
excerpt.en:
The brightly lit object we discovered on this asteroid is an advertisement.

This massive display is supported by a mechanical infrastructure occupying the inside of the asteroid it is mounted on. The asteroid itself is anomalously suspended at one point in sp

excerpt.zh: 一个神秘的物体出现了。我们相信我们对时空裂缝的探索引起了某个人或某个东西的注意。
excerpt.en: A mysterious object has appeared. We believe our exploration into the rifts between space and time has drawn the attention of someone, or something.

excerpt.zh: 我们已消灭行商联盟之家——贸易空间站堂吉。这些贪婪害虫完蛋了！
excerpt.en: We have crushed the profiteering vermin that called Tradestation Tungle home. The Caravansary Caravan Coalition is no more!

excerpt.zh:
在我们探索[Root.GetName]上靠近我们居住站的废墟时。一些殖民者无意中激活了[Root.GetPlanetMoon]上以前使用核武的战争中遗留下来的未引爆的核聚变武器上的计时器。

这个大约35兆吨当量的核心炸弹一旦引爆，附近的数个居住站将从地图上被抹去。此核聚变武器极度不稳定所以无法去挪移，我们也没有足够的时间去撤离这个区域。
excerpt.en:
While exploring some ruins near one of our major settlements on [Root.GetName], a few colonists inadvertently activated the timer on an undetonated hydrogen bomb left over from the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]'s previous nuclear war.

With an estimated yield of 35 meg

excerpt.zh: 我们在对[Root.GetName]的深度空间跟踪矩阵有了重要的发现——目前正有一颗巨大的小行星正在向[Root.GetPlanetMoon]飞来！如果任由它撞击表面的话，将会造成灾难性的后果。必须尽早消灭这颗小行星！
excerpt.en:
Our deep space tracking arrays on [Root.GetName] have made an alarming discovery - a large asteroid is heading towards the [Root.GetPlanetMoon] on a direct collision course! Should it impact the surface, the consequences would be disastrous.

The asteroid must

excerpt.zh: [Root.GetName]本地的政府失误导致一小群叛军收获了更多支持者，他们反对我们的传统思潮。支持他们的人越来越多，这让他们在该区域获得了更大的权利。这样的支持同时也让他们在获得民众支持上取得了一定成功，他们可以利用这些支持来发展自己的事业。
excerpt.en: Local political drama on [Root.GetName] has resulted in increased support among a small group of rebels, opposed to our underlying ethics. Their increased support have enabled them to gain more power in the region and vote for their own causes with limited suc

excerpt.zh: 在[Root.GetName]上定居了一段时间之后，我们收集到了一些奇怪的数据。具体来讲，[event_target:roguemoon.Planet.GetName]的地质构成似乎与[Root.GetName]大相径庭。这意味着它不是与星球同时形成的，而是原本在别处形成，后来不知怎的被[Root.GetName]的重力场捕获了。至于[event_target:roguemoon.Planet.GetName]到底源自何处仍是个谜。
excerpt.en: Now that [Root.GetName] has been settled for a while, some data irregularities have been noticed. Specifically, the moon [event_target:roguemoon.Planet.GetName] does not seem to be made of remotely similar material to [Root.GetName]. This suggests it was not f

excerpt.zh: 随着最后一艘敌舰停止运转，观测分析子例程汇报了一件怪事。这些入侵者的舰船外观与[Root.GetName]在多年前已经停止生产的型号别无二致。而且，这些舰船也不具有超光速引擎，武器也相对老旧。汇报尚未结束时，一道通讯请求信号从怪异的裂口中发出，响彻了整个星系。这个信号使用的竟是我们最高级别的信号交换协议……不过是10年前的版本。
excerpt.en: As the last corvette is rendered inoperable, observation analysis subroutines report something abnormal. The invader ships are similar to outdated vessels that the [Root.GetName] stopped producing years ago. Additionally, the ships lack FTL drives and are equi

excerpt.zh: [Root.GetName]上的构造变动导致一个巨大板块上的黑曜岩薄层破碎。熔岩倾泻而出遍布地表，造成了毁灭性的影响。从殖民地发回的报告相当可怕。
excerpt.en: Tectonic events on [Root.GetName] have caused the Obsidian sheets on one of the giant plates to shatter. Lava pours across the surface to ruinous effect. Reports from the colony are dire.

excerpt.zh: 紧随着最近过境的电力风暴，在[From.Planet.GetName]的地表之下探测到了一场难以解释的能量骤增。进一步扫描发现了一座古老的地下复合体，其中的发电机被风暴重新激活，让这座设施又开始了运作。
excerpt.en: Following the passing of a recent Electric Storm, an unexplained power surge was detected beneath the surface of [From.Planet.GetName]. Further scans revealed an aging subterranean complex whose power generators were reactivated by the storm, bringing the faci

excerpt.zh: [Root.GetName]上的传感器发现[Root.GetStarName]表面正呈现出在超强耀斑出现之前所特有的动荡现象。考虑到[frozen_in_time_planet.GetName]远古文明的命运，我们的[Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural]正在争分夺秒设计一个护盾矩阵来抵挡即将到来的巨量等离子喷发。
excerpt.en: Sensors on [Root.GetName] indicate that [Root.GetStarName] is exhibiting surface turbulence typical to that preceding a superflare. Considering the fate of the ancient civilization on [frozen_in_time_planet.GetName], our [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] are scr

excerpt.zh:
[Root.GetName]船员在研究[From.GetName]时有了惊人发现，星球地表上被遗弃的居住点曾经是某爬行动物社会居住的地方，现在这种爬行动物仍在该星球上生存着，但已经失去了所有高等智能！[Root.GetLeaderName]仔细的调查了这些爬行动物是如何从会制造工具的农耕社会退化为普通的野兽，结果让所有人大吃一惊。

居住站埋葬的爬行动物尸体的颈椎中有某种组织，而这种组织在那些没有智能的爬行动物身上不存在。测试发现这些组织其实是某种神经共生体，通过脊柱与宿主的大脑相连。这些共生体存在于星球地表的温泉
excerpt.en: The [Root.GetName] crew have made some astonishing discoveries on [From.GetName]. The abandoned settlements first seen from orbit were once inhabited by a society of reptiles that still populate the planet - but have since lost all capacity for sapient thought

excerpt.zh:
[From.GetName]附近的空投舱已经在断电状态下漂浮了好一阵子。[Root.GetName]报告称，无论这些外星舱里原本装了什么，都在几百年前就消逝了，只剩下了干瘪的空壳。
