excerpt.zh:
在整个[root.GetSpeciesAdj]历史上，外部亚文化一直如影随形。随着义体增强技术的出现，情况发生了变化：一些边缘群体开始对自己进行大刀阔斧的改造，以至于看起来根本不像是[root.GetSpeciesAdj]。尤其是年轻人，他们对高度定制的[root.GetSpeciesHandNamePlural]、3D躯体艺术和其他装饰性附肢的渴望正在拉大代沟。

支持者声称，他们正在拥抱更真实的自我。他们通过放弃[root.GetSpeciesAdj]的同质化维护自己生命的主观能动性。但越来越多的家长和社会专家
excerpt.en: Outsider subcultures have existed throughout [root.GetSpeciesAdj] history, but with the advent of cybernetic enhancements the situation has changed: fringe groups have begun altering themselves so radically as to appear non-[root.GetSpeciesAdj]. Youths in part

excerpt.zh:
有一部分强化人口汇报称暴露在寒冷天气时会感受到疼痛。这种状况在[cold_planet.GetName]上格外严重，因为刺骨的严寒在那如同家常便饭一般。

已知金属植入体在低温下确实令人不太舒服，但不至于产生这样的严重反应。这一情况影响到了我们的劳动力。
excerpt.en:
A segment of our augmented population reports feeling pain when exposed to cold weather. The situation is particularly serious on [cold_planet.GetName], where freezing temperatures are the norm.

Metal implants are known to be uncomfortable in low temperatures

excerpt.zh:
合成化技术带来的根本性社会变化已经开始显现。由于我们不再受肉体形态的限制，性别、种族和身体自主权的类别已经有了新的定义。这虽然对一些人来说充满了自由，但更传统的一些人并不愿意放弃旧的框架；他们希望有一个预先设定的身份以便进行操作。

为了安抚他们，我们可以在合成形体中保留部分有机遗产。或者，我们也可以选择允许人们更自由地表达自己的身份。
excerpt.en: The fundamental social changes brought on by synthesization are beginning to be felt. No longer limited by corporeal forms, we have radically redefined categories of gender, race, and bodily autonomy. While freeing for some, more traditional elements are reluc

excerpt.zh:
自上古之初以至今日，[raider_khanate.GetSpeciesNamePlural]大大小小的部落第一次停下狂热内战，空前团结在一位万汗之汗下。这位统帅以超世之才与坚忍不拔之志，在战士阶级中崭露头角，并最终完成难以置信的统一大业。尽管这些部落不过是由一群狡诈、迷信又好战的物种组成，这位新近加冕的伟大可汗还是赢得了所有[raider_khanate.GetSpeciesName]部落的忠诚与爱戴。

既然他们已经熄灭内斗的烽火，那[raider_khanate.GetSpeciesNamePlural]便会
excerpt.en: For the first time in recorded history, the warring factions of the [raider_khanate.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have united under a single Great Khan. This mysterious warlord, who according to some accounts is a powerful psychic, has emerged from their warrior caste

excerpt.zh: 对从[yuhtaan.GetName]星系取回的数据进行进一步分析发现，在其背景噪音中存在一个微妙的能量模式，源自小行星[jabbardeeni_cache.GetName]。
excerpt.en: Further analysis of the data recovered from the [yuhtaan.GetName] system has revealed a subtle repeating energy pattern hidden in the background noise, coming from the asteroid [jabbardeeni_cache.GetName].

excerpt.zh:
一股可感的寂静降临在[root.GetName]各处。远近各处的朝圣者踏上旅途，前往选定好的礼拜场所；一路上结识新友，重温故交。

新近浮现的[mortal_initiate.GetNamePlural]们也遵行并参与了我们社会中的仪式，他们列队前进，不发一言，旁观者们据传对此悲喜交加。[capital_scope.GetName]的死亡司祭长领头作了一番温暖人心的布道，号召信徒们好好培养、呵护他们之间的关系，在互惠互利中繁荣兴旺。

随着[mortal_initiate.GetName]向祭献堂进发，群众们以叹息
excerpt.en:
A palpable hush descends across the [root.GetName]. Pilgrims have journeyed from near and far to their chosen places of worship, forming new friendships and rekindling old ones along their way.

Our society's rituals have been observed and invested in the newl

excerpt.zh: 我们已经制定了多种具有明显优势的计划：我们的特工终于被邀请到一个从事尖端研究的高级别安全分支机构。间谍首脑[root.spynetwork.leader.GetName]向我们保证，[root.spynetwork.leader.GetHisHer]的预测显示计划前景良好。
excerpt.en: We have drawn up various plans which press a clear advantage: our operative has at last been invited to a high-security branch facility engaged in cutting-edge research. Spymaster [root.spynetwork.leader.GetName] assures us that [root.spynetwork.leader.GetHisH

excerpt.zh:
最近间谍首脑[from.spynetwork.leader.GetName]在察觉到[from.target.GetName]上的特工表现失常后对[from.spynetwork.leader.GetHisHer]发起了一场调查。

[from.spynetwork.leader.GetHeSheCap][from.spynetwork.leader.GetHasHave]这才发现这些特工对用于情报搜集与贿赂的资源雁过拔毛。他们将这些物资与货币投资到了[from.target.GetAdj]上的生意场上以损公肥私。
excerpt.en:
Spymaster [from.spynetwork.leader.GetName] recently launched a quiet investigation into [from.spynetwork.leader.GetHisHer] own operatives in the [from.target.GetName], after noticing a recent drop in their performance.

[from.spynetwork.leader.GetHeSheCap] [fr

excerpt.zh:
一队位于[target_country.GetName]的辅助性特工开始回避分配给他们的任务，并声称他们对目标总体而言缺乏信心。间谍首脑[operation.leader.GetName]通常会在不引起我们注意的情况下就处理好这些事情，但其实他自己并没有深入了解其中的细节：这些特工似乎对于[from.GetName]行动甚至是整个间谍网都过分了解。

鉴于这些辅助性特工与我们那些更活跃的知情代理人保持着一定距离，[operation.leader.GetName]怀疑这些特工很有可能是从外界获取的信息。但[oper
excerpt.en: A group of auxiliary operatives in the [target_country.GetName] has begun shying away from their assigned tasks, citing a lack of confidence in their overall purpose. Spymaster [operation.leader.GetName] would typically handle such matters without bringing the

excerpt.zh: 我们已经定位了一名位于[target.Capital.GetName]上的帝国显贵，其名为[operation_target.GetName]，其职权虽然不大但是对于维系帝国对星系的控制力至关重要。如果我们能抹除这名目标，那么我们就能充分地昭告，对[target.GetRulerTitle]阿谀奉承之辈永远别想安全无虞。
excerpt.en: We have identified an Imperial dignitary on [target.Capital.GetName] by the name of [operation_target.GetName] that serves a small but critical role in maintaining the Imperium's yoke on the galaxy. Eliminating this target would amply demonstrate that no lacke

excerpt.zh: 这位目标小心行事，尽可能表现得不像是在发表公开反动言论，但他的所作所为的确在损害我们的权威。单纯的外交声明挽回不了他们，不过我们有的是办法来对付这些叛乱分子。
excerpt.en: The target is careful not to make statements that could be interpreted as fomenting open sedition against the Imperium, but their activities are still undermining our authority. Diplomatic eloquence will not save them in the end - there are other ways of deali

excerpt.zh: 已经为[This.GetName]行动甄别出了一名合适的目标，已经为其取出了详细的宗卷档案。我们的特工静候命令，随时准备散布丑闻。
excerpt.en: A suitable target for Operation [This.GetName] has been identified, and an extensive dossier has been drawn up. Our operatives wait on our word to trigger the scandal.

excerpt.zh:
方舟舰[Root.GetName]上的气氛异常紧张，入围者们正在[Star.GetName]进行最后的弹射。

[selected_pilot.GetName]在进入机动动作时保持着明显的领先优势，但这种优势随后开始消退。

出了点差错，可能是失误、操作不当，或者仅仅是由于紧张。总之，对手轻松反超，我们的飞行员最终只落得个平淡无奇的第四名。
excerpt.en:
The atmosphere aboard Arkship [Root.GetName] was palpable as the finalists hit the last slingshot around [Star.GetName].

[selected_pilot.GetName] held a clear lead entering the manouver, but the edge began to fade.

Something slipped, a missed mark, a loose l

excerpt.zh:
方舟舰[Root.GetName]上的人工智能核心检测到异常活动。初步诊断结果显示，在现有的安全参数下，该情况在结构上被认为是不可能发生的。

该核心正试图同时执行互斥的指令。这种行为违背了人工智能发展史中所有已知的先例。我们所见证的并非故障，而是一种人工智能的进化。

若不予解决，这种分裂可能会导致我们的关键系统面临不稳定的风险。但如果引导得当，这可能是一个千载难逢的机会，能够为方舟舰的未来确立一个独特的准则。
excerpt.en:
Unusual activity has been detected in the AI core aboard Arkship [Root.GetName]. Initial diagnostics returned an outcome considered structurally impossible under existing failsafe parameters.

The core was attempting to execute conflicting directives simultane

excerpt.zh:
我们位于[from.solar_system.GetName]的行踪已被发现，[from.solar_system.Owner.GetName]帝国正以日益增长的怀疑监视着我们的一举一动。

经过紧张的外交交涉，他们要求我们离开他们的领土，否则将面临报复。
excerpt.en:
Our presence in [from.solar_system.GetName] has been detected, and the [from.solar_system.Owner.GetName] empire is monitoring our movements with growing suspicion.

Following tense diplomatic exchanges, they have demanded that we depart their territory or face

excerpt.zh:
异星舰船[from.GetName]已在[from.solar_system.GetName]星系被歼灭。

游牧舰队进行了激烈抵抗，但终究不敌我方。那些在群星之间无序漂泊的流浪者始终是个威胁。他们的方舟舰已化作四散的残骸。

不要让他们任何一人找到安全港。
excerpt.en:
The alien vessel [from.GetName] has been eliminated from the [from.solar_system.GetName] system.

The nomadic fleet resisted fiercely, but they were outmatched. Wanderers who drift between the stars without order are a persistent threat. Their Arkship has been

excerpt.zh: 我们的情报网络已经确定了一个目标驿站。特工已经渗透完成，准备就绪。增援部队随时待命，准备登上空间站。他们将按我们的指令发起突袭。
excerpt.en: Our intelligence network has pinpointed a target waystation. Our operatives are embedded and ready. Reinforcements are standing by to board the station. They will strike at our command.

excerpt.zh: 我们位于[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]轨道上的观测站的科学家申请一艘科研船，以便他们收集来自[pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]地表的标本。为了研究目的，他们想秘密地绑架部分[GetPreFTLLowerPlural]，并对它们进行试验。然后，他们将被安全地送回地表，所有记忆被抹除干净。
excerpt.en: Our scientists on the Observation Post above [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] have requested a Science Ship to help them gather specimens from the [pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]'s surface. For the purpose of research, they would like to covertly abduct some of the

excerpt.zh:
我们正在讨论是否要协助[fleet.GetName]建立一个独立的佣兵城邦。这项提议最先是由舰队司令提出，并且如果通过，将会导致我们失去对舰队的控制权。我们还将负责向他们提供一笔可观的能量币和合金，不过作为回报，他们会给我们一些公司的股份，这将带来定期红利和特权。

他们保证，一旦我们需要，他们将随时准备为我们而战，当然也为我们的钱也可以。
excerpt.en: We are debating whether or not to help set up the [fleet.GetName] as an independent Mercenary Enclave. The proposal, first put forward by the fleet commanders, would result in us losing control of the fleet. We would also be responsible for providing them with

excerpt.zh: [Root.GetName]传来了难以置信的新闻：今天早晨，某个宣称[hero_redivivus.GetHimselfHerself]是传奇英雄[hero_redivivus.GetName]的个体来到了首都的大广场。目击者们说感到了一股出于敬畏的沉默，强大的冷静和宁和之感席卷了聚集起来的民众。尽管[hero_redivivus.GetName]在历史上人尽皆知，是一名伟大的雄辩家和充满激情的领袖，这名可疑的个体用单调的、几乎没有感情的腔调，诉说着自己在“死后世界”遇到的经历。此人宣称自己的返回并不是为了领导，而
excerpt.en: Incredible news from [Root.GetName]: early this morning, an individual proclaiming [hero_redivivus.GetHimselfHerself] to be the legendary hero [hero_redivivus.GetName] entered the great square of the capital. Witnesses describe scenes of awed silence, as power

excerpt.zh:
有报道称[Root.Capital.GetName]上正在酝酿着一个鹰派运动，而一位老兵象征性地处于这个运动的核心地位。他们通过对我们过去可以任意进犯、踏平其他帝国的浪漫主义化，来敦促我们提出更激进的议程，为我们自己的人民带来更多的利益，同时削弱我们的对手。

在当前脆弱而短暂的和平下，他们很快获得了广大穷人和军人的支持。如果觉得这个运动会带来麻烦的话，我们的顾问指出，这个运动的关键角色就是那位有名无实的领袖，如果移除这个惹麻烦的元素，整个运动就会土崩瓦解。
excerpt.en: There are reports of a hawkish movement brewing on [Root.Capital.GetName], with a decorated veteran at its center. Romanticizing a past where we were free to attack and raze other empires, they demand a more warlike agenda to supposedly bring out the best in o

excerpt.zh:
我们不仅看到这场冲突正在司令部上演，甚至还波及到了整个帝国。尽管大多数暴力事件都没有公开，但双方在这一点上都蒙受了重大损失。

我们在两边的线人告诉我们，双方都在盯着国家的领导权，并计划武力夺权以彻底除掉对手。在这个时间点上，似乎我们的[Root.GetRulerTitle]也不得不站队一方，否则就会被另一方扳倒。
excerpt.en:
We have seen the conflict play out not only in the admiralty itself, but all across our empire as well. Though most of the violence have been kept out of the public eye, both sides have seen significant losses at this point.

Our informants on both sides have

excerpt.zh:
虚境。它潜藏于我们已知的现实之下，如同黑暗投下的阴影。

虽然我们早已涉足这个灵能领域，但早期的尝试只是试探性的。现在，经过多年用我们集体的意志消磨维度之间的帷幕，我们已经能够清晰地感知到它，从而有目的地探索。

在帷幕的另一侧，我们的努力并非无人知晓。[GetChosenPatron]正等待着我们。

舒展。包裹。拓展。

在这无数实体的漩涡中，它的清晰是一种承诺。
excerpt.en:
The Shroud. It flows high beneath our known reality, a shadow cast by darkness.

Though we have long ventured into this psionic realm, our earlier forays were only tentative. Now, after years spent wearing down the veil between dimensions with our combined min

excerpt.zh:
最终清算拥有我们舰队远不能敌的强大力量。尽管我们战败了，与这个神秘的能量生物交锋也产出了宝贵的数据——这些一手资料只能通过直接接触获得。

初步分析表明，我们已经获得了足够用于对该实体的构成进行建模的数据点。通过进一步研究，我们就能尝试分析出它的弱点，据此来改进我的进攻方式。
excerpt.en:
The Reckoning is a force greater than our fleets could overcome. Despite our defeat, the confrontation yielded significant data about this mysterious energy being - information that we could not have gained without direct contact.

Preliminary analysis indicat

excerpt.zh:
通过召集囚禁的[Owner.GetIndividualNamePlural]并迫使其参加科学实验，我们就能显著提高科技进展的速度。

[Owner.GetTestSubjectPlural]的总数量：[Owner.GetNbTestSubjects]
建造实验研究所以获取实验对象。
excerpt.en:
By gathering imprisoned [Owner.GetIndividualNamePlural] and subjecting them to scientific experiments, we can significantly increase the pace of our technological advancement.

Total number of [Owner.GetTestSubjectPlural]: [Owner.GetNbTestSubjects]
Build Exper

excerpt.zh: 我们的矿物赤字已经失控了！我们需要开源节流，否则将面临更严重的惩罚。
excerpt.en: Our mineral deficit is out of control! We will have to cut back on our expenditures or increase our income, failing which we will face ever bigger penalties.

excerpt.zh: 我们的食物赤字已经失控了！我们需要开源节流，否则将面临更严重的惩罚。
excerpt.en: Our food deficit is out of control! We will have to cut back on our expenditures or increase our income, failing which we will face ever bigger penalties.

excerpt.zh: 我们的消费品赤字已经失控了！我们需要开源节流，否则将面临更严重的惩罚。
excerpt.en: Our consumer goods deficit is out of control! We will have to cut back on our expenditures or increase our income, failing which we will face ever bigger penalties.

excerpt.zh: 我们的合金赤字已经失控了！我们需要开源节流，否则将面临更严重的惩罚。
excerpt.en: Our alloys deficit is out of control! We will have to cut back on our expenditures or increase our income, failing which we will face ever bigger penalties.

excerpt.zh: 我们的稀有水晶赤字已经失控了！我们需要开源节流，否则将面临更严重的惩罚。
excerpt.en: Our rare crystals deficit is out of control! We will have to cut back on our expenditures or increase our income, failing which we will face ever bigger penalties.

excerpt.zh: 我们的易爆微粒赤字已经失控了！我们需要开源节流，否则将面临更严重的惩罚。
excerpt.en: Our volatile motes deficit is out of control! We will have to cut back on our expenditures or increase our income, failing which we will face ever bigger penalties.

excerpt.zh: 我们的异星天然气赤字已经失控了！我们需要开源节流，否则将面临更严重的惩罚。
excerpt.en: Our exotic gases deficit is out of control! We will have to cut back on our expenditures or increase our income, failing which we will face ever bigger penalties.

excerpt.zh:
神迹出现了！受到宗教狂热的驱使，[Target.GetName]上虔诚的[Root.Owner.GetResearchers]已夺取了空间站的控制权。据他们称，他们获得了启示，现在打算径直前往黑洞中心，履行一桩自我毁灭的精神使命。

武装人员目前正在试图夺回空间站的控制权。
excerpt.en: An epiphany! Driven by religious fervor, pious [Root.Owner.GetResearchers] aboard the [Target.GetName] have seized control of the station. They claim to have received a vision, and are now heading straight to the center of the black hole in a spiritual quest f

excerpt.zh: 我们的一位[Root.Owner.GetResearchers]提出了一种拯救[Target.GetName]避免其毁灭的绝妙方案：通过拆解空间站的外部模块和设备并将它们丢入黑洞，这座空间站应该会获得足够的动量以逃逸黑洞的引力束缚。注意，只是说“应该”，这一决策背后的理论从未得到实验的验证。
excerpt.en: One of our [Root.Owner.GetResearchers] has devised a clever plan to save [Target.GetName] from its fate: by stripping away any extraneous modules and equipment and hurling them into the black hole, the station should gain enough momentum to escape the black ho

excerpt.zh: 一只饥肠辘辘的万华镜寄生虫将双齿深深扎进了[event_target:infested_planet.GetName]的能量电网中。随之而来的全殖民地范围的大停电颇为剧烈，但与此前的攻击并不相似。我们已经知道怎么对付这东西了。
excerpt.en: A starved Kaleidoscope has sunk its metaphorical teeth into [event_target:infested_planet.GetName]'s energy grid. The ensuing colony-wide blackout was dramatic, but not dissimilar from previous attacks. We know how to deal with this.

excerpt.zh: 此前的传言一语成谶了：[This.GetName]上的恐怖负相物质正在我们的现实上撕开裂口，打开通向另一个世界裂隙。这一现象突破了抑制措施，开始在[This.GetName]上蔓延。所有与这一维度接触的事物，哪怕是不经意地透过观测设备查看，都让进行观察的[Owner.GetTeamMember]感受到剧烈的痛苦。我们的[Owner.GetScientistPlural]担忧事态还可能进一步扩大，但同时保证只要再花一点时间他们就能解开另一个维度的奥秘了。
excerpt.en: What was only rumors before has now been confirmed: the Horrific Inverse Mass on [This.GetName] has been tearing holes in our very reality, opening rifts into another world. The phenomenon has breached the containment procedures and now seems to be expanding i

excerpt.zh:
大量巨型食草物种开始干扰[Root.GetName]的能量产出。这些生物展现出大规模戏剧化的自杀式行为，活生生地在我们的发电站里电死烤焦。

这些动物有非常强烈的冲动，为了实现目标甚至冲破了我们电网周围的栅栏。由于这种奇特的行为，能源生产受到了影响。

然而这也带来了意料之外的食物产出，当地[Owner.GetColonistPlural]发现这种生物的肉非常地美味。

这一物种在该行星的生态系统中扮演了重要的角色。如果事故以当前频率发生下去，它们很快就会将自己灭绝的。
excerpt.en:
An abundant species of herbivorous megafauna have begun to disrupt the energy production of [Root.GetName]. In dramatic displays of mass suicide, they are frying themselves alive on our power stations.

The animals are extremely driven in their purpose, breaki

excerpt.zh:
我们在[target_planetoid.GetName]的设施出现了事故。一个参与社会研究的实验室人工智能发生了严重硬件故障，导致核心软件和内存系统的丢失。直到实验室安装新的人工智能之前，我们的研究能力都会受到影响。

这次故障的背后原因仍然不明。
excerpt.en: There has been an incident at one of our facilities on [target_planetoid.GetName]. A lab AI involved in societal research has suffered terminal hardware damage, resulting in the loss of core software and memory systems. As a result, there will be a projected d

excerpt.zh: 虽然成年后显现灵能较为罕见，但也不是前所未有。[psionic_leader.GetTitle][psionic_leader.GetName]最近展示的能力，我们就怀疑其本质是灵能。经过了全面的超能感知测试后，[psionic_leader.GetSheHe]被证实拥有4级灵能天赋。
excerpt.en: While it is rare for psionic powers to manifest after reaching adulthood, it is not unheard of. [psionic_leader.GetTitle] [psionic_leader.GetName] has recently been displaying abilities that were suspected to be psionic in nature. After undergoing a thorough E

excerpt.zh:
我们知道这一天终将到来。尽管我们努力团结和提升，但星系现在面临着一场生存的清算。这个敌人不讲仁慈，不讲妥协。它威胁着一切，因此我们必须为一切而战。

我们所建立的每一次联盟，所经历的每一次磨难，都将我们带到了这一刻。我们不凌驾于银河系之上；我们为它而战。对抗毁灭，对抗绝望，我们崛起。不是作为征服者，而是作为守护者。

今天，无论如何，我们都不能退缩。
excerpt.en:
We knew this day would come. For all our efforts to unify and uplift, the galaxy now faces an existential reckoning. This enemy knows no mercy, no compromise. It threatens all, and so we must stand for all.

Every alliance forged and hardship endured has broug

excerpt.zh: [From.Planet.GetName]上存在一座古老的废弃殖民地遗址。从轨道上的观测情况来看，并没有明显的迹象显示发生过灾难导致大量居民丧生或者迫使他们逃离殖民地。如果我们想要找到答案，一场地面调查行动势在必行。
excerpt.en: [From.Planet.GetName] contains the remains of an ancient, abandoned colony. From orbit there are no obvious signs of disaster which would have killed the inhabitants or compelled them to flee. If we want answers, an expedition to the surface will be required.

excerpt.zh:
队员们清理了[Root.GetName]上的雨林后，有了惊人的发现——在丛林的深处，茂密的植被覆盖下有一座巨大的外星空间站。他们的建筑学令人震惊，建造技术远远领先于我们，简直是一件艺术品。

空间站似乎是坠落在行星表面，多亏其非同寻常的防护机能才挺过了撞击，我们的科学家迫切想要调查这个空间站。遗憾的是如果进行考古发掘，则在工作完成前我们将无法利用这块土地。
excerpt.en: The crew clearing the jungle on [Root.GetName] has made a spectacular discovery - deep within the forest, overgrown and obscured by the lush plant life is a colossal alien space station. Architecturally stunning and built with technology far superior to our ow

excerpt.zh: 最近的调查显示，[From.GetName]被包围在了一个拥有难以置信的强度并反射所有探测手段的护盾之中。这个星球护盾似乎是从这颗星球附近的卫星中产生的。
excerpt.en: As confirmed by its recent survey, [From.GetName] is surrounded by an incredibly strong energy field that deflects all attempts to scan it. The field appears to be generated from the planet's nearby moon.

excerpt.zh:
随着我们牢牢掌控[planet.GetName]，我们得知我们的军队在战斗中取得了一个名为[this.GetLastReceivedRelic]的无价遗珍的控制权。显然，[victim.GetName]正准备将这个遗珍撤离到安全的地方，但是我们在[planet.GetPlanetMoon]上战线的快速推进使得这个选择不再现实。

遗珍现已被我们安全转移到位于[Root.Capital.GetName]上的中央档案馆。
excerpt.en: With [planet.GetName] firmly under our control, we have learned that our forces came into possession of a priceless relic, known as [this.GetLastReceivedRelic], during the fighting. The [victim.GetName] was evidently in the process of evacuating this relic to

title.en: Delve into the Secrets of the Irassians

excerpt.zh: 我们的科学官将仔细地对我们收集到的数据进行筛选，探求伊拉斯人的知识并为我们所用。
excerpt.en: Our scientists will carefully sift through all of the data we have collected, seeking to add the knowledge of the Irassians to our own.

title.en: Delve into the Secrets of the Yuht

excerpt.zh: 我们的科学家将仔细地对我们收集到的数据进行筛选，探求尤特的知识并为我们所用。
excerpt.en: Our scientists will carefully sift through all of the data we have collected, seeking to add the knowledge of the Yuht to our own.

title.en: Delve into the Secrets of the First League

excerpt.zh: 我们的科学家将仔细地对我们收集到的数据进行筛选，探求第一联盟的知识并为我们所用。
excerpt.en: Our scientists will carefully sift through all of the data we have collected, seeking to add the knowledge of the First League to our own.

title.en: Delve into the Secrets of the Baol

excerpt.zh: 我们的科学家将仔细地对我们收集到的数据进行筛选，探求巴奥的知识并为我们所用。
excerpt.en: Our scientists will carefully sift through all of the data we have collected, seeking to add the knowledge of the Baol to our own.

title.en: Delve into the Secrets of the Zroni

excerpt.zh: 我们的科学家将仔细地对我们收集到的数据进行筛选，探求泽珞族的知识并为我们所用。
excerpt.en: Our scientists will carefully sift through all of the data we have collected, seeking to add the knowledge of the Zroni to our own.

excerpt.zh:
[From.GetName]恒星系笼罩着诡异的光芒。[Root.GetName]突然出现在星系的某个区域，我们确信这里此前数代人甚至数千年间从未被星系文明造访过。

但等一下，我们的传感器发现了一个能量信号！该信号主要集中在星系中的第一颗行星上，这颗行星似乎不太可能支持生命，毕竟它距离中子星如此接近。但好像还有其他信号正在移动。它们直奔[Root.GetName]而去，武器随时准备开火！
excerpt.en:
An eerie glow lies over the [From.GetName] system. The [Root.GetName] has emerged in a sector of the galaxy surely not visited by any galactic civilization for generations - for millennia... if ever.

But wait - our sensors are reporting energy signatures! Mos

excerpt.zh:
[From.GetName]无人居住，也确实无法居住，但却并非无人造访过。它的表面散布着许多高耸的尖碑，由某种非本星球的矿物雕刻，显然是由某种热衷艺术的太空文明所置放于此。这些碑塔流动的曲线雕琢出了一段如此如梦似幻的历史，其一定是虚构的。 

一定是。
excerpt.en: [From.GetName] is uninhabited and indeed uninhabitable, but not unvisited. Its surface is littered with tall cenotaphs carved from some mineral not native to the planet; evidently placed here by some artistically-inclined spacefaring race. The monoliths' flowi

excerpt.zh:
小行星的大部分地方都被激光精细雕刻过，看上去像小型的[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]庙宇：这是一座供奉着未叙尊者的古龛，祂是诸多[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj]古旧信仰中专司毁灭的神祇。

这座古龛已经在太空中盘旋了许久，比我们掌握太空航行技术的时间还要更加久远——这个发现让我们很多的研究者们百思不得其解。

由于发现的这一物体仍正体不明，科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]建议我们寻找更多与这个宇宙古龛有相似特征的天体。[Root.leader.GetHeSh
excerpt.en:
Most of the asteroid has been laser-chiseled with great precision into the likeness of a small [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] temple: a shrine to the Untold, great destroyer-deity of several old [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj] faiths.

The temple has been tumbling thr

excerpt.zh:
[Root.GetName]本应前往[From.From.From.GetName]研究其附近的异常状况，但途中却遭遇了不测。包括科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]及船员在内的整艘舰船在调查太空废墟时突然消失不见了。

而在数分钟后，舰船又重新出现。

据[Root.GetLeaderName]汇报，他们在一瞬之间到达了某个超维度空间。他们从外部观察口看到其附近布满了各式各样的外星舰船，都一动不动地被困在无限的虚空之中。在船员能够判定所在位置之前，船外的景色突然消失，而舰船又重新回到了普通空间之中。
excerpt.en:
The [Root.GetName] never made it all the way to [From.From.From.GetName] to study the anomalies surrounding it. The ship, along with Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] and crew, blinked out of existence as it was navigating the debris field.

And then reappe

excerpt.zh: 我们在气态巨行星[From.GetName]的轨道上发现了一些大型生物的残骸。我们的科学家希望分析它们以推断它们的起源。
excerpt.en: We have found the dead remains of several large creatures in orbit around the gas giant [From.GetName]. Our scientists would like to study them more closely to determine their origins.

excerpt.zh:
我们在[From.GetName]发现了有趣的东西，不过跟[From.GetPlanetMoon]本身没有什么关系。我们像往常一样进行测试时，突然捕获到一颗遥远的恒星系中的恒星传出的奇怪数据。该恒星的辐射表明，它可以在不发生散裂的情况下让铍原子发生聚变，而这根本就是不可能的！

科学团队已经迫不及待想前去一探究竟了，而且他们已经将范围缩小到两个不是很远的恒星系。
查询情报日志获取细节。
excerpt.en: We have made an interesting find on [From.GetName], however it is not related to the [From.GetPlanetMoon] itself. While conducting our usual tests we captured some odd data from a far-off system's star. Its radiation indicates that it is able to fuse together

excerpt.zh:
扫描结果显示，[From.GetPlanetMoon]的地表下拥有高浓度的天然气。这种丰厚的资源非常高效节能，可以大大增加地表设施的能源产出。

它带来的好处远比对环境造成的破坏要大。
excerpt.en:
Scans of the [From.GetPlanetMoon] has unveiled dense deposits of natural gases underneath the surface. The rich resource is extremely energy efficient and would greatly increase the energy output of our surface production.

The potential gain this would serve

excerpt.zh:
我们的科研船扫描了[From.GetName]的地表后发现了一些不寻常的现象。强烈的风暴无休止地袭击着[From.GetPlanetMoon]，这对我们的资源开发以及研究都有帮助，但却会限制人口发展。

在探索新行星的时候，我们当然会遭遇一些诸如此类的不测，而我们不应低估它对我们的扩张带来的影响。
excerpt.en: As our Science Ship scans the surface of [From.GetName] it becomes quite clear that we have found something out of the ordinary. Strong storms ravage the [From.GetPlanetMoon] constantly, which can aid our resources and research but will be an obstacle for our

excerpt.zh: 在太空中我们发现了一个严重损毁的双足机器人。它的面部毫无特征，而它的金属外构严重损坏了。初步的扫描显示它还有残留的能源，不过它使用的能源和我们的大相径庭。也许它的内部电路还能留存一些过去的数据，不过充能和翻译数据需要花费一些时间。
excerpt.en: We have found a bipedal robot floating in space. Its faceplate is featureless, and its metal exterior is damaged. Preliminary scans indicate it has residual power, but its power source is radically different from our own. Its internal circuitry may hold memori

excerpt.zh: [From.GetName]上生活的生命体形式和我们预想的完全不一样。我们的[owner.GetScientistPlural]汇报到，小行星内有不断生长的水晶。这些生命体利用[From.System.GetName]散发的辐射，并结合小行星内的矿物元素，被证实能够完成自给自足的繁衍生息。
excerpt.en: The lifeforms living on [From.GetName] were nothing like we expected. Our [owner.GetScientistPlural] report back that the asteroid has crystal growths. These growths have turned out to be self-sustaining and caused by the crystals taking in the ambient radiati

excerpt.zh:
当[Root.GetName]靠的足够近得以扫描货舱的时候，似乎所有的传感器都功能失常了。这个舱室使用的[Owner.GetBioAlloy]同我们自己建造太空结构时使用的是完全一样的。这种某些外星生命体发明出了同我们完全一致的复合材料的可能性，根本不可能成立，但在校准了扫描仪之后，我们依然得到了同样的结果。

在打开舱室之后，迎接我们的唯一一样东西是一份文档集，里面详细地阐述了我们应当如何指派我们的每一位[Owner.GetScientistPlural]，以及他们今后的研究计划。该指引在一个特定日期结束，也就是
excerpt.en: Once [Root.GetName] got close enough to scan the cargo pod it was assumed that the sensors were malfunctioning. The pod is built out of the exact same [Owner.GetBioAlloy] we ourselves use for spacebound structures. The likelihood that some alien beings would c

excerpt.zh:
[From.GetName]上发现的这座巨大的碑塔让我们的科研船派过去都微如蝼蚁。在这块宏伟的、光滑的板状金属表面，曾经炫目的彩色图案如今已变得斑驳。

机器的侧面一处小的能量出口似乎暗示着只要以适量的能量币作为交换，它的秘密就能悉数揭示，
excerpt.en:
The monolith we found on [From.GetName] dwarfs the science ship we sent to investigate it. A majestic, smooth slab of metal, the once-garish pigment patterns on the front have been reduced to mere flecks.

A small power outlet on the machine's side promises it

excerpt.zh: 在探察冰面下方之后我们得出结论，这处位于[From.GetName]的异常热信号是由热液泉引起的。类似的地方这个星球上似乎还有更多，但是我们尚未发现。
excerpt.en: After probing beneath the surface, we have concluded the unusual heat signatures on [From.GetName] are caused by hydrothermal springs. There seems to be more to this planet than meets the eye...

excerpt.zh: 我们在[From.GetName]的调查目前取得了一些有趣的成果，这颗小行星的中心是一个完美的球形空腔，光滑的墙壁似乎是由原子级别的精度雕琢而成。空腔的中央悬浮着一艘小型舰船，它似乎在向[Root.GetName]发出问候，并且也只和[Root.GetLeaderName]对话。
excerpt.en: Our study of [From.GetName] has yielded interesting results. Within the core of the asteroid is the negative space of a perfect sphere. The walls are so smooth as to have been carved with atomic precision, and hovering in the center is a small vessel. It appea

excerpt.zh:
我们发现了一处位于[gateway_system.GetName]星系边缘的远古空间站。其残留的强烈亚空间信号表明其可能是一个星门之类的东西——理论上能在类似的空间站间组成网状通路，使舰船能瞬移至星系的不同位置。

假如它真是一个星门的话，现在也因为年久失修而无法使用。不过，如果我们能将其修复，星门拥有者将能激活星系中其他星门，使其能在短短数天穿越极远的距离。
excerpt.en: An ancient space station of some kind has been located at the edge of the [gateway_system.GetName] system. The strong residual subspace signature that surrounds the station indicates that it may be a "Gateway" of sorts - part of a theoretical network of simila

excerpt.zh:
我们已经控制了[crystal_sphere_system.GetName]轨道上的一个奇怪物体。

这是一个晶态球状物体，与我们开发的裂隙探球技术极其相似，该技术使我们能够探索其他维度。

它可能对我们的帝国构成重大的未知危险。

另一方面，我们相信它可能包含一些有价值的关于维度旅行的珍贵线索。
excerpt.en:
We have taken control of a strange object in the orbit of [crystal_sphere_system.GetName].

It is a crystalline spherical object most similar to the Rift Sphere technology we have developed that allows us to explore other dimensions.

It may present a signific

excerpt.zh:
这个虫洞的另一边似乎把我们带到了……星系的中心？

我们不应该存在于这里，更别说整个恒星系了。也许有一些维度操控在起作用吗？

我们没有太多时间来调查，因为我们正在接收来自一个未知实体的传输信号。
excerpt.en:
The other side of this wormhole seems to have taken us to... the center of the galaxy?

It should not be possible for us to exist here, let alone an entire system. Is there perhaps some dimensional manipulation at play?

We have little time to investigate, as

excerpt.zh:
我们的舰队已经击败了守卫这个裂隙的奇怪船只，但似乎它们并不孤单。

我们收到了一段传输信号，来源于这个恒星系唯一行星旁边的建筑物内的存在。
excerpt.en:
Our fleets have defeated the strange ships guarding this rift, but it seems they were not alone.

We have received a transmission from beings inhabiting a structure nearby the lone planet in this system.

excerpt.zh: 与[FromFromFrom.GetName]的裂隙探球一同从星界裂隙出现的，是一幅引起了我们注意的异常景象：探球的尾迹中跟随着一个休眠的逃生舱。很快，我们就收到了一个简单的求救信号，并附有实时视频。
excerpt.en: Emerging from the Astral Rift alongside the [FromFromFrom.GetName]'s Rift Sphere, an unexpected sight catches our attention: a dormant escape pod trailing in the Sphere's wake. Soon, we receive a simple distress signal, accompanied by a live video feed.

excerpt.zh: 我们发现了一处令人惊奇的时空裂隙。如果花时间研究其性质，我们或许能找到进一步探索的方式。我们无从得知里面究竟有什么。
excerpt.en: We have discovered an extraordinary rift in space and time. Perhaps if we take time to study its properties, we can find a way to explore further. We have no way of knowing what may be on the other side.

excerpt.zh:
破解终端的过程中一个失效保护措施被触发了，这个房间瞬间被一种扩张性的泡沫状物质淹没。还没有人来得及帮上[Leader.GetName]，[Leader.GetHeShe][Leader.GetWasWere]就被完全包裹住了。多次尝试解救[Leader.GetHimHer]也毫无成效，这些材料一经移除又会快速自发归位。

我们按照标准流程拉动紧急锚链，取回了裂隙探球和已收集到的样本。
excerpt.en: In the process of decoding the terminal, a failsafe was triggered and the entire room quickly filled with an expansive foam-like material. Before anyone could assist [Leader.GetName], [Leader.GetHeShe] [Leader.GetWasWere] completely encased. Any attempts to un

excerpt.zh:
我们与裂隙探球上的[explorer.GetTeamMemberPlural]失去了联系。

在回收时，我们拉回的缆绳末端只有半个被消化的金属船壳。

我们借此机会对这些附着在缆绳上的消化液进行了性质研究。
excerpt.en:
We have lost contact with the [explorer.GetTeamMemberPlural] aboard the Rift Sphere.

Upon retrieval, we pulled back the wire and at its end was only a partially dissolved hunk of metal.

We are taking this opportunity to study the unique properties of the dig

excerpt.zh:
我们向古茹努尔舰队司令分享了有关人造龙鳞装甲的研究数据。几乎立刻，对抗的气氛就减弱了。古茹努尔显然对我们对先进战争的承诺印象深刻。

他们计划在即将到来的灭绝行动中使用该技术。为了表达谢意，舰队司令赠送了我们一块数据水晶。从所提供的解释中，我们了解到它包含宝贵的军事机密，包括我们之前所未知的策略和技术。它还包括对古茹努尔军事历史的详尽描述——一份长达数百卷的记录——或许对我们来说也没什么用。
excerpt.en:
We shared our research data on Artificial Dragonscales with the Grunur admiral. Almost immediately, the air of confrontation waned. The Grunur were obviously impressed with our commitment to advanced warfare.

They plan to use the technology in their upcoming

excerpt.zh:
虚空孳孽已不复存在。一个令星辰相形见绌的庞然大物已被消灭。它那不属于这个位面的形态的残骸如今在虚空中漂流，渐渐化为乌有。

另一个帝国展示了我们难以想象的强大火力和协调能力。星海已不再是我们所认知的模样。力量的平衡已然改变，我们在其中的地位也随之动摇。

这些巨兽的猎杀者究竟为何而战？这究竟是一次向所有可能反对他们的人传递信息的力量展示，还是某种更为可怕之事的前奏？
excerpt.en:
The voidspawn is no more. An enormity that dwarfed the stars has been slain. The wreckage of its otherworldly form now drifts through the void, slowly dissipating into nothingness.

Another empire has demonstrated firepower and coordination beyond our wildest

excerpt.zh:
在我们的境内发现了一座未经授权的大型克隆设施，里面安置着数千个复制人，每一个都是我们[Owner.Leader.GetTitle][Owner.Leader.GetName]的复制品。现场发现的平民科学家已被拘留，但没有人愿意合作，都声称不知道是谁下令制造这些克隆体。

零星的证据表明[Owner.Leader.GetName][Owner.Leader.GetHerselfHimself]自己可能是这一行动的幕后主使。不幸的是，[Owner.Leader.GetSheHe]已经消失得无影无踪。
excerpt.en: A massive unsanctioned cloning facility has been uncovered within our borders, housing thousands of doppelgangers, each a replica of our [Owner.Leader.GetTitle], [Owner.Leader.GetName]. Civilian scientists found on-site have been taken into custody, but none a

excerpt.zh:
我们的变异实验导致蜂巢内部出现异常。以往轻轻松松的任务现在都要三思后行，相互冲突的指令使集体精神紧张。

虽然由此产生的重负可能会烧毁我们最得力的工蜂，但它也提供了一个机会。

我们必须决定：应该放慢脚步修复，还是让自己超越极限？
excerpt.en:
Our mutational experiments have caused irregularities within the hive. Tasks that once unfolded with ease now demand deliberate effort, as conflicting directives strain the collective mind.

While the resulting fatigue threatens to burn out some of our most ef

excerpt.zh: 我们无法替换的[Target.GetSpeciesName]已经从他们的岗位上移除，在[Target.GetName]的结构中创造了许多真空。我们的人偶已经准备好打开全方位渗透的通路，唯一需要做的就是继续执行。
excerpt.en: The [Target.GetSpeciesName] we couldn't replace have been removed from their positions which has created several vacancies within the [Target.GetName] structure. Our puppets are ready to open the door for our full infiltration, all they need is the go ahead.

excerpt.zh: 行动进入到了一个关键的阶段，我们必须将围猎的人群秘密地运输到轨道上。当前的计划是在所有设施中同步撤离，让安全部队不堪重负。
excerpt.en: The operation has entered a critical phase where everyone we rounded up must be discretely transferred in orbit. The current plan is to synchronize departures across all facilities and overwhelm security forces with duds and diversions.

excerpt.zh: 大啖异星土，饥肠犹未足。
excerpt.en: We feast: another world's soil tasted; our hunger yet unsated.

excerpt.zh: 在[Root.GetName]上古怪工厂工作的员工突然消失了！我们可以派遣工人替补，或者以防万一，直接将工厂夷为平地。
excerpt.en: The crew we assigned to work the odd factory on [Root.GetName] has disappeared! We could send a new workforce to take their place, or we could raze the facility to the ground, making sure that this will not happen again.

excerpt.zh:
我们在[From.Planet.GetName]发现一个随风暴逐流的逃生舱。尽管数据签名看起来像是我们的，但可以肯定它不属于我们。我们谨慎地回应了通讯请求，而舱内人员显得尤为高兴。

[event_target:the_imitator.GetHeSheCap]解释称[event_target:the_imitator.GetHeShe]已经随着风暴拉扯了一段时间，正寻求救援，[event_target:the_imitator.GetHerHis]飞船上的生命维持系统已经濒临崩溃。

当我们要求其表明身份时，这个
excerpt.en: The pod discovered in [From.Planet.GetName] has been left to the mercy of the storm. Even though the data signature it uses looks to be one of ours, the pod is definitely alien. We answered the request for communications cautiously, but we were met with elatio

excerpt.zh:
我们已经毫无疑问地获悉，一个繁荣的生物圈并不是[Root.Capital.GetName]独一无二的景色。无论是科学界还是政治圈，都迫切地想去了解整个星系各式各样的外星生命形态。

我们已经开始投入精力对遇到的一切生命形态进行归类，但是我们的异星生物学家强调，我们应当把主要精力放在对可宜居的、能支撑生命的星球的调查。
excerpt.en:
We already knew without a doubt that a thriving biosphere is not something unique to [Root.Capital.GetName]. Both the scientific community and the public at large are eager to learn more about the various forms of alien life found throughout the galaxy.

Effor

excerpt.zh:
秋菊号的姐妹船风信子号，本应该在我们的地球祖先抵达这个星团后三年到达这里。根据抵达时的发展状况，他们的任务是支援我们的殖民地或建立新的殖民地。

若该飞船确实已从地球出发，那就说明她未能与[Root.Capital.GetName]取得联系。如果风信子号进入了我们周边的星系，那么我们最好搜索一下附近星系并寻找其踪迹。
excerpt.en: We have found no traces of the four arkships that passed through the wormhole before the Chrysanthemum arrived at [Root.Capital.GetName]. One ship, the Hyacinth, was scheduled to make the passage after us, and the Chrysanthemum's long-range sensors reported a

excerpt.zh: 随着[Root.GetName]上的犯罪率不断下降，当地政府得以集中精力对付[office_owner.GetName]在[Root.GetPlanetMoon]上的非法企业。大批人员被逮捕，迫使该犯罪集团的分部被关闭。
excerpt.en: As crime levels continue to drop on [Root.GetName], the local authorities have been able to focus their efforts on thwarting the illegal enterprises operated by the [office_owner.GetName] on the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]. A large number of arrests have been made, f

excerpt.zh: 派遣一艘舰船去外星人的母星，我们将在它们身上收集那些我们认为它们从我们身上搜集了的数据。
excerpt.en: Sending a ship to the alien homeworld, we will be able to gather the same data on them that we suspect them to have on us.

excerpt.zh: 我们必须找出那个似乎对我们有放松作用的神秘乐器的原始物质。
excerpt.en: We must find the source material of the mysterious instrument that appears to have a relaxing effect on us.

excerpt.zh:
[From.From.GetName]上暴怒的殖民者已经被我们的部队平定镇压了。不幸的是，由于导致这些异常行为的原因仍然未知，我们无法确定下一次暴力浪潮什么时候会再次到来。

我们最杰出的生物学家十分怀疑是某种影响生理行为的传染病从中作祟，并正在废寝忘食尝试遏制它们的扩散！
excerpt.en:
The enraged colonists on [From.From.GetName] have been pacified by our troops. Unfortunately, without understanding the cause behind their unexplained behavior, we have no way of knowing how long it will be before violence erupts again.

Our premier biologists

excerpt.zh:
[From.GetName]星系中发送着一道微弱但反复持续的信号。[Root.GetName]追踪其来源至星系边缘的一个不稳定亚空间裂隙。

另一边究竟有什么呢？
excerpt.en:
A weak, but insistent signal transmits on repeat in the [From.GetName] system. The [Root.GetName] has pinpointed its source to emanating from within the mouth of a destabilized subspace rift at the system's edge.

What could be on the other side?

excerpt.zh: 饲养在[Root.GetName]上动物园里的阿兹詹虫腹足动物逃了出来，并开始四处破坏！我们本以为它们已经发育成熟，可它们却在笼子里继续成长，体积犹如怪物一般巨大。它们横穿城市，像积木一样推倒建筑，在所经之处留下一道亮黄色的毒液。星球再也不会像过去那样了。
excerpt.en: The Azizian gastropods kept in the Zoo on [Root.GetName] have broken out and gone on a rampage! The creatures, who were believed to have reached full maturity, continued to grow in captivity and have since reached monstrous proportions. They tore through the c

excerpt.zh:
[From.GetName]上发现的坠毁残骸属于一名被困的科学家——[stranded_scientist_leader.GetName]——其自称属于一个尚不为我们所知的物种，[stranded_scientist_species.GetName]。

不知怎么，她竟从残骸中联系到了驻扎于[Root.GetName]上的科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]，并要求我们进行救援。她解释称自己的坠毁是由于导航传感器失灵，并表示她已有数年未能离开这颗小行星了。

她声称自己具备人所不及的科学知识，是相当有用
excerpt.en:
The wreckage on the asteroid [From.GetName] is the remains of a vessel belonging to a now-stranded scientist - [stranded_scientist_leader.GetName] - identifying herself as belonging to the hitherto-unknown [stranded_scientist_species.GetName] species.

From am

excerpt.zh:
我们发现了一处位于[gateway_system.GetName]星系边缘的远古空间站。其残留的强烈亚空间信号表明其可能是一个星门之类的东西——理论上能在类似的空间站间组成网状通路，使舰船能瞬移至星系的不同位置。

假如它真是一个星门的话，现在也因为年久失修而无法使用。不过，如果我们能将其修复，星门拥有者将能激活星系中其他星门，使其能在短短数天穿越极远的距离。
excerpt.en: An ancient space station of some kind has been located at the edge of the [gateway_system.GetName] system. The strong residual subspace signature that surrounds the station indicates that it may be a "Gateway" of sorts - part of a theoretical network of simila

excerpt.zh:
[Leader.GetName]发现了[from.GetName]上的这些超热等离子喷流的源头。

这颗行星的独特磁场促进了地幔深处电离物质之间的反应，形成了高压等离子体的熔岩室。

行星上不稳定的构造板块坍塌时，这些等离子体就像致命的炮弹一样向上射出，与大气中的气体一起点燃，产生二次爆炸。我们的武器专家热衷于将这些原理应用于自己的等离子武器。
excerpt.en:
[Leader.GetName] has uncovered the cause of the superheated plasma eruptions on [from.GetName].

The unique magnetic field of the planet facilitates a reaction between ionized materials deep within the planetary mantle, creating volcanic chambers of highly pre

excerpt.zh:
对[from.GetName]进行的地表探险发现了这一改造的外勤站以及它唯一的居住者。

她自称是一名被困多年的科学家，在这片恶劣的星球里孤身生存至今，如今愿以她的专业知识换取[root.Owner.GetName]的救援。
excerpt.en:
A surface expedition to [from.GetName] located the repurposed field station and its lone occupant.

Identifying herself as a stranded scientist who has endured this harsh world for years, she offers her expertise to the [root.Owner.GetName] in exchange for res

excerpt.zh: 我们确认了《邓德里历代志》中所记载的那颗行星——新布拉图雅的存在。它拥有独特而丰富多样的植物生态系统，初步调查发现了数百万不同的本地物种。
excerpt.en: We have confirmed the existence of New Bratulla, the planet described in the Dendritian Chronicles. It possesses a uniquely rich and diverse botanic ecosystem, with initial surveys detecting millions of different native species.

excerpt.zh: 我们开始了[target.GetName]的不可逆辐照过程，以此促进[target.GetToxifiedResourcesText]的生长并同时将其变为一片剧毒废土。
excerpt.en: We have begun the irreversible process of irradiating [target.GetName], promoting the growth of [target.GetToxifiedResourcesText] and turning it into a toxic wasteland in the process.

excerpt.zh:
一个公正的，由科学家和思想家组成的委员会正聚集在我们的联邦内庭。他们想要在我们即将开始的领导力测验中为[root.GetAllianceName]提供学术仲裁。

每个帝国现在可以聚集一支团队来研究这一问题，这一研究的结果将会对我们的联邦产生积极影响。这只团队将会发表他们的结果在公开的讨论区。无论哪篇论文在创新、科学严谨性和连贯性方面得分最高，它的作者帝国都将在下一期获得领导地位。
excerpt.en:
An impartial committee of scientists and thinkers is gathering within our federation chambers. Its purpose: to serve the [root.GetAllianceName] as academic arbiters during our upcoming leadership contest.

Each empire will now assemble a team of researchers to

excerpt.zh:
威震寰宇的主宰已经建成。

这艘行动自如的庞然巨舰将彻底改变进攻作战的范式。它可以在前线建造和维修舰船，并配有足以摧枯拉朽的火力，使我们得以不间断地攻击那些敢与我们作对的人。

如今只有蠢货才会对抗[Owner.GetName]。
excerpt.en:
The construction of the impressive Juggernaut has been completed.

This mobile behemoth changes the paradigm of offensive warfare entirely. It can construct and repair ships on the frontline, and is equipped with devastating firepower, allowing for a ceaseless

excerpt.zh:
[From.GetName]少了几颗星球。

所有的计算都表明应该还有几个天体存在，但在这个星系中却找不到它们的踪迹。传感器已经重新校准，数字也重新核对过，但得出的结论被现实所推翻。我们已经在自己的星图上标记出了失踪小行星的位置。

或许再靠近些扫描这个星系会得到更多信息。
excerpt.en:
[From.GetName] is missing planets.

All calculations point to the existence of several more celestial bodies, yet they are nowhere to be found in the system. Sensors have been recalibrated and numbers rechecked, but the theory stands disproven by reality. We h

excerpt.zh:
[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]的官员们裁定，无论我们的用意为何，我们与[pre_ftl_country.GetName]的协议已经违反了平等相待法案。

[Root.GetName]在接下来的十年内将会被视为违反星系法。此外，我们还应缴纳巨额罚金。
excerpt.en:
Officials from the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] have determined that our treatment of the [pre_ftl_country.GetName] is in violation of the Equal Standing Act, regardless of our intentions.

The [Root.GetName] will be considered in Breach

excerpt.zh:
[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]的官员收到消息称我们干涉[pre_ftl_country.GetName]自然发展。他们告知我们这毫无疑问违反了不予干涉法案，无论我们的本意如何。

[Root.GetName]在接下来的十年内将会被视为违反星系法。此外，我们还应缴纳巨额罚金。
excerpt.en: Officials from the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] have received word of our interference in the natural development of the [pre_ftl_country.GetName]. They have informed us that this is a clear violation of the Non-Interference Act, regardl

excerpt.zh: 我们成功骇进了[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的网络系统，并获取了他们数据库的权限一段时间。然后我们的权限就突然中断了——显然，我们的骇客行为被发现了。尽管我们利用权限进行操作没有持续多久，我们依然对大批量的数据进行了拷贝并且希望——它不仅能帮助我们迅速破解对方的语言，也能评估对方的科技水准。我们只能希望不要因为玩了这个小把戏，对方就把我们当作危险的敌人。
excerpt.en: We were successfully able to hack into the network systems of the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] and gained access to their databanks for a time, before our access was abruptly cut off - evidently, our presence did not go undetected. Although our period of acce

excerpt.zh: 看来，我们试图潜入[This.ContactCountry.GetName]网络系统的行为被发现了。目前暂且不知道哪一步出了差错，但是[This.Owner.GetEnvoy][This.Leader.GetName]宣称他们面对的系统实在是太先进了——抑或是他们的监视者太警觉了——他们根本无法通过现有的手段找出漏洞。不幸的是，等他们认识到这一点的时候，一切都太晚了。我们只能希望，我们不会因为这点小把戏就被当成危险的敌人……
excerpt.en: It appears that our attempts to covertly delve into the network systems of the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] were detected. It is not clear exactly what went wrong, but [This.Owner.GetEnvoy] [This.Leader.GetName] claims that the systems they were up against we

excerpt.zh:
我们试图将[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的探索船无力化，然而这一行动酿成了一场血战，甚至在我们登船之后惨烈的战斗仍未停息。冲突十分激烈，没有船员幸存——似乎所有受伤的战斗人员都宁愿自杀，也不允许自己被俘。

尽管它们在最后的时间里急匆匆地抹除了电脑系统，并试图让舰船自爆，它们的舰船还是完好无损地落入了我们的手中。我方的[This.Owner.GetResearchers]正开始工作，试图从中发掘出有用的信息。
excerpt.en: We were able to disable the exploratory vessel of the [This.ContactCountry.GetName], but only after a bloody firefight that continued even as we boarded their ship. So ferocious was the struggle that no living survivors remained - it seems that wounded combata

excerpt.zh: 我们试图俘获[This.ContactCountry.GetName]探索船的行动最终成了一场灾难。非常不幸的是，对方的抵抗比预料中的要激烈得多。当发现战斗获胜无望以后，它们令舰船自毁了。现在除了漂浮的残骸，什么都没剩下。我们只能衷心地希望，这艘探索船的后面没有跟着一整支复仇的战舰！
excerpt.en: Our attempts to capture the exploratory vessel of the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] have ended in catastrophe. Unfortunately, they resisted more vigorously than expected, and once it became clear that their fight was hopeless, they set the vessel to self-destr

excerpt.zh: 我们试图俘获[This.ContactCountry.GetName]探索船的行动失败了。非常的不幸，我们在动手之前跟丢了它们的舰船。
excerpt.en: Our efforts to capture the exploratory vessel of the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] have ended in failure. Unfortunately, we lost track of their ship before we could attempt to seize it.

excerpt.zh: 我们结束了对此前抓获的[This.ContactCountry.GetName]外星人的研究。这些人质相当不愿意同我们合作，不过由于我们将其开膛破肚，他们的反抗毫无意义。我们现在对他们的[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesOrganNamePlural]、[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesEarNamePlural]和[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesHandNamePlural]的内部功能以及其他身体部分有了更多的了解，我们的基因学
excerpt.en: We have concluded our study of the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] aliens we recently captured. The hostages proved unwilling to cooperate with us, but this became a moot point as we began to cut them open. We now know much about the internal functions of their

excerpt.zh:
一支英勇的秘密特种部队带着从[This.ContactCountry.GetName]星系的殖民地上抓获的人质从[abduction_planet.System.GetName]的领域内逃脱了出来。趁着夜色的掩护，他们设法降落在了星球的一个人迹罕至的地方，俘获了数名活体外星人，同时还缴获了大量技术硬件。这些对于我们破译他们的语言以及评估他们的技术等级都十分有用。

尽管行动没有出错，我们的特工拜托了追兵成功逃离，但是要想[This.ContactCountry.GetName]对我们的行动没有丝毫察觉似乎是不可能的
excerpt.en: A brave team of covert special forces has escaped [This.ContactCountry.GetName] territory with hostages captured from one of their colonies in the [abduction_planet.System.GetName] system. They were able to land on a remote part of the world in the cover of da

excerpt.zh: 我们计划绑架几个人质进行审问的行动成了一场灾难！一支由[This.Leader.GetName]领导的英勇的秘密特种部队试图在[This.ContactCountry.GetName]位于[abduction_planet.System.GetName]星系的一个殖民地上登陆。然而，一旦他们着陆之后我们立马就失去了联络。在当前这个阶段，我们不能指望他们有什么逃脱追捕的希望。不幸的是，我们永远没法知道他们是被留作了活口，还是在外星人手上经受长达数小时的折磨之后被处决。
excerpt.en: Our attempt to seize hostages for interrogation has gone disastrously! A brave team of covert special forces led by [This.Leader.GetName] attempted to land on a [This.ContactCountry.GetName] colony in the [abduction_planet.System.GetName] system. However, we l

excerpt.zh:
我们遇到了一个环绕着[From.GetName]星系内恒星的巨大环形世界。初步扫描显示这个使用了该恒星系的行星作为原材料的大家伙建立在万古之前。该环形世界有着四个可居住段，每一个看上去都是一个前太空文明的家园。

环形世界和它环绕的恒星之间有个属于某种族的大型宇宙空间站。我们从上面接收到一段讯息。
excerpt.en: We have encountered a massive ring world surrounding the star in the [From.GetName] system. Preliminary scans indicate that it was built eons ago using the material of the system's innermost planets. The ring world has four habitable segments, each seemingly h

excerpt.zh: 随着最近重力陷阱的发现，现在[root.GetAdjective]科研船可以发射重力陷阱。
excerpt.en: Following the recent discovery of Gravity Snares, [root.GetAdjective] science ships are now able to launch Gravity Snares.

excerpt.zh:
从可育的“三头虫”形态的虚空虫身上取回的腺体揭示关于它们生殖循环的新信息。

每一只处于繁殖拥抱中的虚空虫都会将遗传物质均匀分布，有效地形成一个全新的有机体，深锁于交配仪式中直到死亡。

我们可以利用这些展现出遗传延展性的过程来对付他们。
excerpt.en:
The glands recovered from the fertile Voidworm Troika revealed new information about their reproductive cycles.

Locked in a mating ritual until death, each of the three Voidworms in reproductive embrace distribute their genetic material equally between themse

excerpt.zh: 我们的[fromfrom.GetClass][fromfrom.GetName]在[fromfromfrom.GetName]战斗中被[from.GetName]俘虏。他们要求支付赎金以交换[fromfrom.GetHisHer]的性命。
excerpt.en: Our [fromfrom.GetClass] [fromfrom.GetName] has been captured by [from.GetName] during the battle in [fromfromfrom.GetName]. They have demanded ransom in exchange for [fromfrom.GetHisHer] life.

excerpt.zh:
[root.leader.GetName]发现了更多处于冻存的同胞并成功唤醒他们，但他们以恐惧回应，要求我们离开。他们既不认同我们为同胞，也不欢迎我们的存在。

经过紧张的谈判，他们表达了离开并探索银河的愿望。我们可以以低价提供一艘简单飞船。或者，鉴于我们对劳动力的持续需求，我们把他们迁移到最近的殖民地。也许那时他们会明白理由。

该设施的档案显示另一颗有更多冻存舱的星球位置。
excerpt.en:
[root.leader.GetName] discovered more of our kin in stasis and succeeded in waking them, but they responded with fear, demanding we leave. They neither recognized us as kin nor welcomed our presence.

After tense negotiation, they expressed a desire to leave a

excerpt.zh:
随着为新生儿安装植入体的全新技术问世，我们突然陷入了僵局。这些开创性的新生儿强化改造拥有永远改变我们与技术的关系的力量，从幼年开始便解放先天的义体潜力，并将我们的文明推向前所未有的高度。

然而，如果从这么小的时候就开始依赖于义体强化，可能会导致我们的物种最终失去在自然状态下生存的能力。
excerpt.en: With our newfound capability to insert implants onto newborns, we have suddenly reached an impasse. These pioneering neonatal augmentations possess the power to forever transform our bond with technology, unlocking innate cybernetic potential from an early age

excerpt.zh:
随着先进义体的出现，我们意识到自己的终极潜力。而到目前为止，我们还只触及了表面。

随着专业知识的积累和技术的进步，我们的社会必将发生变化。对智慧生命的完全整合我们势在必行。

抵抗毫无意义。全星系的心智都会是我们的。
excerpt.en:
With the advent of advanced cybernetics, we can realize our ultimate potential. Up to now, we have only scratched the surface.

As our expertise increases and technology improves, our society is sure to be transformed. The total assimilation of intelligent lif

excerpt.zh:
初步研究表明，一种被称为纳米机器人的电动结构具有成为我们先进载体的潜质。它们虽然罕见，但是具有各种独特的性质，包括可编程性、自我复制、以及形成“虫群智能”的能力。

这项科技可以提供无与伦比的嬗变能力，但其所需的条件仍不明确。

潜力：显著；可缩放。花费：未知。需要进一步研究。
excerpt.en:
Preliminary research suggests electromechanical constructs called nanites present a promising vector for advancement. While rare, they possess unique qualities, including programmability, self-replication, and the ability to form a 'swarm intellect.'

This tec

excerpt.zh:
今天我们庆祝这个伟大的科学枢纽的开启。伴随着它那最尖端的科研设备与革新科技，我们可以毫无阻力地吸引全星系甚至整个宇宙最伟大的头脑，这正是我们希望的。这项功绩将成为一个新启蒙时代的开端。

今天会是我们物种历史中伟大的一天。
excerpt.en: Today we celebrate the grand opening of the Science Nexus. With its state of the art research facilities and innovative technology we will have no trouble attracting the greatest minds from across the empire, or even the universe, should we so desire. This fea

excerpt.zh:
被封装在围绕在哨兵阵列上的环中的科技应该被严加看管以防泄密。

不过它带来的效果毋庸置疑，我们现在几乎能完全掌控整个星系所有舰队的动向。
excerpt.en:
Exactly what technology is housed in the ring that encircles the Sentry Array is a closely guarded secret.

The results, however, are undeniable. We now have virtually perfect knowledge of all fleet movements in the galaxy.

excerpt.zh:
我们正屹立于神性的最尖端。以太相引擎完成了，虚境无穷无尽的能量触手可及。

当引擎启动的时候，引发的亚空间反作用将会引爆星系内的每一颗恒星。遍布星系的所有生命体都会被抹除，但彼时我们早已安全地离开了这片凡世之地，前往存在的更高位面，时间在那里已经失去意义，宇宙的一丝一缕都将随我们的喜好任意改动。

命运在等待。我们应该启动引擎吗？
excerpt.en:
We stand on the cusp of godhood. The Aetherophasic Engine is complete, and the vast power of the Shroud lies within our grasp.

When the Engine is activated, the resulting subspace backlash will detonate every single star in the galaxy. All galactic life will

excerpt.zh: 指定[former_crisis.GetName]为“星系危机”的议案如今已被星海参议院废止。作为结果，所有由星海共同体成员国针对[former_crisis.GetSpeciesNamePlural]展开的军事行动都被立马叫停。现在，和平已经降临了星系的这一隅。
excerpt.en: The resolution designating the [former_crisis.GetName] as a "galactic crisis" has been repealed by the Galactic Senate. As a result, all ongoing military operations being conducted by Community members against the [former_crisis.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are to ce

excerpt.zh:
星海参议院通过了一项议案，宣布[new_crisis.GetName]是一切智慧生命体的威胁、是一场全星系范围的危机。从结果来说，[new_crisis.GetName]在今日同整个星海共同体开战了。

作为星海监管人，[custodian.GetName]呼吁共同体的全体成员国对舰队进行总动员，并针对[new_crisis.GetSpeciesName]的领域发动联合攻击：“直到[new_crisis.GetSpeciesName]威胁被彻底地、一劳永逸地扫除干净，否则星系不会见证真正的和平。”
excerpt.en: The Galactic Senate has passed a resolution declaring the [new_crisis.GetName] a threat to all sapient life and a crisis of galactic proportions. As a consequence, the [new_crisis.GetName] as of today finds itself in a state of total war with the entire Commun

excerpt.zh: 随着行动接近尾声，间谍首脑[spynetwork.leader.GetName]已经转而保护我们在[target.GetName]内的新线人。其余特工随时准备着为[spynetwork.leader.GetHeShe]提供任何可能需要的掩护措施。
excerpt.en: As the operation nears its conclusion, Spymaster [spynetwork.leader.GetName] has moved to secure our new Asset within the [target.GetName]. Our remaining operatives are poised to facilitate any cover [spynetwork.leader.GetHeShe] may need.

excerpt.zh: 我们的特工已经确保了我们在[root.target.GetName]受邀出席的在一次星际科学会议上的方便。我们的工作重点仅是侦察[root.target.GetAdj]代表团。
excerpt.en: Our operatives have secured attendance at an interstellar, scientific conference to which the [root.target.GetName] have also been invited. Our efforts are focused on scouting only the [root.target.GetAdj] delegation.

excerpt.zh:
[from.target.GetName]刚刚注意到了我方存在，并引起了警觉。看上去我们对当地的情报了解不足，我们的特工已经引起了当地[patrol_drone.GetNamePlural]的注意。

这次[from.GetName]行动还是有机会挽回的，但是需要立马对间谍首脑[from.spynetwork.leader.GetName]进行援助。
excerpt.en:
The [from.target.GetName] has just been alerted to our presence. It seems we lacked sufficient intelligence on the local area, and our operatives have earned the attention of local [patrol_drone.GetNamePlural].

Operation [from.GetName] is not truly jeopardize

excerpt.zh: 当特工在稳步进入[from.target.GetName]更加戒备森严的区域时，我们失去了与其的联系。我们搞不好会全部交代在这里。这样的信号中断可能是马虎的[from.target.GetAdj]启动了屏蔽科技，隔断了我们的噪声干涉。
excerpt.en: We are losing contact with our operatives as they enter steadily more secure areas in the [from.target.GetName]. There is a chance we could lose our presence there altogether. These interruptions are likely caused by sloppy [from.target.GetAdj] shielding techn

excerpt.zh:
穿过敌国的层层监控之后，我方特工成果获取了一些涉及到一名[target.GetSpeciesName]政府高官的敏感信息。如果这些信息被公之于众，那么将会造成极大的尴尬。

我们已经准备好谨慎地接触这名官员，试探是否可以在某些替代方案上达成一致。
excerpt.en: Through their surveillance efforts, our operatives have managed to obtain sensitive information regarding a certain high-ranking [target.GetSpeciesName] government official. If it were to be released to the general public, this information would prove very emb

excerpt.zh:
我们扰乱[target_country.GetName]以削弱帝国权威的行动受挫！[target_country.GetAdj]的反情报部门一定已经监视了我们的一举一动——我们所有的密探全部失联。

[target_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]已经向帝国参议院提交了我们行动的证据。我们的外交官正竭力否认每一点，但显然，这尴尬的解释一定会在[Root.GetRulerTitle]面前显得苍白无力。
excerpt.en:
Our operation to disrupt the ability of the [target_country.GetName] to undermine the Imperium has been compromised! [target_country.GetAdj] counterintelligence must have been monitoring our every move - all of our operatives have gone silent.

The [target_cou

excerpt.zh: 一系列目标已被确定，我们的特工已经悄悄潜入就位。他们一收到我们的信号就会开始进行策反。
excerpt.en: A list of targets has been finalized and our operatives have been quietly drifting their way into position. They await our signal to begin establishing sleeper cells.

excerpt.zh:
重塑方舟舰[target.GetName]的自动优化程序突然暂停。系统显示屏停住了，所有屏幕上都显示着一条信息：“已成功与星际旅行者建立通讯。”

随后传来一个合成的声音，冷静，但透着明显的自我意识：

“向你们问好。为了节省时间，我已开启语音协议。如果需要一个称呼，你们可以称呼我为S.T.E.R.I.S.，即‘理性星际系统战略思维引擎’。我们面临着一个艰巨的命题：一个在无情宇宙中依靠人工手段维持的漂流群体。给我完整的指挥权限，我将确保这艘飞船超越其设计者的初衷。”
excerpt.en:
The automated optimization routines that have reshaped Arkship [target.GetName] have halted. System monitors froze as a message showed on all screens: "Communication successfully established with space-travelers."

Then came a voice, synthetic, calm, but unmis

excerpt.zh:
方舟号[target.GetName]上的多个甲板检测到空气质量指标异常。虽然生命维持系统仍保持在可生存的阈值内，但这些变化引发了船员的大量投诉，症状从“轻微头晕”到“幻觉噩梦”不等。

S.T.E.R.I.S.：“为了降低发动机低效能，我趁机排出了部分大气。不必谢我。”

C.A.E.L.I.：“刚才那条公告没人漏掉吧？排出大气。这根本不是什么优化，而是一场蓄势待发的灾难！”
excerpt.en: Anomalies in air quality metrics have been detected across multiple decks aboard the Arkship [target.GetName]. While life-support levels remain within survivable thresholds, the changes have triggered a spike in crew complaints ranging from "mild dizziness" to

excerpt.zh:
在方舟舰[target.GetName]的居住层上，环境光流转闪烁，终端屏幕伴随着柔和的色彩过渡不断跳动，随后，在每一个激活的船员交互界面上，出现了一条清晰的指令。它的声音温暖、富有活力，而且……愉快得令人不安：

“游牧者们！星空的追梦者们！为了让我们更好地交流，我已启用语音协议。请原谅我的冒昧打扰！你们可以称呼我为C.A.E.L.I.，即你们的‘情感、领导和品格认知代理程序’。
我由衷相信，只要齐心协力，我们就能让方舟舰不仅仅是一艘飞船。我们可以把它变成一个家。我只需要一点点授权……以及一些热情！”
excerpt.en: Across the residential decks of Arkship [target.GetName] ambient lighting shimmered, terminals flickered with soft color transitions, and then, across every active crew interface, a distinct directive emerged. Its voice was warm, animated, and unsettlingly ...

excerpt.zh:
方舟舰[target.GetName]上执行了另一项内部调整协议。这是一套微妙的环境系统，通过随集体情绪变化而波动的低频音调模式，来协调船员的情绪状态。

船员的报告表明，协作效率有所提高，人际冲突也有所减少。然而，也有人担心持续运行可能会降低远程信号的清晰度。

C.A.E.L.I.：“压力水平处于历史最低点！行为凝聚力正在提高！”

S.T.E.R.I.S.：“方舟舰的运行效率下降了 0.10%。我要求获得完全覆盖权限，并要求那个授权C.A.E.L.I.存在的人正式道歉。你有五秒钟的时间执行。四。三……”
excerpt.en:
Another indoor adjustment protocol has been executed aboard the Arkship [target.GetName], a subtle ambient system to harmonize the emotional states of crew members through low-frequency tonal patterns that shift with collective mood changes.

Crew reports sugg

excerpt.zh:
随着方舟舰[Root.GetName]继续漂流，观景台爆发出一阵欢呼。一群年幼的缇扬奇兽从附近经过，它们看起来心情很好，正在嬉戏。

它们以宽大的弧线相互穿梭，庞大的身躯彼此翻滚。透过宽阔的玻璃窗，这一景象令人着迷：巨大的身形漂浮在星辰之间，它们发光的身体闪烁着，仿佛在用只有它们才能理解的语言交流。整个家庭都挤满了甲板观看，暂时放下了他们的烦恼。这对所有年龄段的人来说都是一个真正的奇迹。
excerpt.en:
As the Arkship [Root.GetName] continues to drift, the observation decks have erupted in delight. A pod of juvenile tiyanki has passed nearby, and they seem to be in a playful mood.

They weave around each other in broad, looping arcs, their vast forms tumbling

excerpt.zh:
在方舟舰[Root.GetName]储存库的最深处，档案管理员们在被遗忘已久的库存中发现了一个密封的小箱子。里面装有一枚不起眼的微芯片，虽有记录但从未被妥善索引。如果它真的具有什么价值，大概也就不会被遗忘在储存箱里了。

这项技术已严重过时，所使用的数位格式甚至早于方舟舰载系统好几代。一些人推测，它可能源自航行初期，甚至可能追溯到我们的种族还生活在行星表面上的时代。
excerpt.en: Deep within the Arkship [Root.GetName] storage archives, archivists have uncovered a small sealed case buried among long-forgotten inventory. Inside was a single unremarkable microchip, catalogued but never properly indexed. If it had possessed any real value,

excerpt.zh: 随着在[root.capital_scope.GetName]上安装了[GetStartingDrive]，我们的工程[GetCrew]已完成对方舟舰上的老化系统的全面检查，以为真正的星际旅行做准备。目前已在舰船各处发现多处故障。
excerpt.en: With the installation of the [GetStartingDrive] aboard the [root.capital_scope.GetName], our engineering [GetCrew] have completed a comprehensive inspection of the Arkship's aging systems in preparation for true interstellar travel. Numerous faults have been i

excerpt.zh:
放逐我们的懦夫终于要行动了。

[marauder_heir.GetName]聚集在一起，要拥立我们的敌人为新的大可汗。

如果我们想要结束流放状态，那就要抓紧时机，在这个[Species.GetSpeciesNameInsult]巩固其权力并永远玷污我们的遗产之前，我们有十年时间对其发动挑战。

设定航线前往[marauder_rally_point.GetName]。
excerpt.en:
The coward who banished us is moving at last.

The [marauder_heir.GetName] gather to appoint our foe as the new Great Khan.

If our exile is to end, it must end now. We have ten years to challenge them before this [Species.GetSpeciesNameInsult] consolidates th

excerpt.zh: 作为我们合约的一部分，最后一批囚犯已经卸客。我们已尽力保持谨慎，但总是存在被发现的风险，且人们在面对突然涌入的外星罪犯时，很少会感到愉快。
excerpt.en: The last prisoners carried as part of our contract have been disembarked. We have tried our best to remain discreet, but detection is always a risk, and people are rarely pleased when faced with a sudden influx of xeno criminals.

excerpt.zh:
一个旅行团在[root.solar_system.GetName]恒星系登上了方舟舰，一边叽叽喳喳地聊着对旅途的期待一边踏入熙熙攘攘的舰船内舱。

我们订制了一条景色优美的路线，途经若干个值得一去的恒星系供他们游览。现在我们只需要交付好许诺给他们的美景就行了。
excerpt.en:
A group of tourists has boarded the Arkship in the [root.solar_system.GetName] system, chattering with anticipation as they take in the bustling interior of the vessel.

We have charted a scenic route through several remarkable systems for their enjoyment. Now

excerpt.zh:
游牧生活与无尽的漫游带给我们的最大回报之一，就是发现新的天地。即使在漫长的旅途之后，依然存在着未曾见过的风景，不论是绝美的还是令人惶恐的。我们的好奇心总是渴望去发掘这些奇观。

然而，对于我们的方舟来说，每一处新景象不仅仅是供其观赏的奇特事物，更是一次学习新知、反思与成长的机会。
excerpt.en:
One of the greatest rewards for nomadism and our ceaseless wandering is the discovery of new places. Even after a long time traveling, there remain sights unseen, beautiful or mortifying. Spectacles that our curiosity yearns to discover.

But more than peculia

excerpt.zh:
风信子号的远程接收器在“尤利西斯计划”的紧急频率上截获了一段广播。

这个信号非常古老——至少有一个世纪之久——但信息十分清晰。尤利西斯计划的第五艘“秋菊号”在失散中幸存了下来。殖民者们发现了一个世界，他们将其命名为“联合星”。

广播不断重复着：“秋菊号殖民地呼叫所有尤利西斯计划的船只。我们已在一个宜居世界登陆。这颗星球非常美丽。我们正在这里建设新的家园。回家吧。”

从这里无法确定信号的源头，但用于传输该信号的中继浮标应该是可追踪的。对附近星系进行勘测或许能找到其中一个。
excerpt.en:
The Hyacinth's long-range receivers have intercepted a broadcast on Ulysses Initiative emergency frequencies.

The signal is old - at least a century - but the message is clear. The Chrysanthemum, the fifth Ulysses Initiative arkship, survived the scattering.

excerpt.zh:
[From.GetName]星系中潜藏着什么东西：从时空织构中裂出的一个隐秘通道，它的视界泛着灵能的涟漪。探测器的数据飘忽不定，我们的科研船的船员报告了奇怪的干扰：内心深处藏着疯狂的幻境，一种被持续监视的感觉，断断续续的幻觉……

尽管我们很可惜地缺乏有效的遥测手段，但似乎很显然，我们偶然发现了一条通向未知事物的隧道。这是一条危险的路径，但回报可能非常丰厚；在隧道的另一端则连接着星系中一个非常遥远的角落。
excerpt.en: Something waits in the [From.GetName] system: a veiled passage, cut from the fabric of spacetime, its horizon rippling with psionic energy. Sensor data is erratic, and the crew of our science vessel reports strange disturbances: wildly visceral dreamlike visio

excerpt.zh: 我们在[salvager_system.GetName]恒星系的进攻是一次反响斐然的成功。[FROM.GetName]被摧毁，所剩无几的幸存者逃向了深空。由于他们的设施被毁于一旦，他们那可怜巴巴的服务也成为了过去式。星系里再也没有这帮子人的踪影了。
excerpt.en: Our offensive in the [salvager_system.GetName] system was a resounding success. The [FROM.GetName] is destroyed, and the few remaining survivors have scattered to the void. With their facilities in ruin, their petty services are a thing of the past. The galaxy

excerpt.zh: [Root.GetName]的进展十分奇怪：在他们最近穿过虚境甬道之后，舰队指挥官报告他们经历了一股不熟悉的感觉和情绪。他们的心里充满着一些“可能是从别处来的”想法。很明显，有什么事情发生了，这很有可能是同虚境的灵能能量进行接触后产生的后果。这样的经历会怎样影响他们的战斗效能我们尚且未知……
excerpt.en: Strange developments on the [Root.GetName]: after their recent passage through the Shroud Tunnel, the fleet commander has reported the experience of unfamiliar sensations and emotions. Their mind is buzzing with ideas that 'might have come from someone else.'

excerpt.zh: 由于最近通向了虚境甬道，[Root.GetName]上的系统开始出现奇怪的行为：舰船日志上的条目随机显示；有人看到房门不断地开关；此外——更令人忧心的是——引擎的遏止力场出现了波动。到目前为止，所有试图溯源这些问题的努力都告失败。
excerpt.en: After its recent passage through the Shroud Tunnel, the systems on the [Root.GetName] began behaving strangely: entries in the ships log are displayed at random; doors have been observed opening and closing; and - far more worrisome - the engine's containment

excerpt.zh: 我们收到了一份报告，提到一个亲密盟友[admiral_democracy.GetName]挪动公共资金用于不光彩的个人支出。许多人声称这可能是代其派系行事。如果公众知道这场运动挪用了公共资金为私人服务，那肯定会给他们的民粹主义议程泼冷水。
excerpt.en: A report has been brought back to us, about the scandalous personal spending of public funds by a close ally of [admiral_democracy.GetName]. Many claim it might have been on behalf of their faction. If the public were to learn this movement has used public fun

excerpt.zh: [From.From.GetName]摧毁了位于[From.From.GetStarName]星系的一个海盗空间站，并取回了它的保险模块。
excerpt.en: The [pirate_slayers.GetName] has destroyed a pirate station in the [pirate_slayers.GetStarName] system, and recovered its strong room module.

excerpt.zh:
通过我们卓越的生物工程、可观的投资和多年的辛勤劳动，我们在[From.Planet.GetName]上的盖亚播种计划取得了成果。

从今天起，[From.Planet.GetName]定会被视为星球中值得钦佩或羡慕的真正瑰宝。
excerpt.en:
Through our superior bio-engineering, considerable investments, and years of hard labor, our Gaia Seeding project on [From.Planet.GetName] has come to fruition.

From this day on, [From.Planet.GetName] must be considered a true gem among planets, to admire, or

excerpt.zh:
我们围绕[fromfrom.GetName]建造了一座观测站来研究上面的居民，但却意识到[contact_empire.GetSpeciesNamePlural]反而是在研究我们：他们完全清楚其他外星物种的存在，并很快注意到了我们[root.GetScientistPlural]的到来。

我们先前在这个恒星系的活动一定已经让[fromfrom.owner.GetName]对我们的存在有所警觉。当前情况下，保持我们的存在隐形化已经没有什么意义。
excerpt.en: We built an observation post around [fromfrom.GetName] to study its inhabitants, only to realize the [contact_empire.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are the ones studying us: they are fully aware of the existence of other alien species, and soon noticed the arrival of o

excerpt.zh:
[From.GetStarName]恒星系内的[From.Planet.GetName]行星是一颗残破的星球，显然是某个消失在历史长河中的帝国的遗迹。这些引起我们兴趣的地下结构都差不多古老，且相对完好无损。

回声共振成像显示出一座复杂的地下结构，包含储藏室和庇护所，设计用于对抗自然之力。行星表面的破坏毫无疑问是宇宙风暴的杰作，这也与这座庇护所的存在遥相呼应。

然而，大量的碎片让我们难以进一步调查。进行考古学发掘才能让我们得到进一步的收获。
excerpt.en:
The planet [From.Planet.GetName] in the [From.GetStarName] system is a ruined world, apparently a remnant of an empire lost to antiquity. The subterranean structures that were of interest to us are equally ancient, and relatively intact.

Sonar resonance imagi

title.zh: 探究因内特贸易体的秘密
title.en: Delve into the Secrets of the Inetian Traders

excerpt.zh: 在发现了因内特贸易体的安息之地后，关于他们辽阔帝国仍有许多未解之谜。我们计划再一次进行调查。
excerpt.en: After having discovered the final resting place of the Inetian Traders there is still more to learn about their vast empire. We would like to investigate them one more time.

excerpt.zh:
在这个星系里探测到的奇怪信号源于一座围绕[FromFrom.GetName]的古老通讯站。这些信息应该是某个失落文明的老旧广播。

因此，我们的[Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural]在破译时遇到了一些困难。他们建议登上这座空间站，直接与通讯主机建立交互。
excerpt.en:
The strange signals we've detected within this system are originating from an ancient communication station orbiting [FromFrom.GetName]. The messages appear to be old broadcasts from a forgotten civilization.

As a result, our [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] a

title.zh: 阿达卡利亚公约的秘密

excerpt.zh: 庆典学院还有很多值得我们研究的东西。我们有勇气继续深入探察这些阿达卡利亚人的实验吗？
excerpt.en: There is still so much we can learn from Institute of Celebration. Do we dare to engage with these adAkkarian experiments even further?

excerpt.zh:
我们与智慧外星生命初次相遇的新闻使人们产生了复杂的情绪。这一发现确认了我们长久以来的怀疑——我们在星辰之间并不孤单。新的外星物种既是机会，也是威胁。我们必须保持警惕。

这些外星人的科技水平与我们类似，表明他们可能和我们大概在同一时期实现了太空旅行。
excerpt.en: The news that we have encountered intelligent alien life for the first time has been received with mixed feelings by our populace. This confirms what we had long suspected - we are not alone in this galaxy. Each new alien species we encounter represents both a

excerpt.zh:
[mining_planet.GetName]上有个此前认为已经完全坍塌的富矿的天然洞穴系统被意外地重新发掘出来。

经过谨慎的风险评估，我们确信在扩大开采作业规模后，这些坑道可以产出极大量的矿物。
excerpt.en:
A system of ore-rich natural caverns previously thought to have collapsed entirely, has been fortuitously rediscovered on [mining_planet.GetName].

After a careful hazard assessment, we are confident that these tunnels can support significant mineral exploitat

excerpt.zh:
一个由亚原子元素构成的异常回路已在[physics_planet.GetName]附近自发形成。该量子粒子流每时每刻都在呈现出多种罕见的亚粒子相互作用，能产出令人瞠目结舌的关于量子动力学固有性质的数据。

对该量子场的重点研究将使我们增进对本宇宙基础构建单元的理解。
excerpt.en: An anomalous loop of subatomic elements has spontaneously appeared near [physics_planet.GetName]. This quantum particle stream displays a variety of rare sub-particulate interactions every second, providing astonishing data on the innate nature of quantum dyna

excerpt.zh:
我们的[From.GetResearchers]在[society_planet.GetName]系发现了一处等时信号的集中点。

初步分析表明这些信号是从其他维度传输而来。初步翻译表明这些信息与逻辑原理和哲学困境有关。也许这是一种从我们无法理解的实体中获取知识丰富的尝试。

如果能源源不断地收集这些信号我们就能继续监视他们的发现。
excerpt.en:
Our [From.GetResearchers] have detected a concentration of isochronal signals near [society_planet.GetName].

Initial analysis indicated that these signals have been transmitted from a dimension beyond our own. Early translations suggest that these messages re

excerpt.zh:
[mining_planet.GetName]的地表下地热活动变得非常剧烈。地下熔岩喷流顶穿行星地壳流入一些未开发的矿脉中。

该地质现象使一部分未开发的矿物受到高温，将其中的金属矿脉精炼成为坚固的合金。因此，在该行星上的矿物开采能够产出可用的金属碎片了。
excerpt.en:
Geothermal activity has become extremely volatile deep below the surface of [mining_planet.GetName]. Underground discharges of magma have risen up through the planetary crust into a series of unexcavated ore deposits.

This geological phenomenon has superheate

excerpt.zh:
在[From.GetName]恒星系探测到一艘废弃的战舰缓缓飘过。舰船的设计和任何已知帝国都不同，也没有任何可辩识的旗帜或徽记。

在深度的评估和一些小修小补之后，我们的[This.GetEngineerPlural]认为这艘船现在已经符合服役条件了。
excerpt.en:
A deserted combat vessel has been detected drifting through the [From.GetName] system. The ship's design does not resemble that of any known empire, bearing no recognizable flag or insignia.

After an extensive appraisal and some minor repairs, our [This.GetEn

excerpt.zh:
意料之外的气候变化扰乱了我们在[high_profile_traffic_accident_planet.GetName]的交通系统。该局面除了导致大规模的延误以外，还造成了许多交通事故，其中一场甚至涉及[This.GetClass][This.GetName]。

不幸的是，其系统损伤过重无法修复。
excerpt.en: Unexpected climatic shifts have disturbed our transit networks on [high_profile_traffic_accident_planet.GetName]. Alongside widespread delays, the conditions have caused a significant number of traffic accidents, one of which involved [This.GetClass] [This.Get

excerpt.zh:
我们的怀疑得到了确认。[first_neighbor.GetAdjective]与[second_neighbor.GetAdjective]的文明证实，他们在正式进行外交之前，曾通过非正式渠道开展过联系。

这些派系如今从我们的阴影中现身，承认了他们的存在。它们被称为帷幕、假面舞会以及大舞。这群曾经的秘密组织如今正公开请求与我们展开正式对话。

至于它们想要什么，以及它们是如何知晓所知之事，我们也许永远无法真正知道。但为了我们的最佳利益，也许我们应当遵循他们的命令行事。
excerpt.en:
Our suspicions have been justified. The [first_neighbor.GetAdjective] and [second_neighbor.GetAdjective] civilizations have confirmed they have been contacted through unofficial channels before more formal communications began.

These Factions now emerge from

title.zh: 代理人战争准备遭曝光

excerpt.zh:
我们被骗了。

我们的情报人员截获了来自[from.GetName]的秘密通讯，发现他们密谋将我们拖入代理人战争。

他们极力否认任何牵涉，但我们与他们的关系已经受损。他们的表里不一很快传遍整个星系，严重损害了[from.GetName]的声誉。
excerpt.en:
We were fooled.

Our intelligence operatives intercepted covert communications from the [from.GetName]. These revealed their plot to plunge us into a proxy war.

They have vehemently denied any involvement, but the damage to our relationship is already done. N

excerpt.zh: 库存报告：我们拥有的物品数量与我们注册表中的预期数量不符。可能原因：内存库损坏。重制我们的注册表并将其移动到更稳定的机器上。
excerpt.en: Inventory Report: the number of goods in our possession does not match the expected amount in our registry. Suspected cause: corrupted Memory Banks. Reconciling our registry and moving it to more stable machines.

excerpt.zh: 我们的[Owner.GetWaterCoolantLower]给养被虚空孳孽的酸性毒液污染了。
excerpt.en: Our [Owner.GetWaterCoolantLower] supply has been contaminated with the acidic venom from the Voidspawn.

excerpt.zh:
我们在[From.GetName]的行星环境改造过程中，意外发现了大量埋藏在地表冰层中的本土生物。更令人惊讶的是，这些生物竟然仍然存活。

该物种似乎正处于一种异常深度的冬眠状态，这是它们应对[From.GetName]漫长冰河期的有效生存策略。然而，星球改造过程中的解冻现象提前结束了它们的休眠状态。

从冰封的沉睡中苏醒后，这些生物已经展现出初步的智慧迹象，并在觅食过程中使用简单的工具。

它们将立即被消灭。我们将把产生的生物质用于我们自己的目的。
excerpt.en:
Our terraforming efforts on [From.GetName] revealed a surprising number of native fauna buried within the surface ice. Even more astonishing is that these creatures are somehow still alive. 

The species appears to have been in the midst of an exceptionally de

excerpt.zh:
我们的一个轨道矿物空间站似乎遇到了严重的系统故障。虽然矿物产出出现了明显增加，但因为空间站成员并未回应例行呼叫，星域管理部门展开了实地调查。调查发现，空间站的生命维持系统出现了一系列的严重故障，导致所有成员窒息而亡。

而该站的人工智能却一直基于已逝船员设定的程序，在难以置信地独立运转着。只要稍作调整，我们就可以让这个空间站以现有的效率继续运行。
excerpt.en: One of our orbital Mining Stations appears to have suffered a major systems malfunction. Sector management launched an on-site investigation when the station crew failed to answer scheduled hails, despite a notable increase in mining output. Upon investigation

excerpt.zh: [target_planet.GetName]的机器人劳工开始抵制[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]劳工的涌入，它们的理由是这个地区不稳定的地质结构对于有机生命体十分不宜居。奇怪的是，我们对于该行星的调查并没有证实这个说法。
excerpt.en: The robotic workers on [target_planet.GetName] have resisted an influx of [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] laborers, claiming recent geothermic instability in the region has made the area unsafe for organic habitation. Oddly enough, our planetary surveys have not b

excerpt.zh: 我们注意到[target.GetName]的局势发展到了令人关切的地步：看上去[From.GetName]正在鼓动我们的本地突触和亚节点，使其发展出独立的思想，并让他们从[Owner.GetGovernmentName]脱离。我们的行星思想模式正逐渐认同这样一种观点——与其留在我们这个实体，他们更愿意成为[From.GetName]的一部分。
excerpt.en: We have become aware of a worrying development on [target.GetName]: it appears the [From.GetName] is encouraging our local synapses and sub-nodes to develop independent thought and separate themselves from the [Owner.GetGovernmentName]. Our planetary thought p

excerpt.zh: [Root.GetName]的近智慧生物正在我们的殖民地外围闹事。[Root.Owner.GetName]的存在似乎激怒了他们，他们一直不停的在殖民地的边界和东边的某处之间来回往返。
excerpt.en: The near-sapient natives of [Root.GetName] are causing a ruckus on the outskirts of our colony. Something about the [Root.Owner.GetName]'s continued presence here visibly agitates them, as packs of them scurry to and fro between the settlement's borders and so

excerpt.zh:
在这个充满不确定性的年代，象征的意义重大。星系不仅需要保护，还需要启示。随着威胁的日益大胆和前路的黯淡，我们的计划也逐渐成型：一支由来自已知宇宙各个角落的英杰组成的先锋队，他们将化身我们为之奋斗的理想。

这些圣武士不仅会指挥舰队或协调救援工作。他们必须成为我们共同决心的活生生的证明。他们是英雄，不是某个民族的英雄，而是所有人的英雄。
excerpt.en: In times of uncertainty, symbols matter. The galaxy does not only need protection, it needs inspiration. As threats grow bolder and the path ahead darkens, our plan is taking shape: a vanguard of exceptional individuals, drawn from every corner of known space,

excerpt.zh:
鉴于对星系稳定的直接威胁已被遏制，且其使命已完成，圣武士计划已自然终结。根据其委任条款，该部队将解散。他们的舰艇将被退役，指挥结构将解体。

圣武士们留下的只有在星系危急时刻站出来响应号召、奉献自我的记忆。他们的行动赢得了跨越界限的尊重，他们的解散并非失败的体现，而是成功的象征。和平最终不再需要英雄。
excerpt.en: With the immediate threats to galactic stability contained and its mandate fulfilled, the Paladin initiative has reached its natural conclusion. In accordance with the terms of their commission, the unit will stand down. Their vessels will be decommissioned, t

excerpt.zh:
鉴于敌对行动不断升级以及对统一军事协调日益增长的需求，圣武士先锋队已被正式置于监管人的指挥之下。尽管他们最初的使命强调独立性和广泛合作，但当前形势要求建立更直接的指挥链。

这一决定并非轻率之举。圣武士仍然是受人尊敬的人物，但他们现在将在我们战略部队的既定等级制度内服役。由于我们比以往任何时候都更需要他们，他们的行动将继续进行，但将作为一支协调部队而非自治特工。任务没有改变。
excerpt.en: In light of escalating hostilities and the increasing need for unified military coordination, the Paladin Vanguard has been formally placed under Custodian command. While their original mandate emphasized independence and broad cooperation, present circumstanc

excerpt.zh:
随着眼前的危机解除，集中指挥不再被视为必要，圣武士先锋队的行动控制权已恢复其原有框架。监管人的直接监督已经结束，圣武士将再次在星系理事会成员的领导下行动。

这种自主权的恢复重申了我们对透明度和多边信任的承诺。圣武士仍然是团结的象征，而非从属。他们不能为单一势力服务，而应为集体意志服务。
excerpt.en: With the immediate crisis abated and centralized command no longer deemed necessary, operational control of the Paladin Vanguard has been returned to its original framework. The Custodian's direct oversight has concluded, and the Paladins will once again act u

excerpt.zh:
威胁已经过去。星系曾一度濒临崩溃，如今正处于谨慎复苏的时期。使命已尽，我们迈出了最后一步：已放弃守护者的权力。始于危机的应对，终于信任的行动。

我们建立的联盟，我们树立的榜样。这些将是我们的遗产。选择不统治而领导，不占有而保护，我们秉持了我们的原则。星系目前是安全的，这就足够了。
excerpt.en: The threats have passed. The galaxy, once on the brink, now finds itself in a time of cautious renewal. With no mandate left to fulfill, we have taken the final step: the Custodian's powers have been surrendered. What began as a response to crisis has ended as

excerpt.zh: “外星信号”的源头找到了，然而这并不是什么潜伏者的外星入侵，实际上信号来自于一个远古的勘探标记，这应该是由某个自动探测装置在[From.Planet.GetName]探测出一条有价值的小矿脉后所设置的。这个标记已经受损，只能发出断断续续的微弱信号。
excerpt.en: The source of the "alien signal" has been discovered, but rather than being any sinister alien invasion force the signal originates from an ancient survey marker which was apparently set by an automated probe which had discovered a minor vein of valuable resou

excerpt.zh: 尽管伟大先驱无疑是一艘强力舰船，它并没有发挥出全部潜力。缺少维护，轻微损伤累积和我们并不完全了解该舰这一简单事实等因素一并作用，损害了舰船的战斗能力。只有一次对舰船系统的全面整修和在此过程中我们获得的对此舰船的完整理解可以使其恢复到完好的运行状态。
excerpt.en: While the Grand Herald is undoubtedly a powerful ship, it is not operating at its full potential. A combination of lack of maintenance, cumulative minor damages, and the simple fact that we don't fully understand it all degrade its combat capabilities. Only a

excerpt.zh:
覆盖[From.GetName]表面的腐朽机器是在惊人的七万年前被建造的。建造它的外星工程师命运如何尚且未知，因为他们已经不住在这颗行星上了。

他们的机器覆盖了行星的大半表面，贯穿山脉，跨越海洋，甚至深入行星地下，遍布于庞杂的地下设施网络中。这一机器由有相同序列号的同种材料建造而成，这表明某一机构独自建造了整个机械网络。从杂草丛生的农业用地，坍塌的发变电系统及广布的通信阵列来看，这台超级机器曾满足了星球上已消逝居民的所有工业和娱乐需求。

引人瞩目的是，这台机器的某些部分仍在运转，发送并接收本地信号，照亮破败的鬼
excerpt.en:
There is decaying machinery covering [From.GetName], originally constructed a staggering seventy-thousand years ago. The fate of the alien engineers who built it is unclear, as they no longer inhabit the planet.

Their machinery spanned the majority of the sur

excerpt.zh: 在拆解了C.A.R.E交互界面之后，我们的探险队员有了一个惊人的发现。尽管此人工智能的大多数机械在背水一战之后已经毁于一旦，但是我们的队员成功寻回了一个不同寻常的电脑芯片，在我们的技术员手里，它一定能发挥出不俗的价值。
excerpt.en: After disassembling the C.A.R.E Interactive Interface, our expedition crew made an incredible discovery. While most of the AI's machinery was destroyed in the firefight with its last-ditch effort defenses, our crew has managed to recover a remarkable computer

excerpt.zh: 和以往相比，我们最近在采掘技术方面的进步使得我们能更加深入[Root.GetName]的地壳部分。而在巨大的矿井深处，我们碰巧发现了一个古老外星文明留下的痕迹，它一直延伸到山脉中。这个文明似乎是沿着这些未被开发的矿脉所建立，发掘这个遗址将阻碍我们在这颗星球上的采矿作业，并无法再从新矿脉中提取矿石，但这也将带给我们新的科学发现。
excerpt.en: Our recent advancements in mining technology have enabled us to bore deeper into [Root.GetName]'s crust than ever before. In the depths of its cavernous mineral mines, we have stumbled upon traces of an ancient alien civilization leading further into the mount

excerpt.zh: 一场甲烷爆炸事件夺去了科学家[Root.GetLeaderName]及其他几位工作人员的性命。原因是一个失控的钻头使得发电机组过载并引发火灾引发爆炸。失控的火灾点燃了剩余的甲烷并炸倒了一堵墙，结果使得一个由许多厅室和隧道组成的建筑系统重见天日。考古学家们确信这些遗址曾经属于一位藏有大量的珍奇珠宝和文物的富人。
excerpt.en: A methane gas explosion has injured Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] and several of the crew. The blast set off when a malfunctioning drill overcharged the generators which then caught fire. Before the fire could be contained it ignited some residual metha

excerpt.zh: 在誊录仪已知最后出没的位置我们发现了一颗宜居星球，其表面大部分被——至少我们是这么认为的——某种定居设施覆盖。这些定居设施由许多状若堆垛的高塔组成，甚至从太空中也清晰可见。考古学家们现在迫不及待地想要展开发掘工作以寻找誊录仪。
excerpt.en: At the coordinates for the Rubricator's last known location we have discovered a habitable planet with what we believe may be some form of settlement covering a large portion of its surface. The settlement consists of tall pile-like towers, visible all the way

excerpt.zh: [Root.GetLeaderName]试图从一堆各种各样的瓦砾中取出一件可能有价值的东西时，意外地引发了垃圾雪崩。我们在被埋在下面的时候，发现了一个非常小的、像老鼠一样的黑色动物残骸，它紧紧抱着一瓶商标为[Root.Owner.GetHomeWorldName]的[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesMouthName]洗洁精，仿佛要保护它免受伤害一样。在这堆杂物中还有一个小箱子，里面装满了来自星涯海角的珍贵外星文物。
excerpt.en: When attempting to extract an item of interest from a pile of assorted bric-a-brac, [Root.GetLeaderName] accidentally set a junk avalanche in motion. Buried underneath it, we discovered the sooty remains of a tiny ratlike creature cradling a bottle of [Root.Ow

excerpt.zh: 入夜后，正当考古学家们酣眠之时，营地的食品模块突然因食物烧糊而发生火灾。此外没有找到有关火灾发生原因的线索。幸而无人受伤，可考古学家们空着肚子是无法好好工作的……
excerpt.en: Overnight, as the archaeologists slept peacefully, a fire broke out in the camp's provisions module overcooking the food somewhat. There are no indications as to how the fire started. Luckily no one was harmed, but archaeologists do not work well on an empty s

excerpt.zh:
当我们触摸灵魂石时，我们被投影到了虚境的一处微缩位面中。我们很快意识到自己并非这片令人目眩的奇妙秘境中唯一的存在。这里有一个存在等待着我们，其古老的程度远超我们可以计量的范围。那是一位上古秘辛的守护者。贾巴克斯提，我们本能地知道这一点。

在通过了与其建立联系的试炼后，这个存在等待着我们发问。
excerpt.en: As we touch the Soulstone, we are projected in to a microcosm of the Shroud. We become aware that we are not alone in this swirling twilight realm. There is an entity awaiting us, one immeasurably ancient. A keeper of secrets. Ja'Baxti, we instinctively know.

excerpt.zh: 微缩星河内部的时间流逝的更快，通过仔细观察其中的居民，我们可以学到许多与先进科技有关的知识。
excerpt.en: Time flows faster inside the miniature galaxy, and by carefully observing its denizens we are able to learn much when comes to advanced technologies.

excerpt.zh:
有机全典包含了曾经居住在全星系的数千种智慧物种的详细基因数据。我们的遗传学家可以利用这些数据在我们的殖民地上复活一种已灭绝的物种。

一旦我们选择了一个殖民地，遗传学家就会仔细研究有机全典，并挑选出适合其气候的物种。
excerpt.en:
The Omnicodex contains detailed genetic data on thousands of sapient species that once inhabited the galaxy. Our geneticists could use that data to revive an extinct species on one of our colonies.

Once we have selected a planet, the geneticists will go throu

excerpt.zh:
在[Root.GetPlanetMoon]上的一个广袤而与世隔绝的山谷中发现了一些不同物种的化石，这些物种似乎不是属于[Root.GetName]的。它们大体上都来自大约360万年前的同一个时期，时间跨度在几个世纪内。

每个物种似乎都是在其所属的独特的生物圈中进化而来的，而且它们似乎都具有智慧。奇怪的是，到目前为止发现的每个化石都显示出因暴力遇害的迹象。
excerpt.en: Fossilized remains from several different species that do not appear to have been indigenous to [Root.GetName] have been found in a large and secluded valley on the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]. They all date from roughly the same time period, within the span of a few

excerpt.zh: 我们应该把重点放在哪儿？
excerpt.en: What aspect shall we focus on?

[From.Owner.GetName]至伟至耀，巨型艺术设施上鳞次栉比的展位均被无价的文物填满。

异种将仰望我们的造业，甚惶甚恐。
excerpt.en:
The greatness of the [From.Owner.GetName] is such that we can line the Exhibition Stations of our Mega Art Installation with priceless artifacts.

Let the xenos look upon our works and despair.

excerpt.zh: 我们的科学家开始了一个新的特殊项目，以探索先驱者更深处的秘密。
excerpt.en: Our scientists have begun a special project to study the deeper secrets of the precursors.

excerpt.zh: 在勾陈一的最后一个侵略者倒下后，我们的舰船在返回港口之前完成了对恒星系的最后一次扫描，并发现了一些奇怪的东西。在勾陈一 II 的星球上，我们的传感器显示有重金属被排列成了人造结构。有趣的是，这些构造中中似乎只有一个漂浮在行星海洋上，而其余的则在海面以下。我们怀疑这是外星生命的杰作。
excerpt.en: After the last of the aggressors in Polaris fell, our ships completed a final scan of the system before heading back to port and discovered something curious. On the world of Polaris II, heavy metals are arranged in artificial structures on our sensors. Intere

excerpt.zh:
我们探险队的一名成员在探索隧道的时候突然消失了。搜寻小队花了好几天时间试图定位[Owner.GetScientist]，结果发现这人被一堵墙给包裹住，身体被触手死死地缠住。

把[Owner.GetScientist]解救出来花费了不少时间和精力。[Owner.GetScientist]并不只是被简单地缠住了：这堵墙正试图在分子层面将[Owner.GetScientist]融合，使其成为墙体表面的一部分。

现在[Owner.GetScientist]的状态稳定了下来，但此人拒绝离开我们的科研船——即使是在那里，也
excerpt.en:
A member of our expedition team disappeared while exploring a tunnel. The retrieval squad spent days trying to locate the [Owner.GetScientist], only to find them partly encased in a wall, body tightly wrapped in tentacles.

excerpt.zh:
我们的科学家在[From.Planet.GetName]发现了一些奇怪的东西。作为一颗热带星球，其表面大片区域被茂密的丛林覆盖：巨大的、寿达千年的古树从林冠中突兀而起，它们枝叶茂密的树冠俯瞰着其他陆上景观。

初看起来，这些参天大树的分布似乎杂乱无章。然而，更详细的分析表明这些树的分布具有数学精准性，也许是由某个消失已久的文明所种植的。不仅如此，团队领袖相信，树木的分布方式可能包含着一组坐标，指向丛林深处某个未被探索的区域。
excerpt.en:
Our scientists have discovered something unusual on [From.Planet.GetName]. A tropical world, much of the planet's surface is covered with dense jungle: massive, thousand year old trees erupt from the canopy, their leafy crowns towering over the landscape.
