excerpt.zh:
星海共同体的特使们撰写了一封措辞强烈的文章，声称[Root.GetName]违反了星系法，并警告我们不遵守星系法可能带来的严重后果。

我们是否要改变自己的政策，以迎合这一要求？
excerpt.en:
Envoys from the Galactic Community have compiled a list of articles that the [Root.GetName] are in violation of, and warn of possible consequences should we not make ourselves in alignment with Galactic Law.

Should we change our policies and accede to their d

excerpt.zh: 能与小信使古怪的科技水平与容量相提并论的就是它可笑的规模了。数千个建造它的渺小生物才能塞满飞船，但如果我们想要塞进最小规格的船员还必须要对其进行大规模的改造。
excerpt.en: The extraordinary level of technology and capacity of The Lesser Messenger can only be rivaled by it's ridiculous scale. Of the ship's tiny creator species thousands could fit into the vessel, but to fit even a skeleton crew of our species in there is going to

excerpt.zh:
随着信号被解密，[Root.Leader.GetName]震惊地发现它一直在广播[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]的一种主语言的古老形式。它不断地广播着“尔等”，“汝等”，“何期”，似乎正在不停地重复着[shakespeare.GetName]的一部已经遗失的著作——而作者是一位火灾600年前的[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]剧作家。

似乎这个广播设备——一个简易的被一个小小的外罩保护的卫星碟片——是[From.GetPlanetMoon]上仅存的非自然结构。没有任何提示
excerpt.en: Having decrypted the signal, [Root.Leader.GetName] was astonished to discover it was broadcasting in an archaic form of one of the main [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] languages. Speaking in 'thees', 'thous' and 'whenceforths', it appears to be reciting one of the

excerpt.zh:
当我们的船进入[From.GetName]星系时，显而易见的是有奇怪的事正在发生。这个星系的其中一个星球拥有着引人注目的卫星数量，而这颗星球似乎曾经适宜居住但现在却显示出相当高的辐射读数。另一个星球被完全摧毁了。碎片散落在整个系统中，表明这里曾经生活过的任何文明都在一场激烈的斗争中被毁灭了。

一艘战舰在星系中巡逻。它不响应我们的问询，而且它的航线表明其正在拦截[Root.GetName]。它的武器系统正在充能。
excerpt.en: As our ships enter the [From.GetName] system, it is immediately obvious that something very strange happened here. One of the planets - which boasts an eye-catching distribution of moons - appears to have once been habitable, but initial scans show high levels

excerpt.zh: 在[From.Planet.GetName]上的考古远征队。由于高水平的放射性物质，我们不得不采取预防辐射中毒的措施。然而，一次在考古学家挖掘的地点的泄露似乎造成了严重的恐慌。[Root.Leader.GetName]和[Root.Leader.GetHerHis]的团队不得不暂停挖掘工作，直到辐射恢复到安全水平。
excerpt.en: The archaeological expedition on [From.Planet.GetName] has been forced to take precautions against radiation poisoning due to the high levels of radioactivity on the ruined planet. However, it seems that a leak has caused a significant scare on the site where

title.zh: 隐蔽的前哨船只被激活

excerpt.zh: 我们的考古学家在[From.System.GetName]星系不经意间引起了隐藏在小行星带的前哨船只的注意。我们不确定为什么它一直保持隐蔽到现在。可能是它的传感器出故障了？我们可以确定的是现在它已经苏醒了，并且它的武器系统正在激活！
excerpt.en: Our archaeologists in the [From.System.GetName] system have inadvertently drawn the attention of a sentinel ship concealed in the asteroid belt. We are not sure why it had remained hidden until now. Perhaps its sensors had malfunctioned? What is certain is tha

excerpt.zh:
初看，[From.GetName]上的一切都似乎平淡无奇。只有当[Root.GetName]上的一位科学家在一次偶然的观测中发现地表之下有一块巨大棱镜在反射星光。扫描仪很快对物体进行了辨识，它的宽度几乎相当于一座中等大小的岛屿。

探针遥测表明，构成该棱镜的化学物质具有非常高的价值；其物理结构可能在我们星系内也是独一无二的。
excerpt.en: At first glance, everything about [From.GetName] seemed routine and normal. Only during a chance alignment did a scientist aboard the [Root.GetName] notice starlight reflecting off a vast lens near the surface below. Scanners were quickly trained upon the crys

excerpt.zh: 我们在[From.Planet.GetName]上最新建设计划被深层地陷打断了。伤亡不大，并且我们的基础设施没有受到太大影响。然而该地质活动揭露了一座地下交通网络的一角。尴尬的测量师们已经开始勘察这些突然出现的隧道。似乎这属于[From.Planet.GetName]过去的历史……
excerpt.en: Deep-level cave-ins have shaken our newest building project on [From.Planet.GetName]. Casualties were minimal, and none of our primary infrastructure was affected. This geological activity has, however, revealed part of a network of transportation tunnels. Emb

excerpt.zh:
我们的[owner.GetScientistPlural]研究后得知，这位客人扭曲触手的动作其实是一种复杂的语言形式。

于是乎我们沮丧地了解到这个生物正因为衣不蔽体而感到尴尬，正在反复地请求合适的衣物以遮蔽其赤裸的躯体。

在得体地遮蔽躯体后，我们的研究者建造了一台多肢机器以便与这个生物交流。
excerpt.en:
Our [owner.GetScientistPlural] has determined the wriggling tentacle motions of our guest are a form of sophisticated sign language.

To our dismay, we thus learned that the creature is embarrassed about its lack of clothing and has been repeatedly asking for

excerpt.zh:
我们的这位访客十分健谈，但文化差异让我们难以相互理解。现在我们知道了该生物为雌性，她称自己为“万爪之母”，似乎隶属于某个它称之为薄幕行者的唯心主义教团。但我们仍然不明白这个她一直唠唠叨叨不停的“山现”是什么，或者它和她的突然出现之间有什么因果关系。

我们继续尝试同其进行沟通。
excerpt.en: Our guest is very talkative, but cultural differences are making it hard for us to understand each other. We now know that the creature is female, refers to herself as "The Many-Tentacled One" and seems to be a member of a spiritual order it calls the Veilfare

excerpt.zh:
我们没能成功地给这位神秘访客提供合适的营养：该生物很快就生病了，它拒绝餐食，还拒绝作出任何应答。

在我们能够进一步了解它的新陈代谢机制之前，通讯行为暂时停止。
excerpt.en:
Our attempts to provide our mysterious visitor with suitable nourishment have failed: the creature quickly sickened, expelled the meal, and is currently unresponsive.

Communication efforts are on hold until we can gain a better understanding of its metabolism

excerpt.zh:
该生物对我们的尝试性联络反应激烈，猛烈地袭击了一位我们的科学家，并拒绝进一步的合作。也许我们无意见冒犯了它。

尽管没有人严重受伤，但是这次事故依然对迄今为止我们同这个生物建立的脆弱的信任造成了损伤。
excerpt.en:
The creature has reacted violently to our communication attempts, lashing out at one of our scientists and refusing further collaboration. We believe we have unintentionally offended it.

While no one was seriously injured, the accident has damaged the fragile

excerpt.zh: [From.Owner.Capital.GetName]上的社会正不断孕育出丰富的文化和对艺术进行深刻鉴赏的风潮。居民们放下了武器，转而使用书写工具。随着这种全新的学习和探索氛围已超脱于冲突之上，我们可能正在见证这个行星上一个黄金时代的到来。
excerpt.en: Society on [From.Owner.Capital.GetName] is blossoming with rich culture and a deep appreciation for art. The inhabitants are putting down their weapons in favor of writing instruments. With this newfound willingness to learn and explore beyond conflict, we cou

excerpt.zh: 使用隐身[GetIndividualNamePlural]和牵引光束，我们能够成功地收集、分析和研究毫无防备的[pre_ftl_species.GetName]个体，之后再将其送还到自己的居所。不幸的是，牵引光束对于[pre_ftl_species.GetAdj]的生理机能产生了预料之外的效果。在返回家中以后，这些样品开始遭受疖子、疹子以及不受控制地打喷嚏，在回到家中的三个小时之后其外表皮还会发生溶解。这种神秘的溶肤病已经酿成了全国范围内的卫健紧急事件，而验尸报告毫无疑问会揭示外部干预的证据。
excerpt.en: Using stealthy [GetIndividualNamePlural] and tractor beams, we were able to successfully collect, analyze and study unsuspecting [pre_ftl_species.GetName] individuals and return them to their dwellings. Unfortunately, the tractor beams had an unexpected effect

excerpt.zh:
从[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上收集活体样本的时候发生了事故。由于计算错误，我们的[GetIndividualNamePlural]上配备的牵引光束强度不足。不仅没有得到样本，我们只能短暂地让它们悬浮在空中，然后立马掉到地面上。

我们试图收集的鸟类样本发现这样的事故特别好玩。这些胆子很大的样本甚至开始追逐我们的[GetIndividualNamePlural]，希望也能被带走，而且完全是出于寻求乐子。
excerpt.en: An accident occurred while collecting live samples from planet [pre_ftl_planet.GetName]. Due to a miscalculation, our [GetIndividualNamePlural] were equipped with tractor beams of insufficient strength. Instead of acquiring the specimen, we only managed to lif

excerpt.zh:
围绕着[From.GetName]星系三颗恒星的每颗行星都是生态天堂，即盖亚星球，每一颗都能维持有机生命。由于这些星球上没有污染，起初我们认为它们可能无人居住。然而在进行了更深入的扫描后，我们在每颗星球上都发现了横亘整颗星球的大型城市。

更奇怪的是，似乎只有环绕中心恒星的行星是属于这个星系的。其他的恒星则由来自贺利托和其他更遥远的星系的行星环绕。
excerpt.en: Orbiting each of the three stars in the [From.GetName] system are ecological paradises, Gaia worlds, each capable of sustaining organic life. Initially, we thought these might be uninhabited, given the lack of pollution. Yet after performing deeper scans we di

excerpt.zh:
在完全控制了[infiltrated_country_species.GetAdj]的政治高层之后，我们的渗透人员已经做好准备迎接首次接触小组的正式到访。

在新的行星首都举办的大型仪式上，所有[infiltrated_country_planet.GetName]领袖共同签署了[infiltrated_country_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]立即并入[root.GetName]的请愿书。我们的外交大使很大度地接受了这一请求。公民们兴高采烈地走上街道，为他们的外星恩主欢呼着。
excerpt.en:
After achieving complete dominion over the [infiltrated_country_species.GetAdj] political leadership, our infiltration cells paved the way for the arrival of a formal first contact unit.

In a lavish ceremony held at the planetary capital, our diplomatic envoy

excerpt.zh: 在[infiltrated_country_species.GetAdj]政治领袖之中立足后，我们的渗透单元为第一次接触单元的正式到来铺平了道路。在行星首都的一场恰如其分的仪式上，我们的特使谦逊地接受了一份由[infiltrated_country_planet.GetName]星球个领袖签署的陈情书。文件展示了将[infiltrated_country_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]吞并如[root.GetName]的计划。许多居民前来夹道欢迎他们的新外星施恩者。
excerpt.en: After gaining a foothold over the [infiltrated_country_species.GetAdj] political leadership, our infiltration cells paved the way for the arrival of a formal first contact unit. In a modest ceremony at the planetary capital, our diplomatic envoy humbly accepte

excerpt.zh: 渗透入[infiltrated_country_species.GetAdj]的政治领导层后，我方特工为第一次接触单元的到来铺平了道路。他们不打算举行任何仪式来庆祝我方外交使节的到达。不过，我方已与[infiltrated_country_planet.GetName]的领袖集团达成共识。他们的[infiltrated_country_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]将被并入[root.GetName]。
excerpt.en: After infiltrating the [infiltrated_country_species.GetAdj] political leadership, our operatives have laid the ground for the arrival of a formal first contact unit. There will be no ceremony to mark the arrival of our diplomatic envoy. However, we have entere

excerpt.zh:
我们对[infiltrated_country_species.GetAdj]政治领导层的渗透并不像我们被灌输的那样彻底。在起先渗透主要国家失败后，我们尝试在一些较小的政权中发动政变。即便如此我们也还是未能获得民众的支持。

我们已经从[infiltrated_country_planet.GetName]撤回了所有还健在的特工。当地居民显然会在未来几年内保持警惕。
excerpt.en: Our infiltration of the [infiltrated_country_species.GetAdj] political leadership was not as complete as we had been led to believe. After initially failing to infiltrate their major nations, we attempted a coup within a minor power. Yet even there, the people

excerpt.zh: 我们对[target.capital_scope.GetName]的[owner.GetPreFTLLower]居民进行潜移默化影响的工作已经达到了顶峰。我们的特工已经准备好把我们的文化价值传播到[target.GetSpeciesAdj]社会。
excerpt.en: Our work to influence the [owner.GetPreFTLLower] inhabitants of [target.capital_scope.GetName] has reached its zenith. Our operatives are now ready to bring our own cultural values to bear on [target.GetSpeciesAdj] society.

excerpt.zh:
尽管一开始的势头看起来颇为靠谱，但只有时间能告诉我们对[from.target.GetAdj]的努力能维持多久。[from.target.GetSpeciesNamePlural]拥护者们已经彻底接纳了我们的意识形态，视如己出。

我们的特工熟练运用光荣祖先的经验建立了一个[root.GetAdj]威权主义的原始模型。精心筛选的一批当地人被赋权以统治这些社群，其中一些将会繁荣昌盛，另一些则会逐渐凋亡。而这一切都会成为令[from.target.GetSpeciesNamePlural]印象深刻的一课，指导他们学会如
excerpt.en:
Time alone will show how lasting our effect may be on the [from.target.GetAdj], however initial projections look promising. [from.target.GetSpeciesNamePlural] advocates have already taken up our ideas as keenly as if they were their own.

Our operatives deftly

excerpt.zh: 我们的特工已尽其所能，将各种细小的技术进步播撒到[from.target.GetSpeciesAdj]社会。现在就看当地人如何连点成线，把量变转化成质变。他们已经做好了一切准备。
excerpt.en: Our operatives have done all they can, seeding various small technological advances into [from.target.GetSpeciesAdj] society. It is up to the locals now to connect the dots, and assemble these small steps into a larger one. They are as ready as they'll ever be

excerpt.zh: 成功了！我们向[from.target.GetSpeciesAdj]社会播撒的科技和知识蓬勃发展，从内部大大推进了他们的文明。只有时间才能说明由此可能产生的长期影响，但目前我们的特工报告说，[from.target.capital_scope.GetName]相当繁荣，善意空前。
excerpt.en: Success! The technology and knowledge we sowed into [from.target.GetSpeciesAdj] society has flourished, greatly advancing their civilization from within. Only time will tell what long-term impacts this may have, but for now our operatives report a great deal o

excerpt.zh: 我们的特工从[from.target.capital_scope.GetName]传来捷报！我们向[from.target.GetSpeciesAdj]社会播撒的科技和知识已开花结果，推动他们的文明向星系进发。只有时间才能说明由此可能产生的长期影响，但目前我们的特工报告说，[from.owner.GetPreFTLLower]星球的繁荣程度有所提高。
excerpt.en: Our operatives report good results on [from.target.capital_scope.GetName]! The technology and knowledge we sowed into [from.target.GetSpeciesAdj] society has borne fruit, nudging their civilization closer towards galactic involvement. Only time will tell what

excerpt.zh: 我们的特工报告说，启迪[from.target.capital_scope.GetName]居民的行动圆满成功。我们传播给[from.target.GetSpeciesAdj]社会的科技和知识已经生根发芽，推动他们的文明在通往星海的道路上更进一步。
excerpt.en: Our operatives report a successful conclusion in our efforts to enlighten the residents of [from.target.capital_scope.GetName]. The technology and knowledge we introduced to [from.target.GetSpeciesAdj] society have taken root, bringing their civilization a lit

excerpt.zh: 我们启迪[from.target.capital_scope.GetName]居民的行动取得了部分成功。尽管遇到了一些挫折，我们还是促进了一些基础的科技进步，确信[from.target.GetSpeciesAdj]社会终会腾飞。不过他们的文明也许不会如我们此前希望的那样迅速或顺利地发展到星际层次。
excerpt.en: We have partially succeeded in enlightening the residents of [from.target.capital_scope.GetName]. Despite some setbacks, we have nevertheless encouraged some basic technological progress and are confident that [from.target.GetSpeciesAdj] society will eventuall

excerpt.zh: 我们在[target.capital_scope.GetName]上的准备工作已经完毕；我们的特工已经准备好将[target.GetName]引入只有一步之遥的星海的大舞台。
excerpt.en: Our preparations on [target.capital_scope.GetName] are now concluded; our operatives are poised to bring the [target.GetName] one step further onto the galactic stage.

excerpt.zh: 多亏了我们的努力，[this.capital_scope.GetName]确信自己在宇宙中并不孤单。现在他们已经做好了接受联络的准备，而不至于对他们的生活方式造成冲击。
excerpt.en: Due to our efforts, the inhabitants of [this.capital_scope.GetName] now know without a doubt that they are not alone in the universe. They are ready to be contacted without risk of extreme shock to their way of life.

excerpt.zh: 我们的间谍首脑[spynetwork.leader.GetName]已经整理总结了结果，事关我们在[target.capital_scope.GetName]上掩盖星际生命存在的行动。
excerpt.en: Our Spymaster [spynetwork.leader.GetName] has outlined the results of our operation to cover up the existence of interstellar life on [target.capital_scope.GetName].

excerpt.zh: 我们在[this.capital_scope.GetName]上的特工通过努力，成功让当地人开始怀疑目前为止所发现的外星生命的证据。有关星际访客存在的故事逐渐被公众遗忘，被视作持阴谋论的少数派一厢情愿的妄想。
excerpt.en: The efforts of our operatives on [this.capital_scope.GetName] have cast doubt on the evidence of alien life found so far. Stories about the existence of interstellar visitors are being dismissed as the delusions of a paranoid minority.

excerpt.zh: 我们在[this.capital_scope.GetName]的优秀特工已消除有关航天文明的猜测。现在传播外星人的故事会迅速被当成失心疯而遭到排挤。
excerpt.en: Our skilled operatives on [this.capital_scope.GetName] have eliminated speculation on the evidence of spacefaring civilizations. Sharing alien stories is now a fast way of becoming ostracized as a delusional outsider.

excerpt.zh: 我们在[this.capital_scope.GetName]的特工已显著减少有关航天文明的猜测。现在传播外星人的故事会被当成是避犹不及之举。
excerpt.en: Our operatives on [this.capital_scope.GetName] have significantly reduced speculation on the evidence of spacefaring civilizations. Sharing alien stories is now considered a shun-worthy eccentricity.

excerpt.zh: 我们在[this.capital_scope.GetName]上的特工通过努力，成功让当地人开始怀疑目前为止所发现的外星生命的证据。有关星际访客存在的故事甚嚣尘上。
excerpt.en: The efforts of our operatives on [this.capital_scope.GetName] have cast doubt on the evidence of alien life found so far. The popularity of stories about the existence of interstellar visitors is increasing rapidly.

excerpt.zh: 我们在[target.capital_scope.GetName]上已逐步整合了当地[target.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的数个关键节点中心。目标是让当地蜂巢在日常活动中对我们更加依赖，并让我们可以最终无缝吞并他们的星球。渗透单位正在巩固我们在[target.capital_scope.GetPlanetHabitat]上的进度。什么时候动手完全取决于我们自己。
excerpt.en: We have slowly assimilated multiple key nodal centers from the local [target.GetSpeciesNamePlural] on [target.capital_scope.GetName]. The goal is to make the local hive more reliant on us for their day-to-day activities until we can seamlessly annex their worl

在完成对[infiltrated_country_species.GetAdj]意识的主宰后，我们很快确定没有任何一个子个体被落下。

[infiltrated_country_species.GetName]意识并未消亡，只是被我们吸收了。我们的意识向着宇宙的深处继续延伸。“一”如既往。
excerpt.en:
After achieving complete dominance over the minds of the [infiltrated_country_species.GetAdj] we quickly ensured that no drone was left.

The [infiltrated_country_species.GetName] consciousness is not gone, merely absorbed. Our minds will now reach further out

excerpt.zh: 在对[infiltrated_country_species.GetAdj]意识取得关键影响后，我们的节点中心已准备好进行直接控制。除了极个别反常问题，我们现在完全将[infiltrated_country_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]整合进了[root.GetName]。
excerpt.en: After gaining critical influence over the [infiltrated_country_species.GetAdj] mind, our nodal centers prepared for us to assume direct control. With only a minor deviancy issue, we have now fully annexed the [infiltrated_country_planet.GetPlanetHabitat] into

excerpt.zh: 在渗透了[infiltrated_country_species.GetAdj]蜂巢意识后，我们整合的节点中心已经准备好吞并剩下的[infiltrated_country_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]。在我们夺取控制时，一小块大陆对我们的影响展现出了抗拒，宁愿选择自我了断也不愿意被我们的意识吸收。他们的[infiltrated_country_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]将被吞并入[root.GetName]。
excerpt.en: After infiltrating the [infiltrated_country_species.GetAdj] hive mind, our assimilated nodal centers were ready to subsume the rest of the [infiltrated_country_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]. As we assumed control, a minor continent resisted our influence, choosing

excerpt.en: The [infiltrated_country_species.GetAdj] hive mind has discovered our influence. Just as we were ready to activate our assimilated nodal centers, we found ourselves cut off from the rest of their hive. Having quickly dismantled our missions, we must declare Op

excerpt.zh:
我们的一位在[from.target.capital_scope.GetName]上工作的关键特工有点……迷恋上了当地的文明，并拒绝了许多已下达的任务。相反，这位过于独立的特工开始进行独立的异种学研究，并提交了许多请求，要求将其正式发布。

这些行为让[from.GetName]行动遭受到推延的风险，但我们必须承认，那个不守规矩的特工的工作事实上对我们相当有用。否认这一努力反而才会减缓我们的进展。
excerpt.en: One of our key operatives working on [from.target.capital_scope.GetName] has become... enamored with the local civilization, and has been refusing many of their assigned tasks. Instead this overly-independent agent has taken up independent xenological study, a

excerpt.zh:
我们在[from.target.capital_scope.GetName]上的工作遇到了一个很怪的难题：[from.target.GetSpeciesAdj]蜂巢正在镜像模仿我们的行为。一开始我们以为不过是当地工蜂的古怪行为，但许多这些新的习惯毫无疑问本质上就是[from.owner.GetSpeciesAdj]的。

这不仅暗示了我们在[from.GetName]行动缜密设计的范围之外影响到了当地的蜂巢，更提醒了我们自己的失败融入正在被倒映回给我们。目前没有迹象表明这个蜂巢意识到了我们的行动，但也许我们的暴露与
excerpt.en: Our work on [from.target.capital_scope.GetName] has met with an unusual complication: the [from.target.GetSpeciesAdj] hive is mirroring our behavior. At first we thought the local drones had simply turned eccentric, but many of these new habits are unmistakeab

excerpt.zh:
一个[from.target.capital_scope.GetName]子个体设法将自己的[from.target.species.GetHandNamePlural]放到了我们的测量装置上。它已经开始把我们的装置拆开了，如果它理解了什么，这股意识蔓延到当地的蜂巢思维只是一个时间问题。

如果我们希望避免干扰它们的自然发展，就必须迅速采取行动。
excerpt.en: A drone on [from.target.capital_scope.GetName] has managed to get their [from.target.species.GetHandNamePlural] on one of our measuring devices. It has already started to take our device apart; it's only a matter of time before the understanding spreads to the

[From.Capital.GetName]上的外星文明已经在他们的母星轨道上建成了第一艘星际飞船。不管其性能如何，这些外星人已经做好了加入星系，并成为太空种族中一员的准备。

他们好像成功地翻译了我们的语言，并向我们打开了外交通道。

[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]的官员收到消息称我们与[pre_ftl_country.GetName]共享科技数据。他们告知我们这毫无疑问违反了开发利用法案，无论我们的本意如何。

excerpt.zh: 我们已成功与[This.System.GetName]星系的神秘外星人建立第一次接触。从今开始至知悉更详细的信息为止，我们将其代称为[This.ContactCountry.GetName]。如果他们具有语言，我们必须进行破译才能建立交流。
excerpt.en: We have made first contact with mysterious aliens in the [This.System.GetName] system. For now, we have code-named them [This.ContactCountry.GetName], until we can find out more about them. If they possess a language, we must decipher it in order to establish

excerpt.zh:
我们试图学习[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的知识，但截止到当前一切都是徒劳。我们很容易就发现了他们显然属于某个十分先进的外星文明，但是除此之外我们一无所知，看来他们花了很大的努力阻止我们或者其他窃听者截获来自他们的任何信号。

我们目前为止仅仅截获了他们语言的很小一片段。然而，根据我们手头的情报，我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]很确信，如果能够获取更大规模的样本，破解对方的通讯不是问题。
excerpt.en: Our attempts to learn more about the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] have so far been in vain. While we were easily able to ascertain that they clearly form part of a technologically advanced alien civilization, further facts have proven elusive as they seem to

excerpt.zh:
[This.ContactCountry.GetName]显然非常希望与我们建立通讯，对方向我们发送了体量庞大的视听通讯数据，显然是来提供翻译他们语言的关键。

我们的专家坚信要不了多久我们就能和对方交流了。当然，我们得相信他们提供的翻译足够精准，不至于造成误解……那之后，我们才能够依据广泛迥异的经验性上下文对信息进行可靠的翻译。
excerpt.en:
The [This.ContactCountry.GetName] appear eager to establish communications with us, having sent a large audio and visual transmission that appears to offer the key to translating their language.

Our experts are confident that we will be able to use this to le

excerpt.zh: 我们破解截获自[This.ContactCountry.GetName]信号的努力有了回报，我们终于达成了一项突破。尽管对于他们语言的掌握还不够熟练，我们还是设法与这个文明成功地开放了外交通道，后者现在被正式称为[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]。
excerpt.en: Our efforts to decipher the signals picked up from the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] have paid off, and we have finally made a breakthrough. While our mastery of their language may not be complete, we have managed to successfully open diplomatic channels with

excerpt.zh: 当我们开始翻译这些所谓的[This.ContactCountry.GetName]进一步送达的通讯消息，我们惊讶地发现：他们讲的正是我们自己语言的一类方言！在惊讶消退之后，通讯极为迅速地建立了起来，他们现在被正式称为[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]。
excerpt.en: As we began to intercept further communications from the so-called [This.ContactCountry.GetName], a startling discovery was made: they were speaking in a strange dialect of one of our own languages! Once the surprise of this encounter was overcome, communicati

excerpt.zh: 当我们将自己的处理器转为翻译从被记作[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的未知外星人截获的通讯信号时，我们惊讶地发现：他们同样也隶属于某个机械智能！尽管他们的程式和我们在各种方面都大不一样，其语言建立于大量不同的有机体语言基础之上，然而他们的语言和我们有着类似的语素假设。结果，我们只花了几瞬的功夫就解密了他们的用语程式，开始进行基础的交流，他们现在被正式称为[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]。
excerpt.en: As we turned our processors to interpreting the communications we have intercepted from the unknown aliens designated as [This.ContactCountry.GetName], a startling discovery was made: they too belong to a machine intelligence! Although their programming varies

excerpt.zh: -当我们将处理器切换为翻译来自未知外星人——被我们标记为[This.ContactCountry.GetName]——的通信时，我们发现了一个惊人的事实：他们也属于一种机械智能！他们的通信协议与我们的非常相似，软件兼容性使我们能够迅速建立通信。相似之处还延伸到其他领域，可以说我们的机械智能可以被视为他们代码库的一个分支。只有一个合理的解释。

excerpt.zh: 我们对从[This.ContactCountry.GetName]截获的信号进行的破译工作已取得成效，最终实现了重大突破。这一进程因一项关键发现而大幅推进——对方与我们类似，也是以集体智慧的形式组织起来的。尽管其生物特征及[this.ContactCountry.GetHiveAuthority]的意识形态与我们有显著差异，但其[this.ContactCountry.GetIndividualNamePlural]的思维结构很可能与我们的兼容，并可整合至[This.Owner.GetGovernmentName]

我们的努力有了回报，现在我们能够破译[This.ContactCountry.GetName]，或者准确来说叫[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]向我们发送来的信息了：

“啊，巧夺天工的谄媚。遇到另一个珍视诗歌的物种已是三生有幸，谁曾想到，亲爱的[Owner.GetSpeciesName]，你们竟是如此热情洋溢、乖唇蜜舌。祝福你们的[Owner.GetSpeciesOrganName]。”

信息后面还有许多诸如此类的词句。我们也没法完全确定是该受宠若惊还是直接大吃一惊，但也许我们的
excerpt.en:
Our efforts have paid off, and we can now interpret the missives sent by the [This.ContactCountry.GetName], who we now know to be the [This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]:

"Ah, the fine art of flattery. It is nice indeed to meet another species that appreciates

excerpt.zh: 我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]在解码[This.ContactCountry.GetName]语言的过程中取得了一项突破性进展。他们使用的文字系统里包含了将近一千七百万种字符，每个字符恰好可以和红-绿-蓝色值一一对应。尽管颇为费解，我们的语言学家们认为他们是可以破译这种外星语言的，只是还需要再花上一些时间。
excerpt.en: Our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] have made a breakthrough deciphering the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] language. They use an alphabet consisting of almost seventeen million unique characters, which in turn correspond with a color on the red-green-blue spectrum.

excerpt.zh: [This.ContactCountry.GetName]在太空中的一艘太空梭靠近了我们。由于没有发生其他事情，我们假设他们希望在远离他们主舰船的地方会面。由于船只尺寸较小，只有我们的[Owner.GetEnvoy][Leader.GetName]被派去，其他外交团队成员留在后方。
excerpt.en: The [This.ContactCountry.GetName] positioned a shuttle close to us in space. Since nothing further happened, we assumed that they wished to meet away from their main ship. The small size of the vessel meant that only our [Owner.GetEnvoy] [Leader.GetName] could

excerpt.zh: [Leader.GetName]返回报告说，没有来自[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的人接见[Leader.GetHimHer]。
excerpt.en: [Leader.GetName] returned to report that no one from the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] met [Leader.GetHimHer].

excerpt.zh: 单方面的沟通让外交团队遭受巨大的挫折。他们渴望成功的第一次接触，为此他们在没有任何事实基础的情况下，制定了分支预测策略来指导剩余的接触流程。
excerpt.en: The one-sided communication greatly frustrated the diplomatic team. Eager for a successful first contact, they created branching prediction strategies for the remaining procedure without any factual information to inform the approach.

excerpt.zh:
[Leader.GetName]从[This.ContactCountry.GetName]返回了！尽管伤痕累累，但却载誉而归。

从一个隐藏的门中，一名外星战士突然现身并开始同我们的[Owner.GetEnvoy]展开搏斗，直到筋疲力尽。在最后一丝力量的召唤下，[Leader.GetName]设法制服了[Leader.GetHisHer]的对手。

不到一个小时，[This.ContactCountry.GetName]发送了一条信息：

“[Leader.GetName]将被记录在我们的史册中，作为一位伟大的战
excerpt.en:
[Leader.GetName] returned from the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] shuttle injured, but victorious.

From a hidden door, an alien fighter emerged and proceeded to batter our [Owner.GetEnvoy] to the point of exhaustion. Summoning a last surge of strength, [Leader

excerpt.zh: 对于在[contact_country.GetName]中俘获的飞船的研究已经结束。尽管因为没有抓到活口来审讯而使调查充满挑战，但我们快速的进程可能使我们得以和[contact_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]建立通信。我们的[Root.GetResearchers]研究员可以研究他们的科技，这能帮助我们在研究突破上找到全新的思路。
excerpt.en: We have concluded our study of the equipment we recently captured from the [contact_country.GetName]. Although investigating it was a challenge without living specimens to interrogate, faster progress could be made once communications were opened with the [con

excerpt.zh:
我们结束了对此前抓获的[This.ContactCountry.GetName]外星人的研究。最初这些人质不太愿意与我们合作，但随着时间推移他们在无意中不断地给了我们有关他们语言的线索，一直到我们能够与他们进行基础的语言交流。从那时起，我们就能迅速拼凑有关他们的细节，一旦有一位或是更多的人质愿意合作，我们就能进入他们的电脑系统。

得益于从他们身上收集到的信息，我们能够确认他们来自[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]，并就其活动和军事实力收集到了相当多的情报。
excerpt.en: We have concluded our study of the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] aliens we recently captured. The hostages were initially unwilling to cooperate with us, but over time they inadvertently gave us clues to their language, until we were able to communicate with t

excerpt.zh:
[This.ContactCountry.GetName]停靠在我们舰队边上，广播着重复的信号。

翻译这些信息颇具挑战，但我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]相信他们是在邀请我们派出一位代表去往他们的舰船上参加一场持续多日的文化交流活动。
excerpt.en:
The [This.ContactCountry.GetName] drew alongside our fleet, broadcasting a repeating signal.

It was a challenge to translate their message, but our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] believe they are inviting one of our representatives to a multi-day cultural exchange

excerpt.zh:
[This.Owner.GetEnvoy][This.Leader.GetName]和我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]连蒙带猜地接受了外星人的文化交流邀请。[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的热烈反应应该是积极的。不久之后，他们发来了表示派对倒计时的象形文字。

[This.Owner.GetEnvoyCap][This.Leader.GetName]正在利用剩余的时间准备并进一步学习我们目前获得的语言样本。
excerpt.en: With a little bit of guesswork, [This.Owner.GetEnvoy] [This.Leader.GetName] and our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] accepted the alien cultural exchange invitation. We interpreted the enthusiastic response from the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] as positive. Shortly

excerpt.zh: [This.ContactCountry.GetName]文化交流活动的倒计时马上就到尾声了。[This.Owner.GetEnvoyCap][This.Leader.GetName]很快就要登上前往外星特使舰船的太空梭。出于尊重，宴会期间与我们的[This.Owner.GetEnvoy]的通讯将会暂停。
excerpt.en: The countdown to the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] cultural exchange event is nearing completion. [This.Owner.GetEnvoyCap] [This.Leader.GetName] is about to board the shuttle to the alien envoy ship. Communication with our [This.Owner.GetEnvoy] will pause for

excerpt.zh:
我们对[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的邀请不闻不问冒犯到了他们。他们的态度发生了一百八十度大转弯。在后续的通讯中我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]翻译出了一些敌意性的言辞。

他们似乎不想要我们拒绝。
excerpt.en:
Our lack of interest in their invitation has offended the [This.ContactCountry.GetName]. Their tone has dramatically changed. Our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] translated some hostile language within their follow-up communication.

It seems they do not want to tak

excerpt.zh:
[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的活动持续的时间远超预期。

[This.Owner.GetEnvoy][This.Leader.GetName]的太空梭返回时汇报了任务失败。

在活动过程中，主办方找到了谍报装置。[This.Owner.GetEnvoyCap][This.Leader.GetName]遭到了审问和训斥，并被遣返。通过后备间谍科技获取的数据，我们现在理解了他们的语言和科技，然而我们的外交前景一片渺茫。
excerpt.en:
The [This.ContactCountry.GetName]'s event lasted much longer than expected.

When [This.Owner.GetEnvoy] [This.Leader.GetName]'s shuttle returned, they reported that the operation failed.

During the event, the hosts found an espionage device. [This.Owner.GetEn

excerpt.zh:
[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的活动举办时间远超预期。

乘坐太空梭返回后，[This.Owner.GetEnvoy][This.Leader.GetName]汇报了行动大获成功。不仅这种外星语言被大部分破解了，我们的扫描也揭示了他们科技能力的清晰图景。

这将会极大地促进我们与[This.ContactCountry.GetName]未来的关系，同时还让他们对我们对他们科技了如指掌一事蒙在鼓里。
excerpt.en:
The [This.ContactCountry.GetName]'s event lasted much longer than expected.

When [This.Owner.GetEnvoy] [This.Leader.GetName]'s shuttle returned, they reported that the operation was a success. Not only did they successfully decipher most of the alien language

excerpt.zh:
敞开心胸来到这场持续多日的盛会，[This.Owner.GetEnvoy][This.Leader.GetName]参加了音乐、戏剧和舞蹈的表演，并尝试了许多餐饮传统。他们对各种体验的接受得到了[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的热烈欢迎。

离开时，[This.Owner.GetEnvoyCap][This.Leader.GetName]对他们的语言获得了非常深切的理解，对他们的文化也颇为赞赏。这段经历将会为我们未来与[This.ContactCountry.GetName]更加积极正面的
excerpt.en: Entering the multi-day event with an open mind, [This.Owner.GetEnvoy] [This.Leader.GetName] joined in musical, theater, and dance performances and explored various culinary traditions. Their receptiveness to experience was met enthusiastically by the [This.Con

excerpt.zh:
[This.Owner.GetEnvoyCap][This.Leader.GetName]在这场持续多日的活动中客气地参观着文艺活动，小试着他们的饮食文化。不温不火的态度让[This.ContactCountry.GetName]颇感沮丧。根据我们对他们语言的理解，他们说我们的特使“很无聊”。

我们的特使被护送回到太空梭上并被示意离开。特使已经掌握了他们的语言，并对他们的文化有了初步的了解，我们可以在未来的外交互动中以此为基础。
excerpt.en: [This.Owner.GetEnvoyCap] [This.Leader.GetName] spent the multi-day event reservedly observing artistic shows and sampling the culinary traditions. The lack of enthusiasm frustrated the [This.ContactCountry.GetName]. According to our understanding of their lang

excerpt.zh:
在这场持续数天的活动这，[This.ContactCountry.GetName]对营养需求的差异的沮丧显而易见。幸好[This.Owner.GetEnvoy][This.Leader.GetName]还是积极参与到了其他的娱乐活动中，并建立了互相的尊重。

[This.Owner.GetEnvoyCap][This.Leader.GetName]离开时对[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的语言文化获得了基本的了解。值得赞扬的是，他们似乎对这一饮食灾难泰然自若，并为我们提供了许多礼仪手册。虽
excerpt.en: The [This.ContactCountry.GetName]'s disappointment in the difference between our nutritional needs couldn't have been more apparent over the multi-day event. Thankfully [This.Owner.GetEnvoy] [This.Leader.GetName] did their best to take an active part in the en

excerpt.zh:
第二次拒绝[This.ContactCountry.GetName]让我们前往他们的舰船的邀请得到了情绪激烈的回复。我们收到了一份来自多名外星船员长达数个小时的通讯，我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]认为他们似乎是在因我们的不愿出息而发出谴责。

这些通信，加上从他们船上截获的信号，使我们能够破译足够多他们的语言以产生有意义的理解。尽管他们对这一事件持消极态度，但我们现在可以建立更适当的外交关系了。
excerpt.en: The second rejection by the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] to invite us to their ship was met with a strong emotional response. We received communication from multiple alien crew members for several hours, in what our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] believe was an at

excerpt.zh:
基于我们与许多外星物种构建通讯的成功经历，我们的一位[This.Owner.GetLinguists]提出了一项激进的举措。虽然过去所有与天龙沟通的努力均不幸失败，[needed_name.GetSheHe]坚称[needed_name.GetSXX]现在是进一步尝试的好机会。

根据我们最古老的历史，[This.Owner.Species.GetName]曾一度与龙建立了传说中的契约，正是由它结束的正面冲突。据此，某种程度的互相理解应该是可以达成的。[needed_name.GetSheHe]指出[needed_
excerpt.en: Following our successes in establishing communications with a number of alien species, one of our leading [This.Owner.GetLinguists] has brought forth a radical proposal. Though past efforts to communicate with the Sky Dragon have failed miserably, [needed_name

excerpt.zh:
如楼房大小、长着许多触手的怪物突然出现在[This.Owner.Capital.GetName]让首都失去了秩序。这个生物对于它自己的突然出现似乎和我们一样困惑，毫无抵抗地就被我们捕获拘束了起来。

我们怀疑该生物应该来自外太空，但无法排除是一种本就在我们星球上的未知物种的可能性。无论如何，轨道上确实没有发现任何外星舰船。这个代号来客的生物的凭空出现，似乎也不是借助的科技手段。

令人困惑（同时它自己也充满困惑）的客人目前被收容在一座研究设施中。
excerpt.en: The appearance of a building-sized, tentacled monstrosity in the midst of [This.Owner.Capital.GetName] has thrown the capital into disarray. The creature seems as perplexed as we are by its sudden appearance, and has allowed itself to be restrained without res

excerpt.zh: 我们已与[MSI_country.GetName]取得联系。当务之急的事情是，我们必须要小心翼翼地驾驭不断变化的局势。我们应该派遣一名特使来代表我们的利益。无论与我们以前的主人进行任何互动，这肯定会对我们的人民产生深远的心理影响。
excerpt.en: Contact has been made with [MSI_country.GetName]. It's imperative that we navigate the evolving situation carefully. An envoy should be be dispatched to represent our interests. Any interaction with our former masters is sure to have a profound psychological e

excerpt.zh: 我们收到了来源不明的读数。这些信号似乎遵循着某种重复的句法，证明其来源应为智慧生物。我们应进一步研究它。它们似乎集中在一个空间站附近，但尚不清楚这个空间站是不是一个更大的太空文明的一部分。
excerpt.en: We have picked up readings of unknown nature. The signals seem to follow some kind of repeating syntax which could indicate sapient origin. It should be investigated further. They seem to be concentrated around a single space station, though it is unclear whet

excerpt.zh: 在成功的翻译了他们的语言之后，我们与[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]的独立空间站建立了通讯。
excerpt.en: After successfully translating their language, we have established communications with the independent space station of the [This.ContactCountry.GetRealName].

excerpt.zh: 长程扫描仪获取了[This.System.GetName]恒星系中的数据，对其的解析几乎说明它是一个巨大热源。这非常值得研究。
excerpt.en: Long range scanners have picked up readings in the [This.System.GetName] system that could best be described as giant heat blobs. It's worth investigating.

excerpt.zh:
我们称之为“缇扬奇”的太空生物十分温顺。它们可以进入低维度的亚空间，因此可以轻易地在星系之间遨游。

它们以气态巨行星外层常见的气体为食。这不太可能是它们唯一的食物来源，但到目前为止尚未观察到其他的进食方式。

它们不会主动进攻，因此可以安全地无视它们。
excerpt.en:
The spaceborne lifeforms - which we call "Tiyanki" - are docile creatures. Capable of accessing some lower dimension of subspace, they roam from system to system with remarkable ease.

They graze on gases common to the upper layers of many gas giants. It is hi

excerpt.zh:
当我们进入[This.System.GetName]时，传感器获取了一个奇怪的数据。一开始把它们当成发光的小行星而忽视了，但后来当发现它们会对太空中的移动物体哪怕距离很远都会做出一定的进攻性反应，事情就变得有趣了起来。

建议最好从安全的距离上观察这些东西。
excerpt.en:
Upon entering [This.System.GetName] our sensors picked up strange readings. Dismissed at first as glorified asteroids, things quickly changed when it was discovered that these entities reacted aggressively to movement in space - even at great distance!

Observ

excerpt.zh: 我们之前用[This.ContactCountry.GetName]指称的不规则物体看起来一定程度上由晶态物质组成。有趣的是，它们可以在虚空中推进，并能在必要的时候保护自己，说明他们应该是具有生命的。我们的[This.Owner.GetResearchers]正在做进一步的调查。
excerpt.en: The irregularity we had designated as [This.ContactCountry.GetName] appears to be made of some sort of crystalline material. Curiously, it seems to be able to propel itself across the void and protect itself when necessary, indicating that it may be alive. Our

excerpt.zh:
我们在[This.System.GetName]发现了一种新的生命形式，虽然称之为“生命”可能不太准确。这些实体看起来完全是一种完全出于未知的工业用途的全自动无人机器人。

我们会继续观察，但由于这些机器有自我保护的编码，所以最好谨慎行事。
excerpt.en:
We have discovered a new lifeform in [This.System.GetName], although calling it a "lifeform" may be incorrect. The entities appear to be fully automated, mechanical drones built exclusively for some unknown industrial purpose.

Observations will continue, but

excerpt.zh:
尽管他们生活在居住站上的事实暗示了他们很可能是一个先进的社会，然而[This.Owner.GetEnvoy][This.Leader.GetName]不能肯定我们是不是真的在和一种智慧生命形式打交道：他们似乎无时不刻在展现敌意，这对于一个稳定的社会而言是不可想象的：即便在我们短暂的调查期间也展现了数次纯粹的野蛮行为。

他们看起来具有语言，但我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]仍在努力解析当中，以便我们在未来能够理解他们的行为。
excerpt.en: Although their dwellings on habitat stations would suggest an advanced society, [This.Owner.GetEnvoy] [This.Leader.GetName] is unsure whether we are indeed dealing with an intelligent lifeform: they seem unremittingly hostile, so much so that a stable society

excerpt.zh: 我们完成了对他们使用语言的破译，[This.Owner.GetEnvoy][This.Leader.GetName]将[encountered_marauder.GetName]识别为一种游牧文明，称为[encountered_marauder.GetRealName]。他们在[marauder_system.GetName]恒星系附近占据了数个大型空间站，其大量的人口都居住在拥挤而肮脏的环境之中。尽管如此，或许正因如此，他们似乎发展出了一种非常尚武的文化。生活在冰冷虚空中成了他们的第二天性，因而高度擅长太空作战。
excerpt.en: Having decoded what counts as a language among them, [This.Owner.GetEnvoy] [This.Leader.GetName] has identified the [encountered_marauder.GetName] as a nomadic civilization known as the [encountered_marauder.GetRealName]. They occupy a number of large space st

excerpt.zh: 我们在[This.System.GetName]遇到的舰船似乎有点过时，但仍然武装到了牙齿。这些舰船应该是有人驾驶的，但对任何靠近的物体都展现了敌意。有必要谨慎应对……
excerpt.en: The vessels we encountered in the [This.System.GetName] system appear to be somewhat outmoded, but nevertheless armed to the teeth. They seem to be piloted by sentient crews but respond with hostility to any approach. We will have to treat them with caution.

excerpt.zh:
尽管我们仍然无法与他们建立联络，主要是因为他们并不想理我们，但我们已经可以确认[This.ContactCountry.GetName]是海盗。视觉指示器表明他们的文化很大程度上是生长于太空的，我们观察到的一些表现形式不符合任何一种居住于行星的文明。

不幸的是，他们的船员似乎对民事交流没有任何兴趣。我们从截获的舰见通讯也表明他们主要以海盗活动为生，偶尔也会招募部分文明边缘的元素到他们的贼船上。
excerpt.en: Although we have been unable to establish communications with them - mainly because they are unwilling to communicate with us - we have been able to identify the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] as pirates. Visual indicators point to their culture being largely s

excerpt.zh:
在[This.System.GetName]星系中探测到的舰船似乎正在进行某种横跨星系的远征，这种生活方式对我们自己的族群而言并不陌生。他们没有表现出任何敌意，而是不断向我们方向重复广播信号。

看到一个族群将家园安于星海之间而非任何星球之上，这种景象令人感到几分莫名的亲切。我们的[This.Owner.GetEnvoy][This.Leader.GetName]迫切希望能够进一步了解这些同为旅人的族群。
excerpt.en:
The vessels detected in the [This.System.GetName] system appear to be on some kind of expedition across the galaxy, a way of life our own people know well. They have made no hostile moves, broadcasting repetitive signals in our direction instead.

There is som

excerpt.zh: 我们已经成功地破译了[This.ContactCountry.GetName]向我们发送的令人困惑的重复信息，我们发现这些信息是一些……商业广告！显然他们自称为[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]，是一个以向偶遇的任何文明提供最优惠的交易谋生的星际商团的一部分，至少他们自称是最优惠的。一如既往，他们似乎正在尝试联系我们。
excerpt.en: We have managed to decipher the confusing, repetitive messages the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] were sending us, and it turns out that they were... commercial advertisements! Apparently they call themselves [This.ContactCountry.GetRealName] and are part of a

excerpt.zh: 我们之前用[This.ContactCountry.GetName]指称的不规则物体可能是一种有机生物，[This.Owner.GetEnvoyCap][This.Leader.GetName]仍在努力验证这一假说。尽管它看起来就是一些随机的星际物质组成的团簇，但毋庸置疑地它们可以在虚空中推进，并展现出了一定程度的自主智能。我们的[This.Owner.GetResearchers]为这种现象困惑，并正在努力验证获得的数据。
excerpt.en: [This.Owner.GetEnvoyCap] [This.Leader.GetName] is still working to confirm the hypothesis that the irregularity we had designated as [This.ContactCountry.GetName] is in fact a living organism. While it seems to be made up of a cluster of random star dust, it i

excerpt.zh: 在[This.System.GetName]恒星系中侦测到的舰队似乎是某种目的不明的跨星系远航舰队的一部分。他们没有采取任何有敌意的举动，也没有任何显而易见的重型武器。然而他们似乎完全缄默不语，我们无法从他们当中获取任何信号。我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]相信他们可以从我们拾获的只言片语中翻译他们的语言，当然这可能要花好长时间。
excerpt.en: The vessels detected in the [This.System.GetName] system seem to be part of some sort of expedition across the galaxy, with purposes unknown. They have not made any hostile moves, nor is there any heavy weaponry in evidence. However, they have been fairly clos

excerpt.zh: 我们成功地破解了神秘的[This.ContactCountry.GetName]语言。我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]被难住了好长时间，直到一次他们开始向我们的大致方向上广播时才取得了突破。广播的内容是一条欢迎讯息，其中他们自称为“那马里安”。看来他们现在愿意与我们交流了。
excerpt.en: We have managed to decipher the language of the mysterious [This.ContactCountry.GetName]. Our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] remained stumped for quite some time, and a breakthrough was only made once they began broadcasting what turns out to be a welcome message i

excerpt.zh: 我们在[This.System.GetName]星系遭遇的舰队与我们此前在此区域见到的任何东西都不一样。它没有表现出攻击性，但我们眼下只能猜测它的起源或目的。我们最有把握的猜测是，该舰队代表的派别与任何地方当局或文明都没有正式联系。
excerpt.en: The fleet we encountered in the [This.System.GetName] system is unlike any we've seen in this region of space before. It does not appear to be aggressive, but we can only speculate as to its origin or purpose here. Our best guess is that the fleet represents a

excerpt.zh:
我们与这支自称是[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]的舰队陷入了僵局。这个不寻常的来客对我们大部分的外交姿态置之不理，但我们可以推断它代表一个独立于星系文明的中立实体。

我们推测，若舰队有传统意义上的所有者，则需要采取非常措施才能接近他们。考虑到这一点，我们总结了目前的发现，供未来的[this.owner.GetScientistPlural]团队使用（如有必要）。
excerpt.en: We have reached an impasse with the fleet identifying itself as the [This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]. This unusual presence ignored most of our diplomatic overtures, but we can infer that it represents a neutral entity which stands apart from galactic civiliz

excerpt.zh: 我们的传感器检测到[This.ContactCountry.GetName]正在发送不断重复的清晰信号，似乎为我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]编码他们语言的工作提供了绝佳的材料。有了这份天降的幸事，语言学家们心态十分乐观，坚信很快就能有重大的进展。
excerpt.en: Our sensors have detected a particularly clear repeating signal from the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] that seems to offer our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] excellent material for codifying their language. They are optimistic that we will be able to make some sign

excerpt.zh: 我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]日渐沮丧，因为我们没能提供给他们充分的材料用于解码[This.ContactCountry.GetName]使用的语言，他们的进度十分有限。似乎这些外星人正使出浑身解数，防止不怀好意的[This.Owner.GetSpeciesEarNamePlural]窃听到他们的信号！
excerpt.en: Our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] are becoming increasingly frustrated at our failure to provide them with sufficient material to make progress on decoding the language used by the [This.ContactCountry.GetName]. It seems these particular aliens are doing their utm

excerpt.zh: 似乎我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]在翻译[This.ContactCountry.GetName]所使用的语言时遇到了重大挫折。不幸的是，他们认为的语言根本就不是一种语言。[This.Owner.GetEnvoyCap][This.Leader.GetName]在[This.Leader.GetHerHis]的报告中指出，在几天内他们从多个角度的探讨，[This.Owner.GetLinguists]最终得到结论，这可能只是种试作音乐……
excerpt.en: It seems our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] have suffered a major setback in their attempts at codifying the language used by the [This.ContactCountry.GetName]. Unfortunately, what they had taken to be their language quite simply was not a language. In [This.Leader

excerpt.zh: 令许多[This.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]大吃一惊的是，似乎一艘属于[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的飞船已经扫描了[This.Owner.Capital.GetName]。我们对该行为出现了不同意见的分歧：我们是应该把这次冲击视为与外星文明建立更紧密的联系的跳板，或者是被认为一种警告，我们必须确保舰队准备万全，以免为时已晚。
excerpt.en: In what comes as a profound shock to many [This.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural], it has emerged that a vessel belonging to the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] has scanned [This.Owner.Capital.GetName]. Opinion is divided on whether we should treat this shock as a spr

excerpt.zh: 我们已经辨识出了先前我们在[This.ContactCountry.Capital.System.GetName]恒星系扫描的殖民地其实是[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的首都。我们的[This.Owner.GetResearchers]通过调查从扫描中获取的资料发现许多关于他们的有价值的线索。
excerpt.en: We have identified the colony we recently scanned in the [This.ContactCountry.Capital.System.GetName] system to be the capital of the [This.ContactCountry.GetName]. Our [This.Owner.GetResearchers] have found many valuable clues about them by investigating the

excerpt.zh: 我们现在已经有一段时间没有获取到来自[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的视听资料了。我们的[This.Owner.GetResearchers]发现他们似乎没有什么新的信息值得获取，并担心这条路似乎行不通了。
excerpt.en: We have caught neither sight nor sound of the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] for some time now. Our [This.Owner.GetResearchers] find they have little information to go on and worry that the trail may have gone cold.

excerpt.zh: 随着我们获取到越来越多被称为[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的外星人的图像，它们不可避免地逐渐被泄露到公众视野当中。他们的外表令[This.Owner.GetAdj]的公众感到兴奋，大家已经迫不及待想要和这些外星人进一步接触了。
excerpt.en: As we began to pick up more and more visual images of the aliens known as the [This.ContactCountry.GetName], it was inevitable that these would eventually be leaked to the wider public. Their appearance has proven delightful to the [This.Owner.GetAdj] public,

excerpt.zh: 随着我们获取到越来越多被称为[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的外星人的图像，它们不可避免地逐渐被泄露到公众视野当中。我们中的许多人对它们的外表感到惊悚，并称他们为“令人作呕的[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePluralInsult]”。并且，已有许多人要求我们采取措施以应对新的“[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesClass]”威胁……
excerpt.en: As we began to pick up more and more visual images of the aliens known as the [This.ContactCountry.GetName], it was inevitable that these would eventually be leaked to the wider public. Their appearance has provoked widespread dismay amongst our populace, who

excerpt.zh: 我们的[This.Owner.GetResearchers]已经在大量收集来自[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的信号取得了稳步的进展。然而，随着我们对他们语言的知识储备越来越丰富，我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]却越来越感到迷惑。很明显他们不得不对先前工作的翻译进行数次重新评估，因为他们发现先前认定文字的含义事实上极度不准确。似乎[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的整体面貌和我们极度相异——比我们能够想象的差的更多！
excerpt.en: Our [This.Owner.GetResearchers] have been making steady progress gathering together a large collection of signals from the [This.ContactCountry.GetName]. However, as our knowledge of their language has grown, our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] have become ever more

excerpt.zh: 随着我们收集到更多有关[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的资料，我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]非常惊讶于进展速度是如此之快。似乎——如果他们是对的话——这些外星人和我们对于整个星系具有大量相同的看法。
excerpt.en: As we have gathered more material on the [This.ContactCountry.GetName], our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] have been surprised at the fast pace of their progress. It seems that - if they are right - these aliens share much of our outlook on the galaxy as a whole.

excerpt.zh: 我们对来自[This.ContactCountry.GetName]信号的语言解析工作遇到了挫折。似乎我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]对翻译中的关键假设已经被证伪。尽管这意味着我们许多的进展不得不被推倒重来，但至少我们未来的努力很可能会被建立在更可靠的基础之上。
excerpt.en: Our attempts to decode the language used in the signals from the [This.ContactCountry.GetName]  have hit a setback. It seems that a key assumption our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] had been relying on in their translations has been conclusively disproven. While th

excerpt.zh: 我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]最近在解析来自[This.ContactCountry.GetName]信号所用的语言取得了明显的进展。很明显他们现在坚信自己已经对该语言的基础有了坚实的把控，并且承诺他们能够很快报道进一步的发现。
excerpt.en: Our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] have recently made significant progress towards decoding the language used in the signals from the [This.ContactCountry.GetName]. Apparently they now believe themselves to have a solid grasp of its fundamentals and promise that th

excerpt.zh: 我们历经艰辛以在[This.ContactCountry.GetName]足够的信息从而让我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]推进进程，但是现在我们的努力终于获得了一个极大的推动：我们的传感器收集到了他们数艘船只之间颇具长度的交流。我们只能猜测是他们的戒备突然松懈了一下，或者是他们的科技并没有我们怀疑的那么先进，他们只是自己觉得通信通道是安全的……
excerpt.en: We had struggled to gather enough information on the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] for our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] to have much to go, but now our efforts have received a major boost: our sensors have picked up a lengthy exchange between several of their shi

excerpt.zh:
[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的语言看似包含了数百万看似冗余的音节，似乎仅仅只是他们古代语言残留下来约定俗成的东西。在翻译的时候，这些不必要的填充性词汇唯一的作用看起来只是用来补充语法的完整性，或者最多有一些微不足道的上下文提示作用。

幸好，我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]已经缩减了他们语言中这些过时的部分，制定出了简化版辞典，这样一来我们就能与[This.ContactCountry.GetName]进行高效的沟通。
excerpt.en: The language of the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] contains millions of seemingly redundant sounds, apparently dialectic hangovers from their precursor civilizations. When translated, these apparently superfluous filler words seem to serve no purpose other than

excerpt.zh:
星海共同体的各个成员国已经投票决定设立星系理事会。这一受人尊敬的实体只允许社群中三个实力最强、最具影响力的帝国成为其成员。到下一轮议会被选出为止，这三个国家将是[council_member_1.GetName]，[council_member_2.GetName]和[council_member_3.GetName]。

共同体期望理事会成员国可以领导和保卫整个星海共同体。他们获得了提权，可以跳过那些时常在大型政治机构中阻碍决策流程的繁文缛节。
excerpt.en: The members of the Galactic Community have voted to establish a Galactic Council. Membership in this august body will be limited to representatives from the three most powerful and influential empires in the Community. Until a new Council is elected, these are

excerpt.zh:
星海共同体的官员就我们最近在[tiyanki_kill_system.GetName]星系击杀缇扬奇提出抗议，通知我们我国的行为违反了缇扬奇保护法。结果是，[Root.GetName]将在接下来10年内被视为违反星系法。

我们从缇扬奇尸体上提取的资源被收缴了，而且他们还对我国处以罚金。
excerpt.en: Officials from the Galactic Community have protested our recent killing of Tiyanki in the [tiyanki_kill_system.GetName] system, informing us that our actions have violated the Tiyanki Conservation Act. As a consequence, the [Root.GetName] is to be considered i

excerpt.zh:
星海共同体的官员收到了我们最近就缇扬奇族母取得胜利的消息。他们告诉我方，消灭这只野兽明显违反了缇扬奇保护法，就算缇扬奇族母是敌对生物也一样。

[Root.GetName]将在接下来十年内被视为违反星系法。此外，我们收到了一份巨额的罚单，理由是我们消灭了“一种独特的，整个星系中再也见不到的缇扬奇生命形式”。
excerpt.en: Officials from the Galactic Community have received word of our recent victory against the Tiyanki Matriarch. They have informed us that our destruction of the beast was a clear violation of the Tiyanki Conservation Act, regardless of the Matriarch's hostile n

excerpt.zh: 我们在[From.From.GetName]发现了原始哺乳动物的文明。这颗星球上最先进的地区才刚刚进入铁器时代，一群互相竞争、争名夺地的封建贵族统治着大地。
excerpt.en: We have discovered a primitive mammalian culture on [From.From.GetName]. The most advanced regions on the planet have only recently advanced beyond the Iron Age, and much of the surface is ruled by feudal nobles who vie with each other in an endless struggle f

excerpt.zh: [From.From.GetName]拥有一个原始的工业文明，她正陷入一场全球战争。两个大型势力正互相争斗，参与其中的地面装甲车辆、航空飞行器和航海舰船数量巨大。其中一些马上就要研究出原子能，这将急剧增大冲突的潜在破坏性。
excerpt.en: A primitive industrial culture is currently locked in a global war on the surface of [From.From.GetName]. Two large alliances of nation states are fighting each other with massive numbers of armored land vehicles, atmospheric aircraft and ocean-going naval ves

excerpt.zh: [From.From.GetName]是一种处于早期太空时代的哺乳动物的母星。这颗星球周围的轨道空间充斥着原始人造卫星，当地人似乎已经向太阳系-IIIa发射了数艘载人航天飞船。在星系内其他天体的轨道上检测到了一些小型亚光速探测器。
excerpt.en: [From.From.GetName] is home to a mammalian civilization currently in an Early Space Age. The orbital space around the planet is cluttered with primitive satellites, and the natives seem to have already launched several manned missions to Sol IIIa. A number of

excerpt.zh:
[From.From.From.GetName]的地表被使用核武的战争所毁灭，整个星球就像是一座坟墓。如今满地白骨的地方曾经是人群聚集的中心，在这荒凉、被灰烬所覆盖的地表之上，唯一能听到的只有那呼啸的风声。

一种当地的昆虫似乎在充满辐射的环境中兴起。变异后的种群在体型上迅速增大，一些群落则表现出了基本的智慧特征。
excerpt.en: The surface of [From.From.From.GetName] has been ravaged by nuclear war, and the planet is little more than a tomb. Withered concrete skeletons jut out of the ground where major population centers once stood, and the howling wind is all that can be heard on th

excerpt.zh:
在[From.From.From.GetStarName]星系的舰队被全灭后，那里的虚空之云从碎屑中聚集了足够的物质开始进行某种宏观上的有丝分离，也就是无性繁殖。

现在追杀[From.From.From.GetStarName]的虚空之云又多了一个。
excerpt.en: Following the destruction of our fleet in the [From.From.From.GetStarName] system, the local Void Cloud appears to have gathered enough material from the debris to undergo what can best be described as a form of mitosis on the macro level - asexual reproductio

excerpt.zh:
[tiyanki_system.GetName]主序星旁，四颗于低轨道环绕的气态巨行星被笼罩在等离子场中。充能的等离子场深入气态巨行星大气内部，这种独特的环境是许多太空生物繁殖的温床。

这些生物大都微乎其微，但有一个显著的例外——巨型缇扬奇。这个恒星系一定就是它们起初进化了千百万年的地方，随后它们开始在整个星系中漫游。由于这个恒星系的等离子场性质极为罕见，这里很可能是星系中缇扬奇唯一的繁殖地。
excerpt.en: Four gas giants enshrouded by a vast plasma field share a close orbit around the [tiyanki_system.GetName] system's primary. The charged plasma field extends well into the atmospheres of these gas giants, and this unique environment serves as a breeding ground

excerpt.zh: 我们在[tiyanki_kill_system.GetName]星系中成功捕杀了一些野生缇扬奇。我方舰队用激光切割以从巨型缇扬奇的尸体内提取矿物和资源。
excerpt.en: We have successfully hunted down and killed some wild Tiyanki in the [tiyanki_kill_system.GetName] system. Our fleet has used laser cutters to extract materials and resources from the massive Tiyanki remains.

excerpt.zh:
我们在[From.From.From.GetName]星系内遭遇了某种极为强大的亚空间实体。它似乎没有敌意，对传统飞行器或许甚至没有完全察觉，但它的存在使得[From.From.From.GetName]整个恒星系中出现了强烈的亚空间扰动。

这些扰动位于实体自身周围，在它离开恒星系后应该也会消失。它对我们的致意没有回复，但这个实体一直在发射模式复杂，似乎是某种语言的快子流。如果我们的翻译软件正确的话，它一遍又一遍说的是：

“弗雷尔在寻找。弗雷尔找到了。”
excerpt.en: An extremely powerful subspace entity of some kind has been encountered in the [From.From.From.GetName] system. It does not appear hostile and may not even be fully aware of conventional spacecraft, but its mere presence in [From.From.From.GetName] is causing

excerpt.zh:
在与[vluur_system.GetName]星系中我方军队交战时，亚空间实体“弗雷尔”提高了其发送快子流的频率，但不停重复的信息与之前一样：

“弗雷尔在寻找。弗雷尔找到了。”

在受到致命一击的同时，这个实体自爆了，大爆炸使得整个恒星系中撒满了暗物质。
excerpt.en:
Throughout its battle with our forces in the [vluur_system.GetName] system, the subspace entity "VLUUR" increased the frequency at which it was emitting tachyon pulses, but the endlessly repeating message remained the same:

"VLUUR seeks. VLUUR finds."

When t

excerpt.zh:
第一眼看过去，[From.GetName]星系就显示出强烈的敌意：所有行星都不适宜居住，不是被星系中的三个太阳轮番炙烤，就是有强烈的太阳风暴肆虐。但是，有一种生命体在这种环境下顽强地繁衍生息，那就是太空变形虫。它们放弃了原本相当孤独的生活方式，成群结队地聚在一起，在酷热的内部星系和远方的气态巨行星之间飞来飞去，这似乎是精心安排的繁殖仪式。

目前还不清楚是什么原因导致变形虫偏爱这种不宜居的星系。不管怎样，它们似乎意图保护自己的栖息地，并已将矛头指向[Root.GetName]，公然对其施加威胁。
excerpt.en: The [From.GetName] system gives off a strongly hostile impression on first sight: none of its planets are remotely habitable, either scorched by the searing heat of the system's three suns or stripped of life by powerful solar storms. However, there is one lif

excerpt.zh: 一大群太空变形虫已脱离其在[amoeba_home_system.GetName]星系的种群，开始独自游荡在星系之中。这些生物进入了我们在[FromFrom.GetName]星系的领地，出于天性，它们似乎无法容忍我们的存在，于是便开始攻击我们的哨站。
excerpt.en: A large group of Space Amoebas has split off from those in the [amoeba_home_system.GetName] system and struck out to roam the galaxy on their own, entering our territory in the [FromFrom.GetName] system. As is the norm with these creatures, they seem unable to

excerpt.zh:
星海共同体已通过太空变形虫保护法案议案，要求帝国与太空变形虫和平共处。

我们的帝国目前不符合此议案的规定，要遵守此议案，更改相关政策吗？
excerpt.en:
The Galactic Community has passed the Space Amoeba Protection Act resolution, mandating that empires peacefully coexist with Space Amoebas.

Our Empire is currently in breach of this resolution. Shall we change our policies to be in compliance?

excerpt.zh: 传感器检测到[This.System.GetName]星系中存在一个向整个星系发出原始信号的物体。这些相同的信号模式也曾在来自未知区域的长程扫描仪上被记录到。虽然目前尚不清楚这些信号是否具有意图，但需要进一步调查。
excerpt.en: Sensors indicate a presence in the [This.System.GetName] system that is sending rudimentary signals across the galaxy. These same patterns have been registered on long-range scanners originating from parts unknown. Though it is not clear whether these signals

excerpt.zh:
[from.GetName]正在遭受攻击。

一大群虚空虫正在殖民地轨道上，用寄生囊肿进行轰炸。

每个囊肿都包含一个剧毒孢子，对我们的殖民者以及所有生命都极其致命。一旦被摄入，它会迅速发育成为一只若虫，并会暴力地从宿主体内破茧而出，彻底摧毁宿主。这些若虫体内有一个压缩气体囊，使它们能够上升到高层大气，在那里它们会本能地将自己推进到预定的目的地。

生物分析表明，每窝虚空虫都拥有有限数量的囊肿，它们很可能在囊肿耗尽后离开。但在那之前，我们会遭受严重的人口损失。
excerpt.en:
[from.GetName] is under attack.

A large group of Voidworms is in orbit of the colony, bombarding it with parasitic cysts.

Each cyst contains a toxic spore that is extremely deadly not only to our colonists, but all life. Once ingested, it rapidly gestates in

excerpt.zh: 我们在[This.System.GetName]发现的异常小行星似乎具有感性。靠近这种物体的轨道是非常危险的，在我们有更多的了解之前，建议科研船立刻远离受其影响的恒星系。
excerpt.en: The irregular asteroid we encountered in [This.System.GetName] appears to be sentient in nature. Approaching the orbit of such objects is highly dangerous, and Science Ships are advised to leave affected systems immediately until we know more about these entit

excerpt.zh: 我们摧毁了一只躲在小行星中的巨型生物。收获它的尸体也许对我们很有价值。
excerpt.en: We have destroyed a massive creature hidden inside an asteroid. Harvesting its remains could prove valuable to us.

excerpt.zh:
新的博物天枢业已在[from.GetName]建成，我们有机会重建在生态园所失去的大部分东西。

我们从之前养育的太空兽群物种身上采集的基因物质都有妥善保存，只要有足够的资源就可以克隆出新的幼体。
excerpt.en:
Now that a new Grand Archive has been established in [from.GetName], we have an opportunity to restore much of what was lost from our Vivarium.

Genetic Material from each Space Fauna species we have previously raised has been preserved, and with enough resour

excerpt.zh: 在击溃了投机取巧的海盗之后，我们可以自由地索取[event_target:treasure_trove_planet.GetName]的宝藏了。
excerpt.en: Having routed the opportunistic pirates, we are now free to claim the treasure trove on [event_target:treasure_trove_planet.GetName].

excerpt.zh:
[from.GetName]地表崩裂，地壳破碎，难以承受的热浪从地底涌上。转变来得迅猛而彻底：群山崩溃，海洋沸腾，天空余烬弥漫。

曾经繁盛的生物群系已不复存在，唯有极端生命体仍栖息于此。
excerpt.en:
The surface of [from.GetName] has ruptured, its crust fracturing as unbearable heat surged from below. The transformation was swift and absolute: mountains collapsed, oceans boiled, and the sky was a veil of embers.

No trace remains of the planet's once-thriv

excerpt.zh:
派往调查发光柱的探测器确定，柱体由可塑硅酸盐岩浆形成。该物质通过基岩裂隙被推升，尚未突破地表即固化，形成的结构可以达数百米，最终因自重坍塌。

如此形成一片由几近纯净透明的火山玻璃构成的尖塔森林，每座尖塔都折射着下方依然翻滚的熔融岩浆发出的暖橙色光芒。

科学家[Leader.GetName]推测这些坍塌尖塔的残骸可能成为宝贵资源。
excerpt.en: Probes dispatched to investigate the glowing pillars have determined they are formed from a malleable silicate magma. This material is forced upward through bedrock vents, solidifying before it breaches the surface. The resulting structures can grow hundreds o

excerpt.zh:
时间与地表范围内均确认大气化学波动，且在行星巨大的裸露岩浆海上空最为强烈，因此派遣探测器前往采样。

进一步分析后，[Leader.GetName]确认[Planet.GetName]上的岩浆海正在释放珍稀的异星天然气。这一意外发现表明，若能成功开发，该行星或将成为我方工业的潜在资源供给。
excerpt.en:
Chemical fluctuations in the atmosphere were confirmed across both time and the surface. The fluctuations were strongest over the planet's large ocean of exposed magma, so a probe was dispatched to collect samples.

Upon closer analysis, [Leader.GetName] deter

excerpt.zh:
[Planet.GetName]表面的首批图像揭示了震撼且出乎意料的地质构造，称为“晶体熔岩湖”。这些岩浆体存在已久，内含的特殊矿物可在特定温度范围内自然自排列为晶体结构。因此，湖面显得极为透明，并泛起红色系虹彩。受行星轨道影响，这种视觉效果伴随季节温度变化呈周期性波动。

晶体熔岩湖的美丽景色可能吸引大量游客。湖中的晶体矿物可于活跃期采集，用于开发能量储存介质。
excerpt.en: Our first images from the surface of [Planet.GetName] have revealed stunning and unexpected geological formations that are being called 'crystal lava lakes'. These long-lived bodies of magma are infused with unique minerals that, within a specific temperature

excerpt.zh:
[Planet.GetName]最初被评定为典型的岩浆烈焰星球，然而调查发现，在行星表面纵横交错的裂谷中，存在复杂的本地植物生态系统。这些植物能够产生氧气并收集少有的水分，在炽热的荒原之中形成近乎温带的微气候区域。

这一生态系统为原本无法在火山星球上生存的物种创造出适合栖息的环境，植被本身也可能适宜农业开发。建议定居者深入峡谷，对其中的生物进行详尽探索。
excerpt.en: Initial assessment of [Planet.GetName] characterized it as a world of magma and fire, but surveys have revealed a native ecosystem of complex flora inhabiting a network of rift valleys across the planet. These plants produce oxygen and collect what little mois

excerpt.zh:
[Leader.GetName]报告称，在[from.GetName]火山表面之下存在广袤的冰川，被隔热特性极佳的特殊矿物岩层包裹。构造活动正缓慢破坏这些隔热层，[Leader.GetName]预测，若冰川与星体其他区域温度趋于平衡，该行星将大幅降温，从火山星球转变为干旱星球，

我们可以加速此过程，提高其宜居性。不过该现象颇具科学价值，也可使其自然演，方便进行研究。
excerpt.en: [Leader.GetName] reports that beneath the volcanic surface of [from.GetName] are vast glaciers. They are encased in unusual rock formations composed of minerals with exceptional insulating properties. Tectonic activity is slowly degrading these insulating laye

excerpt.zh:
[from.GetName]独特的构造与地质特征，造就了罕见而壮丽的奇观。行星大部分区域是酷热的沙漠，充斥着火山烟雾与流动的熔岩。一块巨大坚固的大陆岩石板块从地壳中隆起，高耸于地表数十公里。由此形成的高原凌驾于有毒云层之上，孕育着本地动植物，形成繁荣的生态系统。

该高原不仅适宜许多物种栖息，还可能蕴藏着惊人的科学奥秘。
excerpt.en: The unique composition and tectonics of [from.GetName] has created an unparalleled marvel. While most of the planet is a hot desert clogged with volcanic smog and free-flowing lava, one massive continental plate of solid rock rises dozens of kilometers above t

excerpt.zh:
[Leader.GetName]已确认，该奇特形态为熔岩漩涡。这类现象极为罕见，且记录中从未有过如此规模。[Leader.GetName]震惊于此奇特现象，下令展开采样任务。

样品显示，漩涡活动部分由稳定的活体金属池支持：活体金属被水流撕裂后试图重组，重组过程进一步扰动熔岩，维持漩涡活动。采样还表明，采集该活体金属相对容易。
excerpt.en:
[Leader.GetName] has confirmed the strange shape to be a lava whirlpool. These are exceedingly rare, and none of this size has ever been recorded. Struck by the strange phenomenon, [Leader.GetName] ordered a sampling mission.

The samples reveal that the whirl

excerpt.zh:
[Leader.GetName]报告发现一个有棱角的刚性结构体悬浮于恒星稳定轨道中。该结构体由未知材料组成，表面具有类似晶体结构的棱面，成分无法分析。它保持固定方向，始终面向其恒星，抵抗所有外力操控或旋转。

在一项受控实验中，调查船对该结构体发射集束脉冲，致其整齐裂开，分裂成两个对称半体，每个半体又各自重构为原结构体的小型复制体。后续脉冲产生相同效果：分裂、复制及稳定微缩。

最后，众多微型结构体分散形成一片云，稳定漂浮于轨道上。每一块碎片都保留了原结构体的精确排列与几何特征，整体则还原了原始结构轮廓。

此现象
excerpt.en: [Leader.GetName] reported the discovery of a rigid, angular construct suspended in stable stellar orbit. Composed of an unknown material and marked by faceted planes reminiscent of crystalline structures, the object resisted all compositional analysis. It rema

excerpt.zh:
科研团队抵达[from.GetName]追踪该信号，确认其来自一地下洞穴系统，洞内配有科研设备。

[Leader.GetName]率队深入洞穴，发现一个由未知合金封闭的密室，里面传出微弱的鸣响。[GetMysteriousRingingDesc3210]

配备听觉防护装备进入后，众人发现一物种未知的生物正在沉眠，其身旁正是信号来源：一个奇特的圆柱形装置。

分析结果表明，该装置会定期发射无线电脉冲，并在数小时内发出类似音乐的声音，以及类似该生物的声音。[Leader.GetName]推测其目的是依照固定的时间表
excerpt.en:
A science team arrived on [from.GetName] to track down the signal, and determined that it was coming from an underground cave system outfitted with scientific observation equipment.

[Leader.GetName] led the team into the caverns, where they found a chamber se

excerpt.zh:
[root.leader.GetName]发现了一个地下住房设施，那里有更多处于冻存的同胞，并成功唤醒了他们。与我们不同，他们保留着对前世的模糊记忆，并以一个可能有朝一日会回来救他们的伟大太空帝国的故事为生。

他们很谨慎，但认我们为同胞。我们可以把自己展现为他们期待已久的救星，成为那古老荣耀的继承者。或者我们可以说实话：我们正在打造一些新的东西，同样渴望向他们学习，也愿意教导他们。

这些档案中的额外线索让我们缩小了第二个拥有冻存舱候选行星的范围。
excerpt.en: [root.leader.GetName] discovered an underground facility housing more of our kin in stasis, and successfully awakened them. Unlike us, they retain faint memories of their previous lives, and are sustained by stories of a great space empire that might one day r

excerpt.zh:
[root.leader.GetName]发现了一个较小的停滞设施，以及一个隐藏的星港，里面有一艘几乎可以正常工作的科学船。小修一下就够了。

该地点还保存着大量的科学数据，包括保存下来的其他物种的标本[GetInterstellarRefugiaDesc2535]目前尚不清楚这些标本是被强行带走还是自愿提供的，但这艘船上有专门为有感性货物设计的拘留室。

通过研究它们，我们可以收获很多，也许还有更多的生命形式有待发现。
excerpt.en:
[root.leader.GetName] uncovered a smaller stasis facility, along with a hidden starport housing a nearly functional science vessel. Minor repairs will suffice.

The site also held a trove of scientific data, including preserved specimens from other species[Get

excerpt.zh:
随着[planet.GetName]殖民地的不断扩张，越来越多证据显示有一个使用活体金属的已灭绝文明曾在此活动，尽管至今未发现他们获取这种材料的任何线索。

最近出现了一个答案：一个被力场包裹、闪烁着奇异光芒的球体，从深层核心的熔岩流中缓缓升起。 其最初用途与构造尚不明朗，但在极高温度下，它会持续滴落出活体金属。这一发现虽巧妙地解开了那桩考古谜团，却也让我们面临新的抉择——该如何处置它。
excerpt.en:
As the colony on [planet.GetName] grew, so too did evidence of an extinct civilization that made use of Living Metal, though there was no trace of where they acquired this material.

An answer has recently surfaced, in the form of a strange shimmering sphere e

excerpt.zh:
星系熔炉底盘可部署导管群可引导并强化恒星的熵能，一旦发送，它们就会回收并强化恒星的能量输出。使其演化为红巨星，从而将恒星系加热至支撑帝国扩张基础设施的水平。

此类导管群能够定期生产并自主运作，目前仅限于我方领土，但未来有望扩展至整个星系，推动帝国持续增长。

可升级的巨型结构如下：星系熔炉核心
excerpt.en: The Galactic Crucible Chassis is now ready to deploy Conduits: automated systems designed to channel and amplify stellar entropy. Once dispatched, they'll recycle and intensify a star's energy output, converting it into a Red Giant, heating entire systems to s

excerpt.zh:
我们对导管群的持续研究以及将恒星转化为红巨星的研究表明，我们或许能够扩大行动规模，直接使银河系核心过热，从而在整个银河触发热级联，把它改造成对我们更为适宜的环境。

我们已确定六个核心周边星系，可作为此计划的作业枢纽。这些星系位于星系超空间航路网络之外，但相关稳定虫洞的构建工作正紧锣密鼓进行。
excerpt.en: Our ongoing research into Conduits and transforming stars into Red Giants suggests we may be able to scale up our operations to overheat the Galactic Core itself, triggering a thermal cascade across the entire Galaxy, thus transforming it into a much more hosp

excerpt.zh:
星系熔炉现已全面武装并投入运行。随着虫洞通道完工，我们已取得通往围绕星系核心六个集结星系的通道。

我们开始进行核心过热工作。其它帝国可能察觉并试图进入这些恒星系，但暂时我们占有优势，核心已屈服于我们的意志。

使用虫洞保护星系核心恒星系
excerpt.en:
The Galactic Crucible is now fully armed and operational. With wormhole tunnels completed, we've secured access to all six staging systems around the Galactic Core.

Our work to overheat the Core can begin. Other empires may detect our activity and attempt to

excerpt.zh:
随着[crucible_system.GetName]恒星系被占领，我们的军团夺取了那座环绕恒星建造的星系熔炉。

这座巨型建造物的沦陷，宣告了其缔造者以武力称霸星系的美梦破碎。
excerpt.en:
With the capture of the [crucible_system.GetName] system, our forces have also taken control of the Galactic Crucible that was being built around the local star. 

The loss of this megastructure shatters any remaining hope its creators had of taking over the g

excerpt.zh:
占领[crucible_system.GetName]系统揭露了[crucible_builders.GetName]的阴谋，他们企图通过前所未有的烈焰风暴彻底毁灭整个银河系。

目前，那台可能引发大规模灭绝的机器已被暂停。战争一旦结束，我们应动用剩余资源与兵力，将这座巨型建筑彻底摧毁。
excerpt.en:
Capturing the [crucible_system.GetName] system unveiled the sinister plans of the [crucible_builders.GetName], which included the complete annihilation of the entire galaxy by an unprecedented storm of fire. 

For now, the machine that holds the potential to c

excerpt.zh: [officer.GetName]已被提升至[GetLeaderStatusAdjCap]地位，因在[ship.GetName]最近于[system.GetName]恒星系的交战期间观测到其高度的响应能力。
excerpt.en: [officer.GetName] was elevated to [GetLeaderStatusAdjCap] status following observations of their heightened responses during the [ship.GetName]'s recent engagement in the [system.GetName] system.

excerpt.zh: 在[system.GetName]星系进行战斗后，[officer.GetName]出现了独特的基因表达。
excerpt.en: The engagement in the [system.GetName] system has given rise to unique gene expressions in [officer.GetName].

excerpt.en: The battle in the [system.GetName] system has caused behavioral anomalies within [officer.GetName] to subside.

excerpt.zh: [officer.GetName]在操作舰队方面变得更加灵敏了。
excerpt.en: [officer.GetName] has grown more nimble in the handling of our fleets.

excerpt.zh: 发生在[system.GetName]星系的战斗令[officer.GetName]产生了行为异常。
excerpt.en: The battle in the [system.GetName] system has caused behavioral anomalies within [officer.GetName] to subside.

excerpt.zh: [officer.GetName]在操作舰队方面变得更加灵敏了。
excerpt.en: [officer.GetName] has grown more nimble in the handling of our fleets.

excerpt.zh: 根据我们最近做出的宣布人工智能非法的政策调整，所有拥有智慧人工智能助手的[Root.GetAdj]科学官都被命令放弃他们的助手并将它们回收利用。
excerpt.en: As per our recent policy change outlawing artificial intelligence, any [Root.GetAdj] Scientists in possession of Sapient AI Assistants have been forced to relinquish them for recycling.

excerpt.zh: [leviathan_destroyer_country.GetName]在遥远的[leviathan_destroyed_system.GetName]恒星系消灭了某个远古威胁。
excerpt.en: [leviathan_destroyer_country.GetName] has vanquished an ancient threat in the distant [leviathan_destroyed_system.GetName] system.

excerpt.zh: 我们收到了来自[From.GetName]独立空间站的通讯！他们似乎成功的翻译了我们的语言。
excerpt.en: We are receiving a transmission from the independent space station of the [From.GetName]! They appear to have successfully translated our language.

excerpt.zh: 随着我们能源储备的消耗殆尽，以能源为支付手段的贸易已无法继续进行，因此所有与商人城邦之间的与能源相关协定都已取消。
excerpt.en: With our energy reserves depleted, we can no longer maintain our trade agreements that depended on this resource. All such agreements with Trader Enclaves have been canceled.

excerpt.zh:
在[From.GetName]星系遇到的这种生物不同于[Root.GetName]以往遇见的任何其他生物。

它们具有极强的攻击性与攻击能力，守护着一颗初步扫描发现蕴藏有大量资源的小行星。
excerpt.en:
The creature observed in the [From.GetName] system is unlike anything the [Root.GetName] has previously encountered.

Highly aggressive and with destructive capabilities to match, it guards a planetoid that initial scans indicate is exceptionally resource-rich

excerpt.zh:
我们收到了舰队全灭前发出的最后一则信息。其中提到，这个硕大的敌人似乎盯上了舰队的超光速踪迹……

如果这种怪兽记住了我们的气味，我们最好为之后的疯狂报复做好准备。
excerpt.en:
We received one last transmission from our fleet before it was destroyed. It mentions their gigantic foe seemingly homing in on the fleet's FTL signature...

If the beast has our scent, we should be prepared for savage retaliation.

excerpt.zh:
我们收我们接收到了来自[Root.GetName]的在进行紧急跃迁之前发出的最后的信号。其中指出他们所遇到的巨大的生物能跟踪舰队的超光速踪迹……

如果让那东西记住了我们的气味，我们最好为之后的疯狂报复做好准备。
excerpt.en:
We received one last transmission from the [Root.GetName] before the fleet engaged emergency FTL protocols and went dark. It includes mention of the gargantuan creature they had been fighting seemingly homing in on the fleet's FTL signature...

If the beast ha

excerpt.zh:
对脉冲星的研究让我们的科学家收获了无数的灵感和见解，并且通常不会发现什么明显的危险现象。这让最近从[From.GetName]传来的报告更加让人担忧。

初步的扫描结果显示，在脉冲星本身的电磁脉冲束之外，其还在独立发射一束波长仅在本星系可见的电磁波，而且其发射的时间间隔在不断降低。根据我们的初步计算，发射间隔将在日期[GetMidGameDate]完全变为零。人们仍然在猜测那个时候会发生什么，但对这神秘脉冲找不到科学解释的现实已经让研究这一现象的科研人员抱有了一丝超自然的恐惧。
excerpt.en:
The study of pulsars seems to be an endless source of insights for our scientists, but rarely exhibit any signs of overtly dangerous phenomena. This makes the recent reports on [From.GetName] all the more concerning.

An initial scan revealed that the pulsar,

excerpt.zh:
我们发现了一些静静漂流在[fortress_system.GetName]恒星系的十分巨大的太空建筑。尽管初步扫描显示它们已经很古老了，但是能量识别特征还是非常强烈。在主体建筑周围还能看到漂浮着的几个较小的建筑，所有这些似乎都是全副武装。

如果我们想要了解这个古代遗迹的真实面目，或许我们需要以武力突破其防御…
excerpt.en: We have detected some kind of utterly massive space installation drifting quietly at the edge of the [fortress_system.GetName] system. Although preliminary scans show it to be very old, the structure has an intense power signature. Several smaller structures c

excerpt.zh:
[dreadnought_system.GetName]恒星系发现一艘形单影只的巨型战舰在巡航。船只上未发现生命迹象，但发出强烈能量特征，可能是装备有武器系统。该舰没有回应任何问候信息。

建议小心为上。
excerpt.en: A single, massive warship has been discovered patrolling the [dreadnought_system.GetName] system. No life signs can be detected on the vessel, but it is emitting a very strong power signature and appears to be bristling with weapon systems. It does not respond

excerpt.zh:
在识别出一种潜在的未开智候选者后，我们的创世方舟便开始了对创世保护区的基因提升流程，并为之设立了必须的空间。

[THIS.GetName]上的殖民地已经准备好观测、以及对这一新兴物种的发展进行引导。
excerpt.en:
After identifying a potential pre-sapient candidate, our Genesis Ark began the process of genetic uplifting and established the needed space for a Genesis Preserve.

The colony of [THIS.GetName] is ready to observe and guide this nascent species' development.

excerpt.zh:
我们的创世方舟在召集了所有当地的未开智物种后，开始为它们建立一个创世保护区。

[THIS.GetName]上的殖民地已经准备好观测、以及对这一新兴物种的发展进行引导。
excerpt.en:
After gathering the native pre-sapient species, our Genesis Ark began creating a Genesis Preserve for them.

The colony of [THIS.GetName] is ready to observe and guide this nascent species' development.

excerpt.zh:
在向导的不懈努力下，我们完成了[Root.GetName]上的提升项目。我们已经将[From.GetName]转变为一个完全智慧物种，而他们曾经称之为家园的创世保护区已经被改造成了一座创世纪念碑。

它将永远是这个物种进化成就的不朽见证。
excerpt.en: After our guides' unceasing dedication, we have completed the uplifting project on [Root.GetName]. We have transitioned the [From.GetName] into a fully sapient species, and the Genesis Preserve, which they once called home, has been transformed into a Genesis

excerpt.zh: [Root.GetName]中大部分虚拟人口已经突破我们的防火墙，以一连串的数据和乱码的方式从我们手上逃脱。
excerpt.en: The mostly virtual population of [Root.GetName] has broken through our firewalls and escaped from our grasp in a burst of data and nonsense code.

excerpt.zh:
一个研究团队提出了一项新议案，将监管人工智能集成到我们的移动设备中，随后又可以直接整合进义体件中。

这些监管人工智能将会引导我们公民将关注点从无聊的任务转移到更需要脑力的任务上。虽然会因此丧失一部分自主权，但对生产力前所未有的提高将不容忽视。
excerpt.en:
A team of researchers has put forth an innovative proposal to integrate AI supervisors into our mobile devices. Later these could be incorporated directly into cyberware.

The supervisors would redirect the focus of our citizenry away from idle tasks towards m

excerpt.zh:
一部广受好评的新剧抓住了公众们的集体想象力。

故事发生在一个义体植入体盛行的世界里，讲述一位强化改造的工人遭遇了与改造身体的创伤性分离。故事的悲剧性结局对完全义体化及其对[Owner.Species.GetAdj]身份不可避免的抹除提出了一种几乎不加掩饰的批评。

这部剧的大获成功引发了对义体化倡议的强烈反对，自该剧播出以来，可用测试对象的注册人数骤减了60%。
excerpt.en:
A widely acclaimed new drama has captured the collective imagination of the public.

Set in a world where cybernetic implants are prevalent, the narrative follows an augmented worker experiencing traumatic dissociation from their modified body. The story's tra

excerpt.zh:
我们在神经接口领域取得了显著的突破。大脑信号增幅器可以让用户丝滑但有限地操控一组人工肢体。在未来，这种技术也可以直接整合进义体脑中，而不需要外接设备。

在初步测试阶段，测试对象展现出了更高的敏捷性和精确的物体操纵能力，甚至还有更高的战斗熟练程度。然而，对制造成本的担忧促使人们应定夺这项开创性技术应优先运用于什么人群上。
excerpt.en: A significant breakthrough has been achieved in the field of neural interfaces. A brain signal amplifier could grant users seamless, but limited control over an array of artificial limbs. Later on, this could be integrated directly to a cyberbrain without the

excerpt.zh:
反对将[Owner.Species.GetFleshTypeCyberCreed]和机械融为一体的宗教团体主动退出了我们义体化人口的行动。在实践中，他们甚至缺乏最基本的植入体，这使得他们难以在我们这个日益紧密联系起来的社会中发挥作用。

强制要求每个人都安装完整的植入体将有助于他们更好地融入社会，但无疑会导致怨恨。
excerpt.en: Religious groups opposed to the merging of [Owner.Species.GetFleshTypeCyberCreed] and machine have opted out of our efforts to cyberize the population. In practice, they lack even the most basic implants, making it difficult to function in our increasingly con

excerpt.zh:
最近，一些个体开始公开表达对接受实验性身体改造的懊悔。将脑干换成机械替代品会导致持久的生存恐惧，一些人将他们的经历描述为无法忍受的痛苦的持续循环。

在不断要求赔偿的情况下，我们不得不澄清我们对国家责任的立场。
excerpt.en: Recently, a number of individuals have begun to publicly express remorse over their decision to undergo experimental body modifications. Exchanging the brainstem for a mechanical substitute has resulted in lasting existential dread, with some describing their

excerpt.zh:
一种非法植入模组正在员工中广为传播，它可以刺激大脑产生任意的神经递质。这将会有广泛的用途，例如灌输强烈的快乐或者增强疼痛耐受性。从这些非法植入物中逆向工程出一个稳定的版本需要大量的投资，而且这种刺激的效果必将逐渐减退。

我们是应该将这种非法植入体重新包装为商业化的版本，还是仅仅对其使用进行规范？
excerpt.en: An underground implant mod is spreading amongst the workforce that stimulates the brain to produce neurotransmitter chemicals at will. This has a wide array of uses from instilling intense pleasure to increasing pain tolerance. Reverse-engineering a stable ver

excerpt.zh:
越来越多的公司要求在工作期间的所有经验必须储存在义体大脑中的特殊区域，在工作以外的时候不得访问。

他们声称，这种功能只会在高度机密的任务中使用，以避免商业窃密。有一些甚至要求雇员在工作中屏蔽个人经验，以避免个人道德对生产力造成干扰。
excerpt.en:
More and more companies require that all experiences during office hours are stored in a cyberbrain memory area inaccessible outside work.

They claim to use this functionality only with highly confidential tasks to prevent corporate espionage. Some even requi

excerpt.zh: 随着义体件在我们的生活中愈发根深蒂固，盈利模式的变化将极大地影响整个社会。近来，植入体制造商将一些基本功能限制在订阅模式中成为了一种潮流。如果忘记付款，义体躯干可能会突然被锁定、视力可能会消失。消费者权益组织正在敦促我们出台措施阻止这种现象。
excerpt.en: With cyberware being so engrained in our lives, changes in monetization models affect our entire society dramatically. The recent trend has implants manufacturers lock essential functionalities behind a subscription model. Miss a payment and suddenly, your cyb

excerpt.zh:
在义体大脑植入体方面的发展给予了我们一个诱人的机遇。比起又主观又缓慢的教学方法，我们可以将关键的知识直接在大脑之间传输。该过程需要无菌的实验室环境，因此无法进行大规模应用。接收到的信息也会部分覆盖掉接收者的同类别记忆。

最有影响的应用方式包括在科学家之间共享知识。这可以抵消来自义体化过程的一些工程学研究负担，或者将重点放在其他领域。
excerpt.en: The development of the cybernetic brain implants gives us an enticing opportunity. Instead of relying on subjective and slow teaching methods, we could transfer key knowledge directly from one brain to another. This requires sterile laboratory conditions, and

excerpt.zh:
在许多[root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]愉快地用现成的义体来强化日常生活和人际关系的同时，越来越多的多配偶家庭转而使用带有定制硬件的私人网络。这些家庭群体选择生活在量身定制的隔离中，以独特的亲密感分享彼此的感受和经历。

有社会福利团体和学者称赞这种现象，认为这种对人际关系和家庭纽带的客订化强化改造可以造福所有人。但也有人对这样的避世隐居产生了担忧，甚至认为这种行为可能导致个体在这种迷你的“爱情完形”中迷失自我。
excerpt.en: Whereas many [root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have gladly augmented their everyday lives and relationships using off-the shelf cybernetics, a growing number of multiple-partner households in particular have instead taken to private networks with bespoke hardware. T

title.en: Where Our Hearts Will Take Us

excerpt.zh:
我们的民族自古以来都是旅人、牧民和流浪者。有些人的旅行是到达目的地的一种手段，而我们的目的地就是旅行本身。身体强化改造使新的星球更加触手可及，但也使我们能够跟踪到那些太过离经叛道的人。就是说，并非所有人都对这种变化感到满意。

越来越多的人开始篡改自己的植入体，通过脱离网络以保护自己的隐私。目前这仅仅是一个小众趋势，但它可能会带来麻烦。
excerpt.en: Our people have always been travelers. Nomads. Wanderers. While for some traveling is a means to reach a destination, for us the journey is a destination in itself. Body augmentation has made it easier to reach new worlds, but has also allowed us to track thos

excerpt.zh:
我们的义体研究已经产出了多个有前途的义体原型供我们选择。初步结果表明，一些原型机在体力方面表现出色，而另一些则更适合精密工作。每一种都有其长处和局限性，没有一种具有压倒性优势。

我们意识中浮现出一个令人生畏的提议：我们可以让子个体变得多样化、根据功能不同的来改变身体吗？我们或许将变得不再完全相同。这样的未来难以把控，但也许对于我们整体的效率提高而言这是值得的。
excerpt.en: Our cybernetic research has produced multiple promising cyborg prototypes for our consideration. Preliminary results show that some prototypes excel at physical feats, while others are more suited for precision work. Each has its strengths and limitations, non

title.zh: 这也能是我们的一员吗？

excerpt.zh: 在组装工蜂的过程中偶尔会有存在缺陷的躯体。通常这些畸形的工蜂都会被处理掉，但多亏了义体植入体，它们仍可以加入到我们的行列中。提高我们的数量是好事，但有缺陷的工蜂需要根据问题的严重程度进行个性化植入。我们的蜂巢会成长得更快，但也会变得更……不完美。
excerpt.en: Drone assembly occasionally results in defective bodies. Misshapen drones are usually disposed of, but thanks to cybernetic implants, they could be allowed to join our ranks. Improving our numbers is desirable, but faulty drones require personalized implants d

excerpt.zh:
一小部分受试对象遭受了对强化改造的不良反应。他们的身体排斥植入体，发生了危及生命的并发症。其病因似乎是一种以前未被注意到的遗传缺陷。根据初步计算，这大约会影响5%的工蜂人口。

在确定了问题之后，我们现在可以对工蜂进行筛查加以预防，但不知道该如何处理受影响的人口。
excerpt.en: A small percentage of our test subjects are suffering adverse reactions to augmentation. Their bodies are rejecting the implants, bringing life-threatening side-effects. The cause seems to be a genetic defect, previously unnoticed. According to preliminary cal

excerpt.zh:
由单一实体组成的帝国以怀疑的目光注视着我们，恐惧于我们的人口众多。而义体植入体可以让我们的特使具有更独特的面孔和个性，呈现出不那么同质的外表。

这些分裂体的国家终将会感激我们的努力，甚至可能开始……同情我们，把我们看作他们的同类。
excerpt.en:
Empires composed of singular entities watch us with suspicion, fearing our plurality. With cybernetic implants, we could give our envoys more distinct faces and personalities, presenting a less homogeneous facade.

The disunited would appreciate the effort. Th

excerpt.zh:
我们蜂巢的义体化正在顺利进行中。我们的一部分人口现在已经搭载了义体植入体，而另一部分则还是完全的生物体。我们从未体在自己的身体上验过这样强烈的差异。工蜂现在可以将自己识别为不同群体的一部分，这种分裂感正在诱发它们的个体意识。

有些工蜂开始向自己身上安装小配件以装饰自己，或在植入体上绘制特殊符号以区分彼此。真是一种有趣但又令人担忧的发展。
excerpt.en: The cyberization of our Hive is continuing smoothly. Part of our population now carries cybernetic implants, while others are still completely biological. Never before have we experienced such striking differences between our selves. Drones are now able to ide

excerpt.zh:
义体植入体让死亡这件事变得复杂了起来。

将植入体从死亡的工蜂身上拆下可以让我们进行循环利用，减少浪费。我们的整个废弃物抛弃流程需要进行优化以兼容这一新的步骤；需要花费的资源较多。
excerpt.en:
Cybernetic implants are complicating the logistic of death.

Stripping deceased drones of their implants would allow us to reuse the technology, reducing waste. Our whole waste disposal process would have to get an overhaul to accommodate this new step; the re

excerpt.zh:
我们现有的人口正在稳步地进行义体化，但必须为还未出生的人口建立一种流程。

以我们的科技，我们甚至可以在[owner.Species.GetSpawnNamePlural]出生前就安装上义体植入体，从而创造一个真正义体化的物种：这种方案快速、轻松且高效。另一方面，初步研究表明，在极早期安装植入体可能造成精神分裂、精神错乱、震颤和各种发育障碍。
excerpt.en:
Our existing population is undergoing cyberization at a steady rate, but we must establish a process for those yet to be born.

With our technology, we can fit our [owner.Species.GetSpawnNamePlural] with cybernetic implants before they are even born, creating

excerpt.zh:
合成大脑更强大的算力可以让我们轻松超越生物极限。然而这种力量仍有限制，所以我们必须有所取舍。

我们可以专注于增强决策制定流程，增加记忆容量，或优化脑躯协调，这些选择都会增强特定的岗位。或者我们也可以进行雨露均沾的耐用性强化。

这些功能需要持续的投入，并且只会在建有机器人组装建筑的行星上生效，但我们从这些测试组中所获得的数据会对生产力有立即的提升效果。
excerpt.en:
With the increased processing power of a synthetic brain we can surpass our biological constraints. However, the extra power still has limits, so we must prioritize.

We could focus on amplifying the decision making process, increase memory storage, or streaml

excerpt.zh:
“微聚变模组能让我举起一辆水柜！”这是一条来自消费者的热评。这并不是夸大其词：微聚变技术的最新发展确实有望显著改进我们的机器躯体。

尽管有一定的风险，但安装微型的个人反应堆可以实现爆发式的能量转化、提高速度。当然，这会迫使我们重新评估生产时间表，因为这样的反应堆大大地扩展了项目的规模。
excerpt.en:
"Microfusion mods lets you lift a tank!" crows a major consumer review service. This is not hyperbole: recent developments in microfusion technology promise to significantly improve our machine bodies.

While somewhat risky, installing tiny, personal reactors

excerpt.zh:
一部大受欢迎的新剧吸引了公众的想象力。故事围绕着一个合成劳工逐渐与新身体发生的解离展开。

随着主人公逐渐失去控制，他们的朋友和家人只能惊恐地看着。这部剧集的悲剧结局被视为对我们计划向机器身体过渡的一种毫不掩饰的批评。

围绕这部轰动一时的影片的公众讨论产生了相当大的能量，最终可能会减缓我们的进展。
excerpt.en:
A massively popular new drama has captivated the public imagination. The story centers on a synthetic worker who disassociates from their new body.

As the protagonist spirals out of control, their friends and family can only look on in horror. The drama's tra

excerpt.zh:
一位怀有严重反合成思想的名人遭遇了一场严重的事故，目前已经陷入深度昏迷。无数的人为失去一位敬爱的人而陷入悲痛时，我们支持合成技术的顾问发现了一个好机会。

将这位名人的思维合成化可以给予其第二次生命，这样毫无疑问可以将一部分粉丝转化为坚定的数字化支持者。这个流程是完全合法的，唯一的问题是需要获得许可：在同等情况下，这位名人显然是不可能同意的。如果处理不当，这一公关机遇可能会变成风评灾难。
excerpt.en:
A celebrity holding strong anti-synth views has suffered an accident, and currently lies a vegetative state. While the population laments the loss of a beloved personality, our pro-synth advisors see an opportunity.

Digitizing the celebrity's mind, offering t

excerpt.zh:
将构成生物体意识的、数以兆计的突触连接进行数字化的实验以灾难性的失败告终。一个简单的句法错误导致受试对象的神经通路被擦除。有的人将这称为谋杀。

参与项目的都是志愿者，但他们悲伤的家属正一边痛哭着向我们讨要说法。使问题更加复杂的是，这场失败也使得寻找新的研究对象变得更加困难。
excerpt.en:
Experiments to digitize the trillions of synaptic connections that comprise a biological consciousness have ended in catastrophic failure. A simple syntax error resulted in the instant erasure of our subjects' neural pathways. Some are calling it murder.

The

excerpt.zh:
21,386,732,184个存储单位：这是一个[root.owner.GetSpeciesName]大脑的平均容量。然而，并不是每个灵魂都生来平等。

随着合成化流程的继续，有些人认为并不是每个思想都值得配上一个人工躯体。但是让谁优先也是一个棘手的问题。或许那些不那么理想的人在数字化以后可以……改进一下。或者说，重编程。
excerpt.en:
21,386,732,184 units of memory: that's the average capacity of a [root.owner.GetSpeciesName] brain. Yet, not all minds are created equal.

As the synthesization process continues, some argue not all minds are worthy of an artificial body. However, the question

excerpt.zh:
为了提高[roboticist.GetNamePlural]们的工作效率，管理人员批准了不安全的无线人格软件更新。其目的是将最佳工作流程的知识补上，但不幸的接受者的却丢失了部分个性和记忆。

管理团队认为，在应用人格补丁之前对其进行全面测试太慢，而重新分配那些失去记忆的员工会更容易。
excerpt.en: To increase the productivity of [roboticist.GetNamePlural], managers have approved unsafe over-the-air identity software updates. The intent was to patch in knowledge of optimal work processes, but instead the personality and memories of the unfortunate recipi

excerpt.zh:
我们对纳米机器人的研究完成了。尽管它们的潜力仍不完全明确，但是模拟计算已经得到了很正面的预测。其能力在创造特化的大型形体以及物质变形方面具有不可估量的价值。

估算预测这个过程需要时间、材料和能量，需要大量的结构调整来支持。

可行性：具有前景；变革性。
excerpt.en:
Our research on nanites has concluded. The full extent of their potential remains unclear, but simulations have returned optimistic projections. Their capabilities could prove invaluable in creating specialized megaforms and matter transmutation.

Estimations

title.zh: 值得关注的纳米科技发现

excerpt.zh:
由于目标物质的复杂性，加之投入的科研力量不足，我们对纳米科技的了解仍非常粗浅。有限的预期表明纳米复制和重塑能力可以形成大规模结构。为了支援该项目很可以需要额外的资源。

可行性：不确定。
excerpt.en: Due to the complexity of the subject matter combined with minimal research effort, our knowledge of nanite technology remains rudimentary. The limited projections include nano-replication and reconfiguration as enablers for large-scale structures. Additional r

excerpt.zh:
孜孜不倦的研究验证了初步结论：活体金属与机械躯体的融合是可行的，这让我们的单元能在不影响内部功能的情况下改变特性。这确保了对不同任务的最大兼容性。

经预计，大规模部署模组化功能注入将提高所有部门的资源产量。

可行性：可适应；具有前景。
