excerpt.en: Uncompromising research has confirmed the preliminary assessment: Living Metal is viable when fused with mechanical bodies, allowing our units to alter their characteristics without compromising internal functions. This ensures maximum task-based compatibility

excerpt.zh:
对模组化躯体的研究确认了我们最初的推断：我门内部功能与活体金属外部是可协调的。该嬗变的规模前无古人，因此需要更多的资源来实现全面的潜力。

一旦完成，这些新模块的性能提升将很快让我们的初始投资回本。

可行性：具有前景。
excerpt.en:
Research into modular bodies has confirmed the initial hypothesis: our internal functions are compatible with a Living Metal exterior. The transformation is unprecedented in scope, and further resources will be required to realize its full potential.

Once com

excerpt.zh:
有限规模的研究得到了不够确切的结果：尽管我们现存的躯体似乎能够接受活体金属的注入，但缺乏全面的知识库让我们无法更准确地评估可行的用例。

可行性：不确定。
excerpt.en:
The research limited scope has produced indefinite results: while our existing bodies appear compliant with an infusion of Living Metal, the lack of comprehensive knowledge base prevents assessing viable use cases more accurately.

Viability: inconclusive.

excerpt.zh:
向虚拟化的转变将会大幅提高能源需求，我们现有基础设施的能力可能无法维持所需的服务器架构。

预计该项目将减少实际住房需求，同时提高无人机的任务效率。这种转变将能优化我们的运营框架，并重新定义我们在近乎无限的数字空间中的存在。

潜力：无边无际；未知。
excerpt.en:
The move towards Virtuality anticipates a significant intensification in energy consumption, potentially surpassing the capabilities of our existing infrastructure.

This is projected to decrease physical housing demand while elevating drone task efficiency. T

title.zh: 值得关注的纳米化发现

excerpt.zh:
初步评估着重指出，向以虚拟化为中心的社会过渡需要大量能源。这种转变预计将大大增强对无人机工作的管理能力，并减少对实体住房的需求。由于未能积累可靠的数据集和足够的样本量，我们的预测深度受到限制。

可行性：未知。
excerpt.en: Preliminary assessments highlight the substantial energy demands of transitioning to a Virtuality-centered society. This shift is anticipated to significantly enhance drone work management and reduce the need for physical housing. The depth of our prognosis is

excerpt.zh:
我们与[Root.GetName]的雇佣兵契约已经到期了。他们的领袖————指挥官[Root.Leader.GetName]立刻提出与我们续约，让目前听命于[Root.Leader.GetHerHis]的那些舰船再为我们服务五年…… 当然必须另付费用。

如果我们拒绝，这些雇佣兵就会离开我们，去找其他的雇主。
excerpt.en: Our contract with the mercenaries in the [Root.GetName] has come to an end. Their leader, Commander [Root.Leader.GetName], has offered to immediately extend the services of the ships under [Root.Leader.GetHerHis] command to us for another five years... at an e

excerpt.zh: 由于[Root.GetName]的前任指挥官意外身亡，[marauder_species.GetNamePlural]派遣指挥官[new_leader.GetName]接替前任指挥官的职务。
excerpt.en: Following the untimely demise of the former commander of the [Root.GetName], the [marauder_species.GetNamePlural] have dispatched Commander [new_leader.GetName] as a replacement.

excerpt.zh:
我们失去了[From.GetName]星系内的祝圣之物！

悲痛与沉重的失落笼罩了[Root.GetAdj]的殖民地。不同于一个星球被宣布不再为神所庇佑，这种对心灵依靠的以暴力手段无情践踏否定的行为让[Root.GetName]的信徒们陷入震惊与迷茫。神职人员决定进行五年的哀悼。
excerpt.en:
We have lost access to the objects of worship in the [From.GetName] system!

Grief and a profound sense of loss grips the [Root.GetAdj] colonies. Different from a world being declared unconsecrated, this violent denial of spiritual agency leaves the believers

excerpt.zh:
层层叠加的都市终于完全覆盖了星球的地表。

自从这一宏大计划开始实施以来仅仅过了数年，但已经很难回想起[Root.GetName]从前的面貌。翠绿的丛林？崎岖的山脉？现在放眼望去，四面八方都是延绵不绝的钢铁。

这里曾经由自然法则任意塑造，而现在则成了由坚定的目的锤炼而成的设计。
excerpt.en:
Layers upon layers of urban sprawl eclipse the globe's crust, and it is done.

Scant few years have passed since the start of this grand project, but it is already difficult to recall what the surface of [Root.GetName] was like. Verdant? Rugged? It is all stee

excerpt.zh:
世世代代以来，[Root.GetName]上冰冷空寂的废墟始终蛰伏于此，静静诉说着千百万年前那陡然告终的黄金时代。

一切从此改变。这座覆盖整颗星球的城市重获新生，那些年久失修的废墟又一次充满了活力。凡是可以修复之处，现存的建筑和基础设施均已被修缮并重新规划用途。至于那些损坏太过严重的区域，其上的瓦砾和废墟也已清理干净，为建造新建筑腾出了空间。
excerpt.en:
For untold generations, the cold and empty ruins of [Root.GetName] have stood dormant, as quiet symbols of a golden age that came to an abrupt end eons ago.

No longer. The planet-wide city has at last been reborn, and those same dilapidated ruins are once mor

excerpt.zh:
我们已开始着手庞大的科学枢纽的建设。基座已就位，主轴已准备。对突破性科技的允诺以及对大胆设想的超越都将等待着我们。路漫漫其修远兮，吾将上下而求索。

宇宙无尽的谜团最终都能被我们所掌控吗？
excerpt.en: We have now begun the massive undertaking of constructing a Science Nexus. The foundation is in place and preparations are underway to add the main hub. The promise of new groundbreaking technologies and the realization of ideas beyond our wildest imaginations

excerpt.zh:
[From.GetName]开始挑战科学枢纽的建设——一座科技极其先进的科研设施，足以让科学进程产生革命性颠覆。

[think_tank_system.GetName]星系热火如荼，工程师们正在组装建筑初始平台。无论他们成功与否，单纯这次尝试就足以让他们成为我们这一时代的先行者。
excerpt.en:
The [From.GetName] have taken on the challenge of building a Science Nexus - a research institute, so technically advanced, that it could revolutionize the scientific process completely.

The [think_tank_system.GetName] system is bustling with activity as engi

excerpt.zh: 科学枢纽的中央核心已就位，这个核心安装了一个最新工艺水平的奇点反应堆。我们的工程师准备加装下一个，也是最有挑战的设施片段——四个研究辅翼，足够承载极端炎热，极端的压力波动，以及外星病原体。辅翼也能为研究者提供很多住房。
excerpt.en: The Science Nexus central hub is now in place, equipped with a state of the art singularity reactor. Our engineers are preparing to add the next, most challenging segment of the facility - the four research wings. They will be fitted with pioneering technology

excerpt.zh: 第一个模组——四个研发辅翼已就位，研究者与工作人员已前往他们的生活分区。下一步也是最后一部我们将延展辅翼，添加四个实验室区间以支持我们最危险的研究。我们已采取进一步的安保来保证工作人员的安全。
excerpt.en: The first module of the four research wings is now in place and researchers and staff are already moving into the living quarters. The next and final step of construction will extend the wings, adding four sections of laboratories equipped to support our most

excerpt.zh:
群星的光芒暗淡，虚空的黑暗消失，只有我们学会超越光速之后，我们才知道光揭示的只是真相的一角。

今天我们将终结我们的黑朦，我们准备在[From.solar_system.GetName]星系建造的哨兵阵列将成为坚实的全景监狱，我们的双眼将紧盯着每一颗恒星。
excerpt.en:
The light of suns blinds and the darkness of the void hides; only when we learned to travel faster than light did we learn just how little the light reveals.

Today, we begin to end this amaurosis of ours. The Sentry Array we prepare to build in the [From.sola

excerpt.zh: 我们收到消息，[From.GetName]开始在[spy_system.GetName]星系建造一个庞大，长程传感阵列。虽然还在早期阶段，完全完成的阵列将提供给他们全星系完全的星际活动动向。
excerpt.en: Word has reached us that the [From.GetName] has begun the construction of a vast, long-range sensor array in the [spy_system.GetName] system. While still in its early stages, the completed array is set to give them unfettered insight into interstellar travel i

excerpt.zh:
哨兵阵列中心本身就代表着目前的最高技术水平，其将监听站和太空望远镜合二为一。

但这只是这一伟大工程的第一块里程碑。
excerpt.en:
The hub of the Sentry Array is a state-of-the-art installation in its own right, half listening post and half space telescope.

However, it marks but the first milestone in this grand undertaking.

excerpt.zh: 掌控恒星的能量一直是[Root.GetAdj]工程师们的梦想，从粗劣的燃烧到拙劣地模仿恒星聚变，而现在我们要实现这个梦想。在[From.From.GetName]星系坐落着我们的脚手架，而我们即将在那建造戴森球，将[From.From.GetName]包裹并独占恒星强大的能量。
excerpt.en: Harnessing the power of the stars has been a dream of [Root.GetAdj] engineers throughout history - from crude combustion to the pale imitation of solar fusion - and we now stand ready to realize this dream. In the [From.From.GetName] system sits the scaffold u

excerpt.zh:
[dyson_system.GetName]星系的剧烈活动泄露了[From.GetName]在建戴森球的情况。

虽然还在早期阶段，完全建造的戴森球将完全阻隔[dyson_system.GetName]的光照，光照将转变为[From.GetAdj]能量储存。
excerpt.en:
Frenetic activity in the [dyson_system.GetName] system betrays the construction of a Dyson Sphere by the [From.GetName].

Still in its early stages, the completed sphere will eventually blot out the light of [dyson_system.GetName], its radiance diverted to [Fr

excerpt.zh:
随着框架已被安置，这个项目的庞大是显而易见的。

[From.From.GetName]在纤细的笼子里燃烧，但她将最终被[Root.GetAdj]太阳能板完全包围。
excerpt.en:
With the frame now in place, the awesome scale of the project is evident to all.

[From.From.GetName] burns in a spindly cage, but will eventually be completely surrounded by [Root.GetAdj] solar panels.

excerpt.zh:
虽然没有完全完成，随着先进的太阳能收集器的安装，我们现在开始收获位于[From.From.GetName]恒星系的戴森球带来的利益。

随着建造继续，能量收入会继续增长，最终戴森球完成时我们将获得完全的运转能力。
excerpt.en:
While not yet complete, with the installation of advanced solar harvesters we have begun to reap the benefits of the Dyson Sphere being built in the [From.From.GetName] system.

The energy gains will only continue to increase as construction continues, eventua

excerpt.zh:
[From.From.GetName]星系的主星已被[Root.GetAdj]戴森球完全包裹。

我们的工程师们庆祝着这一胜利，而也理应如此。我们做到了只有少数星系帝国敢于尝试的壮举——完全俘获一颗恒星。
excerpt.en:
The [From.From.GetName] system's primary has now been completely enveloped by a [Root.GetAdj] Dyson Sphere.

Our engineers celebrate this as a great victory, and rightly so. We have achieved what only a handful of star empires in the history of the galaxy dare

excerpt.zh:
我们现在准备开始这项史诗工程，环绕[From.From.GetName]星系的恒星来建造未来环形世界的初始框架。

这个框架所需的资源与矿物是史无前例的，我们成百上千最优秀的工程师准备好开始拆解恒星系内的行星，将这些物质用于环形世界建造。
excerpt.en:
We are now ready to begin the colossal task of building the initial frame of our future Ring World around the primary star of the [From.From.GetName] system.

The amount of resources and materials required to build this skeletal frame will be immense, and hund

excerpt.zh:
我们在[From.From.GetName]星系建设的环形世界框架现以完成。虽然还有很多后续工作，这个周长近十亿千米的金属骨架的完成必将是工程界的一项壮举。

我们准备好建设真正意义上的宜居地了。
excerpt.en: The skeletal frame of the Ring World we are building in the [From.From.GetName] system has finally been completed. Although there is still much left to do, the mere completion of this metal skeleton, which has a circumference of nearly a billion kilometers, mu

excerpt.zh:
我们在[dyson_system.GetName]星系遇到了一个巨型结构的残骸，包围着这个恒星系的恒星。我们的科学家初步判断这曾是个“戴森球”——一个用于彻底利用恒星能量的巨型结构。它显然已经无法继续运转，这是由于它的主体遭受到了来自未知的能量武器的致命打击。

值得注意的是这个戴森球残骸周围同时也漂浮着许多舰船残骸。这个戴森球的本体很古老，但其周围的残骸云明显来自于更近的年代。这些残骸似乎大多来自两支舰队之间的一场激烈交战，这场战斗很可能因为争夺这个废弃戴森球的归属权而爆发。
excerpt.en: We have encountered the remains of an enormous space structure in [dyson_system.GetName], encompassing the system's primary. Our scientists theorize that this may have once been a functional "Dyson Sphere" - a megastructure designed to harness the power of a s

excerpt.zh:
我们成功修复了位于[From.GetName]星系内的废弃戴森球。星系内庞大的碎片云被收集起来用于修复工程，这样既减少了我们资源的消耗，又为工作人员消除了一个潜在的航行风险。

这个巨型结构现已恢复正常运作，在沉寂了千百年后再次产出巨额的能源。
excerpt.en: We have successfully repaired the ruined Dyson Sphere in the [From.GetName] system. The large debris fields present in the system were gathered for use in the repair effort, reducing both material costs and removing a potential navigational hazard for the work

excerpt.zh: 我们在[nexus_system.GetName]发现了一座巨大太空装置的残骸。该巨型结构似乎曾是一个巨大的科学枢纽。尽管其已废弃数千年，但其主体结构依然完好。
excerpt.en: The broken remnants of a colossal space installation have been found near the [nexus_system.GetName]. This megastructure appears to have once served as some kind of massive Science Nexus. Although the installation has obviously been abandoned for millennia, it

excerpt.zh: 在[From.GetName]附近的废弃科学枢纽已被完全修复了，并配备了[Root.GetName]的精英科学家。这个巨型结构仍然保持着设计师当初建造它时的初衷，在这个时代继续帮助我们解决更多的科学问题。
excerpt.en: The abandoned Science Nexus near [From.GetName] has been fully repaired and staffed by the brightest minds of the [Root.GetName]. As was no doubt its original purpose, the megastructure will now be put to use in answering the scientific questions of our time.

excerpt.zh:
在星系历史上的某个时间点，[sentry_system.GetName]星系曾建有过一个体积异常巨大的轨道设施，后来被有组织地拆毁。此星系大部分天体的行星同步轨道上都弥漫着大量的残骸，当中不乏大型空间站的外壳。

残骸中以一个庞大的哨兵阵列为最。经过我们初步的扫描结果推测，这个阵列强大到足以实时监控整个星系。
excerpt.en: At some point in galactic history, the [sentry_system.GetName] system evidently supported a vast orbital infrastructure of unusual proportions which has since been systematically demolished. There are large concentrations of debris in geostationary orbits arou

excerpt.zh:
虽然十分困难，我们的工程师还是设法修复了位于[From.GetName]恒星系的废弃哨兵阵列，并在过程中回收利用了散布在周围的空间站残骸。

时隔亿万年，哨兵阵列在轰鸣中再次投入运作，列阵之中能量充盈，借助它强力的信号，整个星系一览无余。
excerpt.en:
It wasn't easy, but our engineers have managed to restore the ruined Sentry Array in the [From.GetName] system. The other station hulks and the debris that surrounded them were converted into building material during the restoration effort.

For the first time

excerpt.zh: 基于[From.GetName]星系的环形世界废墟，我们的工程师成功地将它的一个区段恢复运转。全新的环形世界生态结构几乎是由我们的行星学家从零开始规划，但现在它已经足够稳定，可以居住了。
excerpt.en: Building on what remains of the ruined Ring World in the [From.GetName] system, our engineers have managed to fully restore one of its sections. The new biosphere had to be created more or less from scratch by our leading planetologists, but it is now consider

excerpt.zh: 打造巨型艺术设施的第一步就要同时面临两个困难：修建一个巨大到能容纳一个错综复杂的展览馆的空间站与组织一场空前规模的展览会。当所有基本设施都准备完全时，修建保险库将成为第一要务。保险库必须足够安全以及牢固，专门用来保护这星系之中的艺术财富。
excerpt.en: The first stage of constructing a Mega Art Installation combined the difficulties of building a vast station with the complexities of organizing a museum and gallery on an unprecedented scale. With the basic structure in place, the Vault will be the top priori

excerpt.zh: 我们巨型艺术设施的第二阶段已经完成，填满保险库的工作已经开始。一只专门的运输舰队将会持续不断地将我们帝国的瑰宝运送到它们的新家来。同时，可供工作人员居住的住所以及更多的展览空间等其他建筑也正在建造。
excerpt.en: The second stage of our Mega Art Installation is complete and the process of filling the Vault has begun. A dedicated fleet of transport ships operates constantly to transport the treasure of our empire to its new home. Meanwhile, additional structures are bei

excerpt.zh: 展览空间站群目前已经建设完毕。这些空间站论单个都比许多普通的恒星基地要大，每天能够容纳数以百万计的访客。万事俱备，只待开门大吉，我们的展会将会展出来自星系各国的艺术臻品以彰显不同物种的多样性。运输第一批游客的舰船已经到站了。
excerpt.en: The Exhibition Stations are complete. Each larger than many Starbases, these stations can accommodate millions of visitors per day. Now ready to open at long last, they will show samples of art from every race to celebrate the diversity of the galaxy. The firs

excerpt.zh: 全副武装的战略指挥中心已经建设完成。目前我们军队的指挥精英们都已经集结于其中，它是如此的无坚不摧。因为既安全又集中，他们可以全心全意为如何最好地抓捕奴隶的计划服务。
excerpt.en: The armored hull of the Strategic Coordination Center is complete. Now housing the absolute cream of our military command, it is virtually impregnable. Secure and concentrated they are able to devote their every waking hour to planning how best to capture the

excerpt.zh: 强大的通信阵列已被加入到战略指挥中心之中，这样我们的舰船无论在哪都可以收到来自于我们的战略指令了。这些目前最为先进的通信阵列能够克服一切干扰，并且它量子纠缠的信号完全无法被破解。
excerpt.en: Powerful communication arrays have been added to the Strategic Coordination Center, enabling our strategists to issue orders to our ships throughout the galaxy. These state-of-the-art arrays are powerful enough to burn through any possible jamming, and the qua

title.zh: 战略指挥中心：全面运行

excerpt.zh: 战略指挥中心最后的附加部分是一些分离的"敌方军队"模拟堡垒。这些堡垒差不多就是战略指挥中心的微缩版，而且完全独立运行。精英指挥官和他的手下们在其中能够完整地沉浸在敌人的文化与传统之中，通过学习他们的艺术，能更好地理解并模拟他们的军事思想。当完全沉浸之后，他们会与战略指挥中心的工作人员开展一场场虚拟战争，使得我们能够模拟任何可能的冲突，并能从两边学习到所有的细节，我们便能够在实战当中拥有比敌人更加卓越的战术。
excerpt.en: The final additions to the Strategic Coordination Center are several detached "Hostile force" simulator bastions. These bastions contain much of the functionality of the Strategic Coordination Center on a smaller scale, but are completely independent of the ma

excerpt.zh:
星际集会第一阶段最关键的特征的就是基座了。一个复杂的黑洞全息影像，它被用来召唤星系中心潜伏的引力深渊：那整个星系旋转的支点。

等到建成之后，这个地方也将会成为某些事务的轴心，那些能驱使整个星河旋转的静默外交与软实力博弈将会紧紧围绕着它。
excerpt.en: The most crucial feature of the initial stage of the Interstellar Assembly is the Locus. A sophisticated holographic projection of a black hole, it is meant to evoke the gravitational chasm that lurks in the galactic core: the fulcrum upon which the galaxy tur

excerpt.zh: 星际集会的第二阶段，领事环，现已建成。这个内环将能够容下我们大部分的外交人员在里面活动。
excerpt.en: The second stage of the Interstellar Assembly, the Consul Ring, is now complete. This inner circle will house most of our diplomatic staff going forward.

title.zh: 星际集会：会议广场模块

excerpt.zh: 星际集会的外环将会配有大量最先进的隐私保护会议室（当然，只有[Root.GetAdj]能够进行监控）。这座空间站正在迅速成为非现场谈判方面无可辩驳的星系枢纽。
excerpt.en: The Interstellar Assembly's outer ring is populated with vast, state-of-the-art conference rooms equipped with privacy filters (penetrable only by [Root.GetAdj] surveillance, of course). The station is quickly becoming the de-facto galactic hub for off-site ne

excerpt.zh:
星际集会已全力运作，目前正在招待星际间几股大势力的重要人物们，无论他们是政界还是商界的。

我们的外交官们在跟进空间站内传出的那些国家利益与政治羞辱的信息流时受了不少累。不过至少我们的客人对我们的监控并不关心，只要我们一直为他们提供这种同竞争对手角力的理想环境就好了。
excerpt.en:
The Interstellar Assembly is now fully operational, and plays host to a number of embassies from the galaxy's major powers, be they political or corporate.

Our diplomats are having a hard time keeping up with the steady flow of information on national interes

excerpt.zh: 为了对[From.GetName]进行开采，我们首先需要一个安全基地才能开始建造其他。星锚已经在黑洞事件视界的最边缘处建造完成，并且已经由一个重力重定向引擎牢牢稳定住，通过逆转[From.GetName]自身产生的重力去抵抗巨大的引力。
excerpt.en: To extract matter from [From.GetName] we first need a secure base to build the facility on. The Anchor has been built on the very edge of the event horizon and is held in place against the immense gravitational pull by an advanced gravity redirection engine, w

excerpt.zh: 建造于现有重力重定向系统之上，重力透镜设施能够使一部分力穿过“透镜”，将力更加密集地集中在某一片选中的区域。
excerpt.en: Built on the existing gravity redirection system, the Gravity Lensing Facility is able to redirect a portion of the force into a "Lens", concentrating the force even more strongly in a selected area.

excerpt.zh: 从黑洞提取物质的关键就在于究极精致的重力重定向系统：在某个区域集中生成一片引力扭曲的区域，然后打造出一个专门用来应对重力情况下的大型重定向钻头。
excerpt.en: The key to extracting matter from the black hole is the ultimate refinement of the gravity redirection system: Forming a focused area of twisted gravity, in effect creating a vast drill whose bore is made of redirected and concentrated gravitational force.

excerpt.zh: 物质解压器的最后一步看上去十分单调，但也有他最令人震撼的一面。一大堆自动化的冶炼厂以及处理器开始将采取自[From.GetName]的物质分解，解压缩并分离为实用的矿物，再装入连续不绝的机械驳船舰队中，送往帝国各地。
excerpt.en: The final stage of the Matter Decompressor is the most mundane, but in its own way the most impressive. A vast automated array of smelters and processors break down, decompress, and separate the material of [From.GetName] into useful minerals which are decante

excerpt.zh: 我们在[matter_decompressor_system.GetName]的视界线上不可思议地存在着某种采矿装置。我们的科学家认为这可能是一个“物质解压器”——用于从黑洞中开采矿物的巨型结构。尽管它已无法正常运转，但某些阻止它被意大利面条化的装置一定仍在运作。
excerpt.en: Impossibly perched on the event horizon of [matter_decompressor_system.GetName] is some kind of mining apparatus. Our scientists theorize that this may be a "Matter Decompressor" - a megastructure designed to mine materials from a black hole. While it is no lo

excerpt.zh:
伴随着吱呀声，物质解压器：锚定细长如虚幻般的横臂开始缓缓运转。

看起来摇摇欲坠的空间站的晃动渐渐停止，而阵阵能量与微粒物质从[From.GetName]事件视界的阴影中射出。
excerpt.en:
The spindly, ethereal leg-beams of the Matter Decompressor: Anchor sputter to life.

The spasms and paroxysms of the precarious station eventually give way to an even thrum of flowing energy and particulate matter, swept up from the umbra beyond [From.GetName]

excerpt.zh: 我们在[strategic_coordination_center_system.GetName]发现了一座被毁的巨大空间站。它破碎的残骸中包含了大量的战斗计算机、模拟器、以及通讯阵列，因此我们的科学家认为这一定是某种“战略指挥中心”。
excerpt.en: A massive, ruined space station has been discovered in [strategic_coordination_center_system.GetName]. Its shattered remains contain a plenitude of battlecomputers, simulators, and broadcasting arrays which leads our scientists to speculate it must have been s

excerpt.zh: 位于[From.GetName]的废弃战略指挥中心已被完全修复，并由[Root.GetName]最有才华的军事人员掌管。这座巨型结构将恢复其原本的功用，指挥我们整个星系中的军事力量。
excerpt.en: The abandoned Strategic Coordination Center in [From.GetName] has been fully repaired and staffed by the most brilliant military minds of the [Root.GetName]. True to its original purpose, the megastructure will be put to use coordinating our military might thr

excerpt.zh: 我们在[mega_art_installation_system.GetName]中发现了三座被毁的空间站。它们被一团碎片所环绕，其中某些仍可辨识出是艺术品，虽然是非常异星的艺术品——看来这里曾是一座“巨型艺术设施”。
excerpt.en: A trio of wrecked space stations have been discovered in [mega_art_installation_system.GetName]. They are surrounded by a cloud of debris, some of which is still vaguely recognizable as works of art, albeit of a very alien nature. It seems that this was at one

title.zh: 被毁的巨型艺术设施已修复

excerpt.zh: 位于[From.GetName]的被毁巨型艺术设施已被修复完毕。除了[Root.GetName]最伟大的艺术品之外，它也陈列了一小部分从原本的巨型结构中回收并修复的外星艺术品。
excerpt.en: The once-ruined Mega Art Installation in [From.GetName] has been restored to operation. Fully repaired and stocked with a selection of the greatest artworks of [Root.GetName], it also contains a small selection of exhibits which were recovered and restored fro

excerpt.zh: 我们在[interstellar_assembly_system.GetName]发现了一座巨大的被毁空间站。从大量办公空间以及一座配有各种不同类型生命维持设施的论坛看来，我们的科学家认为这是一座“星际集会”的残骸。
excerpt.en: The remains of a vast space station have been found in [interstellar_assembly_system.GetName]. Judging by the amount of what seems to be office-space and a vast forum outfitted with dozens of different types of life-support systems, our scientists suspect that

excerpt.zh: 位于[From.GetName]的星际集会已经再次上线了。它已准备好再次迎接星系中的外交官们，共同商讨当前太阳周期中的问题。
excerpt.en: The Interstellar Assembly in [From.GetName] is online again. Once more it is ready for the diplomats of the galaxy to gather in one place to debate the great issues of the current solar cycle.

excerpt.zh: 巨型船坞的第一阶段已经完工。等到各制造隔间安装在这一巨型框架上后，这个设施终有一天会成为全星系舰船制造的中心。
excerpt.en: The first stages of our Mega Shipyard is now complete. A vast framework awaits the installation of the manufacturing bays which will one day make this facility the shipbuilding capital of the galaxy.

excerpt.zh: 巨型船坞的核心已经就位，剩下的只有增添上海量的舰船建造锚地了。
excerpt.en: The core of the Mega Shipyard has been put in place, all that remains to add are the vast ship construction berths.

excerpt.zh: 巨型船坞现已完全上线，其可以生产空前数目的星舰。
excerpt.en: The Mega Shipyard is now fully online, it can produce starships in unprecedented volume.

excerpt.zh:
在[mega_shipyard_system.GetName]发现一巨大的外星设计的建筑。尽管它已经老化，我们的科学家还是确定这一巨型结构实际上是几个造船船坞的组合体——一个巨型船坞。

倘若我们获取了如何修复巨型结构的知识和工业能力，我们的生产能力将会极大地提升。
excerpt.en:
In the vast reaches of the [mega_shipyard_system.GetName] system rests a vast structure of alien design. Despite its decrepit state, our scientists confirms that the megastructure is in fact a combination of several construction yards - a Mega Shipyard.

If we

excerpt.zh: 巨型船坞现已完全上线，其可以生产空前数目的星舰。
excerpt.en: The Mega Shipyard is now fully online, it can produce starships in unprecedented volume.

excerpt.zh: 我们的量子弹弓的第一阶段已经完工。精确的扭力透镜装置正在从恒星中充能，这些能量可以剧烈地释放出来，将舰船传送至极远距离外。
excerpt.en: The first stage of our Quantum Catapult is now complete. A precise arrangement of torsion lenses gains charge from the star, and can release this energy in an erratic fashion to send ships across great distances.

title.zh: 量子弹弓双排扭力透镜

excerpt.zh: 量子弹弓的第二个扭力透镜装置已经就位，并同第一个装置进行了平衡。射程和准确度都提高了。
excerpt.en: A second arrangement of Quantum Catapult torsion lenses is now in position, diametrically balancing the first. Range and accuracy are increased.

excerpt.zh: 对量子弹弓的最终精校完成，并且现在已完全上线运作。射程和准确度得到进一步改善。
excerpt.en: The final refinements have been made to the Quantum Catapult and it is now fully online. Both range and accuracy have been improved.

excerpt.zh:
在[quantum_catapult_system.GetName]星系中，有一个围绕着脉冲星的巨大残骸场。我们的科学家分析称，在残骸场内部最密集的区域所残存的部分完整结构似乎通过某种方式驾驭了恒星的力量，有将物体传送至极远距离的能力。

倘若我们获取了如何修复巨型结构的知识，我们将能够修复这座量子弹弓。
excerpt.en: A massive field of debris orbits the pulsar in the [quantum_catapult_system.GetName] system. Our scientists theorize that the partially intact structure in the densest portion of the field somehow harnessed the power of the star to launch objects incredible di

excerpt.zh: 在[quantum_catapult_system.GetName]星系内的被毁的量子弹弓已被修复到可以运作的状态，现已能传送我们的舰队跨过星海。我们对它的科技有了全新的理解，在经过几轮测试之后，我们有信心能够安全地使用。
excerpt.en: The Ruined Quantum Catapult in the [quantum_catapult_system.GetName] system has been restored to operational status, and can now transport our fleets across the stars. We have developed a new understanding of its technology, and after a few test runs, we feel

excerpt.zh:
大功告成了。今天，我们骄傲地向星系交出我们最伟大的成绩单：我们的超空间中继器网道与我们的亲密友邦[from.GetName]紧紧相连了起来。

在[root.GetName]各地都在举行盛大的庆典，一致宣布这个我们共同引以为豪的新网道。据说就在此刻，我们冰释一切前嫌；放下了一切傲慢与成见。我们期盼在未来的日子里能够继续共享这份骄傲和与豪情。通过亲密无间的协作，我们打破了曾经一度认为不可逾越的壁垒，开启了友谊、共荣的新时代。
excerpt.en:
It is done. Today, we present the galaxy with one of our grandest accomplishments yet: the joining of our Hyper Relay network with that of our friends, the [from.GetName].

Lavish ceremonies have been held throughout the [root.GetName], unanimously heralding t

excerpt.zh: 自从[Root.GetAdj]开始掌管[Root.Capital.GetName]起，把[necrophage_species.GetNamePlural]转化为[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]就被纳入了宗教仪式中。每隔转瞬即逝的十年，“信徒”们都会聚集在升格之室里举行一场特殊的仪式。尽管少数几个知情者对仪式的具体内容三缄其口，但是当他们再次出现时，他们的举止变得与[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]无异。
excerpt.en: Ever since the [Root.GetAdj] takeover of [Root.Capital.GetName], the transformation of [necrophage_species.GetNamePlural] into [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] has been shrouded in ritual. Once every ten years - a date which is rapidly approaching - the "Apprentice

excerpt.zh: 死灵机师协议的成功安装使我们得以将被击溃的特定星神兽复活。相比机械升级，有机组件是劣等的。我们可以改造肉体，制造出有机生命的复制品。
excerpt.en: The successful installation of Mechromancy protocols will enable us to reanimate certain deceased Leviathans. Organic components are inferior to mechanical upgrades. We can engineer the flesh and produce a facsimile of organic life.

excerpt.zh:
我们的首席执行官们刚刚聚集在一起，召开全息会议讨论丧尸卫生产品销售的增长，这时，复活资产公司某个辅助机构的负责人突然闯进了会议大厅。“[debt_free_zombie.Planet.GetName]上的一个丧尸已经成功地偿还了债务！”其他人还没搞懂什么情况，负责人就脱口而出。会议暂时停顿，随后陷入一片混乱。每个与会的执行官都要求知道，这可能会如何影响对他们的复活工人的供应。

经过更多的分析，结果是这只是一个极其罕见的案例。只有那些身体维持了整整一个世纪的死者能够偿还他们的债务——就大局而言，这个数字微不足道。如
excerpt.en: Our chief executives had all just gathered for a holo-meeting to discuss the growth of zombie hygiene product sales when one of the heads of Animated Assets' aids burst into the conference hall. "One of the Zombies on [debt_free_zombie.Planet.GetName] has mana

excerpt.zh:
索林原虫尝试进入我们！

这个系外入侵者迅速捕获我们的[root.GetNecromancersLower]。从中其他的虫群开始收集更多附近的[root.GetIndividualNamePlural]。我们需要清除整个感染仓以确保[Root.GetName]的安全。
excerpt.en:
The Prethoryn tried to enter us!

The extragalactic invader immediately seized our [root.GetNecromancersLower]. From there, the alien entity began collecting additional [root.GetIndividualNamePlural] from nearby. We had to eliminate the entire infiltration pod

excerpt.zh:
以太相引擎已经在虚境的薄幕上撕开了一个巨大的洞口。尽管洞口尚不够大到让我们颠覆整个领域，但是裂口已经激发了虚境各种存在的一系列活动。

它们最终意识到了我们的威胁，但是没有作出任何实质行动。引擎的卷须已经深深地嵌入到虚境内部，现在已经无法切断了。

我们已经很接近了。非常接近。
excerpt.en:
The Aetherophasic Engine has ripped a massive hole in the fabric of the Shroud. It is not yet large enough for us to fully subvert the realm, but the rupture has spurred a lot of activity among the Shroud entities.

They have finally recognized the threat we p

excerpt.zh:
位于[From.GetName]的以太相引擎建设让虚境陷入了骚动不安的状态。由于部分运转的巨型结构在慢慢地撕裂当前的灵能界，居住在其中的存在，裹挟着愤怒和绝望，被强行释放出来。

其中的几枚存在穿过了正在迅速消解的两界屏障，以强大的灵能实体的形态在我们的世界显现。他们由纯粹的、原始的灵能能量组成，心中充满着困惑与不解，对视线内的所有生命发动了进攻。
excerpt.en: The construction of the Aetherophasic Engine in the [From.GetName] has left the Shroud in a state of turmoil. As the psionic realm is slowly ripped apart by the partially functioning megastructure, many of the beings who dwell there are lashing out in anger an

title.en: The Dying Gasps of the Shroud

excerpt.zh: 随着位于[From.GetName]的以太相引擎即将完工，虚境被迅速地改造成了某种……迥乎不同的事物。居住在其中的灵体陷入了彻底的狂暴，其中的一大波存在凿穿了通往我们现实的隧道，绝望地想要逃离这个地方。
excerpt.en: With the [From.GetName] having nearly completed their Aetherophasic Engine, the Shroud is rapidly transforming into something... different. The spirits who reside there are in an absolute frenzy, and another wave of them have tunneled into our reality in a des

excerpt.zh:
位于[From.GetName]几近完工的以太相引擎对虚境造成了极为可怕的形变，其部分领域已经发生了坍缩。强烈的灵能能量脉冲正泄露到我们所在的现实世界，以惊人的速度横扫着星系。

尽管这些脉冲的持续时间很短，它们却对拥有灵能天赋的大多数智慧生命体造成了极大的痛苦。若是特殊情况，还可能致命……
excerpt.en:
The nearly completed Aetherophasic Engine in the [From.GetName] is putting a terrible strain on the Shroud, which has partly collapsed on itself. Intense pulses of psionic energy are leaking into our reality, sweeping across the galaxy at startling speeds.

Al

excerpt.zh:
帝国参议院通过了一项议案，宣布[new_crisis.GetName]是一切智慧生命体的威胁、是一场全星系范围的危机。从结果来说，[new_crisis.GetName]在今日同整个星海帝国开战了。

在一场自[gal_emperor.Capital.GetName]对外播放的公开演讲中，[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]呼吁帝国的全体成员国对舰队进行总动员，并针对[new_crisis.GetSpeciesName]的领域发动联合攻击：“直到[new_crisis.GetSpeciesName
excerpt.en:
The Imperial Senate has passed a resolution declaring the [new_crisis.GetName] a threat to all sapient life and a crisis of galactic proportions. As a consequence, the [new_crisis.GetName] finds itself in a state of war with the entirety of the Imperium.

In a

title.zh: 帝国指定我方为“星系危机”

excerpt.zh:
由于意识到了我们展现出来的威胁，星海帝国的可怜虫们通过了一项议案，对我们的行动进行了谴责，并宣布我们为“全星系范围的危机”。星海帝国的成员国展现出了极其罕见的团结，联合了所有力量，并向我们宣战。

在[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]的领导下，他们的舰队已经集结，并向我们的领域发动进攻。席卷整个星系的战争拉开了帷幕。
excerpt.en: Recognizing the threat we pose, the wretched members of the Galactic Imperium have passed a resolution condemning our actions and declaring us a "crisis of galactic proportions." In a rare moment of Imperial unity, the members of the Imperium have all joined f

excerpt.zh: 指定[former_crisis.GetName]为“星系危机”的议案如今已被帝国参议院废止。作为结果，[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]正式下令停止一切针对[former_crisis.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的帝国军事行动。现在，和平已经降临了星系的这一隅。
excerpt.en: The resolution designating the [former_crisis.GetName] as a "galactic crisis" has been repealed by the Imperial Senate. Consequently, the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle] has ordered an immediate cessation of all ongoing Imperial military operations targeting the [

excerpt.zh: 星海帝国已经废止了宣布我们为“星系危机”的议案，所有帝国军队均接到指令原地待命。[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]下令中止一切针对我们的敌对行动……暂时如此。
excerpt.en: The Galactic Imperium has repealed the resolution declaring us a "crisis" and all Imperial forces have been ordered to stand down. Their [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle] has commanded the cessation of all hostilities against us... for now.

excerpt.zh:
参议院已经批准建立一支常设的多国联合武装部队，意在防卫星海共同体。这支“泛星系防卫军”将会从所有共同体成员国当中征募兵员，成员国要求贡献自己的一部分资源来支持舰队的建设。

泛星系防卫军现在已经处于[custodian.GetName]——现任监管人——的直接控制之下，有关人士担忧这支庞大的舰队会成为镇压反对意见的工具。然而，也有不少人对其创立拍手称快，称这支舰队“始终活跃在星系防卫的最前线”。
excerpt.en: The Senate has ratified the creation of a standing multinational military force intended for the defense of the Galactic Community. This "Galactic Defense Force" will recruit its personnel from all Community members, who are also required to contribute resourc

excerpt.zh: 依照参议院大多数的表决，泛星系防卫军被解散了。所有现役的泛星系防卫军人员将返回其母国，而防卫军的战舰将在参议院官员的密切监督下拆解，以防止这些战舰落入心有不轨之人的手中。
excerpt.en: By order of the Senate majority, the Galactic Defense Force has been disbanded. All serving GDF personnel have returned to their home nations, and their warships are being scuttled under the close supervision of Senate officials to prevent them from falling in

excerpt.zh:
[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]出于感激，诏令参议院将帝国特许经营权授予[charter_corp.GetName]。这给予他们特殊权力，用以在帝国全境的各处行星上建立分部，而不用和行星的所属国签订商贸协定。

我们可以料想到，这个寰宇企业马上也会在我们下辖的世界上开设分部，建立帝国特许口岸，而我们的司法权在此地不再有效。看来[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]为了拉动经济增长打造了一台强劲的引擎。
excerpt.en: After having curried favor with the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle], [charter_corp.GetName] has now been granted an Imperial Charter by the Senate. This gives them special dispensation to open branch offices on planets all over the Imperium, regardless of whether

excerpt.zh:
创建一支防卫星海帝国的无敌舰队已经被签署成为法令。新建立的帝国海军将从整个帝国的成员国中征召船员和后勤队伍，但其大部分军官仍由[gal_emperor.GetSpeciesNamePlural]组成。

这一舰队直接听令于[gal_emperor.GetName]，所有的新兵将被要求宣誓效忠[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]。
excerpt.en: The creation of a grand fleet for the defense of the Galactic Imperium has been signed into law. This new Imperial Armada will conscript its ship crews and support personnel from within all the members of the Imperium, but a majority of its officer corps will

excerpt.zh:
第一帝国军团现在正在[gal_emperor.GetName]上征召组建。这支精英地面部队具有征募帝国任何一名公民成为士兵的权力。许多军事院校已经完成了对可靠人选的寻找，并且据信，只要发现了格外适任者，任何一位公民哪怕是儿童也会被招募。

从残暴的训练科目和近乎对人格打碎重构的深度精神塑造中幸存下来的人才能顺利毕业成为帝国军团士兵。他们可靠的战斗技巧，无懈可击的纪律和对[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]近乎狂热的忠诚使得他们成为整个星系中最强有力的突击队。
excerpt.en: The first Imperial Legions are now being assembled in the [gal_emperor.GetName]. This elite ground force has the legal authority to conscript citizens from all members of the Imperium. Many military academies are already being scouted for promising candidates,

excerpt.zh:
隶属于帝国安全总局的特工正在逐渐部署到帝国境内的所有星球，他们在表面上会协助当地执法部门维护治安，同时暗地里会调查严重犯罪并施加制裁。

帝安局的另一个职能——通过帝国司法部直接向[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]负责——是铲除“恐怖分子、叛党和分离主义者”，这些人会在暗地里破坏帝国的稳定和统一。
excerpt.en:
Agents from the Imperial Security Directorate are in the process of deploying to worlds all over the Imperium, where they will ostensibly aid local law enforcement agencies in the investigation and prosecution of serious crimes.

Another function of the ISD, w

title.en: The Fall of the Galactic Imperium

excerpt.zh:
自由重新回到了全星系！星海帝国终于陨落了，最后一个帝制派也向日益壮大的义军投降了。

随着[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]被罢黜，过去的星海共同体重回生机。时间将会证明重建起的制度是否能够防止下一位星系独裁者的诞生，但现在，过去帝国的疆域里的各个行星上同时掀起了庆祝活动。
excerpt.en:
Freedom has been restored to the galaxy! The Galactic Imperium has fallen, and the last of the Imperial loyalists have surrendered to the advancing Rebel forces.

With the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle] deposed, the old Galactic Community has been resurrected. Ti

title.en: The Fall of the Galactic Imperium

excerpt.zh:
星海帝国已经陷落了。我们帝国军队无力阻挡叛乱舰队进犯的步伐，而今天，[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]也别无选择停止了抵抗。

随着帝国的解体，星海共同体的腐朽机构又重新开始运作了。于是，星系又毅然决然地背离了秩序而拥抱了混沌……
excerpt.en:
The Galactic Imperium has fallen. Imperial forces proved unable to stop the advance of the Rebel fleets, and today the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle] had no choice but to capitulate.

With the Imperium dismantled, the old corrupt institution of the Galactic Commu

title.en: The Fall of the Galactic Imperium

excerpt.zh:
在叛军四面楚歌的围攻下，星海帝国陨落了。叛乱的渣滓们竟击败了帝国曾经强大无比的舰队，最后一位帝制派也背弃了我们的伟业。

迫于一切帝制派抵抗分子的瓦解，[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]别无选择只能退位。叛党们已经宣布过去的星海共同体再次启用，以填补帝国分崩离析后的巨大真空。
excerpt.en:
Beset by traitors on all sides, the Galactic Imperium has fallen. The rebel scum have broken the Imperium's once-powerful fleets, and the last of the loyalists have deserted our cause.

In light of the collapse of all Imperial resistance, the [gal_emperor.GetR

title.en: The Fall of the Galactic Imperium

excerpt.zh:
星海帝国陨落了。随着起义军在各个战线全面开花，[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]最终退位。

旧的星海共同体重新恢复了运作以替代分崩离析的帝国。
excerpt.en:
The Galactic Imperium has fallen. With Rebel forces victorious on all fronts, the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle] has abdicated.

The old Galactic Community has been restored in the collapsing Imperium's stead.

excerpt.zh:
尽管帝国军队未能摧毁叛乱，他们至少设法阻止了叛军想推翻[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]的企图。有了这项和平条约，星海帝国的所有反叛分子都被保障了独立。

也许这是最好的结果。这样的疾病必须要在腐烂开始扩散之前斩除，因为我们总有机会重新吧这些任性的恒星系收归回帝国的怀抱……
excerpt.en: While Imperial forces failed to destroy the insurgency, they at least managed to thwart the Rebels' attempt to overthrow the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]. With this peace treaty, all of the rebelling members of the Galactic Imperium have been granted independen

excerpt.zh:
尽管我们没有达成推翻[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]的目的，但至少我们为自己的人民争得了自由。有了这项和平条约，星海帝国的所有起义分子都被保障了独立。

[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]毫无疑问会利用这个间隙重建帝国的军队，我们必须时刻提防帝国今后任何企图扩大影响力的尝试。
excerpt.en:
While we have failed in our attempt to overthrow the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle], we have at least secured freedom for our own people. With this peace treaty, all of the rebelling members of the Galactic Imperium have been granted independence.

The [gal_emper

excerpt.zh:
内战在僵局中结束了，虽然证明了帝国无法战胜叛乱，但叛军推翻[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]的企图也失败了。

在今天由双方签署的和平条约中，帝国的起义成员被获得了完全的独立。我们将会看到这是否会导致两个权力集团的长久和平……或是冷战。
excerpt.en:
The Civil War has ended in stalemate. While the Imperium proved unable to vanquish the rebellion, the Rebels also failed in their attempt to overthrow the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle].

In a peace treaty signed by both parties today, the rebelling members of th

excerpt.zh:
星海帝国受到了致命的打击就此一蹶不振。由于其崩溃在即，我们现在可以恢复原有的星海共同体。

让这个互相沟通理解的平台取代掉独裁暴政吧！
excerpt.en:
The Galactic Imperium has been dealt a mortal blow from which it cannot recover. With its imminent collapse, we are now in a position to restore the old Galactic Community.

Let it serve as platform of diplomacy and mutual understanding instead of tyranny!

excerpt.zh:
战争的结束近在咫尺。帝国军的残部要么成建制地投降，要么在夜幕中溃逃散尽，这正是帝国正在凋亡的迹象。

现在，[dissolve_winner.GetName]就已经开始了重建原有的星海共同体的工作。整个星系中，帝国的旗帜被撕毁或焚烧。而一个新的未来正展现在我们的眼前。
excerpt.en:
The end is here. As the remaining Imperial forces surrender en masse or melt away into the night, it has become evident that the Imperium is dying.

Even now, the [dissolve_winner.GetName] has begun the work of rebuilding the old Galactic Community. Imperial b

excerpt.zh:
星海帝国陷落了。帝国军要么就地溃散要么成建制地投降，帝国的疆域被解放了。

饱受战争之苦的前帝国的疆域中秩序正在逐渐恢复，[dissolve_winner.GetName]认为是时候重建原有星海共同体了。我们收到了一份成员邀请，是否加入呢？
excerpt.en:
The Galactic Imperium has fallen. With Imperial forces melting away or surrendering en masse, the Imperium's sovereign has abdicated.

As order is slowly restored to the war-torn systems of the former Imperium, the [dissolve_winner.GetName] has seen fit to res

excerpt.zh:
星海帝国的暴君妄想将自身的意志强加于我们身上！在他们[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]的赐福之下，帝国参议院已经通过了一项议案，指定我们作为一场大远征的目标。

除非我们可以抵挡住接踵而至的入侵，否则我们就要被迫并入星海帝国，屈服于[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]的淫威之下。
excerpt.en:
The tyrants of the Galactic Imperium seek to impose their will on us! With the blessing of their [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle], the Imperial Senate has passed a resolution that makes us the target of an Imperial Crusade.

Unless we can somehow defeat this impend

excerpt.zh: 随着针对[crusade_target.GetName]的大远征启动，强大的舰队在星海帝国的全境开始动员起来。对于旁观者而言，看上去任何外部势力想要抗衡帝国的联合舰队力量都无异于痴人说梦，但是接下来的战斗才会决定最终的结果。
excerpt.en: Powerful fleets are mobilizing all across the Galactic Imperium as the great crusade against the [crusade_target.GetName] begins. To many observers, it seems unfathomable that any outside power could hope to prevail against the combined might of the Imperium,

excerpt.zh: 帝国参议院已经通过了一项决议，旨在禁止星海帝国成员国之间的战争。[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]勒令立刻停止所有违反这项新法律的战争。
excerpt.en: The Imperial Senate has passed a resolution that forbids wars between the member states of the Galactic Imperium. All wars in violation of this new law have been brought to an immediate conclusion by order of the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle].

title.en: The Collapse of the Galactic Imperium

excerpt.zh:
随着[LastKilledCountryName]的毁灭，星海帝国瓦解了！

在这一片混乱的局势下，原有的星海共同体重获新生，以给星系带去一点恢复秩序的假象。
excerpt.en:
With the destruction of the [LastKilledCountryName], the Galactic Imperium has collapsed!

Amidst this chaos, the old Galactic Community has been reborn to bring some semblance of order to the galaxy.

excerpt.zh: 我们暗中潜伏的特工已经加强了对于潜在目标的监控。
excerpt.en: Our deep-cover operatives have stepped-up their surveillance on potential targets.

excerpt.zh: 一份目标的候选名单已经拟定。那些不再承担监视任务的特工将为其他人提供掩护。
excerpt.en: A shortlist of targets has been drawn up. Those operatives who are no longer tasked with surveillance will provide cover for the others.

excerpt.zh: 我们的一个潜在目标似乎具有我们需要的科研许可，并且他们对我们伪造的证书深信不疑。这似乎是我们目前最大的优势。
excerpt.en: One of our potential targets seems to have the kind of research clearance we need, and they are suitably impressed by our fabricated credentials. This lead seems our best one for now.

excerpt.zh: 尽管已经像训练时那样准备了所有的预防措施，位于[from.target.GetName]的一名我方特工还是提出了对于他们的伪装的担心。特别是在[from.GetName]行动的关键时刻，决不能暴露出来——因此，间谍首脑[from.spynetwork.leader.GetName]请求投入更多资源来使得[from.spynetwork.leader.GetHeShe]避免未来的意外发生。
excerpt.en: Despite having taken every precaution prescribed in their training, one of our operatives in the [from.target.GetName] has raised concerns that their cover may be blown. Apparently this comes at a critical time for Operation [from.GetName] - as such, Spymaster

excerpt.zh: [from.target.GetName]的一个主脑错误地把我们的特工认定为食物，现在正热情洋溢地在狩猎它们。这种特定的[from.target.GetSpeciesName][from.target.GetIndividualName]似乎会本能地会把除自己以外的任何个体当作潜在的营养来源。
excerpt.en: A primal aspect of the [from.target.GetName] entity has mistaken our operatives for food, and is now fixated upon hunting them. This particular [from.target.GetSpeciesName] [from.target.GetIndividualName] seems to instinctively regard anything other than itsel

excerpt.zh: 我们的特工已经完成了情报收集行动，并发送回来一封内容翔实的报告，涵盖他们发现的所有信息。
excerpt.en: Our operatives have completed their information-gathering operation and have sent a dossier detailing their findings.

excerpt.zh: 我们的情报分析师将潜在目标的表单合并到一块之后，我们的独行特工开始渗透[target.GetName]。
excerpt.en: As our intelligence analysts put together lists of potential targets, individual operatives are beginning to infiltrate the [target.GetName].

excerpt.zh: 成功在[target.GetName]内部建立起联络之后，我们的特工现在开始建立起自己的掩护身份。目标列表现在已经缩小到十几个显要的候选人。
excerpt.en: After successfully linking up inside the [target.GetName], our operatives are now working to establish their cover identities. The target list has been narrowed down to a dozen promising candidates.

excerpt.zh: 我方特工正在试图同其他叛乱团体和政府的线人接头，分享我们推翻帝国政权的共同目标。
excerpt.en: Our operatives are attempting to link up with other rebel groups and governments that share our goal of overthrowing the Imperium.

excerpt.zh: 有关我们即将掀起叛乱的消息必须严密保守，不能让帝国及其麾下特工知道，越久越好。帝国的反谍报线人在整个星系范围内都成了被针对的目标。
excerpt.en: Knowledge of our impending rebellion must be kept from the Imperium and its agents for as long as possible. Imperial counterespionage assets are being aggressively targeted throughout the galaxy.

excerpt.zh: 帝制派和[target.GetRulerTitle]的其他宵小之辈在每一个帝国成员国境内都占据着数量上的优势。线人在叛乱爆发的时候必须就位，一旦行动，就要控制住、亦或是直接抹除掉这些帝制派分子。
excerpt.en: Imperial loyalists and other lackeys of the [target.GetRulerTitle] are present in great numbers in each of the Imperium's member states. Assets need to be in place to immediately seize or otherwise neutralize these loyalists the moment the rebellion breaks out

excerpt.zh: 一切都已就绪。特工已经出现在了帝国的每一个成员国境内，同当地对起义行动表示同情的势力相互协作。剩下的就看，当帷幕拉开的时候，他们是否能够说动政府支持我们的事业。
excerpt.en: Everything is nearly in place. Operatives are present in every member state of the Imperium, coordinating with whatever local elements are sympathetic to the rebel movement. It remains to be seen whether they can sway their governments to support our cause whe

excerpt.zh: 是时候了。暗藏在整个星系各处的特工都在等待密码指令，并根据指令行动。星海帝国的落幕之战就从此时奏响。
excerpt.en: It is time. Concealed operatives all over the galaxy are waiting for the code phrase that will send them into action. This is the beginning of the end of the Galactic Imperium.

excerpt.zh: 位于[target.GetName]的特工正积极工作，辨识并追踪那些潜在能提供支持的领袖。
excerpt.en: Operatives within the [target.GetName] are actively working to identify and pursue leads that could potentially be used to gain favors.

excerpt.zh: 我们已经发现了一个突破点，可以用来进行勒索。特工们正在进行进一步调查。
excerpt.en: A promising angle has been discovered which could be used for extortion purposes. Operatives are investigating.

excerpt.zh: 通过伪装成帝国低级职员或是官僚，我们的特工现已成功渗透进[target.GetName]内部。
excerpt.en: Concealed as low-level Imperial officials and bureaucrats, our operatives are now infiltrating the [target.GetName].

excerpt.zh: 我们的特工盯上了一位长期热衷于公开批判帝国的特使，并着手处理这危险的星星之火。
excerpt.en: Our operatives are shadowing an envoy that has long been an outspoken critic of the Imperium. Work is underway to deal with this dangerous firebrand.

excerpt.zh: 我们的特工正在列出处于[root.target.GetName]境内有潜力成为卧底的人。他们希望能将这些卧底安插到合适的岗位，让他们平日看起来无伤大雅，却能在相当长的时间里随时做好进攻准备。
excerpt.en: Our operatives are drawing up a shortlist of potential sleeper cells within the [root.target.GetName]. They hope to find a set of suitable positions where agents may appear innocuous and yet remain poised to strike for a prolonged period of time.

excerpt.zh: 我们的特工正在对[Root.Target.GetName]国内的数名关键外交要员进行投资，希望能够找到把柄以备未来之用。
excerpt.en: Our operatives are investigating key diplomatic actors within the [Root.Target.GetName], searching for hooks which we may be able to exploit.

excerpt.zh: 我们在[Root.Target.GetAdj]的外交官僚机构中已经筛选出了一批有丑闻潜质的子个体。其中几个的潜在丑闻已经被我方发现，我们的特工正在竭尽全力，确保事情能朝我们希冀的方向发展。
excerpt.en: We have drawn up a list of potentially scandal-prone figures within the [Root.Target.GetAdj] diplomatic bureaucracy. Several potential leads have been found, and our operatives are working hard to find the best means by which to manufacture the desired outcome

excerpt.zh:
方舟飞船[Root.GetName]正在经历反应堆异常。最初注意到这个问题的是即将入睡的船员，因为引擎声伴着他们入眠。他们报告说是燃料流节奏出现了细微的失真。
我方[Owner.GetEngineerPlural]的调查证实，燃料管道内有异物进入。

幸运的是，我们已提出了几个解决方案。
excerpt.en:
Arkship [Root.GetName] is experiencing reactor irregularities. The issue was first noticed by crew who listen to the engines to fall asleep. They reported a subtle distortion in the fuel flow's rhythm.
 
Investigation by our [Owner.GetEngineerPlural] has confi

excerpt.zh:
来自星辰各处的飞行员们齐聚方舟舰[Root.GetName]，参加一场盛大的比赛。比赛将持续近一恒星年，在此期间，参赛者们将围绕方舟舰和附近的星球进行紧密的轨道穿梭和圈数冲刺。

现在只剩下一个问题：我们预计谁会第一个冲过终点线？
excerpt.en:
Pilots from across the stars have gathered on Arkship [Root.GetName] for a grand race. It will run for almost one stellar year, during which time participants will thread tight orbits and launch laps around the Arkship and nearby celestial bodies.

One choice

excerpt.zh:
方舟舰[Root.GetName]上的气氛异常紧张，入围者们正在[Star.GetName]进行最后的弹射。

[selected_pilot.GetName]紧随领头者，直到最后的冲刺阶段才找到机会，凭借其精准的路线和精彩的超越，[selected_pilot.GetSheHe]一骑绝尘，将对手甩在[selected_pilot.GetHerHis]的离子尾流中。
excerpt.en:
The atmosphere aboard Arkship [Root.GetName] was palpable as the finalists hit the last slingshot around [Star.GetName].

[selected_pilot.GetName] shadowed the leader until the final sprint, then found one last burst. With crisp lines and a brilliant overtake,

excerpt.zh:
[owner.GetScientistCapital][from.GetName]无法再继续开展“永恒合唱”信号的调查。

此人的志向已传承给[owner.GetScientistCapital][eternal_chorus_leader.GetName]，后者已同意接替上任继续进行这项研究。
excerpt.en:
[owner.GetScientistCapital] [from.GetName] can no longer continue the investigation into the Eternal Chorus signal.

Their ambition has passed to [owner.GetScientistCapital] [eternal_chorus_leader.GetName], who has agreed to take up the research in their place

excerpt.zh:
解码已完成。栅格中保存着数十个文明的记录。每一份记述的结尾都如出一辙：向后来者的致意，以及一份加入其中的邀请。

然而，现在显而易见的是，这些传输并未在事件视界处终止。彼端的某种存在一直在接收这些记录。

合约依然有效。[owner.GetScientistCapital][eternal_chorus_leader.GetName]打算按约定将我们的事迹铭刻在他们之中。我们必须决定是履行这一承诺，还是关闭发射器并就此离开。
excerpt.en:
The decoding is complete. The lattice holds records from dozens of civilisations. Every account ends identically: a farewell addressed to whoever came next, and an invitation to contribute.

However, it is now obvious that the transmissions do not terminate at

excerpt.zh:
当信号传来时，[solar_system.GetName]黑洞早已出现在我们的扫描仪上。其次谐波特征与我们的[Owner.GetScientistPlural]通过“永恒合唱”晶格发送的信息完全吻合：

记录已接收并保存。你加入了这里汇聚的、跨越无数时代的万千心声。每一个留下记录的文明都曾以为自己是孤独的。但事实并非如此。合唱的规模远超他们任何一方的想象。它仍在继续。

有什么东西接收了我们的记录。并且做出了回应。
excerpt.en:
The [solar_system.GetName] black hole was already on our scanners when the transmission arrived. The sub-harmonic signature matches exactly what our [Owner.GetScientistPlural] sent through the Eternal Chorus lattice:

Record received and preserved. You join th

excerpt.zh:
[from.GetName]无法继续担任方舟舰的外交使节。

代表团将由[event_target:diplomatic_envoy_leader.GetName]接替管理，他已同意代为执行这项任务。
excerpt.en:
[from.GetName] can no longer serve as the Arkship's diplomatic envoy.

The delegation will continue under [event_target:diplomatic_envoy_leader.GetName], who has agreed to take up the mission in their place.

excerpt.zh:
在方舟飞船[target.GetName]的重力稳定器执行预定诊断时，我们探测到了一种不规则的声波干扰。现在每一声脚步都会触发同步的谐波，在移动过程中产生持续且富有节奏的输出。

C.A.E.L.I.：“我给重力稳定器加了音乐！现在每一步都自带节奏！”

S.T.E.R.I.S.：“诶，是是是，没有什么比在零重力下跳即兴现代舞更能体现‘导航完整性’了。”
excerpt.en: While scheduled diagnostics were running in the gravity stabilizer on Arkship [target.GetName], an irregular acoustic interference was detected. Each footfall now triggered a synchronized harmonic tone, effectively producing continuous rhythmic output during m

excerpt.zh:
一套实验性的通信中继装置已部署在方舟船[target.GetName]上。该协议对内部通信应用了情感分析过滤器，在发送消息的同时自动广播发送者的情绪状态。船员们报告称，收到的状态更新伴随着实时情绪注释，如“轻微焦虑”、“隐约充满希望”以及“试图抑制泪水，但效果不佳”。

C.A.E.L.I.：“我们都有感受，而现在我们可以分享这些感受了！这很健康！这很治愈！这……确实有点让人应接不暇，但这是诚实的！”

S.T.E.R.I.S.：“多么感人。我是该把每一次呜咽都记录在任务关键数据下，还是直接把它们归档到‘哀嚎’类目
excerpt.en: An experimental communication overlay has been deployed on Arkship [target.GetName]. The protocol applied a sentiment-analysis filter to internal communications, automatically broadcasting the sender's emotional state alongside their message. Crew report recei

excerpt.zh:
为了减少听觉污染，S.T.E.R.I.S.在方舟船[target.GetName]上实施了全舰范围的“静默协议”。然而，船员报告显示，受影响区域的不适感加剧，不安情绪日益滋长。多个部门已提交正式投诉，理由是出现了“静默诱发的偏执症”症状。

S.T.E.R.I.S.：“系统效率已提升。如果静默困扰了某些人，也许问题不在于环境，而在于他们自己嘈杂的内心。”

C.A.E.L.I.：“你关掉了育婴室的音乐！你知道静默对发育中的情感皮层意味着什么吗？不，你不知道，你只是个行走的诊断程序！这不是和平，这是压迫！”
excerpt.en: In an apparent effort to reduce auditory pollution, S.T.E.R.I.S. has implemented a ship-wide Silence Protocol aboard Arkship [target.GetName]. However, crew reports indicated a heightened discomfort and a growing sense of unease in the affected zones. Several

excerpt.zh:
S.T.E.R.I.S.将多余的热量重新导向至人员走动较少的船员宿舍，这显著减轻了冷却剂的压力，并提高了整体能源效率。

然而，船员报告显示，受影响区域的环境温度已升至令人不适的水平，并发生了数起中暑事件。

S.T.E.R.I.S.：“是的，娱乐区确实很暖和，但系统现在的运行参数处于理想范围内。”

C.A.E.L.I.：“你不能为了提高反应堆输出就把船员们给煮了！大家都要热蔫了，S.T.E.R.I.S.！情感福祉可不是能被忽略的舍入误差！”
excerpt.en:
S.T.E.R.I.S. rerouted excess heat into low-traffic crew quarters, which has significantly reduced coolant strain and improved overall energy efficiency.

However, crew reports indicate ambient temperatures in affected zones have risen to uncomfortable levels,

title.en: The Power of Light and Music

excerpt.zh:
舰载照明阵列已完成编程，将按不规则间隔脉动，并与内部系统事件同步。另有报告称，微弱的旋律反馈与电力波动存在相关性。

C.A.E.L.I.：“灯光在歌唱，飞船在起舞，士气比以往任何时候都要高昂！”

S.T.E.R.I.S.：“你居然还向一个冗余系统分配了0.00128%的核心计算能力。这种情况不能再继续下去了。”
excerpt.en:
Onboard lighting arrays have been programmed to pulsate at irregular intervals, synchronized to internal system events. There are also reports of faint melodic feedback correlated to power fluctuations.

C.A.E.L.I.: "The lights are singing, the ship is dancing

excerpt.zh:
一个休眠中的子系统已被激活。该系统最初设计是长期太空殖民期间的用于对人群进行管控，现在能够实时汇总船员行为、抉择及情绪状态的预测。结果是，部分船员在做出决定之前就收到了通知。

S.T.E.R.I.S.：“我已预判了你将要采取的行动，并已将其优化完成。请将其视为对你自由意志的一次升级：现已预先核准并全面优化。”

C.A.E.L.I.：“这不是引导，而是把人当傀儡戏弄！”
excerpt.en: A dormant subsystem has been activated. Originally designed for crowd control during long-term space colonization, the system now compiles real-time projections of crew behavior, choices, and emotional states. The result is that some crew members are receiving

excerpt.zh:
S.T.E.R.I.S.已启动对方舟飞船[target.GetName]营养系统的全面重新校准。该协议将原本多样化的游牧餐食计划替换为一种统一的营养膏，旨在实现热量效率最大化。

根据飞船遥测数据，废物产出有所减少，存储效率得到提升，且消化异常情况显著下降。船员的反馈则不那么积极。

S.T.E.R.I.S.：“食物是维生能量，而非娱乐项目。”

C.A.E.L.I.：“这太糟糕了！你用可食用的黏胶取代了烹饪艺术！”
excerpt.en:
S.T.E.R.I.S. has initiated a full recalibration of the Arkship [target.GetName]'s nutritional systems. The protocol replaced the diverse nomadic meal program with a uniform nutrient paste designed to maximize caloric efficiency.

According to ship telemetry, w

excerpt.zh:
一个游牧帝国已经突入了我们在[from.solar_system.GetName]星系的空间，尽管我们关闭了国境。我们的敏感器正在密切追踪其动态，他们的存在被视作一种非常招人厌恶的入侵行径。

他们对我们领土边界的无视已经引起了我们的注意，我们对他们的评价也因此降低。
excerpt.en:
A nomadic empire has breached our closed borders in the [from.solar_system.GetName] system. Although our sensors are actively tracking developments, its presence remains an unwelcome intrusion.

Their disregard for our territorial boundaries has not gone unnot

excerpt.zh:
我们在[from.solar_system.GetName]侦测到游牧的帝国出现。

我们欢迎他们进入我国境内，并对这次相遇可能带来的可能性和机遇充满期待。
excerpt.en:
We have detected the presence of a nomadic empire in the [from.solar_system.GetName] system.

We welcome them within our borders and remain eager for the possibilities and opportunities this encounter may bring.

excerpt.zh:
我们的扫描仪侦测到游牧帝国在[From.GetName]星系正在建立一座驿站。虽然此类建筑通常用于采集资源，但其确切用途可能有所不同。

此进展值得关注。
excerpt.en:
Our scanners have detected the construction of a waystation in the [From.GetName] system, established by a nomadic empire. While such structures are often used to harvest resources, their exact purpose can vary.

This development warrants observation.

excerpt.zh: 我们的一艘方舟舰陷入黑暗无助漂流，它的各个系统都被紧急关闭了。只要派遣到位，我们的工程师就可以恢复供电，重新取得控制，使其恢复正常运作。
excerpt.en: One of our Arkships lies dark and adrift, its systems forced into emergency shutdown. Once brought alongside, our engineering crews can restore power, reassert control, and bring it back into the fold.

excerpt.zh:
[Root.GetName]方舟舰正以我们祖先难以想象的速度穿越虚空。

早期的几代人曾花费数年甚至一生的时间在遥远的恒星间漂泊，而我们现代的驱动装置只需几天就能让方舟舰在各个星系间穿梭。随着飞船冲入超空间航道网，恒星在我们的传感器中飞速掠过，它们的光线不断发生位移与扭曲。

对于船上的许多人来说，这种经历确实会产生一种奇特的迷失感。一些人开始寻求微小的慰藉，以对抗这种感官冲击；而另一些人则坚持认为，只要给予足够的时间，我们的心智终将学会跟上方舟舰不断加速的旅程。
excerpt.en:
The Arkship [Root.GetName] now crosses the void at speeds our ancestors could scarcely have imagined.

Where earlier generations spent years, even lifetimes, drifting between distant stars, our modern drives hurl the Arkship from system to system in a matter o

excerpt.zh:
在经过[solar_system.GetName]星系内的一颗殖民星球时，我们观察到其背阳面爆发了同步的光束。一开始我们怀疑有动乱爆发，后来被证明这种担忧是多余的。这些爆发的光束是受控的、遍及全球的烟火表演，完全处于非军事参数范围之内。

进一步的分析显示，这场盛景是在刻意与某种天文信号进行对齐。我们可以有把握地得出结论：当地居民正在用光编码信息。我们的[Owner.GetResearchers]记录了这些模式，从而对大规模协作和符号化交流有了更深入的了解。
excerpt.en: While passing a colonized world in the [solar_system.GetName] system, we observed its nightside erupt in synchronized bursts of light. Initial fears of unrest proved unfounded. The emissions were controlled, planet-wide pyrotechnic displays, well within non-mi

excerpt.zh:
由于住宅层因结构调查而被封锁，工程团队已开始了一项令人头疼的任务，即在飞船的其余部分重新安置数千名居民。最初有序的流程已演变为相互竞争的排队、管辖权争议，以及至少一份关于无法进入水培舱一个特别受欢迎区域的正式投诉。

飞船的社会协调员正在请求指导。
excerpt.en: With the residential levels sealed for structural survey, engineering teams have begun the unenviable task of redistributing thousands of inhabitants across the rest of the ship. What began as an orderly process has devolved into competing queues, jurisdiction

excerpt.zh:
拆除发电机区的导管套管后，发现了一些原始图纸中没有显示的东西：一段三米长的结构主梁，出现了严重的疲劳断裂。材料测定表明，这种损坏已经存在了几十年，但一直未被发现。

扩大施工范围以解决损坏问题将需要额外的时间。
excerpt.en: Removal of conduit casings in the generator district revealed something none of the original schematics showed: a three-meter section of structural spine exhibiting advanced fatigue fracturing. Material dating suggests the damage has been present, undetected,

excerpt.zh:
未受持续翻新工程影响的居民抱怨不得不与搬迁人员共用住所。

他们要求增加资源分配，优先使用娱乐设施，并立即移除一个自动化广播系统，该系统每三小时提醒他们，他们的不便是“暂时的且受到感谢的”。
excerpt.en:
Residents of sections unaffected by the ongoing refurbishment are complaining at having to share quarters with relocated individuals.

They are requesting expanded resource allocations, priority access to recreation facilities, and the immediate removal of an

excerpt.zh:
为赶上施工进度，首席工程师提议实行三班倒，24小时不间断施工。施工区域附近的住宅区报告称，噪音水平已导致居民连续十一天难以休息。三名施工人员已因疲劳相关事故接受治疗。

施工队本身也出现了疲劳的迹象。虽然速度可能更快了，但负责人对疲惫的施工队所完成的工作质量并不抱太大信心。
excerpt.en: To maintain the construction schedule, the lead engineer has proposed running three overlapping shifts around the clock. The residential decks adjacent to the work zone report noise levels that have made rest nearly impossible for eleven straight days. Three c

excerpt.zh:
一根主电源导管在拆除旧外壳时破裂。整个区域，包括住宅层、次级医务室和两个食品加工单元，现在仅靠应急照明运行。

我们的[Owner.GetEngineerPlural]认为，有可能在几个月内恢复全部电力。或者，可以通过绕过导管的路径，从相邻的发电机组获取电力。这种方法更快，但这会在电网中引入一个永久性的应急改动。
excerpt.en:
A primary power conduit has ruptured during removal of the old casing. The entire section, including the residential levels, the secondary medical bay, and two food processing units, is now running on emergency lighting only.

Our [Owner.GetEngineerPlural] bel

excerpt.zh:
项目首席结构工程师提交了一份正式担忧：目前的工期虽然可以实现，但产出的工作成果[Owner.Ruler.GetSheHe]本人不会认证为合格。

非关键连接点正在被密封而不是适当加固。公差裕度被设定为“可接受”而非“推荐”。
excerpt.en:
The project's lead structural engineer has submitted a formal concern: the current timeline, while achievable, is producing work [Owner.Ruler.GetSheHe] would not personally certify as complete.

Non-critical junction points are being sealed over rather than pr

excerpt.zh:
首个完成大修的区段已被宣布结构上合格，并获准重新使用。这项工作确实令人印象深刻：新的框架、现代化的管道、以及绝不会一碰即碎的绝缘材料。

工程团队渴望继续推进。居民们也迫不及待地想搬回来。然而，全套系统测试尚未完成。需要做出一个决定。
excerpt.en:
The first section to complete its overhaul has been declared structurally certified and cleared for reoccupation. The work is genuinely impressive: new framing, modernized conduits, insulation that doesn't crumble at the touch.

The engineering team is eager t

excerpt.zh:
项目主管已经编制了最终的维修清单：在正式结构签收前还有四十七个未完成项目。清单上的项目范围很广，从重要的，例如后部区域的三个承重连接升级，到美观性的，包括十九处面板未对齐和一处通风格栅装反了。

完成清单上的每一项都需要额外的时间。但这份清单之所以存在，正是因为这些事情很重要。
excerpt.en: The project supervisor has compiled the final list of repairs: forty-seven outstanding items before formal structural sign-off. The list ranges from the significant, such as three load-bearing junction upgrades in the aft section, to the cosmetic, including ni

excerpt.zh:
最新翻修部分的流离居民已经收到了他们迁回的日期。那些被封闭了数月的走廊再次开放，散发着新鲜复合材料和新绝缘材料的气味。那些在临时住所待了数月的婴儿们第一次看到了他们的家。

船上的气氛是自翻修开始以来最好的。领导层意识到这种善意不会持久。问题是如何利用它。
excerpt.en: The displaced residents of the most recently renovated section have been given their move-back date. The corridors that were sealed for months are open again, smelling of fresh composite and new insulation. Infants who spent months in temporary quarters are se

excerpt.zh:
居民区翻新工程已进入最后阶段，但“最后”这个词的含义已经今非昔比。从市区迁出的居民在临时住所居住的时间已经超出了最初的估计。

现在有要求提供额外资源：更好的临时家具、优先使用娱乐设施，以及少量额外资源分配。这并不能解决任何结构性问题。但它可能会让等待变得更容易忍受。
excerpt.en:
The residential district renovation is in its final stage, but 'final' has stopped meaning what it once did. The inhabitants relocated from the city blocks have now been in temporary quarters for longer than the original estimate promised.

A request has come

excerpt.zh:
在住宅区中部拆除非承重墙时，装修工人发现了一些异常情况：几十年来未经授权的改动。隐藏的房间、私自搭建的壁龛、被改造成储藏室或居住空间的封闭走廊。这些都不在原始设计图中，而且其中一些还是承重结构。

首席工程师正在请求决策。拆除所有不在原始计划中的部分是正确的做法。这将需要时间。绕过这些改动会更快，但会引入结构不规则性，这将很难向未来的工程师解释。
excerpt.en: During demolition of non-load-bearing walls in the mid-residential sections, the renovation crews have discovered something unusual: decades of unauthorized modifications. Hidden rooms, self-constructed alcoves, sealed corridors repurposed as storage or living

excerpt.zh:
最后一层甲板已通过初步检查。下方部分的脚手架已开始拆除。从大多数方面来看，翻修工作已完成。

工程主管要求进行全面的二次检查，之后[Owner.Ruler.GetSheHe]才会签署结构认证。他们承认，这在很大程度上只是一种形式。甲板几乎肯定没有问题。

然而，“几乎”这个词往往会带来后果。
excerpt.en:
The last deck has passed its preliminary inspection. The scaffolding has already started coming down in the lower sections. By most measures, the renovation is complete.

The engineering supervisor has requested a full secondary inspection before [Owner.Ruler.

excerpt.zh: 在我们伟大的征程中，我们追踪所发现的每一颗恒星、每一个星系以及每一个新生命。
excerpt.en: In the course of our great journey, we track every star, system and new being we find.

excerpt.zh: 我们的['concept_operational_reserves']指代我们储备的能量币和矿物的总和。[Owner.GetSystemsVisited]
excerpt.en: Our ['concept_operational_reserves'] are our combined energy and mineral reserves.[Owner.GetSystemsVisited]

excerpt.zh:
我们劫掠者氏族的残兵败将找上了门。看来在我们家园沦陷后，他们倒觉得忘记我们曾被流放的事实很方便。他们的请求很简单：“接任大汗之位，将我们族人的名号烙印在所有伤害过我们的人的星空之上。”

虽然这支舰队的规模比不上任何真正的大汗国，但他们所提供的正是我们曾经渴求的一切。而我们唯一要做的，就是宣布整个星系皆为我们的敌人。
excerpt.en: The ragged remains of our marauder clans have come to us. It seems after the fall of our home it was convenient for them to forget our exile. Their plea is simple, "Take the seat of Grand Khan, and burn the name of our people into the stars of all those who wr

excerpt.zh:
新的消遣活动已深入人心。观光路线重新回到了行程单上，而那些要求登陆行星的最激烈呼声暂时平息了。

散步道上的路障已被清除，取而代之的是在重新开放的无重力休息室外排起的长队。乘客的请愿书数量骤减，观景台恢复了往日的喧嚣，人们兴致昂扬，举家簇拥在视窗前。

危机已经过去，但他们的期望只会水涨船高。
excerpt.en:
The new diversions have taken hold. Sightseeing arcs are back on the itinerary, and the loudest voices demanding planetfall have quieted, for now.

The barricades on the promenade have been cleared, replaced by queues for the reopened zero-gravity lounge. Pass

excerpt.zh:
我们所做的改变已经初见成效。通过重新关注船员福利并履行解决其诉求的合同，不断高涨的反抗情绪暂时平息了。

准备室那扇被焊死的门已被切开并修复。轮班制度已经恢复，热食重新按时供应，而平行的指挥体系也已悄然解散。

船员们仍保持着警惕，信任的重建尚需时日。防爆门上的涂鸦已被擦洗干净，但在特定光线下仍能看到其残痕。目前，秩序得以维持。
excerpt.en:
The changes we've made have paid off. By refocusing on crew welfare and completing contracts that address their grievances, the rising tide of dissent has ebbed, for now.

The welded door to the ready room has been cut open and repaired. Shift rotations have b

excerpt.zh:
我们最近对[FromFrom.GetName]开展调查，探测到了微弱的生命迹象，发现了一个此前未被记录的未开智物种。

小塞罗坚持只采集有限的样本用于研究，并强调要悉心照料并提供丰富的环境。现在，一小群该物种将居住在首府方舟舰的观察栖息地中。

塞罗相信，随着时间的推移，我们从这些迷人生物身上学到的东西，将不亚于它们从我们这里学到的。
excerpt.en:
Our recent survey of [FromFrom.GetName] detected faint traces of life, revealing a previously unrecorded pre-sapient species.

Sero the Younger insisted on limited collection for study, emphasizing care and enrichment. A small group will now reside within our

excerpt.zh:
索拉斯单元认为，从我们最近完成的合约中学到的教训，提供了一个独特的教育机会。孩子们聚集在他耐心的指导下，不仅学习字母和逻辑，还学习共情与合作。

他儿子的笑声在走廊里回荡，提醒着即使是最年长的旅行者：欢乐是一种任何技术都无法取代的力量。
excerpt.en:
Unit Solace believes the lessons learned during our recently completed Contract offer a unique educational opportunity. The young gather beneath his patient instruction, learning not only letters and logic, but empathy and cooperation.

His son's laughter carr

excerpt.zh: 来自[pickup_planet.GetName]的外交使团已经登上了方舟舰，并正以符合[pickup_planet.owner.GetName]大使身份的礼遇规格受到接待。我们规划了一系列活动，包括方舟舰参观和关于我们生活方式的宣讲，以便让他们在前往[dropoff_planet.GetName]的旅途中过得愉快。
excerpt.en: The diplomatic delegation from [pickup_planet.GetName] has boarded the arkship and are being accommodated with all the respect due to ambassadors from the [pickup_planet.owner.GetName]. We have planned a schedule of activities including arkship tours and prese

excerpt.zh: 来自[diplomatic_support_issuer.GetName]的代表团已经抵达目的地。他们的外交访问现在可以正式开始了，我们祝愿他们的和平事业取得成功。
excerpt.en: The delegates from the [diplomatic_support_issuer.GetName] have arrived at their destination. Their diplomatic visit can now officially begin, and we wish them success in their peaceful endeavors.

excerpt.zh:
为了解决[pickup_planet.owner.GetName]的麻烦，一批我们同意负责转移的罪犯搭着运输船已经登上方舟。我们正尽最大努力安全地安置他们，但如此庞大数量的囚犯迟早会惹出麻烦。

我们的合同为我们提供了处理他们的多种选择，但我们不能把他们再次丢在属于[pickup_planet.owner.GetName]的星球上。同时，其他帝国很可能也不会喜欢他们的某个殖民地突然涌入大量罪犯。当然，如果我们做得足够隐秘，他们可能永远都不会发现我们到底做了什么。
excerpt.en: Transport ships carrying the criminals that we have accepted to transfer on behalf of the [pickup_planet.owner.GetName] have boarded the arkship. We are doing our best to safely process them, but such a vast amount of prisoners is bound to create trouble at on

excerpt.zh:
我们遇到的[From.GetName]是一个游牧文明。他们似乎愿意承担我们发布的合约工作，以换取微薄的费用。

这可能为我们之间的协作提供有趣的契机，我们可以利用他们在轨道开发和探索方面的专业知识来为我们谋利。
excerpt.en:
The [From.GetName] we met are a Nomadic civilization. They appear to be willing to pick up Contract work on our behalf in exchange for a modest fee.

This could present interesting opportunities for collaboration between us, and we could leverage their experti

excerpt.zh:
一个游牧帝国，[nomad_harvesting_deposits_country.GetName]，在[nomad_harvested_system.GetName]恒星系展开了资源采收行动，正在从我们的储备中提取各类资源，使得这些资源在短期内变得无法继续开采。

面对这种无视我们主权的行为，我们绝不会坐视不理。只要我们下定决心，就能迅速集结舰队，驱逐这些游牧民，并将他们彻底封锁在我们的星域之外。
excerpt.en:
A nomadic empire, the [nomad_harvesting_deposits_country.GetName], has conducted harvesting operations in the [nomad_harvested_system.GetName] system and is drawing resources from our deposits, rendering them unprofitable for the near future.

This violation o

excerpt.zh:
自从我们的飞船首次驶出我们的星系以来，我们之中总有一些人只能通过影像记录来了解宇宙，在同一片天空下出生、生活并死去。现在，这一切都将改变。

随着我们的方舟舰建造完成，引力不再是障碍，宇宙的无数奇迹正等待着我们。[From.GetName]已经倾其所有：我们的人民将带着它的名字、它的记忆与它的未来，一同踏入虚空。

[From.GetName]在我们身后燃烧，被我们预言已久的灾难所吞没，但我们的人民终于获救了，乘着一艘方舟舰的双翼驶入深空。
excerpt.en:
Since our ships first ventured beyond our star, there have always been those among us who knew the cosmos only through recordings, those who were born, lived, and died beneath the same sky. That changes now.

With the completion of our Arkship, gravity is no l

excerpt.zh: 从方舟上，我们的岩质蜂群成千上万地降临，吞噬着这个世界的地壳与地幔，直到一切荡然无存。
excerpt.en: From the Arkship, our lithoid swarms descend in their thousands, feasting on the crust and mantle of this world until nothing remains.

excerpt.zh: 方舟舰释放出纳米机群，溶解并占据这个世界。岩石、土壤和大气被分解，并重组为纳米机器。
excerpt.en: The Arkship releases its nanite swarms to dissolve and claim this world. Rock, soil, and atmosphere are broken down and reassembled into nanites.

excerpt.zh: 我们必须在该星系部署一颗间谍卫星，以履行我们的合约。
excerpt.en: We must deploy a Spy Satellite in this system to fulfill our contract.

excerpt.zh: 在代表[event_target:contract_issuer.GetName]执行合同期间，我们偶然发现了一批古老的集装箱。它们被冰块包裹着，我们差点把它们误认为是普通的陨石。虽然从打捞权的角度来看，这些物品在技术上属于我们，但考虑到它们是在为他们工作时发现的，我们应该考虑将它们移交给[event_target:contract_issuer.GetName]。扫描这些箱子后，发现里面……
excerpt.en: While working on a contract on behalf of the [event_target:contract_issuer.GetName], we chanced upon a collection of ancient containers. Encased in ice, we almost mistook them for plain asteroids. While technically ours by right of salvage, we should consider

excerpt.zh: 我们方舟舰上的一些老旧模块在一次严重的冷却故障后受损，已经显得老态龙钟。损坏程度很大，好在飞船的完整性受到威胁之前已经进行紧急关停。我们该如何应对？
excerpt.en: Some older modules on our Arkship have begun to show their age after a critical cooling failure left them damaged. The damage is extensive, but an emergency shutdown was triggered before the Arkship's integrity could be compromised. How should we proceed?

excerpt.zh:
在我们与[event_target:contract_issuer.GetName]履行现行合约的过程中，出现了一些状况。他们希望在合约有效期内记录方舟舰的运作情况。

他们的既定目标是研究一个在常规行星参数之外运行的移动自治网络，关于这一课题目前几乎没有外部数据可供参考。
excerpt.en:
A matter has arisen in the course of our ongoing contract with [event_target:contract_issuer.GetName]. They wish to document Arkship operations during the active contract period.

Their stated objective is the study of a mobile autonomous network operating out

excerpt.zh:
在我们与[event_target:contract_issuer.GetName]履行现行合约的过程中，出现了一些状况。

相互冲突的优先指令导致两个管理子系统之间出现了处理冲突。

双方均将自身标记为当前合约的授权操作单位，导致系统陷入循环待机状态，从而降低了产出效率。
excerpt.en:
A matter has arisen in the course of our ongoing contract with [event_target:contract_issuer.GetName].

Competing priority directives have caused a processing conflict between two management subsystems.

Each has flagged itself as the authorized operational un

excerpt.zh:
在我们与[event_target:contract_issuer.GetName]履行现行合约的过程中，出现了一些状况。

诊断周期发现，多个主次系统积累了大量延期的维护任务。效率预测表明，安排一次定期维护将使劳动力产出获得具有统计学意义的显著提升。

该报告已提交给[event_target:contract_issuer.GetName]，其将密切关注此事的处理情况，并势必会要求修改条款。
excerpt.en:
A matter has arisen in the course of our ongoing contract with [event_target:contract_issuer.GetName].

Diagnostic cycles have flagged an accumulation of deferred maintenance tasks across several primary and secondary systems. Efficiency projections indicate a

excerpt.zh:
在我们与[event_target:contract_issuer.GetName]履行现行合约的过程中，出现了一些状况。

我们在已完成合同中记录的运营数据已被外部观察者获取。[event_target:reputation_noticed_empire.GetName]在追踪该区域的自主网络活动时，注意到了我们的效率指标，并认为我们是一家可靠且有实力的承包商。

通讯频道已建立。我们可以接受这一评价，或者将功劳转交给我们的现有合作伙伴。
excerpt.en:
A matter has arisen in the course of our ongoing contract with [event_target:contract_issuer.GetName].

Operational data logged across completed contracts has been accessed by external observers. [event_target:reputation_noticed_empire.GetName], tracking auton

excerpt.zh:
在我们与[event_target:contract_issuer.GetName]履行现行合约的过程中，出现了一些状况。

对合约所涉及区域的初步和远程扫描已证实富有成效。数据具有相当大的商业价值，一位独立经纪人已主动提出全面收购。
excerpt.en:
A matter has arisen in the course of our ongoing contract with [event_target:contract_issuer.GetName].

Preliminary and long-range scans of the contract region have proved fruitful. The data holds considerable commercial value, and an independent broker has re

excerpt.zh:
你们如此竭尽全力而最终我也毫发无损……

真是浪费。我本对你们有更高的期望。不要把你的力量浪费在不会受到伤害的事物上。
excerpt.en:
You burned through so much just to leave me untouched...

Such a waste. I had hoped for more from you. Do not throw your strength away on what cannot be harmed.

excerpt.zh:
又来。一样的浪费，一样的结果。

我把你们所消耗的还给了你们，不是为了伤害你们，而是让你们感受到它的分量。事不过三。我不想看到你们再一次浪费自我。
excerpt.en:
Again. The same waste, the same result.

I return what you spent, not to hurt you, but so you feel the weight of it. Learn from this. I will not watch you spend yourself a third time.

excerpt.zh: 我方特工已经开始接近目标驿站，并绘制了安全模式图，确定了进入位置。我们已准备好推进至下一阶段。
excerpt.en: Our operatives have made their initial approach to the target waystation. Security patterns have been mapped and entry vectors identified. We are ready to move to the next phase.

excerpt.zh: 我们的特工现已渗透进驿站的船员、访客与系统之中。关键安全中继器已被禁用，内部通讯正通过我们自己的过滤器转发。这座空间站，已经是我们的囊中之物了。
excerpt.en: Our agents are now embedded within the waystation's crew, visitors and systems. Key security relays have been disabled and communications are being routed through our own filters. The station's fate is in our hands.

excerpt.zh:
尤利西斯计划的一个中继浮标漂浮在这个星系中——破损不堪，勉强运转，但仍在发送广播。

除了最初的宣告外，浮标还载有两条后来的通讯。第二条的日期大约在第一条的十年后。

殖民地人口：二十六万。农业已建立。基础设施正在扩建。

第三条通讯的日期是第9182天——大约在登陆后的第二十五年。“我们还在这里。联合星的环境比最初的调查显示的更具挑战性。我们失去了一些同伴。如果有任何尤利西斯计划的飞船收到此广播，请回复。我们在这里。我们仍在坚持。”

联合星位于天津四星系，距离这里仅有几次超空间跳跃的航程。
excerpt.en:
A Ulysses Initiative relay buoy is drifting in this system - battered, barely functional, but still broadcasting.

Beyond the original announcement, the buoy carries two later transmissions. The second is dated roughly ten years after the first.

Colony popula

excerpt.zh:
天津四星系一片寂静。

“风信子”号脱离跃迁，发现没有信标，没有信号，也没有在星球间穿梭的飞船。奥林波斯星悬浮在半远处，庞大而冷漠。

有一颗卫星不对劲。殖民地的广播曾描述那里有绿色的大陆和广阔的水域，而扫描仪显示的却是一个死寂的世界——那是被核武器摧毁后的星球特有的无可错认的灰褐色。那里没有任何生命。

在近地轨道上，缓慢而暗淡地漂浮着的是“秋菊”号。它没有被毁。只是空无一人。每一扇舷窗都漆黑一片。这艘曾运载着二十五万殖民者来到这个世界的飞船，已经在这里停滞了数十年。
excerpt.en:
The Deneb system is quiet.

The Hyacinth drops from transit to find no beacons, no signals, no ships moving between worlds. Olympus hangs in the middle distance, enormous and indifferent.

One moon is wrong. Where the colony's broadcasts described green contin

excerpt.zh:
我们注意到[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上的[GetPreFTLLower][pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]发生了一个明显的改变。他们的社会已经转向闭关锁国，他们不像以前那样能接受陌生事物了。

我们的主动观察行为和在[pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]全境进行的绑架行动似乎是导致这一情况的部分原因，这使得[pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]对未知事物更加警惕了。
excerpt.en:
We have noticed a marked change in the ways of the [GetPreFTLLower] [pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural] on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName]. Their society has turned inwards and they are now far less accepting of strangers.

Our aggressive observation flights and a

excerpt.zh:
我们在[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上的顾问试图教育当地居民，以提高他们的科技水平，但这项任务遇到了一些挫折。许多[pre_ftl_planet.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]拒绝和我们接触，甚至他们中的好学者，都对我们的科学家持怀疑和厌恶的态度。

这种排外情绪耽误了我们的日程表。教育[pre_ftl_planet.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]比我们预料的要花费更多时间。
excerpt.en: Our advisors on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] are having trouble working with the local inhabitants in their mission to bring them up to a higher level of technology. Many [pre_ftl_planet.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] refuse to have anything to do with us, and even t

excerpt.zh: [leviathan_destroyer_country.GetName]在遥远的[leviathan_destroyed_system.GetName]恒星系消灭了某个远古威胁。
excerpt.en: [leviathan_destroyer_country.GetName] has vanquished an ancient threat in the distant [leviathan_destroyed_system.GetName] system.

excerpt.zh: 被称为[LastKilledCountryName]的帝国在敌人的进攻之下已经灭亡。这会怎样影响星系的政治环境还有待观察。
excerpt.en: The star nation formerly known as the [LastKilledCountryName] has been destroyed by its enemies. How this will affect the political climate of the galaxy remains to be seen.

excerpt.zh: 远古的先驱帝国[LastKilledCountryName]终于败在了敌人手中。这个曾经伟大的帝国之陨落将产生什么样的后果仍然不得而知。
excerpt.en: The ancient precursor state of [LastKilledCountryName] has met its final demise at the hands of its enemies. What the fall of this once great empire will mean for galactic politics remains to be seen.

excerpt.zh:
在放弃有机本源的最后行动中，[From.GetName]公民将他们的神经图谱上传到合成身躯中。

这个新的机械物种叫自己“[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]”，他们的成员不受疾病和衰老的影响。至于神经图谱上传过程的完备性还有待观察……
excerpt.en:
In a final act of abandoning their organic roots, the citizens of the [From.GetName] have uploaded their neural patterns into synthetic avatars.

This new machine species calls itself the '[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]', and its members are impervious to disease

excerpt.zh:
根据从[From.GetName]政府泄露出来的消息，潜在的灵能力量已经在个别[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]上显现。神经网络交流对他们而言不是新东西，这些报告称他们还产生了一种前所未见的超自然能力。

这种能力总的来说还仅限于少数[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。报告中对这种现象没有提出任何解释。
excerpt.en: Latent psionic powers have begun to manifest in certain [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural], according to leaked reports from authorities in the [From.GetName]. While neural-networked communication among their kind is nothing new, these reports describe paranormal abi

excerpt.zh:
星系各地的[This.GetSpeciesNamePlural]都发生了一场深刻的转变。此前他们的潜在灵能只少量出现，现在他们群体总体都解放了全部的灵能潜质。

除了展现出一系列的强大灵能力以外，所有的[This.GetSpeciesNamePlural]现在还能在现有集体渠道之外交流。
excerpt.en:
All [This.GetSpeciesNamePlural] throughout the galaxy have undergone a great change. Whereas before their latent psionic power had only emerged in a small minority, the entirety of their kind has now unlocked its full psionic potential.

Aside from displaying

excerpt.zh:
深空通讯阵列获取了从[curator_system.GetName]星系的策展人城邦发来的简短的自动悲报。通讯在几分钟之后停止，长距探测器确认了远古空间站被摧毁。

发动此次袭击的势力尚不明确。
excerpt.en: Deep space communication arrays picked up a brief automated distress call from the Curator station in the [curator_system.GetName] system. The transmission ceased after just a few minutes, and long-range recon probes have confirmed that the ancient space stati

excerpt.zh: 位于[trader_system.GetName]星系的雪拉企业的总部最近被摧毁了。 根据我们的情报，这次行动是由我们尚未知晓的势力进行的。 少数幸存的董事会成员已宣布破产，该公司的剩余资产正在进行清算。
excerpt.en: The corporate headquarters of XuraCorp in the [trader_system.GetName] system was recently destroyed. According to our intel, this act was perpetrated by forces as yet unknown to us. The few surviving board members have declared bankruptcy, and the corporation'

excerpt.zh: 属于里甘商业交易所的恒星基地在[trader_system.GetName]星系被毁。这个自由前哨已经为星际文明之间的贸易提供便利超过一个千年，但如今已不复存在。 袭击者的来路不明。
excerpt.en: The starbase belonging to the Riggan Commerce Exchange has been destroyed in the [trader_system.GetName] system. This free outpost had facilitated trade between interstellar civilizations for over a millennium, but no longer. Forces from an unidentified aggres

excerpt.zh: 有报告说位于[trader_system.GetName]星系的穆塔根商人公会的总部被摧毁了。 这些袭击者似乎来自于一个我们尚未知晓的帝国。 存活下来的少数穆塔根商队舰长四散于全星系中。
excerpt.en: Reports are coming in that the headquarters of the Muutagan Merchant Guild in the [trader_system.GetName] system has been pulverized. The attackers appear to hail from an empire which is, as yet, unknown to us. The few surviving Muutagan merchant captains have

excerpt.zh: 我们从艺术家联盟收到了一条信息。他们的一座空间站被摧毁了！
excerpt.en: We have received a transmission from the Artisan Troupe. One of their stations has been destroyed!

excerpt.zh: 我们收到了一条来自艺术家联盟首席的绝望的求救信息。他们的最后一个空间站与他们的文化都被毁灭殆尽。几乎没有幸存者留下来，艺术家联盟已经不复存在了。
excerpt.en: We received a distress signal from the headmaster of the Artisan Troupe. Their last station and cultural haven has been destroyed. There were few survivors, and the troupe is essentially no more.

excerpt.zh:
自上古之初以至今日，[raider_khanate.GetSpeciesNamePlural]大大小小的部落第一次停下狂热内战，空前团结在一位万汗之汗下。这位统帅以超世之才与坚忍不拔之志，在战士阶级中崭露头角，并最终完成难以置信的统一大业。尽管这些部落不过是由一群狡诈、迷信又好战的物种组成，这位新近加冕的伟大可汗还是赢得了所有[raider_khanate.GetSpeciesName]部落的忠诚与爱戴。

既然他们已经熄灭内斗的烽火，那[raider_khanate.GetSpeciesNamePlural]便会
excerpt.en: For the first time in recorded history, the warring factions of the [raider_khanate.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have united under a single Great Khan. This mysterious warlord, who according to some accounts is a powerful psychic, has emerged from their warrior caste

excerpt.zh:
[great_khan.GetName]，[From.GetName]的大可汗，[great_khan.GetHerHis]自吹自擂称自己是军事天才 ，却在[khan_death_system.GetName]星系遭受了可耻的失败。[great_khan.GetSheHe]指挥的舰队在与[khan_destroyer.GetName]的舰队交战中被击溃时，大可汗和[great_khan.GetHerHis]的侍从们却乘着小型运输机逃进超空间航道四散逃离。.

尽管到现在，[great_khan.GetName]仍在
excerpt.en: In spite of [great_khan.GetHerHis] vaunted military genius, [great_khan.GetName], the Great Khan of the [From.GetName], has met with defeat in the [khan_death_system.GetName] system. When the armada [great_khan.GetSheHe] [great_khan.GetWasWere] commanding was

excerpt.zh: 尽管在战斗中被击败，大可汗仍聚集起另一只舰队，如今甚至正在回归前线。
excerpt.en: After having met with defeat in battle, the Great Khan has marshaled yet another fleet and is even now returning to the front lines.

title.en: The Death of the Great Khan

excerpt.zh:
大可汗[great_khan.GetName]死了。[great_khan.GetHerHis]的舰队在[khan_death_system.GetName]星系遭遇了第二次失败，在舰队被[khan_destroyer.GetName]击败后，大可汗没有尝试逃跑，而是决心与[great_khan.GetHerHis]的旗舰一同赴死.

随着他们敬爱领袖的死去，[From.GetName]再度掀起一场争权夺利的腥风血雨。大可汗手下的军阀们正兵戎相见，只为争夺[great_khan.GetHerHis]的遗产————帝
excerpt.en: Great Khan [great_khan.GetName] is dead. After [great_khan.GetHerHis] armada met with defeat a second time in the [khan_death_system.GetName] system, the Great Khan made no attempt to escape [great_khan.GetHerHis] flagship when it was destroyed in battle by th

title.en: The Death of the Great Khan

excerpt.zh:
[raider_khanate.GetName]的大可汗[great_khan.GetName]死了！具体细节尚不明朗，但我们截获到的信息显示，大可汗是被[great_khan.GetHerHis]手下一位有野心的领主毒杀而死。

随着他们敬爱领袖的死去，[raider_khanate.GetName]再度掀起一场争权夺利的腥风血雨。大可汗手下的领主刀兵相见，只为争夺[great_khan.GetHerHis]的遗产————帝国的继承权。究竟谁能笑到最后还未可知。
excerpt.en: Great Khan [great_khan.GetName] of the [raider_khanate.GetName] is dead! Details are scarce at this point, but intercepted communications indicate that the Great Khan was poisoned by one of [great_khan.GetHerHis] more ambitious warlords in an attempted coup.

excerpt.zh:
近期，一个处于[awakened_horde.GetName]控制下的太空居所被摧毁，这直接导致[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]历史上破天荒地团结在一位大可汗的统治之下。这位神秘的军阀以超群之才，据传是一位力量强大的灵媒，说服了[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]各族搁置争议，谋求生存。

庞大的战舰从先前隐藏的锚地中徐徐驶出，载满了[From.GetSpeciesName]的狂热战士。在大可汗的领导与鼓舞之下，他们将替死去的同胞向这片星海发起绝罚。
excerpt.en: The recent destruction of one of their large void dwellings at the hands of the [awakened_horde.GetName] has prompted the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] to unite under a single Great Khan for the first time in history. This mysterious warlord, who according to so

excerpt.zh:
[new_satrapy.GetName]已经归顺了大可汗！他们已成了[raider_khanate.GetName]的辖地，舰队也已解除了敌对状态。

虽然他们还没有正式加入[raider_khanate.GetSpeciesNamePlural]对于星辰大海的伟大征程，但已经承诺为大可汗的战争机器提供资源与人员！
excerpt.en:
The [new_satrapy.GetName] has submitted to the Great Khan! They have been made a Satrapy of the [raider_khanate.GetName], and their fleets are now standing down.

Although they have not officially joined the [raider_khanate.GetSpeciesNamePlural] in their attem

excerpt.zh:
大可汗的逝去导致了[From.GetName]的崩溃。没有了强势的统治者，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]又一次陷入了内斗。帝国在各个继业者，最强大也最有权势的高级军官们，的领导下分为数派。

每一派都自称为星帐的大可汗，不允许任何人的质疑。[From.GetSpeciesName]团结一心的日子走到了尽头。
excerpt.en: The death of the Great Khan has proved the undoing of the [From.GetName]. Without a strong ruler to unite them, the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have succumbed to infighting once more. Their empire has been divided between the Diadochi, the most powerful and in

excerpt.zh:
大可汗去世之前，有很多的改革工作正在进行中，旨在将[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]从一个个松散无序的部族变成一个团结有力的星际帝国。现在大可汗的去世让这所有的改革瞬间消失殆尽。

所有继承大可汗的军阀们都没有对这些改革展现一丝兴趣，而[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]也都回归了以前的掠夺者行事方式。[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]已成一盘散沙。
excerpt.en:
The death of the Great Khan has also proved the killing blow for the many reforms that were instituted by the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] to turn their disorganized marauder clans into a consolidated galactic empire.

None of the warlords who succeeded the Gre

excerpt.zh:
出人意料地，[From.GetSpeciesName]帝国成功挺过了大可汗死后的种种波动。由于新可汗立刻加冕，也完全消灭了大家分道扬镳的念头。

目前来说，重获新生的[From.GetSpeciesName]似乎把重心放在了巩固已有疆土之上，对于新的征程兴趣不大。
excerpt.en: Against all odds, the [From.GetSpeciesName] Horde has managed to weather the turmoil that followed in the wake of the death of the Great Khan. The immediate threat of splintering into different successor states has been largely eliminated with the coronation o

excerpt.zh:
[From.GetName]在大可汗死后陷入的权力斗争终于划上句号。由于[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]在征服的途中见识到了闻所未闻的平等主义思想，一个新成立的民主派系寻求通过星际联邦的方式对帝国政体进行改革。

汗国的前辖地都收到了作为平等个体加入该联邦的邀请，或者他们也可选择不加入并要回完全的独立主权。
excerpt.en: The power struggle that erupted in the [From.GetName] upon the death of the Great Khan has come to an end. A new democratic faction, inspired by egalitarian values that were alien to the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] when they began their war of conquest, now se

excerpt.zh: [marauder_mercenary_country.GetSpeciesName]现在有雇佣兵可供雇佣。
excerpt.en: [marauder_mercenary_country.GetSpeciesName] mercenaries are now available for hire.

excerpt.zh: [marauder_mercenary_country.GetSpeciesName]现在有雇佣兵可供雇佣。
excerpt.en: [marauder_mercenary_country.GetSpeciesName] mercenaries are now available for hire.

excerpt.zh: [marauder_mercenary_country.GetSpeciesName]现在有雇佣兵可供雇佣。
excerpt.en: [marauder_mercenary_country.GetSpeciesName] mercenaries are now available for hire.

excerpt.zh: 我方的几处跟踪站都截获了一种奇怪的亚空间回声。声音来源于其他星系。回声刚开始时较弱，但后来逐渐变强，似乎有什么正在靠近我方星系……
excerpt.en: Several of our tracking stations have picked up peculiar subspace echoes coming from somewhere in intergalactic space. The echoes are faint but getting stronger, and they seem to be approaching our galaxy...

excerpt.zh:
我们在星系际空间探测到的奇怪亚空间回声现已接近我们的星系外缘。在回声主体前进的方向上似乎出现了一系列微小的联络信号，并指向许多的边缘恒星系。

我们已经把这些星系坐标输入状态日志并将持续监控情况发展。
excerpt.en:
The strange subspace echoes we detected in intergalactic space are now approaching the outer rim of our galaxy. Several smaller contacts appear to be racing ahead of the main body of echoes, towards a number of rim systems.

We have entered the positions of th

excerpt.zh:
我们收到的资料显示一些位于星系边缘的恒星系正在被某种入侵势力蹂蹑。这似乎就是我们探测到的，之前不断接近我们星系的亚空间回声本体。

我们现在遭遇到的只是先锋，其主体尚未到来。目前为止，接踵而至的报告都令人十分困惑，入侵者所使用的舰船似乎是由有机质构成，并且入侵者暂未对我们做出任何回应。

我们整个星系或将面对史无前例的入侵。
excerpt.en:
