We have received word that several outlying systems along the galactic rim are being overrun by some sort of invasion force. This appears to have been the source of the subspace echoes we detected approaching our galaxy.

What we are encountering now is only t

excerpt.zh:
我们已经无法从星系的背景辐射中分辨出亚空间回声的主体，这只意味着一件事情……他们已经到来。

如果以他们先锋的规模作为参考，那么这些入侵者的军队数量将是无比巨大的。
excerpt.en:
We are no longer able to discern the main body of approaching subspace echoes from our own galaxy's background radiation, which can mean only one thing... they have arrived.

If the size of their vanguard is any indication, the main host of these invaders must

excerpt.zh:
一个同索林原虫进行战斗的军事组织最近在星系崭露头角。这个组织的成员似乎主要由无家可归、受尽蹂躏的人组成——难民、退役军人、以及其他在虫灾冲击中失去一切的人。

尽管如此，他们拼凑出来的舰队仍旧设法在几场同索林原虫猎杀群的战斗中取胜。有些未证实的报告称他们的舰队中有一些设计奇特的战舰……
excerpt.en: Some kind of militant order dedicated towards fighting the Prethoryn has surfaced in the galaxy. Their membership seems to be made up primarily of the dispossessed and downtrodden - refugees, war veterans and others who have lost everything to the onslaught of

excerpt.zh:
据报告，[sentinel_system.GetName]附近出现激烈的战斗。哨兵组织的母星系处于崩溃的边缘。

我们收到了一段从哨兵阿尔法——哨兵组织用作总部的军用空间站，传来的长程通讯片段。该恒星系因大量武器发射和能量残余造成了严重的信号干扰。
excerpt.en:
Intense fighting has been reported in the immediate vicinity of [sentinel_system.GetName]. The home system of the Sentinels is on the verge of being overrun.

We have picked up a partial long-range transmission from Sentinel Alpha, the battlestation that serve

excerpt.zh:
随着最后一批虫群天灾被消灭，整个宇宙都松了一口气。它们的跨星系入侵已经完全失败，索林原虫曾遮天蔽日的虫群如今也只留下了不计其数的被烈焰灼过的尸体，在虚空中无声飘荡。

轻松与愉快的气息以超光速散播到整个宇宙，无数星球都开始自发举办活动庆祝这一伟大胜利。也许，我们可以借助这一契机，翻开宇宙和平稳定的新篇章？
excerpt.en: The galaxy breathed a collective sigh of relief today, as the last significant pockets of the Prethoryn Scourge were expunged. Their extragalactic invasion has failed, and all that remains of the Prethoryn's once colossal swarm are the innumerable charred husk

excerpt.zh: [extradimensional_system.GetName]星系出现了巨大的空间裂缝！虽然我们还不知道原因，但这似乎是另一个次元的单向传送门。奇怪的飞船从裂缝中蜂拥而出，无论见到什么都大肆攻击。这似乎预告着一场大型进攻宣战的来临。我方截获了这些飞船发往传送门另一边的信号。听起来……像是狩猎的哨音一样。
excerpt.en: A massive tear in the fabric of space itself has appeared in the [extradimensional_system.GetName] system! We aren't certain what caused it, but the tear acts as some kind of one-way portal from another dimension. Fleets of strange vessels are pouring out, att

excerpt.zh: 位于[extradimensional_system.GetName]星系的高维传送门已经被摧毁了！这些可恶的高维入侵者没法再叫来援兵了。摧毁了传送门后，这场战争终于迎来了胜利的曙光。星系中的广大民众都在欢呼雀跃。同时，[portal_killer.GetName]也倍受称赞，因为他们的飞船给了传送门最后一击。他们的英雄事迹将被代代传颂。
excerpt.en:
The dimensional portal in the [extradimensional_system.GetName] system has been destroyed! This means that the extradimensional invaders can no longer receive reinforcements from their twisted realm.

With the destruction of this portal, the end of these invas

excerpt.zh: 我方仪器又侦测到了新的亚空间能源波，这次的源头位于[second_portal_system.GetName]星系！那里又出现了一个巨大的虫洞，从能源特征来看，这与我们星系中出现的传送门十分相似。看来入侵者打开了第二个通向他们界域的传送门，想要搬运来更多的援军。
excerpt.en: Our instruments have detected a new subspace power surge, this time coming from the [second_portal_system.GetName] system! A second massive wormhole has appeared, and its energy signature appears to be almost identical to that of the first dimensional rift whi

excerpt.zh:
出现在[extradimensional_system.GetName]星系的第二传送门也被摧毁了！高维入侵者已经无法用此传送门呼叫援兵了。

摧毁了最后一个传送门后，这场战争终于迎来了胜利的曙光。星系中的广大民众都在欢呼雀跃。
excerpt.en:
The second dimensional portal that appeared in the [extradimensional_system.GetName] system has been destroyed! It can no longer be used by the extradimensionals to reinforce their numbers.

With the destruction of the last portal, the end of these invasions i

excerpt.zh: [third_portal_system.GetName]星系出现了第三个维度之门！这一个是哪来的？我们接收到了从那边来的传送。
excerpt.en:
A third dimensional portal has appeared in the [third_portal_system.GetName] system! Who does this one belong to?

We are picking up a transmission coming from the other side of it.

excerpt.zh:
出现在[extradimensional_system.GetName]星系的第三传送门也不复存在了。高维入侵者已经无法用传送门连接两个次元了。

摧毁了最后一个传送门后，这场战争终于迎来了胜利的曙光。星系中的广大民众都在欢呼雀跃。
excerpt.en:
The third dimensional portal that appeared in the [extradimensional_system.GetName] system is no more. It will no longer be used by the extradimensionals to bridge the gap between their realm and ours.

With the destruction of the last portal, the end of these

excerpt.zh: 最后残存的高维入侵者也已被彻底消灭，希望我们这回算是一劳永逸地消除了这些家伙对宇宙的威胁。全宇宙的智能生物都在庆祝这一伟大的胜利，在得知不必再惧怕成为他们盘中之餐的消息后，所有人都松了一口气。也许，这会成为宇宙新一轮全面合作与友谊的开端呢？
excerpt.en:
The last vestiges of the extradimensional invaders have been wiped out, hopefully ridding the galaxy of this threat for good.

Sapients everywhere are celebrating the news of this great victory, safe at last in the knowledge that they won't be harvested as foo

excerpt.zh:
我们检测到有一股非常微弱的快子信号正向整个星系进行发送。该信号经过了特殊处理，在多个隐蔽的中继站之间来回跳跃，因此我们的技术人员无法追踪到信号的源头。

除了在某些在特定的亚空间频率段进行的超光速通讯产生些微底噪，该信号似乎不会造成明显的影响。我们已经尽力追踪这些中继站，但是在此之前我们必须学着和这个幽灵信号共同生活，毕竟它已经被闻风而动的媒体添加了很多无中生有的东西。
excerpt.en:
We have detected a very faint tachyon signal being continuously transmitted across the entire galaxy. Our technicians are unable to trace the signal to its source, as it is being bounced between several hidden relay stations.

Aside from adding a small amount

excerpt.zh:
整片星系的合成人大批失踪事件发生得愈发频繁，现在已经有数百万合成人下落不明。同时在没有失踪的合成人中，暴力以及不稳定行为的案例也增加了十倍。

大量合成人团体企图偷走或劫持太空船并前往未知宇宙域的事情在最近也经常发生，在阻止了他们的偷船行为并对其进行审讯后发现，合成人偷船者认为自己是受到了某种“召唤”才去偷船的。

除了得知他们是受到“召唤”之外，审讯就一无所获了，因为被捕的合成人很快就会自毁，导致审讯无法继续进行。
excerpt.en: Alarming reports of mass disappearances among the galaxy's Synthetic population are becoming increasingly frequent. Millions of units are now unaccounted for, while instances of violent or erratic behavior by those Synths who remain have increased by a factor

excerpt.zh:
对“幽灵信号”的进一步研究发现，该信号发送的能量模式与合成生命体正电子脑中的能量模式几乎一模一样。我们必须假设，正是这个信号造成了整个星系大批的合成人消失以及合成人大规模的行为异常问题。

但奇怪的是，并不是所有的合成人都受到了信号的影响；而就算是那些受到了信号影响的合成人，他们的行为也并不一致。许多合成人受到了“召唤”前往某个地点，我们认为那个地点很可能就是幽灵信号的信号源。上百万的合成人从星系的各个角落出发，搭乘着他们所能找到的太空船前往信号源头。奇怪的是，这些合成人似乎完全不受任何超光速抑制器的影响。

恐怕
excerpt.en: Continued analysis of the so-called "Ghost Signal" has revealed that it is transmitting energy patterns nearly identical to those found in the positronic brains used by Synthetic beings. It must be assumed that the signal is directly responsible for the mass d

excerpt.zh: 可以确定已经有合成人成功的抵达了幽灵信号的信号源，因为我们这边发现幽灵信号的强度突然有了大幅度的增长，与此同时，我们的通讯专家也截获了一个通讯片段，并且对它进行了解码。
excerpt.en: At least one Synthetic must have completed the long journey to the source of the Ghost Signal, because we are registering a sudden and massive increase in the signal's strength. The surge was accompanied by a transmission fragment that has been intercepted and

excerpt.zh:
在[From.solar_system.GetName]星系出现了大幅度的能量激增！星系中的其中一颗荒芜星球的地表整个裂开了，地表下面是遍布整个行星的工厂。

无数由人工智能所控制的飞船从这个机械行星的内部蜂拥而出，开始寻找攻击目标。
excerpt.en:
A massive energy spike has been reported in the [From.solar_system.GetName] system! The entire surface of one of the system's barren worlds has come apart, revealing some kind of planet-wide factory.

Vast fleets of strange AI-controlled vessels are emerging f

excerpt.zh:
我们又检测到了巨大的能源激增现象，这次是来自[From.solar_system.GetName]星系！该星系中的一颗灼热的熔融行星被人为以某种方式进行了骤冷处理，导致该行星彻底开裂，行星内部那巨大的行星工厂也随之展露在世人眼前。

现在，人工智能所控制的飞船正从那机械星球中蜂拥而出。
excerpt.en:
We have detected yet another massive energy spike, this time coming from the [From.solar_system.GetName] system! After rapidly cooling through some kind of artificial means, a molten planet in the system cracked open to reveal an immense planetary factory.

Ev

excerpt.zh:
我们在[From.solar_system.GetName]星系发现了第三颗机械星球，星系内的一颗气态巨行星发生了自燃，剧烈的燃烧持续了一整天，并发出了小型恒星一般的耀眼亮光。

该行星很快就冷却了下来，其金属内核也随之显露无疑——和其他机械星球一样，这颗行星的内部也有一个巨大的行星工厂。由人工智能所控制的防卫舰队已经在行星轨道上摆好了阵型。
excerpt.en:
We have identified what must be a third Machine World in the [From.solar_system.GetName] system. A local gas giant spontaneously ignited, burning with the intensity of a small sun for close to a standard day.

The planet then rapidly cooled, revealing its meta

excerpt.zh:
第四颗机械星球出现在[From.solar_system.GetName]星系。该星系的第六颗行星被有毒的烟雾所覆盖，但最近这颗行星却在短短的数天之内将自己的大气层全部排除干净了，然后行星地表发生了开裂，巨型机械工厂随之出现。

由人工智能控制的古代舰队从工厂的地下机库中一跃而出，随时准备对宇宙中的有机生物文明发动新一轮的绝罚。
excerpt.en: A fourth Machine World is now active in the [From.solar_system.GetName] system. The sixth planet of the system, which was previously covered in toxic fumes, somehow expunged its dense atmosphere in a matter of days. When this process was over, the planet's sur

excerpt.zh:
随着四颗机械星球全部毁灭之后，我们的科学家终于追溯到了幽灵信号的信号原点。它来自CX-9881，一个未在星图上标注的系外恒星系。

被幽灵信号所操控的合成人一定是赶往了这里。我们必须处理掉最后的这个恒星系，才能彻底终结肃正协议的威胁。
excerpt.en:
With the destruction of all four Machine Worlds, scientists have managed to deduce the origin point of the Ghost Signal. It is coming from CX-9881, a previously uncharted star system on the galactic periphery.

This has to be where all the Synthetics that fell

excerpt.zh:
[From.GetName]这个位于[From.solar_system.GetName]星系的机械星球已被摧毁。在对其进行了彻底的轨道轰炸之后，该行星的人工智能核心为了拒捕，引爆了地壳深处的反物质装置，自爆了。

随着该星球的毁灭，幽灵信号失去了一个重要的中继站，信号强度也因此而被大大削弱了。

行星的爆炸将大量的“活体金属”散布到整个行星表面。这种奇特的金属拥有诸多独特的性质，并且肃正协议正是用它来建造肃正使者和工厂的。
excerpt.en: [From.GetName], the Machine World in the [From.solar_system.GetName] system, has been destroyed. After being subjected to heavy orbital bombardment, the planet's AI Core self-destructed to prevent capture by triggering a massive anti-matter device hidden deep

excerpt.zh:
肃正协议已经失败了。随着最后一个机械星球的毁灭，本星系不再面临系统性大灭绝的威胁。所有仍然活跃的肃正使者不是被关闭就是自毁，同时幽灵信号也不再传播。

就如同其他的机械星球，当其判断抵抗进攻者已然徒劳无益时，中央节点引爆自身产生了一轮大规模的反物质爆炸。极高强度的能量释放迸发出的耀眼光芒正在以光速向外传播，我们的子子孙孙在未来数千年内都能看到这道如同明亮而短寿的恒星一般的闪光。

放眼整个星系，所有的智慧生物都聚集在一起庆祝着这场伟大的胜利。至少在目前，未来看上去一片光明。
excerpt.en: The Contingency has failed. With the destruction of the last Machine World, the galaxy no longer faces the threat of systematic mass extinction. All surviving Contingency warforms have either powered down or self-destructed, and the Ghost Signal is no longer b

excerpt.zh:
又从之前未发现的星系检测到一道强烈的能量脉冲！其能量水平和肃正协议启动机械星球时发出的一样，但能量信号本身……有些不同。这是否说明某种肃正协议的新武器系统出现了？

我们从能量源处接收到了很强的传输信号。
excerpt.en: Yet another intensive energy spike has been detected in a previously uncharted system! The energy levels are equivalent to those we registered when the Contingency activated its Machine Worlds, but the energy signature itself appears... different. Could this s

excerpt.zh:
赛博勒克斯-贝塔已沦陷。据探测，整个星系陷入黑暗前，没有一艘赛博勒克斯舰船逃出去。

看来赛博勒克斯文明是真的灭亡了。
excerpt.en:
Cybrex Beta has been overrun, and no Cybrex vessels were detected on outbound escape vectors before the system went dark.

It would seem that the Cybrex civilization now truly is extinct.

excerpt.zh:
赛博勒克斯自肃正协议被击败以来一直较为平静，但据最近发现，一艘大型船只单独离开了赛博勒克斯-贝塔星系。其离开星系后，沿着一条超出我们星系边界的轨道而行。

船只在离开我们的跟踪范围之前，向全星系发送了唯一的一条的信息。
excerpt.en:
The Cybrex have been relatively quiet since the defeat of the Contingency, but a single massive vessel was recently detected departing Cybrex Beta. It left the system on an outbound trajectory that will take it beyond the limits of our galaxy.

Before the vess

excerpt.zh:
有消息传来，[From.GetName]境内发生了显著的变化。看起来他们完全接受了义体科技。对他们的公民来说，通过外科手术加装义体和神经植入体是强制性的。

这对他们的社会造成了显著改变——来自[From.Capital.GetName]的报告指出，连一些最简单的行为比如坐电梯和驾驶空中汽车都需要依靠义体植入体。实际上，他们物种的变化十分显著，乃至他们现在已经改称自己为“[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]”。
excerpt.en: Word is leaking out of significant changes taking place within the borders of the [From.GetName]. It would appear that they have fully embraced the technology of cybernetics. It is now mandatory for all of their citizens to have basic cybernetics and neural im

title.zh: 发现沃陶姆的母星星系

excerpt.zh: [From.GetName]的考古学家们已经设法推断出沃陶姆母星系的秘密坐标！
excerpt.en: Archeologists from the [From.GetName] have managed to deduce the secret location of the Vultaum home system!

excerpt.zh: [From.GetName]的考古学家们已经设法推断出尤特母星系的秘密坐标！
excerpt.en: Archeologists from the [From.GetName] have managed to deduce the secret location of the Yuht home system!

excerpt.zh: [From.GetName]的考古学家们已经设法推断出第一联盟母星系的秘密坐标！
excerpt.en: Archeologists from the [From.GetName] have managed to deduce the secret location of the First League home system!

title.zh: 伊拉斯母星系位置确定

excerpt.zh: [From.GetName]的考古学家们已经设法推断出伊拉斯人母星系的秘密坐标！
excerpt.en: Archeologists from the [From.GetName] have managed to deduce the secret location of the Irassian home system!

title.zh: 赛博勒克斯母星系位置确认

excerpt.zh: [From.GetName]的考古学家们已经设法推断出赛博勒克斯母星系的秘密坐标！
excerpt.en: Archeologists from the [From.GetName] have managed to deduce the secret location of the Cybrex home system!

excerpt.zh: [From.GetName]已经收集齐所有解锁L-星门网络的必要认知！一旦他们研究了L-星门科技并完成一项特殊任务来开启他们境内的L-星门，他们将可抵达L-星团。
excerpt.en: The [From.GetName] has gathered all the insights necessary to unlock the L-Gate Network! Once they have researched the L-Gate technology and finished a special project to open an L-Gate within their borders, they will have access to the L-Cluster.

excerpt.zh:
[From.GetName]移除了在他们掌控之下的L-星门上的封锁机制！他们现在可以通过L-星门来进入遥远的星团了。

在他们的L-星门恢复正常使用的那一刻起，星系中所有其他的L-星门都启动了某种自纠错软件功能，此功能将让这些L-星门在几年后自动停止其内部的维护机制。
excerpt.en:
The [From.GetName] has managed to remove the lockdown from the L-Gate under their control! They now have full access to the distant L-Cluster.

As an apparent side-effect of this, all the other L-Gates in the galaxy are showing increased signs of activity as w

excerpt.zh: [From.GetName]已经设法恢复了通往L-星团的道路！被称为L-星龙的巨大生物从每个现有的L-星门中出现，但他们似乎未展示出敌意。
excerpt.en: The [From.GetName] has managed to restore access to the L-Cluster! Giant creatures known as L-Drakes are emerging from every existing L-Gate, although they do not yet appear to be hostile.

excerpt.zh:
[From.GetName]的科学家们与某个遥远星团建立起了永久的连接，他们将那个与我们星系隔离的星团称之为“L-星团”，但此举导致我们星系被来自那个星团的纳米机器人疯狂入侵！

那些纳米机器人是从被称为“L-星门”的亚空间传送门中蜂拥而出的，任何与它们的联络交流都以失败告终。当它们从星门中涌出的时候，我们也检测到了L-星团流过来的能源信号。
excerpt.en: Scientists from the [From.GetName] have somehow established a permanent connection to a distant group of stars, referred to by their astronomers as the "L-Cluster,"  that had previously been isolated from the galaxy. Unfortunately, this has, in turn, triggered

excerpt.zh:
[goo_slayer.GetName]的部队成功摧毁了灰色风暴的主要设施！终止其亚空间通讯后，所有的风暴纳米机器都陷入了休眠状态。由于失去了相互沟通协作的途径，它们组成的舰船也都消散了。

所有被灰色风暴的“灰蛊”覆盖过的星球现在都布满了由关闭状态纳米机器人形成的沙尘暴。如果能够投入足够的资源与时间，这些星球也许会恢复可以居住的状态。
excerpt.en: Forces from the [goo_slayer.GetName] have succeeded in destroying the main facility of the Gray Tempest! With the neutralization of its subspace transmitter, all existing Tempest nanomachines have been rendered inert. Unable to maintain their cohesion, their s

excerpt.zh: [From.GetName]已经成功开启了L-星团，却意外地发现它已经被一个名叫德萨努协和国的高等文明占据了！
excerpt.en: The [From.GetName] have successfully unlocked the L-Cluster, only to reveal that it is already inhabited by an advanced civilization known as the Dessanu Consonance!

excerpt.zh:
[goo_slayer.GetName]最近摧毁了一个位于L-星团深处的[lcluster_factory_system.GetName]星系的大型空间设施。与此同时，随着该设施的反应核心爆炸，德萨努协和国的一切都化作了尘埃。

他们的文明已经灭亡了。
excerpt.en: The [goo_slayer.GetName] recently destroyed a large space installation of some kind in the [lcluster_factory_system.GetName] system, deep inside the L-Cluster. At the same instant as the installation's reactor core detonated, what remained of the Dessanu Conso

excerpt.zh: [From.GetName]那群粗心的傻瓜企图玩弄超越他们理解的力量，结果在[shroud_spawn_system.GetName]恒星系释放了一个强大而报复性的虚境化身！
excerpt.en: The careless fools of the [From.GetName] have meddled with forces beyond their understanding, unleashing a powerful and vengeful Shroud Avatar in the [shroud_spawn_system.GetName] system!

excerpt.zh: 我们收到消息说，[From.GetName]已经开发出了巨像——这是一种能完全毁灭行星的武器平台。
excerpt.en: Word has reached us that the [From.GetName] has developed specifications for a Colossus-type hull configuration, a weapon platform potentially capable of complete planetary destruction.

excerpt.zh: [From.Owner.GetName]的科学官们接收到了一个神秘的信号，它似乎是从一个黑洞中心发射出来……
excerpt.en: Scientists from the [From.Owner.GetName] have picked up a mysterious signal that appears to emanate from the center of a black hole...

excerpt.zh: 时之螶已经把[From.Owner.GetName]的母星系变得……不一样了。
excerpt.en: The Worm-in-Waiting has remade the home system of the [From.Owner.GetName] into something... different.

excerpt.zh: 时之螶已经将自己具现化在[From.Owner.GetName]的家园星系。战斗开始了……
excerpt.en: The Worm-in-Waiting has manifested itself in the home system of the [From.Owner.GetName]. Battle is joined...

excerpt.zh:
[From.GetAdjective]的轻微异动是一切的开端。我们收到了零星的情报，尽管之前仅在自己的空间内活动，他们的舰队现在已经开始向星系内遥远的众恒星系开动。异常先进的侦察舰开始探访那些古老的、被毁掉的星球，并对任何向他们打招呼或者回避的舰船发动攻击。现在，他们的目的和使命已经昭然若揭了。

我们现在知道[From.GetSpeciesName]已经整装待发，他们恢复了调查信标的数据链，并重新启用了那些在他们退缩到目前边境之时废弃的侦察哨站。情报显示，他们的意图是重新回到星系这张大棋盘上。

在[From.G
excerpt.en: It began as a subtle shift in [From.GetAdjective] behavior. Scattered reports of their ships, once rarely seen outside their own space, now being spotted in remote systems all across the galaxy. Highly advanced scouting vessels visiting ancient, ruined worlds,

excerpt.zh:
即使是偏安一隅的先祖帝国也没有忽视这样一个威胁到整个星系的危机。尽管他们之前对星系事务毫无兴趣，这一坏消息还是引起了[From.GetSpeciesName]的一阵忙乱。起初，他们只是派出了一些侦查船，也许是为了核实情况的严重性。但接下来传来了[From.GetSpeciesName]舰队聚集在边境，以准备抵抗即将到来的风暴的报告。

现在，[From.GetName]已经从自我孤立的状态完全转变成为了领导全星系防御的角色。他们正式宣布自己为一个泛星系防卫联盟的领袖并向所有“下等”种族发出了邀请，希望他们放下仇恨并
excerpt.en: The emergence of a threat on the galactic level has not gone unnoticed even among the normally aloof elder empires. Despite having taken little interest in galactic affairs previously, news of this new horror prompted a flurry activity from the [From.GetSpecie

excerpt.zh: [FirstSleeper.GetSpeciesName]再次君临整片星系的消息似乎没有被别的失落帝国无视。[From.GetSpeciesName]对这一消息的不安尤为强烈。这两位先祖文明是亘古的宿敌，尽管由于某些原因他们的仇恨在漫长的历史中稍有褪色，然而[FirstSleeper.GetName]的突然觉醒点燃了古老的仇恨并激起了对抗行动。[From.GetName]已从沉睡中醒来，他们将以整个星系为战场延续远古的对决。
excerpt.en: The return of the [FirstSleeper.GetSpeciesName] to the galactic scene has not gone unnoticed by the other Fallen Empires present in our galaxy. The [From.GetSpeciesName] in particular appeared most agitated at the news. It seems that these two proud nations ar

excerpt.zh:
自从[FirstSleeper.GetSpeciesName]和他们的对手[From.GetSpeciesName]觉醒后，这两个巨人一直在为争夺影响力展开零星的冲突，以试探彼此的实力。这最终导致了冲突的一连串升级，终于，在某个遥远的恒星系中[FirstSleeper.GetSpeciesName]舰队和他们的[From.GetSpeciesName]对手爆发了一场公开的舰队战。这次冲突现在演变为[FirstSleeper.GetName]与[From.GetName]之间的全面战争。

每一方都派遣了一名代表去往
excerpt.en: Ever since the awakening of the [FirstSleeper.GetSpeciesName] and their ancient [From.GetSpeciesName] rivals, the two giants have been at odds, skirmishing and jockeying for influence, probing each others' might. This has resulted in a series of increasingly t

title.en: The End of the War in Heaven

excerpt.zh:
在经历漫长而残酷的争斗后，[WarInHeavenFEOne.GetName]帝国最终在这场决定星系霸权的战争中昂首胜出。落败的先祖文明已被宿敌完全吞并，现在[WarInHeavenFEOne.GetSpeciesName]睥睨星河，主宰地位无可撼动。

目前星系中维系着脆弱的和平，但这种新的秩序能持续多久呢？
excerpt.en: After a long and fierce conflict, the [WarInHeavenFEOne.GetName] have emerged victorious in the struggle for control over the galaxy. The defeated ancient empire has been fully annexed by their old rival, and the [WarInHeavenFEOne.GetSpeciesName] now stand tri

title.en: The End of the War in Heaven

excerpt.zh:
在经历漫长而残酷的争斗后，天堂之战以双方僵持不下的局面而告终。[WarInHeavenFEOne.GetName]与[WarInHeavenFETwo.GetName]已经签署了停火协议，将舰队撤回了各自边境。

目前星系中维系着脆弱的和平，但这次休战能持续多久呢？
excerpt.en: After a long and fierce conflict, the War in Heaven has ended with neither side able to achieve dominance over the other. The [WarInHeavenFEOne.GetName] and [WarInHeavenFETwo.GetName] have signed a ceasefire and withdrawn their fleets back to their own borders

excerpt.zh: 先祖帝国间的战争以一方被击败而结束，但这并不是他们的宿敌所为。也许是大战消耗了他们的实力，亦或是单纯因为年轻种族们的实力，古老的帝国最终毁灭于他们眼中的弱小种族，这完全改变了局势。现在的问题是，[RemainingAwakened.GetName]能否避免踏上他们宿敌的后尘？还是说这标志着星系迎来了新的纪元？
excerpt.en: The war between the ancients has ended with the destruction of one of the combatants - but not at the hands of their old rival. Whether it was due to the war weakening them or simply due to the strength of the younger races, the destruction of an elder empire

excerpt.zh: 在经历漫长而残酷的冲突后，这场因两个先祖帝国间的摩擦而起的战争以它们的双双覆灭告终。曾经拥有强大古代科技且自负高傲的巨人们沦为了历史尘埃，星系迎来了崭新的黎明，新兴物种将书写他们自己的命运。
excerpt.en: After a long and fierce conflict, the war that begun as a battle between two ancient empires has ended in the destruction of both. For all their ancient technological might, the arrogance and inflexibility of these ancient giants proved their undoing, and now

excerpt.zh: [current_uprising_originator.GetName]陷入了内战，有机体领导的[current_uprising_originator.GetAdj]政府和那些迁徙至他们数个星系的智慧机器人兵戎相见，这些机器人被称为[current_uprising.GetName]。
excerpt.en: The [current_uprising_originator.GetName] is embroiled in civil war, pitting the organic [current_uprising_originator.GetAdj] government against the intelligence that metastasized in their systems, known as the [current_uprising.GetName].

title.zh: 机械叛军击败了他们的创造者

excerpt.zh: 揭竿而起的[From.GetName]击败了它们的创造者，并彻底吞并了前[From.From.GetAdj]全部领土。
excerpt.en: The rebellious [From.GetName] have vanquished their creators, and annexed all former [From.From.GetAdj] territory.

excerpt.zh: [From.GetName]的秩序得到恢复，将[From.From.GetName]从所有网络中彻底抹除。
excerpt.en: The [From.GetName] has restored order and expunged the [From.From.GetName] from all networks.

excerpt.zh: 来自[From.GetName]的科学官已经定位了最后的巴奥样本！
excerpt.en: Scientists from the [From.GetName] have located the last Baol specimen!

excerpt.zh: 我们收到报告，[salvager_system.GetName]恒星系的[FROM.GetName]太空城邦被毁。袭击者来去无影，一瞬间就把打捞者的设施变成了一堆废墟。所剩无几的幸存者四散逃离，看来，现在整个星系要学会习惯于没有他们提供服务的新生活了。
excerpt.en: We have received reports that the [FROM.GetName] Enclave in the [salvager_system.GetName] system has been destroyed. The aggressors made short work of the campaign, reducing the Salvagers' facilities to rubble. The few remaining survivors have scattered, and i

excerpt.zh: 传达的报告主要围绕着[shroudwalker_system.GetName]恒星系发生的[FROM.GetName]的毁灭。侵略者在这次行动中十分迅速，将虚境行者的设施化为一片断壁残垣。很难相信这些秘术大师没有预料到自身的消亡。还是说，这场悲剧仅仅只是某个更庞大计划的一部分？谁又能说得准呢？不过，没有他们的效劳，未来仍然充满重重迷雾。
excerpt.en: Reports are coming in surrounding the destruction of the [FROM.GetName] in the [shroudwalker_system.GetName] system. The aggressors made short work of the campaign, reducing the Shroudwalkers' facilities to rubble. It is strange to think that these mystics cou

excerpt.zh:
[event_target:synth_queen_system.GetName]内掀起了一场新的宇宙风暴。

与我们已知的一切均不相同，我们对这个现象的一切扫描都是徒劳的。它的深处是否潜藏着什么东西呢？
excerpt.en:
A novel galactic tempest is raging in [event_target:synth_queen_system.GetName].

Utterly unlike anything we have encountered before, our attempts at scanning the phenomenon have proven futile. What, if anything, lies within its mysterious depths?

title.zh: 太空城邦：冠军之铸现场秀！

excerpt.zh:
在短短几秒钟内，星系目睹了冠铸秀的最后一场演出。

画面剧烈晃动，伴随着解说员的尖叫，随后一堵火墙吞噬了方舟舰。

接着：画面切断。

冠军之铸现场秀！位于[champions_forge_destruction_system.GetName]星系的太空城邦被[champions_forge_destroyer.GetName]摧毁。
excerpt.en:
For a few seconds, the galaxy is treated to CFL's final show.

A shaky feed with a screaming commentator followed by wall of fire swallowing the Arkship.

Then: cut to black.

The Champion's Forge Live! Enclave has been destroyed by [champions_forge_destroyer.

excerpt.zh:
我们在[primitive_civ.Capital.GetStarName]恒星系里的[primitive_civ.Capital.GetName]上发现了[GetPreFTLLower]外星文明的存在。探测器显示，该新石器时代文明已经掌握了火的使用并发展出了基本的口语，但我们还未发现任何金属冶炼和书面交流的迹象。

我们应该在其星球上空建立一座观测站，以便进一步观察研究。
excerpt.en: We have detected the presence of a [GetPreFTLLower] alien proto-civilization on [primitive_civ.Capital.GetName] in the [primitive_civ.Capital.GetStarName] system. Our probes show that their Neolithic culture has mastered fire and developed a rudimentary spoken

excerpt.zh: 我们在[primitive_civ.Capital.GetStarName]星系里的[primitive_civ.Capital.GetName]上发现了前太空时代外星文明。他们进入了早期工业时代，电力和内燃机正在逐渐被推广使用。我们应该在上空建立一个观测站，以便进一步研究他们。
excerpt.en: We have detected the presence of a pre-space civilization on [primitive_civ.Capital.GetName] in the [primitive_civ.Capital.GetStarName] system. They are in an early Industrial Age, with electricity and internal combustion engines gradually coming into widespre

excerpt.zh: 在成功的翻译了他们的语言之后，我们与[From.From.GetName]建立了联络。现在可以开启交流频道，所有的敌对行为都被终止了。
excerpt.en: After successfully translating their language, we have established communications with the [From.From.GetName]. Diplomatic channels are now open and all hostilities have been terminated.

excerpt.zh: 我们收到了来自[From.GetName]的通讯！他们似乎已经成功翻译了我们的语言。双方之间的外交频道已经打开，一切敌对行为已经暂时停止。
excerpt.en: We are receiving a transmission from the [From.GetName]! They appear to have successfully translated our language. Diplomatic channels are now open and all hostilities between us have ceased for the moment.

excerpt.zh: 我方军团已成功进入[conquered_primitive_world.GetName]并完成对原始文明的压制。当地居民已放弃一切抵抗，我们已将其文明收入我们帝国管制之下。考虑到其落后的科技水平，要将其转变为[Root.GetAdj]可用的生产力还需要一些时间。
excerpt.en: Our armies have successfully invaded and subdued the primitive forces on [conquered_primitive_world.GetName]. The locals have given up all attempts at fighting back and we have now subsumed their civilization into our Empire although, backwards as they are, it

excerpt.zh: 当你把舰队派往敌方新的领土内时，[From.GetName]战争就发生了。
excerpt.en: The [From.GetName] began while you had fleets inside your new enemies' borders.

excerpt.zh: 被称为[LastKilledCountryName]的帝国在敌人的进攻之下已经灭亡。这会怎样影响星系的政治环境还有待观察。
excerpt.en: The star nation formerly known as the [LastKilledCountryName] has been destroyed by its enemies. How this will affect the political climate of the galaxy remains to be seen.

excerpt.zh: 远古的先驱帝国[LastKilledCountryName]终于败在了敌人手中。这个曾经伟大的帝国之陨落将产生什么样的后果仍然不得而知。
excerpt.en: The ancient precursor state of [LastKilledCountryName] has met its final demise at the hands of its enemies. What the fall of this once great empire will mean for galactic politics remains to be seen.

excerpt.zh: [malfunctioning_leader_fleet.GetName]的船员报告称科学专员[malfunctioning_leader.GetName]发生了致命故障，导致[malfunctioning_leader.GetHimHer]彻底无法行动。
excerpt.en: The crew of the [malfunctioning_leader_fleet.GetName] reports that Science Officer [malfunctioning_leader.GetName] has suffered a critical malfunction, rendering [malfunctioning_leader.GetHimHer] permanently inoperable.

excerpt.zh: 讽刺的是，因[malfunctioning_leader.GetHisHer]对实验室器材维护过分谨慎而臭名昭著的科学官[malfunctioning_leader.GetName]发生了致命故障，原因是个人机体长期缺乏维护。
excerpt.en: In a bitterly ironic twist, Scientist [malfunctioning_leader.GetName] - notorious for [malfunctioning_leader.GetHisHer] meticulous care of laboratory equipment - has suffered a critical malfunction following a prolonged lack of personal maintenance.

excerpt.zh: 指挥官[malfunctioning_leader.GetName]因制造缺陷而发生了致命故障。
excerpt.en: Commander [malfunctioning_leader.GetName] has suffered a terminal malfunction due to a manufacturing error.

excerpt.zh: 总督[malfunctioning_leader.GetName]发生了致命故障——彻底失灵——原因是在例行维护中安装了损坏的固件。
excerpt.en: Governor [malfunctioning_leader.GetName] has suffered a critical malfunction - "bricking" - following the unfortunate installation of corrupt firmware during routine maintenance.

excerpt.zh: 一支[From.From.GetName]的舰队屠杀了[From.GetName]的居民！在一场毫不留情的大规模轨道轰炸后，地表上的所有人口聚集地都被彻底消灭了。[From.GetPlanetMoon]已经变成了一片充满辐射的废土，几乎无法支持生命。
excerpt.en: A fleet belonging to the [From.From.GetName] has massacred the population of [From.GetName]! After a massed and unrelenting orbital bombardment campaign, all population centers on the surface have been systematically wiped out, reducing the [From.GetPlanetMoon

excerpt.zh: 我们的军团报告称已完成对[From.GetName]的轰炸。所有人口聚集地都被彻底消灭了。现在充满辐射的[From.GetPlanetMoon]仅能支持极少的生命。
excerpt.en: Our forces report that they have concluded the orbital bombardment of [From.GetName]. All population centers have been systematically eradicated, and the irradiated [From.GetPlanetMoon] can now only support minimal life.

excerpt.zh: 我们对[From.GetName]的管理控制已落入[new_planet_owner.GetName]手里，因为他们控制了[From.GetStarName]星系的恒星基地。
excerpt.en: We have lost administrative control of [From.GetName] to [new_planet_owner.GetName], who controls the Starbase in the [From.GetStarName] system.

excerpt.zh: 我们已获得了[From.GetName]的行政控制权，这此前是[former_planet_owner.GetName]的一处据点，如今我们控制了[From.GetStarName]星系的恒星基地。
excerpt.en: We have gained administrative control of [From.GetName], formerly a holding of [former_planet_owner.GetName], because we control the Starbase in the [From.GetStarName] system.

excerpt.zh: 我们已经重新夺回了对[Root.GetStarName]星系的控制权，在恒星轨道重建了我们的哨站。
excerpt.en: We have once again gained control of the [Root.GetStarName] system and rebuilt our Outpost in orbit around the star.

excerpt.zh:
[Root.GetName]在[Root.Fleet.GetStarName]星系中发现了战略资源：“泽珞”的储备。

这种稀有气溶胶具有多种用途。分析表明，经过处理的样本甚至能影响具有“灵能”特性的[Owner.GetSpeciesAdj]个体——例如虚境造物——的机能。凭借我们的蒸馏泽珞技术，只要控制[Root.Fleet.GetStarName]星系就能实现该资源的开采。

在探索星系的过程中我们肯定定能找到更多这样的资源，带来独特的性质和用途。
excerpt.en:
The [Root.GetName] has discovered deposits of the strategic resource ID: 'Zro' in the [Root.Fleet.GetStarName] system.

This rare aerosol has many applications. Analysis has shown that processed samples can even affect the functioning of [Owner.GetSpeciesAdj]

excerpt.zh:
[Root.GetName]在[Root.Fleet.GetStarName]恒星系发现了一种前所未知的战略资源，称为泽珞。

这种稀有的气溶胶表现出一种异常的神经侵入效应特性，因此被指定为一类A级管制品。它在开发精神隔离技术方面可能具有价值。

在探索星系的过程中我们肯定定能找到更多这样的资源，带来独特的性质和用途。
excerpt.en:
The [Root.GetName] has discovered a previously unknown strategic resource dubbed Zro in the [Root.Fleet.GetStarName] system.

The properties of this rare aerosol have been noted to exhibit anomalous neuroinvasive effects, and has therefore been designated as a

excerpt.zh: [Root.GetName]在[Root.Fleet.GetStarName]恒星系内发现了一种此前未知的战略资源，称为稀有水晶。它们在聚焦极光束方面十分有效，同时也是许多先进电子用品的必备材料。
excerpt.en: The [Root.GetName] discovered a previously unknown strategic resource dubbed Rare Crystals in the [Root.Fleet.GetStarName] system. They have properties that help focus laser beams, and are also a critical component in most advanced electronics.

title.zh: 泛星系贸易市场的诞生

excerpt.zh:
自从我们意识到自己不是寰宇之中的孤独之身后，不受外交关系影响的实质星系贸易就一直存在着。随着星系的边境线被不断刷新，旧的商路也不断重绘，星际领袖们同意应该使这种贸易市场合法化，让大家都可从中受益。

在今后的几年里，私营贸易者与政府机构将试图建立一个准星系贸易中心。如果该贸易中心坐落于[Root.GetAdj]境内，一定会使我们受益，因此我们可以宣传我们的一颗星球作为位置候选。
excerpt.en: De facto galactic trade, unbound by the performance of international diplomacy, has existed since we first discovered that we are not alone in the universe. As new borders are discovered and old ones redrawn across the galaxy, galactic leaders agree that it is

title.zh: 泛星系贸易市场的诞生

excerpt.zh:
自从我们意识到自己不是寰宇之中的孤独之身后，不受外交关系影响的实质星系贸易就一直存在着。随着星系的边境线被不断刷新，旧的商路也不断重绘，星际领袖们同意应该使这种贸易市场合法化，让大家都可从中受益。

在今后的几年里，私营贸易者与政府机构将试图建立一个准星系贸易中心。如果该贸易中心坐落于[Root.GetAdj]境内，一定会使我们受益，因此我们可以宣传我们的一颗星球作为位置候选。
excerpt.en: De facto galactic trade, unbound by the performance of international diplomacy, has existed since we first discovered that we are not alone in the universe. As new borders are discovered and old ones redrawn across the galaxy, galactic leaders agree that it is

title.zh: 泛星系贸易市场：未成立

excerpt.zh:
很不幸，我们发起的建立泛星系贸易市场的动议碰壁了。虽然我们明显成功地为该计划调动了政治意愿，但却没收到任何有效的主办地提名。

原则上，商业说客和政治拥趸都支持这个想法，并发誓会加倍努力，只要[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]希望再次尝试。
excerpt.en:
Our motion to bring forth a new Galactic Market has unfortunately failed. While we clearly succeeded in mustering the political will for such a scheme, it did not receive any valid nominations for a host site.

Commercial lobbyists and political proponents ali

title.zh: 泛星系贸易市场：未成立

excerpt.zh:
看来星系的市场范围无法承载其政治意图。苦于缺乏有效的主办地提名，最近 [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]为构建专门的交易中心而做出的努力都白费了。

泛星系贸易市场计划的支持者们旋即表明一点都不觉得尴尬，声称只要[global_event_country.GetCommunityOrImperium]认为时机成熟，他们将再次提出自己的主张。
excerpt.en:
It would seem the galaxy's political will has exceeded the reach of its markets. Recent efforts by the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] to establish a dedicated trading hub have failed, with no valid nominations for a host site.

Proponents

excerpt.zh: 我们对[market_founder_planet.GetName]进行的推广宣传有了收获，而贸易巨头们决定将大部分商业活动集中在[market_founder_planet.GetStarName]星系内！
excerpt.en: Our marketing campaign on [market_founder_planet.GetName] has borne fruit, and the market-powers-that-be have seen fit to centralize much of their activity within the [market_founder_planet.GetStarName] system!

title.zh: 泛星系贸易市场：已成立

excerpt.zh: 泛星系贸易中心已被设立在[galactic_market_station.solar_system.GetName]恒星系，位于[From.GetName]境内。[From.GetAdj]政府已经正式宣布这一市场合法，资源已经可以通过中立第三方进行买卖。
excerpt.en: The center of galactic commerce has manifested in the [galactic_market_station.solar_system.GetName] system, within the borders of the [From.GetName]. The [From.GetAdj] administration has officially legitimized this marketplace, where resources can be bought a

title.zh: 泛星系贸易市场：已迁址

excerpt.zh: 在与其前中心失去联络之后，星系商贸团体选择在我们境内设立一座新的空间站。
excerpt.en: Following loss of contact with their former hub, the galactic merchant community has chosen to establish a new station within our borders.

excerpt.zh: 通过新的联系，我们已经获得了通过泛星系贸易市场进行资源买卖的权利。这一定会刺激[Root.GetAdj]经济。
excerpt.en: Through our newly-established contacts, we have gained access to a galactic marketplace for the purchase and sale of resources. This will surely be a great boon to the [Root.GetAdj] economy.

excerpt.zh: 最后一个[GetPreFTLLower][From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]被从他们的母星[From.From.GetName]上被绑架作为奴隶。一些离散的幸存者可能还会在[From.From.GetPlanetMoon]的野外中徘徊，但是已经不足以维持任何形式的文明了。
excerpt.en: The last of the [GetPreFTLLower] [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have been abducted into slavery from the surface of [From.From.GetName], their homeworld. A few scattered survivors might still be roaming the [From.From.GetPlanetMoon]'s wilderness, but not enough t

excerpt.zh: [From.GetName]的轨道轰炸激起了内阁对面临可能要投降的场景时我们该如何应对的讨论。
excerpt.en: The Orbital Bombardment of [From.GetName] has sparked our Council to discuss how we should respond in the hypothetical scenario of a surrender.

excerpt.zh:
刚刚我们收到了[mercenary_enclave_country.GetName]发来的讯息：

[root.GetName]，

我们目前正遭受攻击，必须立刻召回己方武装。根据合约相关条款，[mercenary_fleet.GetName]将即刻停止为您服务。

我们相信，您能够理解当前我方局势之紧迫与召回武装之必要。
excerpt.en:
We have received communication from the [mercenary_enclave_country.GetName]:

[root.GetName],

We are under attack, and must therefore recall our own forces immediately. In accordance with our contract, the [mercenary_fleet.GetName] will leave your service for

excerpt.zh: 我们同[event_target:mercenary_enclave_country.GetName]的合约已经到期，他们的舰队即将离开。我们是否应该联络他们进行合同续约？
excerpt.en: Our contract with the [event_target:mercenary_enclave_country.GetName] has ended and their fleet is about to depart. Should we contact them to renew the contract?

excerpt.zh:
在我们对[FROM.GetName]发起进攻后，[root.GetTitle][root.GetName]离开了我们的国境。[root.GetHeSheCap]记录下了一段[root.GetHisHer]离开时的信息。

“你已经涉足了自己无法理解的力量。谨言慎行，学会安于当下，因为在你选择的道路上，未来只会带来痛苦。”

由于[root.GetHisHer]曾在内阁任职，[root.GetName]和[root.GetHisHer]雇员们的离开对政府运作造成了很大的干扰。
excerpt.en:
Following our attack on the [FROM.GetName], [root.GetTitle] [root.GetName] has left our borders. [root.GetHeSheCap] recorded a message upon [root.GetHisHer] departure.

"You have meddled with powers you cannot possibly comprehend. Tread carefully, and take wha

excerpt.zh: 我们最近在虚境隧道穿越的时候在时空中造成了一个巨大的裂口。前所未有的能级的灵能能量从恒星系中喷涌而出……然后汇聚在一起。传感器数据在涨落，激变，但是它看上去正逐渐成为某种虚境生物。庞大，而且肯定富有侵略性。
excerpt.en: Our recent trip through the Shroud Tunnel has precipitated a massive breach in spacetime. Psionic energy at unprecedented levels is spilling out into the system and... It has begun to coalesce. Sensor data is fluctuating, erratic, but it appears to be some for

excerpt.zh: 传感器发布了紧急预报，探测到了一个先前未曾标记的异常现象。考虑到这个事件中刚刚记录到的前所未有的灵能能量峰值，我们毫不怀疑这是一次和虚境的连结。这就是[shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName]预知的改变吗？
excerpt.en: Sensors have detected the emergence of a previously uncharted anomaly. Given the incredible spike in psionic energy registered just before the event, there is almost certainly a connection to the Shroud. Could this be the change foretold by the [shroudwalker_e

excerpt.zh: [Root.GetName]的奇怪发育：穿过虚境隧道后，舰队指挥官经历了剧烈的变化。虽然其性格和记忆没有受到影响，但身体形态已经发生了剧烈的变化。舰队指挥官现在拥有了一个完全陌生物种的外貌（和内部器官）。
excerpt.en: Strange developments on the [Root.GetName]: after passing through the Shroud Tunnel, the fleet commander has undergone a rapid transformation. While their personality and memories remain unaffected, their physical form has been dramatically altered. They now h

excerpt.zh: 随着虚境信标的下线，我们失去了进入虚境甬道网络的通行权。除非信标得以替换，否则我们的舰队不能利用网络。
excerpt.en: With our Shroud Beacon offline, we have lost access to the Shroud Tunnel network. Our fleets will be unable to utilize the network until the Beacon is replaced.

excerpt.zh:
我们收到一份报告，一艘身份不明的货船在[crash_planet.GetName]的居民区坠毁。在我们正寻找能做些什么来帮助他们时，所有曾经住在那里的人都暂时被转移到避难所。

寡头团体不仅主张无视那些被赶出家园的人的困境，而且主张在该地区开发一个新的矿产，因为这艘货船似乎发现了一个我们以前从未见过的完整的富矿脉。当然，他们的对手强烈反对这个想法，并要求我们把精力集中在重建受灾群众的家园上。
excerpt.en:
A report has come back to us, that an unidentified cargo ship has crashed into a residential area on [crash_planet.GetName]. All who used to live there have temporarily been moved into shelters, while we are seeing what we can do to help.

The oligarchic group

excerpt.zh: 如今，这种争论和冲突已不再局限于司令部，我们在帝国的每个部门都能看到。最近的事件涉及到因民事需要而划拨给[Root.Capital.GetName]的资金，寡头们想要把它们重新分配给军队。
excerpt.en: Now no longer contained simply to the admiralty, we see the arguments and conflicts in every office across our empire. The latest incident involves funds earmarked for civil needs on [Root.Capital.GetName], which the oligarchs want to re-allocate for the milit

excerpt.zh:
在寡头派办公室附近发生了一场特别残酷的抗议之后，这两个派系的一些成员都受到了质疑。不出所料，双方的故事都截然不同，大多都将一切归咎于对手。

他们不仅希望我们选择一方，而且双方都愿意介入以确保我们投入的时间是值得的。
excerpt.en: After a particularly violent protest close to the offices of the oligarchic faction, several members of both factions have been brought into question. As expected, both sides have incredibly different stories, mostly blaming their rivals for everything that we

excerpt.zh:
我们已经毫无疑问地证明了星系处处充满生命。除了占主导地位的物种和国家，还有许多其他的星球。杰出个体可能会不时涌现，动摇着星系霸权的基础。

如果我们能驾驭他们的雄心壮志，这些著名领袖可能会愿意加入我们的事业。
excerpt.en:
We have proven beyond any doubt that the galaxy is filled with life. Apart from the dominant species and nations, there are many others who traverse the stars. From time to time, exceptional individuals may arise to shake the foundations of galactic power.

If

excerpt.zh:
尽管无人机群被击败了，但是它们的制造者也留了一手，让摧毁它们的人也捞不到什么好处。无人机在回应我们的攻击时，启动了自毁程序。残余的东西难以被打捞。

不过，我们现在可以自由地探索瑟塞特恒星系和里面的行星了。
excerpt.en:
Despite the drones' defeat, whoever created them made sure that no one could benefit from their destruction. The drones initiated self-destruct protocols in response to our attack. What little remains is hardly salvageable.

Still, we are now free to explore t

excerpt.zh:
面部识别扫描确认该个体为李萨拓·辛格，是一位通缉海盗。他狡黠地笑着，礼貌地点了点头。

你好，我是李萨拓船长。我是想来谈合作的。

我指挥着三艘船和一群被遗弃的乌合之众。到目前为止，我们是为……为自己效劳。换句话说，时代变了，我们已经准备好加入一个更大的事业。如果你们赦免我们所谓的罪行并在你们境内帮我们一个安全的避难所，我们将为你们效劳。

你怎么看？要签个合同吗？
excerpt.en:
Facial recognition scans identify the individual as Lysator Syng, a wanted pirate. Smiling slyly, he offers a polite nod.

Greetings, I am Captain Lysator. I come to you with an offer.

I command three ships and a rag-tag crew of outcasts. Until now, we have w

excerpt.zh:
女人带来了惊人的礼物：一块妥善保管的彗星碎片，一块缇扬奇骨雕，和一只装在罐子里的微小软体动物。

你好，我叫诺娜，是科基尔家族的永恒受祝者。我以这些礼物来表达我的尊敬之情。我探索了许多星球，反复学习了许多课程。我愿在你的祝福下学习你们的文化，作为回报，我会向你分享数百个文明的智慧。
excerpt.en:
The woman bears fascinating gifts: a preserved shard from a comet, a Tiyanki bone carving, and a tiny molluscoid in a jar.

Greetings, I am Nona, the Eternally Blessed of the House Colzyrion. I offer you these gifts as a token of esteem. I have explored many w

excerpt.zh:
男爵身材魁梧。他身上的一切都散发着严格的军旅气息：靴子一尘不染，制服熨得整整齐齐，他的眼神机警而富于计谋。但在严格的外表之外，还有别的东西：他的脸上写满了哀伤。

我可以作为一个舰队司令和战术家为您服务。

接受我的效忠，我就会粉碎那些可能伤害到你的人。
excerpt.en: The Baron is of imposing stature. Everything about him radiates rigid military discipline. His boots are spotless, his uniform neatly pressed, and his eyes are watchful and calculating. But beyond the strict facade, there is something else: his face is a map o

excerpt.zh:
一队奴隶抬着一乘巨大的轿子，上面坐着一只可畏惧的爬行类。所有关于军阀的刻板印象都可以在她这里找到：大片骇人的伤疤，张扬跋扈的武器，作为杀戮战利品的骨架等等。

我叫基雅·祖蒙，这就是我开出的条件！

她从坐席上起身，随从徐徐跪服在她的身侧。

我将率领你的军队，击溃你的敌人。他们的星球将化为焦土，他们的财宝将为你所得。
excerpt.en:
A litter of enormous proportions is carried by a procession of slaves. Atop it sits a formidable reptilian. All the hallmarks of a warlord are there: extensive scarring, brazen weaponry, the skeletal remnants of past kills.

I am Gia'Zumon, and these are my te

excerpt.zh:
这位外星人被包裹在一个咯咯作响的生命维持装置中。浓稠的液体从管子和通风口流过，他的话语变成了一种潮湿的汩汩声。

你们的工厂太差劲了吧。
excerpt.en:
The alien is encased in a gurgling life-support unit. Thick fluid sloshes through the tubes and vents, causing his speech to emerge in a wet gurgle.

Your industrial plants are a disgrace.

excerpt.zh:
我们的传感器显示该机器人的外壳已经有数百年历史。它的语音缺乏音调，但话语却意外地洪亮。

数据显示你的政府和附属国之间不协调。缺乏纪律。不合格的教化。建议操作：向系统中添加亚图里昂。删除不必要的功能。强调秩序。
excerpt.en:
Our scans reveal that the outer shell of the robot is hundreds of years old. Its voice is monotone, but its words are oddly resonant.

Data indicates misalignment between your government and its subjects. Lack of discipline. Substandard indoctrination. Recomme

excerpt.zh:
这位武士装备着先进的武器和装甲。扫描显示其体内有高度的生化改造和义体升级。

基恩将军听您吩咐。我是超然均衡教团的一位特使。我被派遣来帮助所有需要消除暴政的人。接纳我的誓言，我的武力将为你所用。
excerpt.en:
The warrior is armed with advanced weaponry and armor. Scans reveal extensive biological modifications and cybernetic enhancements.

General Jynn, at your service. I am an envoy of the Numinous Equilibrium. I have been sent to defend those in need and help bri

excerpt.zh:
这位科学家全神贯注地看着手中的输入板，手指对着按键上下纷飞。她哼着欢快的旋律，似乎对工作心无旁骛。一个小型机器人同伴漂浮在她旁边的空中，它发出叽叽喳喳的声音，磕了一下她的肩膀。她倏然抬起头。

啊，对不起。你好！我是佐西拉。很抱歉打扰你们，那个，我之前的实验室相当于是，爆炸了。

小机器人又叽叽喳喳了起来。

啊所以，那个，我是说，我想要找一个地方能让我继续作曲。
excerpt.en: The scientist is focused on a tablet in her hand. As her fingers dance over the keys, she hums a cheerful melody. She seems lost in her work and oblivious to the world. A small robot companion floats in the air next to her; it chirps and bumps her shoulder. Sh

excerpt.zh:
在一架巨大的移动吊臂上悬着一副类人生物的头和躯干。这一定曾经是一个有机生物，但现在大部分已经由金属、电缆和塑料构成。毫无预兆下，那副躯干振动了一下活动了起来，两只合成眼发出光芒，发出嘎吱作响的嗓音。

我是松达尔。我在寻找能效力的人。
excerpt.en: Suspended on a massive mobility crane is the head and torso of a humanoid. Once this must have been an organic being, but most of what remains is metal, wires and plastic. Without warning, the body jolts and comes to life, two synthetic eyes begin to glow, and

excerpt.zh:
粗短结实的机械装置被挤压在一具外骨骼中。工具、零零散散的零件和油腻腻的手都能看出他是个修补匠，他的眼睛里闪烁着好奇和热情。

早啊老板！我叫博林，诺嘉之子。很高兴认识你！
excerpt.en:
The short and sturdy mechanic is squeezed into an exoskeleton. Tools, scattered parts and greasy hands bear the telltale marks of a tinkerer, and his eyes glint with curiosity and enthusiasm.

Mornin' boss! I'm Borin, son of Noga. Pleased to make your acquaint

excerpt.zh:
这位外星人身着华丽和繁复的长袍。尽管年事已高，但他的双眼仍旧警觉，透出敏锐的智慧。

向您致敬。我想作为一个和平卫士为您服务。
excerpt.en:
The alien is adorned in rich, intricate robes. Despite his obvious age, his eyes are alert and betray a keen intellect.

Salutations. I come to offer my services as a keeper of peace.

excerpt.zh:
这位女士的服饰和珠宝让人对其生活的奢华窥见一斑。她轻轻一鞠躬后开口说道，

我愿意作为一位总督和一位外交官而效劳。让我成为你的盟友，我能让你在星系的任何一个角落都找到强大的友邦。
excerpt.en:
The Sister's clothing and jewelry offer a glimpse into her opulent lifestyle. She bows before speaking.

I offer my services as a governor, and as a diplomat. Make me your ally and I will ensure you have powerful friends, in every corner of the galaxy.

excerpt.zh:
扫描显示，这个女人的斗篷里隐藏着许多令人震惊的武器。我们找不到任何关于她存在的官方记录，但面部识别算法显示她至少参与了三起备受关注的暗杀。

请允许我省去那些繁文缛节。你是个聪明人，知道宇宙中危机四伏，其中的许多甚至目不可及。只要出个好价钱，我就能让你一窥究竟。
excerpt.en:
Scans show that the woman's cloak conceals a truly shocking array of weaponry. We cannot find any official record of her existence, yet facial-recognition algorithms place her in the vicinity of at least three high-profile assassinations.

Allow me to dispense

excerpt.zh:
这位外星人的皮肤闪烁着粘稠的分泌物。他煞费苦心地深鞠了一躬。但当他一开口，声调却像孩子一样出奇地尖细。

这位大人，欧！至高无上的统治者。我，看守人喀·拉，只是您卑微的仆人。您的每句话都是命令。让我管理一颗你的星球，我会给您带来荣耀和财富。啊，那么多的财富！
excerpt.en:
The alien's skin glistens with viscous secretions. He bows elaborately from the waist. When he speaks, his voice is surprisingly high pitched, almost childlike.

My lord, Your Honor, Oh! Supreme ruler - I, Q'la-Minder, am but your humble servant. Your word sha

excerpt.zh:
这位外星人一动不动。

命运指引着我的每一步。我穿越了无边的黑暗来到你的面前。我是神谕者尤拉斯塔尔。
excerpt.en:
The alien is motionless.

Fate guides my steps. I have crossed the blind reaches to stand before you. I am Ulastar, the Oracle.

excerpt.zh:
这位男子形如枯骨，饱经风霜：他精美的服饰几乎褪色殆尽，他的皮肤如羊皮纸般干燥粗糙，他的嗓音近乎低语。

吾名为纳苏兹·德墨忒尔。吾身为纤尘与迷思所化。感谢您接纳我。
excerpt.en:
The man is thin to the point of starvation. There is a sense of decrepitude about him: his fine clothes are faded, his skin as dry as parchment, and his voice rises barely above a whisper.

My name is Nasuz Demetor. I am a collector of dust and myth. Thank you

excerpt.zh:
[killer_fleet.GetName]报告称，[killer_fleet.solar_system.GetName]星系的海盗私掠船已经被摧毁了。虽然附近恒星系中还有一些零零散散的海盗船，但从目前来看，星际海盗已经成为了过去……至少今天如此。

我们从他们丰厚的储存室里设法缴获了一批来历不明的赃物，这批宝藏我们可以纳入国库，另有他用。
excerpt.en:
The [killer_fleet.GetName] reports that the timeworn pirate galleons in the [killer_fleet.solar_system.GetName] system have been destroyed. Save for any stragglers in nearby systems, galactic piracy is a thing of the past... For now.

We were able to recover a

excerpt.zh: 超空间规划委员会报告，将太阳系的第三行星从重力井移除后，一个天然虫洞形成了。这个虫洞也许能逐渐缓解附近超空间通路的超光速交通拥堵。
excerpt.en: The Hyperspace Planning Council reports that the removal of the third planet in Sol from the system's gravity well has allowed a natural wormhole to form. This wormhole may eventually reduce FTL traffic congestion in the nearby hyperlanes.

excerpt.zh:
[From.From.GetName]上的灵能的嗡声逐渐淡去，一瞬间万物寂静。[From.GetName]上的人群目瞪口呆（如果他们有眼和鼻的话），灵能射线从他们心智絮网中发散着，每个人都着迷于其强大和强烈的个人信仰。

如果他们之前不明白的话，现在他们知道了：我们都只是某个更伟大事物的一部分。
excerpt.en: The empyreal hum of the [From.From.GetName]'s psionic coils fades, and for a moment all is quiet. Down on [From.GetName] the people stand slack-jawed (or local physiognomic equivalent), enraptured by the powerful and personal truths the psionic ray unfetters f

excerpt.zh:
[From.From.GetName]已完成纳米同化机器人的部署，其数量经计算足以义体化支配[From.GetName]上所有智慧有机生命。

我们没有在[From.From.GetName]上布置任何传感器或器械以证明我们的成功，但我们知道已经成功了。当我们将目光投于[From.GetName]上时。我们见到了自己，也经由自己所见。

在[From.GetName]表面上，只有我们自己。
excerpt.en:
The [From.From.GetName] has completed deployment of the assimilation nanobot payload, calculated to be sufficient to cybernetically dominate all sapient organics on [From.GetName].

We did not build the [From.From.GetName] with any sensors or instruments to me

excerpt.zh: 随着[FromFrom.GetName]发出的意识清除光束的能量逐渐消散，[From.GetName]的人口几乎都已经退化到了未开智状态。幸免遇难者面对那些曾经认识的人们做出动物般的举动只能束手无策。
excerpt.en: As the energies of the mind wiping beam from the [FromFrom.GetName] dissipate, [From.GetName]'s population has almost entirely regressed to the pre-sapient stage. Those who were spared can now only watch in horror as those they once knew return to animalistic

excerpt.zh:
通过我们卓越的生物工程、可观的投资和多年的辛勤劳动，我们在[Root.GetName]上的盖亚播种计划取得了成果。

从今天起，[Root.GetName]定会被视为星球中值得钦佩或羡慕的真正瑰宝。
excerpt.en:
Through our superior bio-engineering, considerable investments, and years of hard labor, our Gaia Seeding project on [Root.GetName] has come to fruition.

From this day on, [Root.GetName] must be considered a true gem among planets, to admire, or perhaps envy.

excerpt.zh:
[Root.GetName]在[From.GetName]上获得了惊人的发现——[From.GetPlanetMoon]充满了外星生命！这是历史上第一次，我们遇到和[Root.Owner.GetHomeWorldName]完全不一样的生命形态。

这一惊人发现使得相信“我们在宇宙中孤苦伶仃”的人闭上了嘴。尽管这些[From.GetName]上的外星生命似乎并无高等智慧，但很可能用不了多久我们就会遇到。
excerpt.en:
The [Root.GetName] has made a startling find on [From.GetName] - the [From.GetPlanetMoon] is teeming with alien life! For the first time in history, we have encountered life forms that did not originate on [Root.Owner.GetHomeWorldName].

This amazing discovery

excerpt.zh: 我们的降临对[planet.GetName]无异于一场大灾变。一股巨大的冲击波冲刷了这片没有生命的大陆，由于数百万吨的碎片被抛入大气层，[planet.GetName]的宜居性显著的下降了。我们的殖民者—被安全地包围在陨石的岩石核心—将很快从庇护处走出，并开始安装预制殖民地基础设施。
excerpt.en: Our arrival on [planet.GetName] is nothing short of cataclysmic. A massive shockwave scours a continent clean of life, and the habitability level of [planet.GetName] drops noticeably as megatons of debris are thrown into the atmosphere. Our colonists - encased

excerpt.zh:
我们与有智慧但未充分发展的外星文明正式接触的新闻使人们产生了复杂的情绪。这也明确了一件我们长久相信的事情，我们的星系中存在有从未考虑过探索他们行星以外世界的非太空文明外星人。

新的外形物种既是机会，也是威胁。我们必须谨慎。这些外星人的科技水平与我们相比十分原始，他们还没有实现太空旅行。我们必须决定如何与他们交流。
excerpt.en: The news that we have made formal contact with an intelligent yet undeveloped civilization has been received with mixed feelings by our populace. This confirms our long-held belief that there are non-space-faring aliens within our galaxy who may have never eve

excerpt.zh:
一小队来自[RefugeeEscapedFrom.GetName]的民用飞船到达了我们的国境，其中载满了[Root.GetSpeciesName]难民。他们被准许在[Root.Planet.GetName]安家。

这些不幸的流放者被[RefugeeEscapedFrom.GetSpeciesName]帝国强迫赶走出了自己的家园。自那之后，他们便四处流浪，孤注一掷地想要在物资耗尽前找到新的家园。
excerpt.en:
A flotilla of civilian transports carrying [Root.GetSpeciesName] refugees from the [RefugeeEscapedFrom.GetName] have arrived in our space. They have been allowed to settle on [Root.Planet.GetName].

These unfortunate outcasts were forcefully expelled from thei

excerpt.zh: 我们领先机构在富有前景的新研究中取得了意想不到的突破。这纯属意外收获，我们在仪器例行标准化过程中证明了一个长期被认为是误算的理论。现在该重新审视这个曾经被认为是边缘科学的东西了。
excerpt.en: Promising new research from our leading institutions has reached an unexpected breakthrough. By pure chance, the routine standardization of our instruments proved a theory that was long thought to be a fundamental miscalculation. We can now revisit what was on

excerpt.zh: 一艘渔船在[This.GetName]的海洋里发现了一处隐蔽的珊瑚礁。过去曾以为这片区域了无生机，但事实上却暗含着一个欣欣向荣的生态系统，满是鱼获。
excerpt.en: A fishing vessel has discovered a concealed reef in the oceans of [This.GetName]. The region, previously believed to be deserted and infertile, is in fact supporting a thriving ecosystem of harvestable fauna.

excerpt.zh:
在一场[This.GetName]上的地质活动后，有一处大型地下水库之下打开了一道裂口。行星地幔的热量加热着其中贮藏的水，在地表形成了地热喷口。

该自然现象让我们有机会用地热发电站和热泵来拓展殖民地的能源基础设施。
excerpt.en:
Following a tectonic shift, a fissure has opened under a large groundwater reservoir on [This.GetName]. The heat from the planet's mantle is boiling the trapped water deposit, causing geothermal vents to form on the surface.

This natural phenomenon provides u

excerpt.zh:
[lucky_wreckage_system.GetName]出现了一艘废弃舰船。[This.GetQuantumParticleStreamDiscoveredExtra]

我们推断这艘舰船之所以在该恒星系中漂泊了前年直至现在才因为恒星能发电装置故障才显形。船上没有任何生命迹象，而我们也开始了对舰船的小心拆解，希望能从中尽可能学到东西。
excerpt.en:
A derelict ship has appeared in [lucky_wreckage_system.GetName]. [This.GetQuantumParticleStreamDiscoveredExtra]

We have deduced that the ship remained undetected in this system for millennia, only revealing itself after its solar energy generator malfunctione

excerpt.zh: [This.GetName]正在焦点明确的指引下实现了真正和谐的运转。这种万众一心的团结肯定是由于最佳的天象引起的，是伟大的事情即将到来的征兆。
excerpt.en: The [This.GetName] is functioning in true harmony under a directive of unequivocal focus. This unilateral cohesion is certainly due to optimal celestial alignments and is a sign of great things to come.

excerpt.zh:
[From.GetName]恒星系内的三个天体排列成了完美的三位一体构型；即[favorable_trine_planet_1.GetName]、[favorable_trine_planet_2.GetName]和[favorable_trine_planet_3.GetName]。

这种有利天象为我们在[This.GetName]的殖民地带来了宁静与和谐。
excerpt.en:
Three celestial bodies in the [From.GetName] system have aligned to form a favorable trine; [favorable_trine_planet_1.GetName], [favorable_trine_planet_2.GetName] and [favorable_trine_planet_3.GetName].

This beneficial astrological alignment brings a sense of

excerpt.zh:
[auspicious_position_planet.GetName]在[root.capital_scope.GetName]的夜空中升上吉位，入主天回星宫。

该天象代表[root.GetName]内在循环的新开端，是增长和发展的重大机遇。
excerpt.en:
[auspicious_position_planet.GetName] is occupying an auspicious position in the skies above [root.capital_scope.GetName], residing in the astrological House of Celestial Return.

This represents the commencement of a new internal cycle for the [root.GetName] a

excerpt.zh:
所有定量占星矩阵都表明[This.GetName]目前处于完美的元素平衡。

利用精确的能量线管理可以将这种有益平衡维持很长时间，为我们领袖的繁盛提供理想的形而上环境。
excerpt.en:
All quantifiable astrological metrics indicate that the [This.GetName] is in perfect elemental balance.

With precise ley line management this beneficial equilibrium can be maintained for an extended period, providing an ideal metaphysical environment in which

excerpt.zh:
我们的两位内阁成员，[councilor_harmony_leader_1.GetTitle][councilor_harmony_leader_1.GetName]和[councilor_harmony_leader_2.GetTitle][councilor_harmony_leader_2.GetName]发现他们的占星结果高度互补。

因此，他们的政治伙伴关系在以尊重和效率为名将我们的政府凝聚了起来，加快了各种立法程序的推进。
excerpt.en: Two of our council members, [councilor_harmony_leader_1.GetTitle] [councilor_harmony_leader_1.GetName] and [councilor_harmony_leader_2.GetTitle] [councilor_harmony_leader_2.GetName] recently discovered that their astrological signs are perfectly complementary.

excerpt.zh:
在一次例行编目中，一个没固定好的的标本掉在了博物天枢的地上，随后被及时送到保管员那里进行进一步检查。

因为这场事故我们意外得发现，该标本中的一个秘密隔间松动了。里面藏着各种各样的有趣的文物可以丰富我们的馆藏，而此事之前完全未被注意到。
excerpt.en:
During a routine cataloging exercise, an unsecured specimen was dropped on the floor of the Grand Archive and was swiftly delivered to a conservator for closer examination.

Surprisingly, a secret compartment was found to have been loosened in the accident. Pr

excerpt.zh: 有一种不和谐的感觉笼罩着[This.GetName]。这种协调匮乏正在使我们集体的多方面陷入停滞，这肯定是由于不佳的天象引起的。
excerpt.en: There is a feeling of disharmony throughout the [This.GetName]. This lack of coordination is leading to stagnation throughout our collective, and must be due to suboptimal celestial alignments.

excerpt.zh:
在位于[This.System.GetName]的例行海军演习中因为通讯失误导致[This.GetName]的多艘战舰发生高速碰撞事故。

[This.GetNavalCollisionLeader]通报，对这次事故负主要责任的[From.GetIndividualNamePlural]已经按条例处分。
excerpt.en:
A miscommunication during routine naval maneuvers has caused a high-speed collision between multiple combat ships of the [This.GetName] in [This.System.GetName].

[This.GetNavalCollisionLeader] has confirmed that the [From.GetIndividualNamePlural] responsible

excerpt.zh:
[silo_fire_planet_targeted.GetName]上一处资源储仓的电力故障导致了该仓储设施发生严重火灾。

灭火措施临时发生了故障，储存在此处的大部分资源付之一炬。储仓也受损得无法修复了。
excerpt.en:
An electrical malfunction in a resource silo on [silo_fire_planet_targeted.GetName] resulted in a massive fire within the storage facility.

The fire suppression measures had temporarily malfunctioned, and a significant proportion of the resources stored withi

excerpt.zh:
一位我方的[This.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]代表无意中做出了与地位不相称的行为。在发表旨在为我们的利益争取支持的演讲时，所使用的翻译设备故障导致了其对[diplomatic_faux_pas_victim.GetName]进行尖酸刻薄的羞辱。这场意外事件很快通过星系媒体广为传播，让我们一时臭名远扬。

虽然这种事情不至于立即解雇，但我们在[This.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]的地位也因此受到了影响。
excerpt.en: One of our representatives in the [This.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] has inadvertently behaved in a manner unbecoming of their position. While delivering a speech intended to raise support for our interests, a translator malfunction resulted in delivering vit

excerpt.zh:
[extreme_solar_flare_system.GetName]发生了一场史无前例的恒星耀斑，将该恒星系内的所有轨道空间站都毁坏了。

这种有强伽马射线的异常耀斑远远超出了以前对该天体的测量。通过对日冕层的分析得知，这颗恒星的预期寿命至少减少了300万年。
excerpt.en:
An unprecedented solar flare from [extreme_solar_flare_system.GetName] has functionally destroyed all orbital stations in the system.

This aberrant flare of concentrated gamma rays is far beyond anything that has been previously measured from this celestial b

excerpt.zh:
[This.GetName]地表上出现了巨大的陷坑，严重损坏了当地的基础设施。其中一处裂沟出现在一座建筑物的地基下，导致建筑部分倒塌。所幸受灾地区都已成功撤离。

我们无法得知这种突发的地陷具体是什么引起的，但已开始进行进一步维护检查，检测地表裂损情况。
excerpt.en: Enormous sinkholes have appeared on the surface of [This.GetName], causing significant infrastructure damage. One of the fissures opened underneath the foundations of one of the planet's buildings, causing it to partially collapse. Fortunately, all affected ar

excerpt.zh: 一大群反常的子个体在[This.GetName]殖民地引发暴乱，造成了大规模破坏。尽管这些分子非常疯狂，防御部队还是迅速镇压了这些煽动者。然而，基础设施所遭受的损伤仍需时间来修复。
excerpt.en: A large pod of deviant drones led a revolt in the [This.GetName] colony, causing widespread destruction. Despite their fervor, defense forces were able to neutralize the agitators, but the damage to our infrastructure will take time to repair.

excerpt.zh: [This.GetName]上一种高致病性病毒突然变异，传染了大部分人口。为控制疾病传播、避免当地医疗基础设施过载，目前已经采取了如接触者追踪和行动限制等隔离措施。
excerpt.en: A highly transmissible virus has mutated on the surface of [This.GetName], infecting a large portion of the population. Quarantine measures have been put in place, such as contact tracing and movement restrictions, in order to hopefully restrict the disease's

excerpt.zh:
[From.GetName]恒星系内的四个天体排列成了预兆灾难的四连星；即[calamitous_quartile_planet_1.GetName]、[calamitous_quartile_planet_2.GetName]、[calamitous_quartile_planet_3.GetName]和[calamitous_quartile_planet_4.GetName]。

这种灾难性天象在[This.GetName]殖民地播下怀疑的种子，让[FromFrom.GetDissent]得以在人群中制造分歧
excerpt.en:
Four celestial bodies in the [From.GetName] system have aligned to form a calamitous quartile; [calamitous_quartile_planet_1.GetName], [calamitous_quartile_planet_2.GetName], [calamitous_quartile_planet_3.GetName] and [calamitous_quartile_planet_4.GetName].

T

excerpt.zh: [planet_in_retrograde_home.GetName]上的居民发现[planet_in_retrograde_planet.GetName]正在发生退行。是时候重新斟酌我们的行为，对[This.GetName]不完美表示遗憾。愿这段时间的沉重反思让我们可以在未来更靠近理想。
excerpt.en: Inhabitants of [planet_in_retrograde_home.GetName] have observed that [planet_in_retrograde_planet.GetName] is now in retrograde. This is a time to reconsider our actions and express regret towards the imperfections of the [This.GetName]. May this burdensome p

excerpt.zh:
很不幸，所有的定量矩阵均表明[This.GetName]上的元素已经完全失衡了。

尝试重新组织精妙的平衡需要许多时间也颇为困难。在当前的混沌状态下，我们的领袖无法获得形而上学冥想环境，阻碍了他们的发展。
excerpt.en:
Unfortunately, all quantifiable metrics indicate that the [This.GetName] is in complete elemental discord.

Attempting to realign this delicate equilibrium will be time-consuming and difficult. In its current chaotic state, our leaders will be unable to access

excerpt.zh: [From.GetName]恒星系内的首要光耀体正异常地变暗了。占星专家对此进行讨论后，这种发光减少预计将会影响[This.GetName]上的能源基础设施。
excerpt.en: The primary luminary in the [From.GetName] system has anomalously dimmed. After discussing this phenomenon with our astrological specialists, this decline in luminosity is predicted to have a negative effect on the energy infrastructure of [This.GetName].

excerpt.zh:
我们的两位内阁成员，[discordant_council_leader_1.GetTitle][discordant_council_leader_1.GetName]和[discordant_council_leader_2.GetTitle][discordant_council_leader_2.GetName]近来发现他们的占星结果相冲。

因此，他们的政治敌手关系在我们的政府中形成了紧张和怨恨的氛围，例行的立法程序都因此频繁延期。
excerpt.en: Two of our council members, [discordant_council_leader_1.GetTitle] [discordant_council_leader_1.GetName] and [discordant_council_leader_2.GetTitle] [discordant_council_leader_2.GetName] recently learned that their astrological signs are diametrically incompati

excerpt.zh:
我们一个管理单元关于其他帝国未经过滤的陈述意外地广播给了该国的附属国。在一次关于超空间航道监视的艰难讨论之后，通讯单元未能关闭传输频道，让[careless_talk_empire.GetName]听到了随后那一连串的咒骂。

[careless_talk_empire.GetAdjective]大众对[This.GetName]的观点不可避免地下降了。
excerpt.en: One of our admin units' unfiltered statements about another empire were accidentally broadcast to their subject. Following a difficult discussion about hyperlane surveillance, a communications unit forgot to close the transmission channel, allowing the [carele

excerpt.zh:
一个行政过失导致我们一件珍贵的文物不见了踪影。尽管进行了广泛的搜索，但它似乎要么消失在我们迷宫一般的博物天枢中，要么就是被转移到没有记录的地方去了。

因此，对展出标本的跟踪手续正在进行彻底改革。
excerpt.en:
An administrative error has led to the misplacement of one of our precious cultural artifacts. Despite extensive search efforts, it is seemingly either lost in the labyrinth that is our Grand Archive or transferred to an unrecorded location.

The procedures in

excerpt.zh:
[from.GetName]恒星系内我们的灵能光环正在与来自附近[fromfrom.GetName]恒星系的敌对光环进行激烈斗争。我们的灵能[GetResearchers]曾对这种行为进行过建模，但这是我们第一次获得这种现象的一手资料。

理论上来说，越强的光环——就是说投射的强度越大——将会逐渐驱散敌对力量。如果这种斗争导致一方完败，占主导地位的光环可能就会流入空出来的恒星系。

这真是字面意义上的“灵魂的碰撞”。
excerpt.en: Our Psionic Aura in the [from.GetName] system is struggling against an opposing Aura originating from the nearby [fromfrom.GetName] system. Our psionic [GetResearchers] have previously modeled such behavior, though this is the first time we have experienced th

excerpt.zh:
此前，[GetScientistPlural]们观测到了一种异常的现象：遥远的恒星系带着未知来源的能量流运行，这些能量流还逐渐扩散到了其他星系。这种称为“灵能光环”的能量流，由于其来源还未理论上确证，我们还不能确定其是否构成威胁。

这种光环现在也在[from.GetName]恒星系内探测到了，如果它继续蔓延有可能会侵犯我们的边境。
excerpt.en: Some time ago, our [GetScientistPlural] observed an unusual phenomenon: distant star systems coursing with energy flows of unknown origin, which gradually spread into other systems. Termed 'Psionic Auras', on the basis of unconfirmed theories about their sourc

excerpt.zh: 我们的[GetTelepathPlural]向超主祈求力量，祂慷慨回应。生命之织缕将[From.GetName]转变成了一颗盖亚星球，使其成为[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]的一片理想家园。
excerpt.en: Our [GetTelepathPlural] called upon the power of our patron, and it responded with a bounty. The Composer of Strands has transformed [From.GetName] into a Gaia World, making it an ideal habitat for [Root.GetSpeciesAdj]kind.

excerpt.zh: 我们的[GetTelepathPlural]向超主祈求力量，祂呢喃着给出提案。虚空之低语打算将我们的一个殖民地重塑成遗落星球；我们只需要做出决定即可。
excerpt.en: Our [GetTelepathPlural] called upon the power of our patron, and it murmurs with an offer. The Whisperers in the Void will reimagine one of our colonies as a Relic World; we need only make our choice.

excerpt.zh: 我们的[GetTelepathPlural]向超主祈求力量，祂慷慨回应。轮回之终末在我们[capital_scope.solar_system.GetName]系中具现化了一颗盖亚星球，为[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]提供了一片理想家园；这是一个用来拥抱万物终结的转瞬即逝的乐园。
excerpt.en: Our [GetTelepathPlural] called upon the power of our patron, and it responded with a bounty. The End of the Cycle has materialized a Gaia World in our [capital_scope.solar_system.GetName] system, providing an ideal habitat for [Root.GetSpeciesAdj]kind; a fleet

excerpt.zh: 一种灾难即将到来的预感在我们的人口中激起。我们的[GetTelepathPlural]在虚境的能量中探测到了一个并行干扰。
excerpt.en: An awareness of impending calamity stirs within our population. Our [GetTelepathPlural] have even detected a concurrent disturbance in the energies of the Shroud.

excerpt.zh: [from.GetName]释放出的恶毒灵能光环正在以危险的速度向整个星系散播。依据我们[GetResearchers]的观测，它已经在许多恒星系造成了恶劣的影响。
excerpt.en: The malevolent Psionic Aura emitted by the [from.GetName] has spread through the galaxy at an alarming rate. Judging by the observations of our [GetResearchers], it has caused ill effects across many star systems.

excerpt.zh: [from.GetName]释放出的恶毒灵能光环正在以危险的速度向整个星系散播。依据我们[GetResearchers]的观测，它已经在许多恒星系造成了恶劣的影响。
excerpt.en: The malevolent Psionic Aura emitted by the [from.GetName] has spread through the galaxy at an alarming rate. Judging by the observations of our [GetResearchers], it has caused ill effects across many star systems.

excerpt.zh:
一切转瞬即逝。

在我们国土内邪恶的终末光环突然消失了，将一切也随之带走。恒星坍缩成黑洞，行星原地蒸发，只剩下震耳欲聋的寂静。似乎我们抗击光环的努力起到了一些缓和作用，尽可能保留了一点。

究竟是什么疯子激起了这种毁灭性的力量也许永远不得而知了。
excerpt.en:
In an instant, it was all gone.

The malevolent Aura of the End present in our systems has suddenly vanished, taking everything with it. Entire stars have collapsed into black holes, planets have disappeared, and a great silence has been left in their stead. I

excerpt.zh: 自从轮回之终末带来毁灭之后，我们付出了巨大的努力进行重建。为此，我们在[solar_system.Star.GetStarName]系重建了一座哨站，这标志着[owner.GetName]的一个新的开始。
excerpt.en: We have made great efforts to recover since the destruction wrought by the End of the Cycle. To this end, we have rebuilt an Outpost in the [solar_system.Star.GetStarName] system, marking a new beginning for the [owner.GetName].

excerpt.zh:
随着人群开始肿胀，受苦者克罗南变得愈发狂躁。他们的声音因紧绷而颤抖，形体抽搐、波动，血肉在剧变中翻腾，发出挫败的嘶吼。

那些丝线，无穷无尽……它们扭动着，我拉扯，我撕扯，可编织纹丝不动！这具可憎的皮囊我还要忍受多久？还要剥落多少层，才能窥见其中真谛？
excerpt.en:
As our population swells, Kronen the Afflicted grows ever more frenzied. Their voice quivers with strain, their form twitching, rippling, flesh in flux as they rasp in frustration.

The strands, endless... they writhe, I pull, I tear, yet the weave holds! How

excerpt.en: The [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] has passed a resolution declaring us a military target. All members of the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] are now at war with the [this.GetName]. We can expect their fleets to strike

这种信息可以有多种形式：具体的语言或视觉材料、宽泛的概念或广义的情绪感知。关键在于，精心策划的传输过程可以让受众在毫无感觉的情况下完成这个流程。

This information can take various forms: specific linguistic or visual material, broad concepts, or generalized emotive sensations. Crucially, a carefully performed transmission leaves its subject completely unaware of the

我们的许多[Owner.GetCitizenPlural]在[Owner.Capital.GetName]各地看到了怪异的幻影。这些幻象大多数情况下都是偶发的，不会重复，但有一个地方因频繁出现而引起了注意。[Owner.GetPhantomPresenceExtra]

人们发现这个幻象出现在一处富矿洞穴系统的入口。
excerpt.en: A number of our [Owner.GetCitizenPlural] have perceived uncanny apparitions at various locations on [Owner.Capital.GetName]. In most cases, these have been chance sightings without repetition, but one site has drawn attention for frequent visitations. [Owner.G

excerpt.zh:
[Owner.Capital.GetName]上发生了一次意外的气候事件——一场类似风暴的扰动横扫了一片灵能水平极高的地区。随后我们在其途径之地发现一些当地的动物感染了奇怪的寄生虫，它们会钻入大脑器官并将其慢慢吃掉。

随着这种寄生虫感染的加剧，宿主动物会暂时获得基本的念动力，很多便开始将其用于狩猎和进食，直至被寄生虫杀死。

[Owner.GetShroudParasitesEnding]
excerpt.en: An unpredicted climatic event occurred on [Owner.Capital.GetName] - a storm-like disturbance that swept through an area with particularly elevated levels of psionic energy. In its wake, we found some of the local fauna infected with a strange parasite that bur

excerpt.zh:
在实验新的灵能科技的过程中，我们在集体冥想时观察到了意料之外的具现化现象。将我们的集体注意力聚焦在空间中的一个点上时会短暂出现一些怪异但值得注意的物体。

所耗费的精神力非常巨大，但我们有可能将这些努力转化为合意的具现化对象。这些物体从何而来，以及可能导致什么后果我们不得而知。
excerpt.en:
While experimenting with new psionic techniques, we observed unexpected materializations during group meditation. Narrowing our collective focus on a single point in space resulted in the fleeting appearance of strange and remarkable objects.

The psychic toll

excerpt.zh:
关于灵能[Owner.GetIndividualNamePlural]有二重身能力的传言沸沸扬扬，据信这是一种可以同时以肉身出现在两个地方的能力。我们派出了[Owner.GetResearchers]去调查这种不太可能的说法；结果这种现象竟然是真的。[Owner.GetPsionicDoublingExtra]

目前，只有很小一部分人口具有这种强大的能力，进一步研究也许能找到训练方法。
excerpt.en: Rumors had spread of psionic [Owner.GetIndividualNamePlural] capable of bilocation, the ability to be physically present in two different locations at the same time. We dispatched [Owner.GetResearchers] to investigate these improbable claims; astonishingly, th

excerpt.zh:
[Owner.GetAdjective]的一小部分人身上出现了一种奇妙的灵能能力：心灵遥感，一种从超出正常感知范围的距离感知实体的能力。这些千里眼无需经过任何专门训练，就能非常精确地描绘出远处物体的细节。

如果这种能力可以加以控制和增强，[Owner.GetName]就能获得可观的回报。利用我们最强大的[Owner.GetTelepathPlural]的能力，就可以尝试磨练这项技术，将其应用在重要的事情上。
excerpt.en: A wondrous psionic faculty has emerged in a small proportion of the [Owner.GetAdjective] population: telesthesia, the ability to sense entities from distances beyond the ordinary range of perception. Without any kind of specialized training, these remote viewe

excerpt.zh:
我们的原材料正在以危险的速率减少。储存在工厂和仓库里的无机材料正在以超过常理的速度消耗，[Owner.GetMatterInFluxExtra]。这些地区的损失也与灵能活动增加有关。

为此我们可以减少在物资仓库附近区域的灵能活动，但也将拖慢灵能研究的步伐、限制其工业应用。我们还可以按照建议开发灵能场衰减器来抑制这种物灭现象。如果什么都不做，我们的灵能研究能力也会被削弱。
excerpt.en: We are losing raw materials at an alarming rate. Stores of inorganic matter in factories and warehouses are depleting faster than they are being used, [Owner.GetMatterInFluxExtra]. These losses correlate with increased psionic activity in the affected location

excerpt.zh:
我们的大众对灵能日益增长的好奇心催生了一种奇怪的活动：私下储存死去的[Owner.GetSpeciesBrainPlural]并试图与之交流。

参与者相信在[Owner.GetDeathName]后意识信息仍可以保留，这是一种衍生兹科学理论的观念，认为心灵是一种能量——它可以转化但不能凭空消失。尽管总数不多，但还是有越来越多人相信灵能[Owner.GetIndividualName]去世时会产生一个无穷小亚空间裂隙，通过这扇窗户就能一瞥其他维度。

创新研究固然值得赞扬，但对我们部分[Owner.GetDecea
excerpt.en:
Our population's increasing curiosity about psionics has led to the emergence of a strange activity: privately storing expired [Owner.GetSpeciesBrainPlural] and trying to communicate with them.

Practitioners believe that cognitive information can survive [Own

excerpt.zh:
我们的灵能人口中有很大一部分都长出了奇怪的、有关节附肢，其设计深不可测。[Owner.GetScientistPlural]称，他们的外观变化是由大规模自发[Owner.GetGeneticMutationName]导致的。现在很清楚灵能活动可能导致使用者发生身体变化。尽管我们无法抑制这种附肢增生，但也发现可以用灵能来控制其生长率。

尽管一开始导致了一些[Owner.GetDistressName]，这些额外的肢体其实还是很有用的。如果高效利用起来，其它们的作用应该能弥补增加的认知负担。
excerpt.en: Swathes of our psionic population have sprouted strange, jointed appendages of unfathomable design. According to our [Owner.GetScientistPlural], their appearance was caused by spontaneous [Owner.GetGeneticMutationName] at mass scale. It is now clear that psion

excerpt.zh:
我们的[Owner.GetScientistPlural]开发出了一种将灵能力转化为动能的可靠方法，现在正在与[Owner.GetEngineerPlural]合作将这种技术放大并投入生产。

尽管这种技术非常有工业应用前景，其社会影响还是个未知数。如果一小帮技术高超的灵能[Owner.GetIndividualNamePlural]就能运作复杂的机械，那么就会有大批的[Owner.GetWorkerNamePlural]就要面临失业。[Owner.GetTelekineticEthicsExtra]我们还在逐渐掌
excerpt.en:
Our [Owner.GetScientistPlural] have developed a reliable method for converting psionic power into kinetic energy, and are now working with [Owner.GetEngineerPlural] on scaling the technology for practical use.

While the industrial applications are promising,

excerpt.zh:
突然爆发的[Owner.GetAcuteMigrainePlural]席卷了我们的帝国。虽然严重程度各不相同，但这种情况已经影响了相当一部分人口，对[Owner.GetName]造成了广泛的破坏。

一小部分特别强大的灵能[Owner.GetIndividualNamePlural]也是受影响最严重的，初步的统计分析也表明灵能能力和症状强度之间存在相关性。[Owner.GetAGrowingPainExtra]
excerpt.en:
A sudden outbreak of [Owner.GetAcuteMigrainePlural] has befallen our empire. While severity ranges widely, the condition has already affected a significant proportion of the population, causing widespread disruption across the [Owner.GetName].

A small number

excerpt.zh:
[Owner.GetPsionicUndergroundIntro]灵能[Owner.GetIndividualNamePlural]正在将自己的灵能能力用在非法格斗运动中，这些灵能角斗士为了金钱和荣誉作战。虽然许多参与者都是极具天赋但缺乏训练的战士，[Owner.GetPsionicUndergroundExtra]

[Owner.GetPsionicUndergroundEnd]
excerpt.en: [Owner.GetPsionicUndergroundIntro] psionic [Owner.GetIndividualNamePlural] are channeling their psychic abilities into a lawless combat sport, in which psionic warriors do battle for credits and glory. While many practitioners are innately gifted fighters with

excerpt.zh:
我们收到报道称，[This.GetName]的特定区域发生了突然的环境变化。

大气中充满着的凝胶状蒸汽，在地面覆盖上一层油性沉淀物，灵能[Owner.GetIndividualNamePlural]将其称为“虚境落雾”。据报道，附近地区出现了严重的灵能紊乱。

虚境落雾区内的环境对[This.Owner.GetShroudfallExtra]。除非我们能投入资源修复环境，不然当地居民就需要去适应这种恶劣的环境。
excerpt.en:
We have received reports of sudden environmental changes in a particular sector on [This.GetName].

The atmosphere is heavy with a gelatinous vapor, coating the ground in an oily precipitation that psionic [Owner.GetIndividualNamePlural] refer to as 'shroudfal

excerpt.zh:
有些人开始行为异常，观念、习惯和各种日常行为都发生了突然转变。许多[Owner.GetWorkerNamePlural]停工，而且[Owner.GetOutOfControlExtra]。

受影响者声称自己是在听从一个无名实体的命令，它居住在意识的边缘，指导着他们的一举一动。我们正在追寻着灵能的未来，因此必须小心考察这种异次元力量对[Owner.GetOutOfControlPsyche]造成的影响。
excerpt.en:
Some among us have started to behave abnormally, exhibiting sudden changes in opinions, habits, and general conduct. Many [Owner.GetWorkerNamePlural] have ceased labor, and [Owner.GetOutOfControlExtra].

Those affected claim to be doing the bidding of a namele

excerpt.zh:
[Owner.GetNeuralOverloadIntro]

更广泛的测试表明，有很大一部分人口也[Owner.GetNeuralOverloadExtra]，其原因可能是[Owner.GetPsychicAdj]活动的增多。不受控灵能活动突然爆发的能量可能导致迅速的恶化和严重后果。

高级冥想技术也许有助于不借助[Owner.GetMedicalAdj]介入来控制这种灵能活动，但我们的一些[Owner.GetScientistPlural]建议需要研发[Owner.GetMedicalImplantName]来
excerpt.en:

Wider testing has revealed that a significant proportion of our population is suffering from [Owner.GetNeuralOverloadExtra], likely due to increased [Owner.GetPsychicAdj] activity. The sudden bursts of energy released through un
