随着我们与周遭的灵能力量愈发调和，[Owner.GetAdjective]人口开始受到[Owner.GetHorrifyingNightmarePlural]的荼毒。

[Owner.GetNightmaresExtra]

[Owner.GetNightmaresEnding]
excerpt.en:
As we become ever more attuned to the psionic forces around us, the [Owner.GetAdjective] population has become plagued by [Owner.GetHorrifyingNightmarePlural].

[Owner.GetNightmaresExtra]

[Owner.GetNightmaresEnding]

excerpt.zh:
[Owner.Capital.GetName]遭受到一连串当地野生动物的攻击。这它们袭击了我们的人口和建筑，消耗了宝贵的库存。

通过武装巡逻和宵禁来保护大众并未取得实质成效。我们的[Owner.GetResearchers]们认为，是现实和虚境之间的微小穿孔出现在了[Owner.Capital.GetName]上的一个地方，泄露的灵能力将一些无害的野兽转变成了残暴掠食者。为了应对威胁，这里可能是我们汇聚能量的最佳地点。
excerpt.en:
[Owner.Capital.GetName] has experienced a rash of attacks by local wildlife. These creatures have attacked our population, raided our buildings, and depleted valuable stockpiles.

Attempts to protect the populace with armed patrols and curfews have had limited

excerpt.zh:
灵能能力在我们人口中的不均衡分布正在引发新的社会矛盾。

那些对新获得的能力控制得更好的人开始认为自己高人一等，因此理应享有各种政治和经济特权。他们的分裂言论越来越激进，并有可能演变成暴力。
excerpt.en:
The uneven distribution of psionic abilities among our population is causing new forms of social conflict.

Those with better control over their newfound powers have come to view themselves as superior and thus deserving of various political and economic privi

excerpt.zh:
一场反对我们探索接纳灵能潜能的活动正在愈演愈烈。这些异见团体主张对灵能个体进行更严格的监督，全面否定在这一领域进行任何进一步的研究。

如果继续默许他们的活动，可能会威胁到我们理解和利用新兴灵能力量的进程。
excerpt.en:
A growing rebel movement is voicing opposition to continued efforts to explore and embrace our psionic potential. These dissident groups advocate for stricter oversight of psionic individuals and a wholesale rejection of further research in this area.

If thei

excerpt.zh:
随着灵能能力日益增强，我们的人口中出现了越来越多的滥用、欺骗和狡诈的行为。一小撮[owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]很明显在用有问题的方式使用新获得的力量。

愤怒的受害者们要求全面修改现有法律，加强对灵能犯罪的打击。
excerpt.en: As our psionic abilities grow stronger, we have seen an increase in reports of exploitation, trickery, and fraudulent behavior among our population. A small but sizable minority of [owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are clearly applying their newfound powers in ques

excerpt.zh:
我们的人口在逐渐适应新力量的过程中，有些[owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]开始尝试冒极大的风险来加速灵能发展。

黑市[owner.GetMentalUpgrade]的使用急剧增多。不受管控的[owner.GetMedicalFacility]出售各式用来最大化个体灵能能力的不可靠服务。这些冒险行为的后果难以预料。
excerpt.en:
As our population adjusts to their newfound powers, some [owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have begun taking considerable risks in an effort to accelerate their psionic development.

The use of black market [owner.GetMentalUpgrade] has increased dramatically. Unreg

excerpt.zh:
[owner.GetName]各地兴起了一种令人担忧的隔离现象，灵能子个体时常聚集在一起，甚至疏远[owner.GetHiveEntity]的其他部分。

尽管这些子个体还在集体中保持[owner.GetMentalAdj]存在，但无法解释的身体行为引起了关于进一步发展灵能可能带来后果的担忧。
excerpt.en:
A concerning form of segregation has developed across the [owner.GetName] with psionic drones clustering together physically, sometimes away from the rest of the [owner.GetHiveEntity].

Although these drones remain [owner.GetMentalAdj] present within the colle

excerpt.zh:
[owner.GetName]各地兴起了一种令人担忧的隔离现象，灵能个体被社会排斥，以至于开始自我放逐形成离群索居的小社群。

据报道，非灵能者造访这些地区的后身体虽然未受损伤但是他们的精神以难以描述的方式遭到了干扰。
excerpt.en:
A concerning form of segregation has developed across the [owner.GetName] with psionic individuals being socially ostracized to the point that they are withdrawing and forming their own remote communes.

Those without psionic powers who visit these areas have

excerpt.zh:
一种新型疾病在[owner.GetName]上爆发，对我们人口的神经器官造成了无法解释的损伤。

这种疾病只出现在最有灵能能力的[owner.GetIndividualNamePlural]身上，而且很多时候会危及生命。

然而对这种异常灵能现象的后续研究表明，有多种方式可以操作该过程。
excerpt.en:
A new disease is sweeping through the [owner.GetName], with our population forming inexplicable lesions within their neural organs.

The outbreak is exclusively affecting [owner.GetIndividualNamePlural] with the most significant psionic capabilities and is, in

excerpt.zh:
[owner.GetName]上一种无法解释的硬件故障大规模爆发，我们人口体内的神经处理器开始毫无征兆地失效。

奇怪的是，这种问题只出现在拥有强大灵能能力的[owner.GetIndividualNamePlural]身上，而且在很多情况下，这种故障不仅会带来干扰，更会造成破坏。

然而对这种异常灵能现象的后续研究表明，有多种方式可以操作该过程。
excerpt.en:
A surge of inexplicable malfunctions is sweeping across the [owner.GetName], as neural processors within our population begin to fail abruptly, and without warning.

Curiously, only [owner.GetIndividualNamePlural] exhibiting strong psionic signatures are affec

excerpt.zh:
[owner.GetIndividualNamePlural]对灵能潜力的初步试验失败了，多数实验个体产生了大量记忆损失。

尽管这些结果也并非没有实验价值，但这种工作对我们进一步理解羽翼未丰的灵能而言是否是最佳方式值得怀疑。
excerpt.en:
Initial experiments on [owner.GetIndividualNamePlural] with psionic potential have ended in failure, with most subjects being left with significant memory loss.

Although these outcomes are not without research value, it is questionable whether continuing such

excerpt.zh:
探索新获得的灵能能力对[owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的共情能力造成了根本性的转变。

很显然，我们现在能对其他意识的观点、思维模式和情感进行比以前复杂得多的建模。这些变化对[owner.GetName]究竟意味着新的优势还是劣势，还有待观察。
excerpt.en:
The exploration of our newfound psionic abilities has resulted in fundamental changes to [owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] empathetic capacities.

It is already clear that we are now capable of much more sophisticated modelling of the perspectives, thought patterns

excerpt.zh:
随着我灵能能力的发展，我们中的有些人开始难以承受新力量之重。受影响的[owner.GetIndividualNamePlural]在从集体重断连中遭受到重度反常行为的影响。

我们的研究表明这种不稳定不是缺陷，而是由于这些受影响的[owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]具有极高的灵能效率。通过正确的训练，这些[owner.GetIndividualNamePlural]可以成为我们灵能进化的下一步。但利用这些新能力的尝试必然潜藏着风险。
excerpt.en: As our psionic abilities develop, there are those among us who have begun to struggle under the weight of our emerging powers. The [owner.GetIndividualNamePlural] in question are suffering from concerning levels of deviant behavior as they disassociate from th

excerpt.zh: 我们的最早期数据集中，有些单元记录了拥有非凡能力的[This.GetSpeciesNamePlural]——他们能入侵机械和有机体的思想，用意念举起重物，或者表演各种各样的超自然的壮举等等。
excerpt.en: From our earliest datasets, some of our units have recorded [This.GetSpeciesNamePlural] wielding extraordinary powers - hacking into the minds of both machines and organics, manipulating objects by internal processing alone, or performing a range of other impr

excerpt.zh:
我们位于[This.GetName]的殖民者有了瞠目结舌的发现。在偏僻的山脉深处，他们碰巧撞见了一座神秘的结构，根据我们的扫描，这座建筑在我们第一次调查[This.GetPlanetMoon]的时候还不在那里。它的状态完好无损，就像是刚刚建造的一样，但是没有证据表明[Owner.GetAdj]参与了建造。事实上，它的构型显示出种种异星特征，曲边和拱角非常的不寻常，完全有悖于我们的美学感知。

在它的入口，有一个标志，上面写着（很神奇，用的是我们的语言）：“欢迎来到壮阔秀丽的跨次元异常点迷宫。进入者自行承担风险。”
excerpt.en: Our colonists on [This.GetName] have made a startling discovery. Deep in a remote mountain range, they stumbled across a mysterious structure that, according to our scans, was not there when we first surveyed the [This.GetPlanetMoon]. Its condition is excellen

excerpt.zh:
我们在[Root.GetName]的殖民者汇报了一个奇怪的现象：在他们一个主要殖民定居点外，“雪”开始聚集起来。

好吧，“雪”只是他们用来描述这种物质的代名词。显而易见的是这肯定不是真正的雪，因为[Root.GetName]可是一颗沙漠星球，即使在两极地区温度也极少降到冰点以下。而且，也没有任何人目击到这些东西从天而降。不过，初步的扫描显示这种物质确实主要由冰冻的水构成，至于为什么不会融化仍不清楚。我们的[Root.Owner.GetResearchers]希望能进一步研究它的性质，而另一些人则认为它会带来危险，
excerpt.en:
Our colonists on [Root.GetName] report a strange phenomenon: snow has begun gathering outside of one of their main colonial settlements.

Well, "snow" is the term they have used to describe it, anyway. It would seem implausible that it is real snow, given that

excerpt.zh:
这些“雪”似乎很抗拒被移除。尽管我们可以从其主体上取下小块使其融化，但这对阻止其势不可挡的增殖似乎收效甚微，而更激进的手段目前为止统统失败了——整个行动过程中围绕着一连串神秘的机械故障。

更糟糕的是，有越来越多的报告称，在受到“雪”影响的范围内有殖民者失踪。这些事件似乎是有所关联的，而这些雪可能是有生命，而且有恶意的。
excerpt.en: The snow, it appears, is resistant to being removed. While we are able to remove small parts of it from the main body and melt it in that manner, this has done little to halt its onward march, and more invasive attempts to destroy it have so far failed - a spa

excerpt.zh: 我们收到了一些令人担忧的汇报，事关[Target.GetName]的“雪的问题”。似乎有数名殖民者在去“打雪仗”之后失踪了。与他们的联络已经中断了数日，而且我们已经无法找到任何他们的踪迹了，活不见人死不见尸。我们现在已经对当地殖民者通告，不要与这些雪有任何形式的接触，直到我们的[Owner.GetResearchers]找到更多的线索——或者找到那些失踪的人口。
excerpt.en: We have heard concerning reports regarding the "snow problem" on [Target.GetName]. It appears that several of our colonists have gone missing, having set off to engage in a "snowball fight." Contact was lost with them several days ago, but we have been unable

excerpt.zh: 在[Target.GetName]上雪的扩散对我们的殖民者而言已经不仅仅是什么新奇小事了，现在它还带了了一些困难。它对生态系统造成了剧烈的影响，许多当地的动植物种群承受了巨大的压力。目前从受影响地区已迁出了大量移民。然而出乎意料的是，有另一些物种在这种新的寒冷环境中欣欣向荣。我们的气候学家敦促对事态进展的关注，并称其为观察正在进行中的非[Owner.GetAdj]操控气候变化的“百年难得一遇”的好机会。
excerpt.en: The spread of the snow on [Target.GetName] has not just been a source of novelty - and difficulty - for our colonists. It has also caused rapid changes to the ecosystem, with various native species of flora and fauna put under enormous strain. Already, there h

excerpt.zh:
由于与太空垃圾发生意外碰撞，[gravity_well_station.GetName]已经偏离了最佳稳定运转轨道，现在正缓缓落入最近的黑洞。这一事故使得整个空间站陷入了危险，但同时也是一个绝佳的研究黑洞、虹吸大量暗物质的契机。

应急推进器已经就绪准备修正空间站的轨道。
excerpt.en: Due to an unexpected collision with a chunk of space debris, the [gravity_well_station.GetName] has deviated from its innermost stable circular orbit and is now slowly closing the distance towards the nearby black hole. While the accident puts the whole statio

excerpt.zh: 在接近黑洞的过程中，时空以出乎意料的方式发生了弯曲，而[Target.GetName]的仪器也在艰难运转。经过对船上的仪器进行细致的重校准后，我们才发现这座空间站比我们之前预料的更加接近黑洞。
excerpt.en: When approaching a black hole, spacetime bends in unpredictable ways, and [Target.GetName]'s instruments are struggling to keep up. After a careful recalibration of the onboard instruments, the station was shown to be much closer to the black hole than we prev

excerpt.zh: [Target.GetName]与黑洞的超近距离使其[Root.Owner.GetResearchers]能获取海量的数据，大大推动了我们对物理学最基本定律的理解。
excerpt.en: [Target.GetName]'s proximity to the black hole allowed its [Root.Owner.GetResearchers] to gather a vast amount of data, furthering our understanding of the most fundamental laws of physics.

excerpt.zh: 我们的特工通过假扮成技工成功渗透进入了[target.GetName]的能源区划。他们的下一项任务是安装一个返航信标，诱惑能量寄生虫前来这个行星。
excerpt.en: By posing as technicians, our operatives successfully infiltrated the [target.GetName]'s energy districts. Their next assignment is to install a homing beacon to lure the energy parasite to the planet.

excerpt.zh: 一只贪婪的万华镜正试图强行连接到我们在[target.GetName]上的能量中枢。这提供了一个研究这只生物独特能力的绝佳机会，但我们预计这座建筑将因此受到严重破坏。
excerpt.en: A ravenous Kaleidoscope is trying to forcibly connect itself to one our Energy Nexus on [target.GetName]. This presents a remarkable opportunity to study the being's unique abilities, but we expect the building will be severely damaged as a result.

excerpt.zh: 万华镜焦躁地颤动着，让我们的天空充满了不和谐、不均匀的光线。我们的人不禁觉得这种景象令人不安。
excerpt.en: The Kaleidoscope trembles nervously, filling our skies with jarring, uneven patterns of light. Our people can't help but find the spectacle unnerving.

excerpt.zh: 万华镜犹如一道敞开的窗口，让我们的天空充满了不祥而病态的图案。我们的祭祀认为这是凶兆。也许明智的做法是牺牲一些能量给这个生物，消除它的饥饿，平息我们人民的恐惧。
excerpt.en: The Kaleidoscope throbs like an open wound, filling our skies with ominous, sickly patterns. Our priests believe it an ill omen. It may be wise to sacrifice some energy to the creature, to quench its hunger and appease our people's fears.

excerpt.zh: 万华镜号渴求能量，它学会了如何从我们的舰队中吸取能量。尽管能量消耗很小，但对我们的航速有明显的影响。
excerpt.en: Hungry for energy, the Kaleidoscope has learned how to siphon energy from our fleet. The power drain is minimal, but is having a detectable impact on our ships' speed.

excerpt.zh:
开心的万华镜让[owner.capital_scope.GetName]的天空中涂满了令人愉悦的图形，一个个分型互相流变，带来了一波波变化万千的奇观。

整颗星球仿佛静止了。人们驻足欣赏，为之惊叹。
excerpt.en:
A happy Kaleidoscope fills [owner.capital_scope.GetName]'s skies with pleasing shapes, fractals melting into other fractals in ever-changing waves of wonder.

The planet stops. Admires. Breathes.

excerpt.zh: 万华镜不断变化的图案会不会是一种沟通的方式？或者这只是一种类似呼吸一般的自发流程？我们的[root.GetScientistPlural]尚未找到答案。万华镜也正在为我们带来不可估量的研究数据。
excerpt.en: Could the shifting patterns of the Kaleidoscope be a form of communication? Or are they an autonomous process, more akin to breathing? Our [root.GetScientistPlural] still don't have an answer. The Kaleidoscope is providing us with an invaluable amount of scien

excerpt.zh: 万华镜寄生虫事实证明是一个异常好相处的邻居，但是要让它持续保持满足的心态不是一件容易的事情。建一个戴森球能不能满足它对能量的那种无底洞般的胃口呢？
excerpt.en: The Kaleidoscope has proven to be a strangely amiable neighbor, but keeping it sated has proven to be a challenge. Would a Dyson Sphere quench its endless thirst for energy?

excerpt.zh:
[Target.GetAdj]双星系统的光芒照耀着我们的货运飞船驶入[Target.capital_scope.Solar_System.GetName]。

他们的货物，数以百万计的微型噬星者，在绝对零度下储存，以确保它们稳定而惰性，直到将他们送到恒星系的主恒星。货运飞船需要继续保持静默飞行一段时间，以便进一步渗透[Target.GetSpeciesAdj]首都。
excerpt.en:
The light of the [Target.GetAdj] twin stars shone down on our transport ship as it entered the [Target.capital_scope.Solar_System.GetName] system.

Their cargo - millions of tiny Stellar Devourers - is stored at absolute zero, which keeps them docile and inert

excerpt.zh: 运载噬星者的货运飞船已经通过了恒星系的安全检查，其中使用的密码是此前由间谍首脑[spynetwork.leader.GetName]所捕获的，这对顺利通行至关重要。我们的操作员已经开始将这些噬星者宝宝重新解冻以恢复其活动。货运飞船将再次瞄准恒星系的首要恒星，作为这次旅途的终点。
excerpt.en: Our Stellar Devourer transport has cleared the system's security check - the security codes that Spymaster [spynetwork.leader.GetName] has been gathering were crucial for passing into the system. Our operatives have started the heating procedure to get the bab

excerpt.zh:
我们在[From.GetName]观测到大量晶状生命体的出现。这很明显是某种巢穴——或者至少是晶状生命体的聚集地，就如在[From.GetName]有一个我们从未见过的晶状结构。

这个结构展现出了很多类似晶状生命体的性质，但它的体积大得吓人。
excerpt.en:
We see significant crystalline presence in the [From.GetName] system. Evidently some kind of den - or at least a hub of crystalline activity, such as it is - [From.GetName] is home to a crystal construct unlike any previously encountered.

This construct exhib

excerpt.zh: 我们成功摧毁了[FromFrom.solar_system.GetName]的晶态结构。过程比我们想象中更加艰难，并在期间回收了一些碎片供研究之用。这样一来，我们应该就能模仿战斗中遭遇的晶体矩阵展现出的再生特性了。
excerpt.en: We have destroyed the crystalline construct in the [FromFrom.solar_system.GetName] system. It proved hardier than expected, and some shards have been recovered for study. We should be able to emulate the reconstructive properties of the crystal matrix observed

excerpt.zh: 我们在[From.GetName]星系发现了大量的古代采矿无人机。看来这里是一个巨大的采矿与矿石处理中心，甚至可能是整个星系中最后一个类似的存在。
excerpt.en: We have encountered a significant Ancient Mining Drone presence in the [From.GetName] system. It appears to be a major mining and mineral processing hub, perhaps the last of its kind in the galaxy.

title.zh: 已摧毁采矿无人机基地

excerpt.zh: 我们摧毁了采矿无人机基地，并成功取回了其中储存的大部分经过加工的矿产和珍贵的合金。
excerpt.en: We have destroyed the Mining Drone base, and managed to recover most of its stores of processed minerals and precious alloys.

excerpt.zh: 我们已经用勘探器遗珍的强力扫描光束扫描了我们的领土，并且在[chosen_planet.GetName]上发现了一个以前不为人知的资源储藏！
excerpt.en: We have swept our space with the strong scanning beam of the Surveyor relic, and a previously unknown resource deposit has been identified on [chosen_planet.GetName]!

excerpt.zh:
[Root.GetName]上的居民正在经历严重的身体突变，细胞和重要器官的功能遭到了破坏。虽然在某些情况下，这些变化提高了代谢效率，但更常见的结果是死亡。

这些副作用与万能巨噬细胞原始研究笔记中描述的完全吻合。尽管我们做出了努力，但由配方引起的致命突变似乎是不可避免的。这项技术不能再被信任了。我们正在销毁所有剩余的配方并将停止使用。
excerpt.en:
Citizens on [Root.GetName] are experiencing severe physical mutations that disrupt the functioning of cells and vital organs. While in some instances these changes have enhanced metabolic efficiency, more commonly they are causing fatalities.

These side effec

excerpt.zh:
对[From.GetName]的气候进行干化改造，使得整个星球新近显露的海床上出现了一个巨大的熔岩隧道网络。

形成这些深层隧道的岩浆流现在已经休眠，留下了富饶的矿脉，这些矿脉是在很久以前[From.GetName]熔融核心的极端高温和高压下形成的。

这些火成矿藏非常密集；在此地的开采作业成本高昂，但利润丰厚。
excerpt.en:
Drying the climate on [From.GetName] uncovered a vast network of lava tubes throughout the planet's newly-exposed ocean floor.

The magma flows which created these deep tunnels are dormant now, leaving behind a rich seam of minerals forged long ago in the extr

excerpt.zh:
[From.GetName]的环境改造工程意外引发了本地动物种群数量的激增。

我们发现，许多本地物种的繁殖周期与环境中的水资源供应密切相关。它们的卵原本需要在土壤中埋藏数月，吸收足够的水分后才能孵化，如今却大量散布在地表。该星球的动物数量正以对数级速度迅速增长。

这些生物中许多都富含营养，将为[From.GetName]提供丰富的食物来源，同时也为研究一个极其活跃的生态系统提供了机会。前往该星球的访客现在需要在离开时接受严格的筛查程序，以防止对外界造成污染。
excerpt.en:
The terraforming of [From.GetName] has caused an unexpected surge in the native fauna population.

We have discovered that the breeding cycles of many local species are intrinsically linked to the availability of water in the environment. Their eggs, which pre

excerpt.zh:
我们的环境改造专家已对[From.GetName]上即将出现的问题发出警告。

在这颗星球的冰冻山脉之下，蕴藏着大量高丰度的铁和碳资源，这些资源在环境改造过程中被过度加热。

我们现在可以安全地移除这些接近熔化的资源。或者，通过让过度加热持续下去，我们将培育出一个永久的合金来源。当然，这将以减少宜居生活空间为代价。
excerpt.en:
An impending issue on [From.GetName] has been flagged by our terraforming specialists.

Beneath the frozen mountain ranges of the planet lie vast, highly concentrated deposits of iron and carbon, all of which were superheated by the terraforming process.

We c

excerpt.zh:
在[From.GetName]进行的环境改造产生了意想不到的后果。我们未曾意识到，该星球表层的土壤是一种含有高浓度易爆微粒的细颗粒混合物，而我们的改造过程扰动了这些微粒，并将其散布到了整个星球的大气中。

不幸的是，这些空气中的高能粒子增加了地表意外燃烧事件的风险。任何未来的殖民地都必须优先考虑事故和冲突的预防，以避免灾难性的后果。

然而，如果我们能够谨慎管控这些危险，[From.GetName]的大气将成为这些稀有材料的丰富来源。
excerpt.en: Terraforming on [From.GetName] had unforeseen consequences. Unbeknown to us, the planet's topsoil was a fine particle mix containing  high concentrations of Volatile Motes which our terraforming process disturbed and seeded throughout the planet's atmosphere.

excerpt.zh:
[From.GetName]的行星地壳因环境改造过程而发生位移，导致了一种不寻常的自然现象。

移动的构造板块使多个异星天然气气穴发生位移，这些气体与行星火山中富含合金的矿脉发生反应，导致火山喷发呈现出鲜艳的蓝色。

这一现象的不稳定性使得行星的宜居性有所下降，从而影响了我们为[Root.GetColonistPlural]们创造居住空间的计划。

作为额外的好处，这些火山周围的土地现在富含资源，可供我们利用。
excerpt.en:
The planetary crust of [From.GetName] has shifted as a result of the terraforming process, leading to an unusual natural phenomenon.

The shifting tectonic plates have displaced several pockets of Exotic Gases which have reacted with the Alloy rich mineral dep

excerpt.zh:
我们收到报告，在[From.GetName]上出现了一种新兴的天气现象。

在星球的环境改造过程中，地壳中的水晶矿床暴露出来，并与改造过程中使用的化学物质发生反应，进而受到辐射。由此引发的空气温度波动导致了一场覆盖整个星球的持续雷暴。

这种独特的天气条件将不可避免地影响基础设施的建设，而受到辐射的水晶矿床也必然会对长期宜居性产生影响。然而，我们的[Owner.GetScientistPlural]相信，一旦环境改造完成，他们就能够利用这些风暴的能量。

此外，我们的[Owner.GetEngineerPlural
excerpt.en:
We have received reports of an emerging weather phenomenon on [From.GetName].

Crystal deposits within the bedrock of the planet have become exposed during terraforming, reacting to the chemicals used in the process and becoming irradiated. The resulting fluct

excerpt.zh:
当我们完成在[From.GetName]的环境改造后，尸体开始从天而降。

从如此高的高度坠落，这些古老的遗骸在撞击时化为肉泥。与内脏一起，我们发现了一些小物件的集合——装饰性的器物和奇异的遗迹——它们都从星球高层大气中相同的浓密云层中坠落。

这些厚重的云层，我们只能推测是被某种未知的外星物种用作最终的安息之地，现在正因我们的星球改造而变得稀薄，并释放出之前悬浮在其中的物品。我们可以预见，随着大气稳定，这些遗骸将继续坠落，直到云层墓穴完全空空如也。
excerpt.en:
As we finished terraforming on [From.GetName], bodies began falling from the sky.

From such heights, these ancient carcasses are reduced to a pulp upon impact. Amongst the viscera we have discovered clusters of small objects - ornamental instruments and odd r

excerpt.zh:
由于轨道上存在着许多太空垃圾和小型轨道碎片，我们在[event_target:junk_moon_planet.GetName]的环境改造工程师正在面临着危险的工作环境。其极大的数量给穿梭机在地表和轨道间往回航行带来了危险。

由于这些物体的密度极高，我们起早了一份，将其中最大的一些碎片进行磁化，使其在轨道上吸引其他的碎片，最后逐渐整合成一个更便于管理的整体。我们任务应该能制造出一颗人工卫星。

虽然这将增加环境改造的时间，但它将大大方便穿梭车进入地表，并消除大型轨道碎片频繁进入行星大气的风险。
excerpt.en: Our terraforming engineers on [event_target:junk_moon_planet.GetName] are facing hazardous working conditions due to various pieces of space junk and minor debris orbiting the planet. The high volume of these objects pose a navigational danger for shuttles tra

excerpt.zh:
将环绕[event_target:junk_moon_planet.GetName]的太空垃圾进行整合的工作成功了。

通过将许多大型碎片磁化后，我们逐渐将所有的物体集合成一个巨大的废金属团块。它的密度上升至足以产生自身引力的可观水平。这颗新形成的卫星随后被送入了稳定的轨道。

摆脱了这些危险的轨道碎片之后，前往[event_target:junk_moon_planet.GetName]的表面容易多了，我们再也不用担心这些东西掉入大气层。不仅如此，我们的工程师也确信这颗新的卫星甚至可以承载自己的开采站。
excerpt.en:
Efforts to consolidate the space junk orbiting [event_target:junk_moon_planet.GetName] were successful.

By magnetizing many of the larger pieces, we gradually gathered everything into a massive single body of scrap metal. Its density has risen to the point wh

excerpt.zh: [malfunctioning_leader_fleet.GetName]的调查单位[malfunctioning_leader.GetName]因为无意之中长时间暴露在高压电缆下而停止工作。
excerpt.en: Survey Unit [malfunctioning_leader.GetName] of the [malfunctioning_leader_fleet.GetName] has ceased functioning due to unintended and prolonged exposure to unshielded high-voltage cables.

excerpt.zh: [malfunctioning_leader_fleet.GetName]的舰队指挥单位[malfunctioning_leader.GetName]因非战斗原因停止工作。
excerpt.en: Fleet Commander Unit [malfunctioning_leader.GetName] of the [malfunctioning_leader_fleet.GetName] has ceased functioning for reasons unrelated to battle.

excerpt.zh: 星域管理单位[malfunctioning_leader.GetName]因严重的模式缓存故障而停止工作。
excerpt.en: Sector Governing Unit [malfunctioning_leader.GetName] has ceased functioning due to a severe pattern buffer issue.

excerpt.zh:
[target_planet.GetName]的行星政府报告称在全球范围内发现了一些多余的机器人劳力单元。虽然这些新机器人劳工的效率超乎想象，但政府对他们的莫名出现依然多少有些困惑。尽管他们的结构和接口都像是[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]的设计，我们仍然无法根据机器人的序列号追溯到任何已知记录上登记的制造商。

然而，当地的一些居民则对机器人生产效率的提高感到担忧，因为这种自动化程度的提升可能意味着，他们的岗位被替代。
excerpt.en: Planetary administration on [target_planet.GetName] has reported that an unplanned surplus of robotic workforce units have been located planetside. Though the efficiency of these new robotic workers is exceptional, administration is somewhat baffled by their s

excerpt.zh:
监测系统记录了我们传感器阵列的异常功率激增。似乎这个激增的出现并不是因为传感器阵列受到了什么损伤。实际上，这股在能量传递时发生的激增倒是暂时提高了我们的深空扫描能力，因为我们在边境内发现了之前未曾记录过的战略资源。

分析员们仍加班加点试图尽快确定激增来源，但是初步的分析结果显示，这并不是受外部天体影响造成的。
excerpt.en: Monitoring systems have recorded an unusual power surge in our sensor arrays. There does not appear to have been any damage. In fact, the brief fluctuation in transferred energy must have temporarily boosted our deep-scanning capabilities, because a hitherto u

excerpt.zh:
很不幸，我们的两艘舰船在一次例行训练中因事故而报废。事故原因应该是我们的几部舰载计算机的高级瞄准系统出现了故障，造成了走火事件，在人工进行紧急接管前两艘舰船被打成了筛子。

那些有缺陷的计算机将立刻被重新编程。
excerpt.en: Regrettably, two of our ships have been lost in an accident during a routine training exercise. It would appear several of our fleet's onboard combat computers were affected by a high-level targeting systems malfunction, resulting in a burst of friendly fire t

excerpt.zh: 我们的几个机械化消费品生产企业近期的生产效率大大增加。管理机关报告称，这次机器生产效率和生产精度的意外提升有利于降低我们的生活消费品价格。
excerpt.en: Several of our mechanized consumer goods manufactories have experienced a recent boom in production efficiency. Citing an unanticipated rise in precision and effectivity among our factory machinery, administration reports these benefits will be felt as lowered

excerpt.zh:
我们在[target_planet.GetName]上发现了数量巨大的机器单位的异常行为。每隔一段时间，星球上的一部分机器人会停止所有已分配的任务，开始移动到一个看上去完全是随机挑选的位置，其同步程度精确到毫秒。

在这个奇怪的集会过程中，这些受影响的机器人之间似乎没有进行任何可观测的沟通或是数据传输。他们只是站在那里，完全不动，好像在凝视着什么。

我们的调查一直无法确定这个现象背后的原因。这些机器人从这种恍惚状态恢复到正常工作状态的时间无迹可寻，就像它们触发恍惚的时间和集会的地点一样，让人丝毫摸不着头脑。我们未
excerpt.en: We have received accounts of unusual behavior exhibited by robotic units on [target_planet.GetName]. At unpredictable intervals, a number of our planetside robots will cease all assigned functions and begin moving to a seemingly randomly-determined location in

excerpt.zh: 我们的[Owner.GetTerraformerPlural]现在清除了[Root.GetName]上的最后一点地形改造残余物。尽管清除工作十分痛苦、还黏黏糊糊，但这一切并非没有价值。对造成这一事故的原因和后果进行分析，使我们对地形学有了更加深远的理解。
excerpt.en: Our [Owner.GetTerraformerPlural] have now cleared the final Terraforming Residue on [Root.GetName]. While the cleanup was painful and quite sticky, it was not all for naught. Analysis of the cause of this issue and the fallout has led to furthering our underst

title.zh: 发现剧毒环境改造候选

excerpt.zh:
我们对[From.GetName]的详细调查得出了结论，尽管由于其大气层内充满剧毒气体，现阶段生命不适合栖居，但是它具有维持可支持生命的大气层的潜质。通过合作筹划，我们或许能够将[From.GetPlanetMoon]的有毒物质降解成为毒性更加轻微的化合物。

对这个[From.GetPlanetMoon]进行环境改造理论上是可能的，但是我们目前还没有积累足够的技术手段，在合理的时间框架内完成这项壮举。
excerpt.en: Our detailed survey of [From.GetName] has revealed that although it is currently unsuitable for life due to the noxious gases present in its atmosphere, it is capable of sustaining a hospitable atmosphere. Through a concerted effort, we may be able to break th

excerpt.zh:
我们在[From.GetName]上发现了一片自然构造，其完美的几何结构令人窒息。这实乃上天的鬼斧神工，要引领我们到群星中去！

我们应该继续调查这些异常现象。这样一定会获得新的知识和科技的吧。
excerpt.en:
We found a natural formation on [From.GetName], stunning in its geometrical perfection. This is surely a divine sign, marking our way out towards the stars!

We should continue to investigate these sorts of anomalies whenever we get the chance. It will most as

excerpt.zh:
我们在[From.GetName]附近发现了微弱的超光速航道轨迹。其年代久远，业已无法进行追溯。这说明在很早之前就有星际旅行者来过这里，观察我们，收集情报。

我们应该继续调查这些异常现象。这样一定会获得新的知识和科技的吧。
excerpt.en:
We have detected a weak FTL trail near [From.GetName]. It is very old, making it impossible to track. This must mean that other interstellar travelers have been here before, watching us, surely gathering intel.

We should continue to investigate these sorts of

excerpt.zh:
我们在[From.GetName]上找到了一个我方的旧探测器。这些年来它一直保持运作，还试图将数据传送到母星上去。这是我们往日艰苦奋斗的纪念碑，也代表了昔日我们冲破行星枷锁的愿望。

我们应该继续调查这些异常现象。这样一定会获得新的知识和科技的吧。
excerpt.en:
We found one of our old probes on [From.GetName]. It has somehow kept intact all these years and is still trying to send data to our homeworld. It stands as a testament to our past struggles, and our wish to flee our Planet's bounds.

We should continue to inv

excerpt.zh: 我们派遣了一批[Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural]去分析调查[From.solar_system.GetName]中古老战舰的遗骸，从其中收集一切我们能得到的东西。我们虽然没能确定这些战舰作战的确切年代，也不知道它们究竟所属何方，但还是获得了一些关于这些舰船的建造技术。
excerpt.en: We sent in some of our [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] to analyze the remains of the ancient battleships in [From.solar_system.GetName], and glean from them what they can. Though unable to determine how old these vessels are, or for what banner they once fough

excerpt.zh:
我们对克兰尼克斯恒星系进行的初步扫描显示，巴洛瑞兹已经被核武器所摧毁。居民们使用了威力强大的星球级武器相互毁灭，甚至连卫星都被震碎了。

我们想要知道发生了什么，就只能通过目前还在恒星系中巡航的一艘舰船，但它正在用导弹攻击我们。
excerpt.en:
Our initial scan of the Xraneax system revealed that the planet Baloryz was destroyed by nuclear weapons. The inhabitants annihilated themselves using planet-based weapons so powerful that they even shattered their moon.

Our only chance to learn more about wh

excerpt.zh:
在船上未探测到生命迹象，因此这艘船明显是一艘人工智能，但它在战斗中一直将保全自身而非战斗效果最优化置于第一优先级。这意味着巴洛瑞兹上那次可怕冲突的唯一幸存者是这位智慧人工智能。

舰船在被摧毁前发送了一条简短的信息：

"为什么"

我们不知道这究竟是询问巴洛瑞兹居民自我毁灭的原因，还是对我们摧毁它的原因进行质疑。

虽然这些技术在我们的科技水平下较为原始，但我们可以通过拆解残骸来获取一些见解。或者出于对它勇敢履行了自己的职责的敬佩，我们可以用它的名字来命名这颗星球，以此来纪念这位智慧人工智能。
excerpt.en:
No life signs were detected aboard the vessel, so while clearly an AI, the ship repeatedly prioritized self-preservation over optimal combat effectiveness. This means that the only survivor of the horrible conflict on Baloryz was sapient.

The ship sent a brie

excerpt.zh:
[Root.GetName]一进入到[Root.solar_system.GetName]恒星系，发现许多无人机在广播着以下消息：

欢迎来到星达广场。

我们的自动无人机随时待命，协助您到达我们的轨道停泊区。你的飞船一熄火，我们的穿梭车就会带你去星达广场体验。明亮的水疗中心，完美的营养庭院，以及超大规模的产品和服务等着你！

在这个星系的唯一一颗气态巨行星附近，废弃的星达广场居住站孤独地漂浮着。看来已经很久没有人前往此处消费了。
excerpt.en:
As the [Root.GetName] entered the [Root.solar_system.GetName] system, several drones broadcast the following message:

Welcome to Star Mall.

Our automated drones are standing by to assist you to one of our orbital parking zones. Once your vessel is powered do

excerpt.zh: [Root.GetName]上的群众对我们的统治已经不满有一段时间了。现在他们的反抗甚至变得更为不加掩饰，并且不满分子已经公开呼吁要从[Root.Owner.GetName]独立。如果我们还想维持对这个殖民地的控制力，展现一次权威的力量是有必要的。
excerpt.en: The populace of [Root.GetName] has been discontent with our rule for some time now. Now their defiance is becoming ever more brazen, and dissidents are openly calling for independence from the [Root.Owner.GetName]. A show of authority may be necessary if we ar

excerpt.zh: 在一段局势紧张的日子后，[Root.Target.GetName]上的不满终于酿成了恐怖行动。尽管人员伤亡与财产损失微不足道，但居民已经开始质疑[Root.Owner.GetName]的保护他们的能力。
excerpt.en: After a period of mounting tension, the unrest on [Root.Target.GetName] has resulted in terrorist action. While casualties and property damage were minimal, faith in the [Root.Owner.GetName]'s ability to protect its citizens has been shaken.

excerpt.zh: 近来在深陷泥潭的[Root.Target.GetName]殖民地上发生了一起重大事件。尽管关键国有设施均安然无恙，但这场有组织的恐怖袭击仍造成了难以估量的财产损失以及人员伤亡，深深地动摇了殖民地稳定的根基。
excerpt.en: A major incident has occurred on the badly-troubled colony of [Root.Target.GetName]. While state-critical facilities remain unscathed, extensive property damage and significant loss of life as a result of coordinated terrorist attacks have shaken the colony to

excerpt.zh: 自[Root.Target.GetName]发来的报告表明，当地有相当大的风险爆发暴力骚乱。然而，幸亏[Root.Owner.GetAdj]军队迅速而果断地采取了行动，在忠诚的公民们的帮助下，这场威胁得以平息。
excerpt.en: Reports from [Root.Target.GetName] suggested that there was an imminent risk that violent rioting would break out. However, thanks to the quick and decisive action of [Root.Owner.GetAdj] forces, in partnership with loyalist civilians, this threat has been quel

excerpt.zh: [target.GetName]上的奴隶们已经揭竿而起！在精心计划的袭击中，[target.GetName]上的激进分子躲过了当地政府的搜查，击溃了我们的快速反应部队。该行星因此陷入骚乱的状态，愤怒的奴隶们拉帮结派，拿着威力强大的武器冲上街道大肆破坏，攻击任何胆敢阻止他们的人。
excerpt.en: The slaves on [target.GetName] are rioting! In a carefully planned assault, radical elements on [target.GetName] escaped the local authorities, overwhelming our rapid response teams. The planet has since descended into a state of general disarray as mobs of en

excerpt.zh: 看来[target.GetName]上的奴隶们已经无法再忍受下去了，他们开始绝食抗议。奴隶团体的发言人告诉我们，一大批奴隶开始拒绝摄入任何食物，直到我们废除奴隶制为止。到目前为止我们强迫他们进食的尝试均已失败。令人遗憾的是营养不良将大大的降低他们的工作效率。
excerpt.en: It would seem that the slaves on [target.GetName] have had enough...to eat. Spokespersons have informed us that a large number of slaves will be refusing all intake of food till we abolish slavery planetwide. So far all our attempts to force-feed them have fai

excerpt.zh: 由于在[revolt_planet.Planet.GetName]上终止了奴役劳动，动乱终于逐渐平息了。现在民众生活应该能够回归正规了吧。
excerpt.en: Thanks to the discontinued use of slave labor on [revolt_planet.Planet.GetName], unrest is beginning to die down. Maybe now life can return to normal.

excerpt.zh:
[From.GetName]的一批未开化物种不知为何进入了我们殖民地外围的安保隔离区域，尽管他们在不久之后就被赶出去了，但他们已经对我们专门负责运输货币的几条星际上行运输线造成了严重的破坏。

恐怕我们要失去几百能量币。
excerpt.en: A number of individuals belonging to the pre-sapient, native population of [From.GetName] somehow got into a secure compound on the outskirts of our colony. They were chased off within hours, but not before severely damaging several interstellar uplinks dedica

excerpt.zh:
[Root.GetName]的外星生物研究员发表了一封公开信，要求当地立法部门解除对接近智慧生物进行实验的限制。

他们从科研角度出发阐述了自己的观点，警告称如果法律得不到修改，[Root.GetName]的整个科研团体的实验效率都会下降。

其中涉及的伦理问题仍有争议。
excerpt.en:
Xeno-researchers on [Root.GetName] have published an open letter demanding that the local legislation restricting experiments on near-sapient alien species be relaxed.

They make a convincing case for the scientific benefits, and warn that the output of the en

excerpt.zh:
自从我们文明的伊始以来，一直有关于强大的术士掌握着只能用超自然力量形容的力量的传说。这些稀有的[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]可以侵入他们同胞的心智，用一个念想就能举起重物，或者表演其他的“魔法”壮举。直到最近，这些故事才变成“故”事。

如今，我们的科学家终于得到了结论性的证据以证明某些[Root.GetSpeciesName]个体存在潜在的灵能潜力。虽然我们的物种只有非常少的一部分人被天赐了灵能潜力，他们数量相对于总人口数在过去几世纪里稳步增长。

不知这是因为某种瞬间的增长井喷，还是因为
excerpt.en: Since the dawn of our civilization, tales have flourished of mighty sorcerers wielding powers that can only be described as supernatural in nature. These rare [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] could supposedly invade the minds of their fellows, lift heavy objects wi

excerpt.zh:
根据从[From.GetName]政府泄露出来的消息，潜在的灵能力量已经在个别[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]上显现。神经网络交流对他们而言不是新东西，这些报告称他们还产生了一种前所未见的超自然能力。

这种能力总的来说还仅限于少数[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。报告中对这种现象没有提出任何解释。
excerpt.en: Latent psionic powers have begun to manifest in certain [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural], according to leaked reports from authorities in the [From.GetName]. While neural-networked communication among their kind is nothing new, these reports describe paranormal abi

excerpt.zh:
[Root.GetSpeciesName]物种经历了只能被形容为“大觉醒”的蜕变，以往，我们伟大的灵能潜力便是我们物种固有的存在，虽然只在一小部分人身上有所展示，而如今……

几乎是一夜之间，身处各处的[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]都解锁了他们全部的灵能潜力，就像某种共通的[Root.GetSpeciesName]灵能能量池达到了激活值一样，将我们大脑中的灵能潜力集体激活。

心灵感应已经取代了[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]间大部分语音交流，而且这只是我们的社会面对的
excerpt.en: The [Root.GetSpeciesName] species has experienced what can only be described as a Great Awakening. For a time now, we have been aware of the great psionic potential inherent in our species, but such powers have only manifested themselves in a small minority...

excerpt.zh:
星系各地的[This.GetSpeciesNamePlural]都发生了一场深刻的转变。此前他们的潜在灵能只少量出现，现在他们群体总体都解放了全部的灵能潜质。

除了展现出一系列的强大灵能力以外，所有的[This.GetSpeciesNamePlural]现在还能在现有集体渠道之外交流。
excerpt.en:
All [This.GetSpeciesNamePlural] throughout the galaxy have undergone a great change. Whereas before their latent psionic power had only emerged in a small minority, the entirety of their kind has now unlocked its full psionic potential.

Aside from displaying

excerpt.zh: 在动身探索星系之前，我们必须对[home_system.GetName]恒星系进行全面调查。我们必须完全了解自己的“后院”。
excerpt.en: Before venturing into the rest of the galaxy, we should conduct a full survey of the [home_system.GetName] system. Our own backyard must not be left unexplored.

excerpt.zh: 为了确保长期生存，[This.GetSpeciesName]物种需要扩张到[This.Capital.GetName]之外的地方去。建立我们的第一个殖民地，并在外星球的地表上插上[This.GetName]的旗帜。
excerpt.en: The [This.GetSpeciesName] species needs to spread beyond [This.Capital.GetName] to secure its long-term survival. Establish our first colony and plant the banner of the [This.GetName] on the surface of an alien world.

excerpt.zh: 在我们境内侦测到奇怪的外星人出现，我们无法与其建立通讯通道。另外因为我们无法翻译他们的语言，目前只能静观其变。
excerpt.en: We have detected that the odd aliens, whose communication we cannot tap into, have appeared within our borders. Since it's impossible for us to translate their language we can only wait and see who they are and what they want.

excerpt.zh: 消灭一个太空变形虫。
excerpt.en: Neutralize a Space Amoeba.

excerpt.zh: 再消灭4个太空变形虫，以便更好的了解这个种群的生物特性。
excerpt.en: Eliminate 4 more Space Amoebas to get a better understanding of their biology.

excerpt.zh: 摧毁一个晶态实体来获取矿物质样本。
excerpt.en: Destroy a Crystalline Entity formation to retrieve a mineral sample.

excerpt.zh: 摧毁4个晶态实体舰队来进一步获取战斗场景数据。
excerpt.en: Crush 4 Crystalline Entity fleets to gather further combat scenario data.

excerpt.zh: 试图拆解并反向组装一个采矿无人机。
excerpt.en: Disable and attempt to reverse-engineer a Mining Drone.

excerpt.zh: 消灭一个虚空之云来获取它的原始星质。
excerpt.en: Neutralize a Void Cloud to sift through its primordial star-stuff.

excerpt.zh: 使用古代采矿无人机的评估系统中的技术，我们定位了一些矿产资源丰富的天体。
excerpt.en: Using techniques derived from the Ancient Mining Drones' assessment systems, we have pin-pointed a handful of stellar bodies that are likely to be particularly rich in minerals.

excerpt.zh:
所有的虚空之云在量子层面上都是相连的；这些散发能源的个体样本很可能就是一个单独的亚空间实体的多个表示形式。

对一个虚空之云进行了仔细研究之后，我们找到了其他可能富含这些云的星系。
excerpt.en:
All Void Clouds are entangled with one another on the quantum level; it is possible that the energies animating the individual specimens are nothing but multiple instances of a singular sub-space entity.

Through careful study of one Void Cloud, we have been a

excerpt.zh: 领导太空时代的十字军对抗[parameter:heathens.GetName]。
excerpt.en: Lead a crusade against the [parameter:heathens.GetName].

excerpt.zh: 有些东西正在破土而出感染我们的殖民地！
excerpt.en: Something is burrowing out of the ground and infesting our colony!

excerpt.zh: 我们已经找到了弥那玛特种实业集团的星系坐标。
excerpt.en: We have learned the galactic coordinates of Minamar Specialized Industries.

excerpt.zh: 太空兽群会将我们的种荚带到遥远的土地。只要一抹星光，我们的种子就能绽放为新的殖民地。
excerpt.en: Spaceborne fauna will carry our Seed Pods to distant lands. With a touch of starlight, our seeds can bloom into a new colony.

excerpt.zh: 星辰不过是我们饥渴的燃料，灾难只是我们野心绽放的土壤。我们将违逆自然法则，锻造一头巨大而不可阻挡到能重塑宇宙的巨兽。
excerpt.en: The stars are but fuel for our hunger, and calamity is merely the soil where our ambition blooms. We shall defy the natural order, forging a beast so immense, so unstoppable, that it will reshape the cosmos.

title.zh: 我们发现一颗行星表面覆盖着密密麻麻数以兆计的红色昆虫。这对于我们而言究竟是灾疫还是机遇呢？
title.en: We found a planet carpeted in trillions of red insects. A plague, or an opportunity?

excerpt.zh: 猩红爬虫
excerpt.en: Crimson Crawlers

excerpt.zh:
我们已经获悉在星系边缘的某个地方有一个神秘的星团。我们只能通过L-星门到达该星团，这是一种在特定恒星系中发现的人造亚空间入口。

这些星门已经被人蓄意地关闭了，并且现在我们对解除禁制所需要的亚空间原理缺乏足够的理解。
excerpt.en:
We have learned of a mysterious star cluster somewhere just beyond the periphery of our galaxy. It can only be accessed through L-Gates, artificial subspace portals found in certain systems.

These Gateways have been deliberately disabled by someone, and for n

excerpt.zh: 能量辐射
excerpt.en: Energy Emissions

excerpt.zh:
星系中的虚空虫数量已达到无法继续维持的水平，必须将其彻底消灭。

我们已经找到了所有剩余的虚空虫巢穴，必须将其摧毁。
excerpt.en:
The Voidworm population in the galaxy has reached unsustainable levels, and they must be eradicated.

We have located all remaining Voidworm Nests that must be destroyed.

excerpt.zh: 塞塔娜的真正目的大白天下了。她癫狂想除一切身体上的苦痛，“上传”所有感性生物的意识，消灭我们所知的一切生命。无论如何，我们必须找到能阻止她疯狂野心的力量。
excerpt.en: The true intentions of Cetana are at last made clear. In a monstrous bid to end physical suffering, she plans to 'upload' the consciousness of every sentient being, eradicating life as we know it. Somehow, we must find the strength to thwart her mad ambition.

excerpt.zh:
在追寻神圣的召唤时，我们将实现崇高身体与神圣义体技术的融合。没有任何事物能阻挡我们通往启迪之路。

融合即神圣。强化物即崇拜。
excerpt.en:
In pursuing the divine calling, we shall achieve the fusion of the exalted body and sacred cybernetics. Nothing shall hinder our path to enlightenment.

To fuse is divine. Augmentation is worship.

excerpt.zh: 前往目标帝国的恒星系并进行正式外交接触。
excerpt.en: Travel to the target empire's home system and conduct a formal diplomatic engagement.

excerpt.zh: 该恒星系中有可采集的高价值矿物。
excerpt.en: There are valuable Minerals in this system that can be harvested.

excerpt.zh: 采集该恒星系中的可用能量。
excerpt.en: Harvest the available Energy in this system.

excerpt.zh: 收集该恒星系内可用的消费品。
excerpt.en: Collect the Consumer Goods available in this system.

excerpt.zh: 可以从该恒星系收集高价值的合金。
excerpt.en: Valuable Alloys can be harvested from this system.

excerpt.zh: 该恒星系中可以找到罕见的易爆微粒。
excerpt.en: Rare Volatile Motes can be found in this system.

excerpt.zh: 这里可以找到罕见的异星天然气。应当采集它们。
excerpt.en: Rare Exotic Gases can be found here. They should be harvested.

excerpt.zh: 该恒星系已探测到稀有水晶。采集它们。
excerpt.en: Rare Crystals have been detected in this system. Harvest them.

excerpt.zh: 根据扫描结果，该恒星系中存在活体金属。
excerpt.en: According to scans, there is Living Metal in this system.

excerpt.zh: 这里可以收获纳米机器人。
excerpt.en: There are Nanites here that can be acquired.

excerpt.zh: 我们的工程师认为在该恒星系内有藏有一批£energy£ 能量币。
excerpt.en: Our engineers suspect that there is an £energy£ Energy Credits cache in this system.

excerpt.zh: 我们的工程师认为在该恒星系内有藏有一批£minerals£ 矿物。
excerpt.en: Our engineers suspect that there is a £minerals£ Minerals cache in this system.

excerpt.zh: 我们的工程师认为在该恒星系内有藏有一批£alloys£ 合金。
excerpt.en: Our engineers suspect that there is an £alloys£ Alloys cache in this system.

excerpt.zh: $contract_scientific_observation_internal_desc$
excerpt.en: $contract_scientific_observation_internal_desc$

excerpt.zh: $contract_scientific_observation_internal_desc$
excerpt.en: $contract_scientific_observation_internal_desc$

excerpt.zh: 我们将进入轨道，让乘客们沉浸在陌生太阳的光辉之中。
excerpt.en: We'll settle into orbit and let the passengers soak in the light of an unfamiliar sun.

excerpt.zh: 乘客中的业余天文学家发现了该星系中罕见的太阳活动，目前正在请愿要求在驻留轨道期间获得前排的观赏位置。
excerpt.en: Amateur astronomers among the passengers have spotted rare solar activity in this system and are petitioning for a front-row viewing from orbit.

excerpt.zh: 巡游舰正在举办一场围绕该星系恒星的穿梭机比赛。乘客们纷纷下注，挤满了每一个舷窗。
excerpt.en: The cruise is hosting a shuttle race around this system's star. Passengers are placing bets and crowding every viewport.

excerpt.zh: 疗愈中心需要长时间暴露在未经过滤的恒星辐射下，以进行乘客们一直要求的一种奇特的焕新理疗。
excerpt.en: The spa requires prolonged exposure to unfiltered stellar radiation for an exotic rejuvenation treatment the passengers have been requesting.

excerpt.zh: 一场盛大的正式舞会将在观景甲板上举行，沐浴在直射的星光下。这是此次航程中的社交盛事。
excerpt.en: A grand formal ball is to be held on the observation decks, bathed in direct starlight. The social event of the voyage.

excerpt.zh: 在主发电机进行计划维护期间，我们需要环绕该星系的恒星运行，并依靠太阳能供电。
excerpt.en: We need to orbit this system's star and run on solar power while the main generators undergo scheduled maintenance.

excerpt.zh: 外层船体板需要在持续的恒星照射下进行热荷载测试。为确保安全，朝向恒星一侧的所有舷窗都将被遮蔽。
excerpt.en: The outer hull plating requires thermal load testing under sustained stellar exposure. All viewports on the starward side will be shuttered for safety.

excerpt.zh: 冷却系统需要在热负载下进行一次完整的排空循环。近恒星轨道能让我们高效地冲洗管线，尽管甲板温度会出现波动。
excerpt.en: The coolant system needs a full purge cycle under thermal load. Close stellar orbit will let us flush the lines efficiently, though deck temperatures will fluctuate.

excerpt.zh: 导航阵列必须在近距离根据实时恒星信号进行校准。此过程将占用娱乐系统的带宽。
excerpt.en: Navigation arrays must be calibrated against a live stellar signature at close range. The process will commandeer bandwidth from entertainment systems.

excerpt.zh: 水循环系统需要进行一次高强度的紫外线杀菌，此过程只有在近恒星轨道上才能高效完成。疗愈中心与游泳池现已关闭，各层甲板均实行限量供水。
excerpt.en: The water recyclers need an intensive UV sterilization run that is only efficient in close stellar orbit. The spa and pool are closed and water is rationed across all decks.

excerpt.zh: 乘客们渴望踏上坚实的土地，去探索下方的外星城市。我们已经安排了由向导带领的进城游览。
excerpt.en: The passengers are eager to set foot on solid ground and explore the alien city below. We've arranged guided excursions into the city.

excerpt.zh: 下方星球上的著名餐饮区已同意接待乘客，为他们举办一场由向导带领的当地美食品鉴之旅。
excerpt.en: The renowned dining districts on the planet below have agreed to host the passengers for a guided tasting tour of local cuisine.

excerpt.zh: 该星球的首都设有一座享誉星系的博物馆。乘客们一直在请愿，要求安排带有导游的游览活动，以参观其中的纪念碑和历史展品。
excerpt.en: The planet's capital hosts a museum of galactic renown. Passengers have been petitioning for a guided tour of its monuments and historical exhibits.

excerpt.zh: 地表上一个庞大的露天市场交易着来自整个星域的商品。乘客们迫不及待地想要去逛一逛并讨价还价。
excerpt.en: A sprawling open-air market on the surface deals in goods from across the sector. The passengers are eager to browse and haggle.

excerpt.zh: 下方星球上的自然保护区提供穿越其外星荒野的导览服务。乘客们可以从导览步道上近距离观赏外星动物群。
excerpt.en: A nature reserve on the planet below offers guided tours through its alien wilderness. Passengers will observe alien fauna from guided walkways.

excerpt.zh: [GetShoreleaveCrewDesc1]
excerpt.en: [GetShoreleaveCrewDesc1]

excerpt.zh: [GetShoreleaveCrewDesc2]
excerpt.en: [GetShoreleaveCrewDesc2]

excerpt.zh: 储备即将耗尽。船组小队将前往星球表面寻找备件、原材料，以及飞船制造机在几个周期前就已停止生产的各类补给品。
excerpt.en: Stores are running low. Crew teams will go planetside to source replacement parts, raw materials, and the supplies the ship's fabricators stopped producing cycles ago.

excerpt.zh: 当地工程师已开放他们的设施供考察。他们对常见工程问题的解决方案与我们的模型存在显著差异，而当地人也同样渴望研究方舟舰。
excerpt.en: Local engineers have opened their facilities for inspection. Their solutions to common engineering problems diverge significantly from our own models, and the locals are equally eager to study the Arkship.

excerpt.zh: [GetShoreleaveCrewDesc5]
excerpt.en: [GetShoreleaveCrewDesc5]

excerpt.zh: 为了娱乐乘客，我们将在指定的恒星系中部署一颗非功能性的“间谍卫星”。
excerpt.en: To entertain the passengers, we'll deploy a non-functional "spy satellite" in the indicated system.

excerpt.zh: [GetEspionageSupportPassenger2]
excerpt.en: [GetEspionageSupportPassenger2]

excerpt.zh: 乘客们在导游的带领下前往下方的城市游览，船组特工已在预定地点放置了虚假的情报包裹，供他们去发现。
excerpt.en: Passengers are taken on guided excursions to the city below, where crew operatives have planted fake intelligence packages at prearranged locations for them to discover.

excerpt.zh: 全船各层甲板已通报发生一起模拟的安全事件。乘客们被招募参与一场全船范围的调查游戏，以找出安插在船员中的“外来特工”。
excerpt.en: A staged security breach has been announced across all decks. Passengers are recruited to identify planted 'foreign agents' among the crew in a ship-wide investigation game.

excerpt.zh: 观景台已被改造为监听站。乘客们驻守在这些站点，破译着船员们从底层甲板秘密发送的、预先编排好的外星信号。
excerpt.en: The observation decks have been converted into listening posts. Passengers man the stations, decoding scripted alien transmissions that the crew is secretly broadcasting from below decks.

excerpt.zh: 船员们对于在这个恒星系遭遇干扰的担忧是合情合理的。侦察卫星能对任何可能打乱我们行程的情况提供提前预警。
excerpt.en: Concerns about interference in this system are legitimate. A surveillance satellite will give us advance warning of anything that might disrupt our itinerary.

excerpt.zh: 停靠权和边境通行权可能会在毫无预警的情况下被撤销。一颗监控政府通信的监视卫星将告诉我们，这个帝国的热情好客究竟是真诚的还是有条件的。
excerpt.en: Docking privileges and border access can be revoked without warning. A surveillance satellite monitoring government communications will tell us whether this empire's hospitality is genuine or conditional.

excerpt.zh: 我们预定航线上的舰队动向、边界变动与军事集结可能会使飞船受困于敌对星区。侦察卫星将为导航提供足够的预警时间，以便规划备用路线。
excerpt.en: Fleet movements, border shifts, and military buildups along our projected route could strand the ship in hostile space. A surveillance satellite will give navigation enough lead time to plot alternatives.

excerpt.zh: 当采购部门了解真实价格时，供应谈判会进展得更加顺利。一颗监控贸易渠道和资源流向的监视卫星，将确保我们的团队在下一个港口不会支付过高的价格。
excerpt.en: Supply negotiations go better when procurement knows the real prices. A surveillance satellite monitoring trade channels and resource flows will ensure our teams are not overpaying at the next port.

excerpt.zh: 该地区出现了反游牧情绪的相关报道。侦察卫星将确认这一局势仅仅是空谈，还是正在成为当地的政策。
excerpt.en: Reports of anti-nomad sentiment have surfaced in this region. A surveillance satellite will confirm whether the talk is just rhetoric or whether it is becoming policy.

excerpt.en: $contract_espionage_support_nomad_desc$

excerpt.zh: 加入[From.GetName]的所有战争。
excerpt.en: Join the [From.GetName] in all their wars.

excerpt.zh: 对该系统进行深度扫描，以评估其资源和战略相关性。
excerpt.en: Complete a Deep Scan of this system to assess its resources and strategic relevance.

excerpt.zh: 代表[from.GetName]轰炸行星以积累荒废度。
excerpt.en: Bombard planets on behalf of [from.GetName] to build up Devastation.

excerpt.zh: 支援巨型结构的建造。
excerpt.en: Assist with the construction of a Megastructure.

excerpt.zh: 扫描一场战斗之后留下的残骸。
excerpt.en: Scan the debris left behind after a battle.

excerpt.zh: 清理该帝国的殖民地上所有的行星自然障碍。
excerpt.en: Clear every Natural Planetary Blockers from this Empire's Colony.

excerpt.zh: 在此帝国的某个恒星系中建造一座驿站。
excerpt.en: Build a Waystation in this Empire's system.

excerpt.zh: 该恒星系的太空兽群正给我们带来麻烦。请铲除它们。
excerpt.en: The Space Fauna in this system are causing us problems. Please eradicate them.

excerpt.zh: 将代表团运输至[from.capital_scope.solar_system.GetName]星系的[from.capital_scope.GetName]。
excerpt.en: Transport delegates to [from.capital_scope.GetName] in the [from.capital_scope.solar_system.GetName] system.

excerpt.zh:
从[fromfrom.GetName]接收罪犯。我们将按认为合适的方式驱逐他们，并可以选择将他们留在船上或送往另一个殖民地。我们不应将他们带回属于[from.GetName]的行星。

在接收囚犯后，选择将他们留在船上，或使用方舟舰指令“移交囚犯”将他们捎到我们选择的殖民地。
excerpt.en:
Pick up criminals from [fromfrom.GetName]. We are to deport them as we see fit, and can choose to either keep them aboard or drop them off on another colony. We are not supposed to bring them back to a planet owned by [from.GetName].

After collecting the pris

excerpt.zh: 代表合约发布方在方舟舰上研究£physics£ 物理学研究。
excerpt.en: Conduct £physics£ Physics Research aboard an Arkship on behalf of the contract issuer.

excerpt.zh: 代表合约发布方在方舟舰上研究£society£ 社会学研究。
excerpt.en: Conduct £society£ Society Research aboard an Arkship on behalf of the contract issuer.

excerpt.zh: 代表合约发布方在方舟舰上研究£engineering£ 工程学研究。
excerpt.en: Conduct £engineering£ Engineering Research aboard an Arkship on behalf of the contract issuer.

excerpt.zh: 在方舟舰上研究£engineering£ 工程学研究，以改善该恒星系现有的£minerals£ 矿物矿脉分布。
excerpt.en: Conduct £engineering£ Engineering Research aboard an Arkship to improve existing £minerals£ Minerals deposits in this system.

excerpt.zh: 开展£physics£ 物理学研究研究以改进该恒星系中现有的£energy£ 能量币来源。
excerpt.en: Conduct £physics£ Physics Research to improve existing sources of £energy£ Energy Credits in this system.

excerpt.zh: 在方舟舰上研究£society£ 社会学研究，以提高该星系中可开发的£food£ 食物储量。
excerpt.en: Conduct £society£ Society Research aboard an Arkship to improve exploitable deposits of £food£ Food in this system.

excerpt.zh: 带领一群游客进行一场银河观光之旅。
excerpt.en: Take a group of tourists on a galactic sightseeing tour.

excerpt.zh: 协助让这个新殖民地设立且高效地运转起来。
excerpt.en: Help get this new colony up and running efficiently.

excerpt.zh: 我们获得可靠情报，[marauder_country_1.GetName]的掠夺舰队将经过此恒星系。这将是一个埋伏他们的绝佳机会。
excerpt.en: We have good intelligence that the [marauder_country_1.GetName] raiding fleet will be passing through this system. It will be a great opportunity for an ambush.

excerpt.zh: 看来[marauder_country_1.GetName]已在此恒星系建立了一处哨站。我们应该在他们站稳脚跟前将其铲除。
excerpt.en: It seems that the [marauder_country_1.GetName] have set up an outpost in this system. We should knock it out before they get a foothold.

title.zh: 提名冠铸秀锦标赛的举办恒星系

excerpt.zh: 我们已经购买了下一届“冠军之铸现场秀！”锦标赛的场地权。或许我们可以利用这一点为我们谋取优势。
excerpt.en: We have purchased the venue rights for the next Champion's Forge Live! tournament. Perhaps we can use this for our advantage.

excerpt.zh: 使用方舟舰的恒星引擎将气态巨行星转化为新生恒星，为该恒星系解锁海量资源。
excerpt.en: Use the Arkship's Stellar Engine to transform a gas giant into a newborn star, unlocking vast resources for the system.

excerpt.zh:
对[exiled_country.GetName]的战争迫在眉睫。

这场灵能浩劫必须从根源上解决。我们必须先在[exiled_center_system.GetName]恒星系内建造一座虚境封印，以此中和掉灵能光环；只有这样我们才能踏足，并将其从这个星系里净化掉。
excerpt.en:
War against the [exiled_country.GetName] is now upon us.

The psionic scourge must be quelled at its source. We must first construct a Shroud Seal in the [exiled_center_system.GetName] system, thereby neutralizing the Psionic Aura; only then can we move in and

excerpt.zh: 该终末光环正受到能衰装置的挑战，这些外来机械可衰减灵能。我等受其主宰之意志所驱，必须拆解这些亵渎之器。
excerpt.en: The Aura of the End is being challenged by foreign devices capable of psionic attenuation. The will of our patron compels us to dismantle these blasphemous machines.

excerpt.zh: 在我们探索繁星之前我们需要先拓宽视野。幸好，我们有一张复杂的星系地图可用。要打开星系地图，你可以按M键或是屏幕底部的星系按钮。之后就可以按Esc或是右上角的按钮关闭情报日志了。
excerpt.en: Before we can explore the stars we need to broaden our view. Thankfully, we have a sophisticated Galaxy Map at our disposal. To access the Galaxy Map, you can either press M or the Galaxy Button at the bottom of your screen. Afterwards feel free to close the S

excerpt.zh:
首先选中我们的£science_ship£科研船。你可以在星系地图上直接点击舰船或是从总览中选中。

然后在察看星系地图的同时，在左下角的舰队界面点击调查按钮，然后选择一个没有调查过的£system£恒星系。你也可以右键点击一个未调查的恒星系然后选择调查恒星系。

我们的科研船会自动对那个恒星系内的所有天体进行调查。
excerpt.en:
Begin by selecting our £science_ship£ Science Ship. This can be done by clicking on the Ship on the Galaxy Map or by selecting it from the Outliner.

While viewing the Galaxy Map, click the Survey button on the fleet interface in the lower left corner, then se

excerpt.zh:
我们需要研发新科技。新世界协议将使我们可以建造£colony_ship£殖民船，如果我们要扩张自己的帝国，那我们应该尽快研发它。

点击顶部界面左端的按钮或是按下F4键来开启科技界面。然后点击选择研究并从中挑选一项科技作为研究目标。
excerpt.en:
We need to research new technologies. The New Worlds Protocol will enable us to construct £colony_ship£ Colony Ships, and we should focus on this as soon as possible if we are to expand our empire.

Access the Technology screen by clicking its button in the le

excerpt.zh:
如果您想要开发被£science_ship£科研船发现的资源，那么您需要派遣£construction_ship£工程船执行相关任务。

点击恒星基地选择船坞界面。再在几个选项中选择工程船。

注意您需要足够的£alloys£合金才能开始建造这些舰船。
excerpt.en:
We will need a £construction_ship£ Construction Ship if we are to exploit the resources that are discovered by our £science_ship£ Science Ship.

Click on our Starbase and select the Shipyard tab, then select Construction Ship from among the available choices.

excerpt.zh:
想开发£planet£行星上的£minerals£矿物或者战略资源矿藏，需要在轨道上建立£mining_station£开采站。为此，你需要选择£construction_ship£工程船，可以直接点击工程船或者在总览选择。

选中之后，在工程船的舰队界面点击[GetBuildGrowCap]开采站按钮，然后点击拥有矿藏的可用行星或小行星。

注意，建造£mining_station£开采站会花费£minerals£矿物资源，所以在建造前一定要确保拥有足够的矿物。
excerpt.en: Before a £minerals£ Mineral deposit or a Strategic Resource can be collected from a £planet£ Planet, a £mining_station£ Mining Station needs to be built in orbit. To do this, select your £construction_ship£ Construction Ship either by clicking directly on it o

excerpt.zh:
当£science_ship£科研船已经准备探索星系时，所需要做的只有取消暂停了。只需要简单地按下空格键£space£或在顶部栏点击以下按钮即可：

                                    £pause_button£
excerpt.en:
With a £science_ship£ Science Ship standing by to explore the galaxy, all that is left is to unpause. To do this, simply press the Space Bar £space£ or select the following icon in the top bar:

                                    £pause_button£

excerpt.zh:
为了提升我们研究新技术的速度，请在拥有£physics£物理，£society£社会或£engineering£工程资源的行星上建立£science_ship£研究站。

研究站的工作方式和£mining_station£开采站类似，其区别在于收集的资源不一样。研究站无法收集£strategic_resource£战略资源和£minerals£矿物。

要建造研究站，需要选择一艘£construction_ship£工程船，并在舰队界面选择[GetBuildGrowCap]研究站的按钮，然后点击含有拥有物理、社会或
excerpt.en:
To improve the rate at which we research new technologies, £science_ship£ Research Stations should be built above any world that possesses £physics£ Physics, £society£ Society or £engineering£ Engineering resources.

Research Stations function much in the same

excerpt.zh:
我们的母星已经有少量£building£建筑，但我们应该继续建造。

要完成这项任务，首先在总览点击我们的母星，点击地表选项卡。在一个区划中点击一个空白建筑槽，并从可用建筑中选择。只要我们拥有足够资源，建造就会立即开始。

建筑提供£job£岗位，但在有£pops£人口被委派上去工作之前不会有任何产出。你可以在经济选项卡中查看你的人口都在从事什么岗位的工作。
excerpt.en:
Our homeworld already has a small number of £building£ Buildings, but we should build another one.

To do this, select the homeworld in the Outliner and click on the Surface tab. Select an empty building slot in a district, and choose from one of the available

excerpt.zh:
我们母星上的一些=£blocker£障碍妨碍了区划的进一步开发，罪当清除。这就需要花费资源。

要清理障碍，在管理选项卡中找到障碍，然后点击其上的清理障碍按钮。


                                        £clear_blocker£


清理不同的障碍需要的花费和时间也有所不同。
excerpt.en:
Several £blocker£ Blocker on our homeworld are preventing the construction of additional Districts, and should be cleared. This takes time and costs Resources.

To clear a Blocker, click the Clear Blocker button on the blocker itself, which can be found on the

excerpt.zh:
我们需要在£system£母星系外扩张我们的帝国。首先要做的就是调查邻近星系。

要进行探索，请选择你的£science_ship£科研船，在舰队界面点击调查按钮，然后点击屏幕下方的打开星系地图按钮，选择一个邻近星系。科研船会自动前往该星系，调查其中的全部天体。
excerpt.en:
We need to expand our influence beyond our home £system£ System, and the first step towards doing this is to survey the neighboring star systems.

To do this, select your £science_ship£ Science Ship and click on the Survey button in its fleet interface. Then c

excerpt.zh:
我们应该考虑[GetBuildingGrowing]第二艘£science_ship£科研船来加速星系的探索进度。

点击恒星基地选择船坞选项卡。再在几个选项中选择科研船。

注意您需要足够的£alloys£合金才能开始建造这艘舰船。
excerpt.en:
We should consider [GetBuildingGrowing] a second £science_ship£ Science Ship to increase the speed at which we survey our region of the galaxy.

Click on our Starbase and select the Shipyard tab, then select Science Ship from among the available choices.

Note

excerpt.zh:
我们或许应当考虑雇佣一名新的£scientist£科学官来指挥全新的£science_ship£科研船。虽然科研船可以在没有科学家的情况下继续探索，但是失去了科学家的指导，他们便无法探测到异常现象。

选择我们的新科研船，点击指派领袖。领袖页面会展开，显示为我们服务的所有科学家。在列表顶部点击招募按钮。

选择你想要的科学家，然后点击招募按钮。招募领袖会花费£unity£凝聚力，请务必储存足够。

招募完毕后，新的科学家便会在母星中等待安排。
excerpt.en:
We need a £scientist£ Scientist to command our new £science_ship£ Science Ship, as it cannot survey or research Anomalies without one.

Select our new Science Ship, and then click on the portrait in the fleet interface. The Select a Leader window will open, sh

excerpt.zh:
现在该殖民另一颗星球了。首先我们得[GetBuildGrow]一艘£colony_ship£殖民船。[GetBuildGrow]这种舰船需要花很长时间，以及大量的£alloys£合金、£food£食物和£consumer_goods£消费品，但兴旺发展的£colony£殖民地带来的回报远远大于这笔投入。

点击你的恒星基地，打开船坞选项卡。然后从各种选项中点击选择殖民船。

请注意，在建造开始之前，你必须先积累足够的资源。
excerpt.en: The time has come to colonize another world. First we will have to [GetBuildGrow] a £colony_ship£ Colony Ship. These Ships take a long time to [GetBuildGrow] and require a large amount of £alloys£ Alloys, £food£ Food, and £consumer_goods£ Consumer Goods, but a

excerpt.zh:
现在我们该用新造的£colony_ship£殖民船来设立我们的第一个£colony£殖民地。最佳的候选星球是与我们的母星类型相同的星球，这样我们的殖民者在适应环境方面不会有任何问题。

要殖民一颗£planet£行星，点击你的殖民船，或者在总览窗口中选中它。然后在其舰队界面中点击殖民按钮，并选择你想殖民的星球。注意你只能在已调查并且没有异常点的星球上殖民。星球也必须位于你的境内。虽然你可以选择在宜居性较低的星球上殖民，但代价会非常高昂。
excerpt.en:
We should now use our new £colony_ship£ Colony Ship to establish our first £colony£ Colony. The best planetary candidates are those that are of the same planet class as our homeworld - our colonists will have no problems adjusting to their environments.

To co

excerpt.zh:
我们需要招募一名总督来管理我们新的£colony£殖民地。要进行招募，可点击殖民地，进入到殖民地总览标签中，在总督窗口点击更换按钮。此时会展开一个领袖窗口，显示现在为我们工作的总督。

在屏幕上方点击招募按钮，选择一名可供使用的总督。注意，招募领袖会花费£unity£凝聚力。如果储备不足，就要等到收集足够后再进行招募。

新总督招募完毕后将会在母星等待安排。
excerpt.en: We should recruit a Governor to administer our new £colony£ Colony. To do this, click on the colony and go into its Colony Summary tab. Then click on the Change button in the Governor window. This will open the Leaders screen, showing the Governors currently w

title.zh: 教程：建立更多的殖民地

excerpt.zh:
以建立£colony£殖民地的方式继续扩张我们的帝国。我们有充足的£alloys£合金、£food£食物和£consumer_goods£消费品时，就[GetBuildGrowCap]更多£colony_ship£殖民船，然后让它们去建立更多殖民地。

小心，不要在殖民地发展阶段同时建立过多的殖民地，因为他们能够自己自足之前一直会消耗£energy£能量币。
excerpt.en:
Continue to expand our empire by founding new £colony£ Colonies. [GetBuildGrowCap] more £colony_ship£ Colony Ships when we have enough £alloys£ Alloys, £food£ Food, and £consumer_goods£ Consumer Goods then send them off to establish new colonies.

Take care no

excerpt.zh:
我们不断成长的工业渴求原料，因此必须增加£minerals£矿物的产量。我们可以在有矿物储藏的£planet£行星和小行星上[GetBuildingGrowing]£mining_station£开采站，或是在某个已殖民的星球表面上建造采矿区划。

空间站和£building£建筑都需要£energy£能量币来维护，因此我们也需要保证这项资源的充足供应。能量币由已殖民星球上的发电区划生产，也可以通过在有能量币储藏的行星、小行星和恒星上建造开采站来生产。
excerpt.en: Our growing industry is ravenous for raw materials, and we need to increase our supply of £minerals£ Minerals. This is done by [GetBuildingGrowing] £mining_station£ Mining Stations above £planet£ Planets and asteroids with Mineral deposits, or by building Mini

excerpt.zh:
我们必须[GetBuildGrow]一支强大的星际舰队，以确保[Root.GetName]的安全。

目前来看，我们需要再[GetBuildGrowCap]几艘护卫舰。等到合金储量足够的时候，我们可以在恒星基地中进行。新造的军舰会自动并入位于建造它的恒星基地轨道上现有的舰队。

为了最大化舰队的战斗力，我们可以为其指派一位舰队司令。这会让这支舰队在面对那些没有£commander£指挥官管辖的舰队时更具优势。
excerpt.en:
We should [GetBuildGrow] a potent starfleet to uphold the [Root.GetName].

A few more Corvettes should do, for now. [GetBuildGrowCap] the Ships at a Starbase when our Alloy supplies permit. New military ships always join any existing fleets in orbit of the Sta

excerpt.zh: 我们应该指派一位总督来管理我们的新星域。星域中的所有£planet£行星将受益于总督的能力等级与特质。
excerpt.en: We should assign a Governor to administrate our new Sector. All £planet£ Planets within the sector will then benefit from the effects of the Governor's skill level and traits.

excerpt.zh:
要设计一种新的舰船，在侧边栏打开舰队管理或按F9后，点击打开舰船设计器。点击新设计按钮，在选择舰船尺寸时选择护卫舰。点击无区段按钮为该设计选择一个区段。

护卫舰是最小型的战舰，它只有一个区段。更大型的舰船区段更多。区段的种类决定了武器和通用槽位。选择一个区段后，用各种不见填满，并注意保证能源供给虫族。

通过点击自动装配可以简化该流程，让游戏自动完成设计。

excerpt.zh:
我们应该在一个[Owner.GetPreFTLUpper]社会的母星上方[GetBuildGrow]观测站。这些空间站可以完成多种不同的任务，而任务的种类则取决于我们想要如何影响这些发展中的文明。

观测站的建造方式与£mining_station£开采站和£science_ship£科研站相同，但只能造在[Owner.GetPreFTLUpper]文明的母星上方。只需要选择一艘£construction_ship£工程船，然后在其舰队界面中点击[GetBuildGrowCap]观测站。

我们应该在拥有£strategic_resource£战略资源的天体轨道上[GetBuildGrow]一个£mining_station£开采站。这些稀有的原料拥有巨大的战略价值。

通过调查找到这类资源后，选取一艘£construction_ship£工程船，然后选择[GetBuildGrowCap]开采站，然后点击相应的天体，即可进行建造。
excerpt.en:
We should [GetBuildGrow] a £mining_station£ Mining Station in orbit of an astronomical object with a £strategic_resource£ Strategic Resource. These rare materials have immense strategic value.

Having located such a resource through Surveying, select a £constr

我们应该提升一个低等物种，不过首先我们需要研究基因表达学机制科技。

提升未开智的物种，可以访问物种界面并选中该物种，然后点击提升按钮。
excerpt.en:
We should Uplift a lesser species, though we may need to research the Epigenetic Triggers technology first.

Uplift a pre-sapient species by selecting their entry in the Species screen, and then clicking on the Uplift button.

excerpt.zh:
我们在宇宙空间的黑暗之中与未知的存在遭遇了，最好尝试着建立通讯。

可以通过在情报日志中选择对应的第一次接触项目，点击显示第一次接触按钮，或者在星系地图上点击第一次接触图标来直接访问。


                                            £firstcontact£
excerpt.en:
Having encountered unknown entities in the blackness of space, we should attempt to establish communications. 

This can be achieved by selecting First Contact in the Situation Log and clicking the Show First Contact button, or alternatively, by clicking the F

excerpt.zh:
我们可以修饰住在我们帝国的任何开智种族，如果他们有足够的特质点数的话。

通过物种界面的修饰菜单，然后研究特殊项目。这个项目需要£society£社会学研究，并且在执行项目时会暂停正在进行的社会学研究。
excerpt.en:
We can Modify any sapient species living within our empire, provided they have enough Trait Points.

This can be achieved by accessing the Modify menu from the Species screen, and then researching the appropriate Special Project. The project requires £society£

我们可以通过在外星球轨道上建造[GetBuildingGrowing]恒星基地来扩大我们的领土。这类前哨的存在宣示了我们对这颗恒星及其周围£system£星系的控制，也就意味着我们有权对其资源进行采集，并禁止已有过接触的外星种群随便进入。

选择一艘£construction_ship£工程船，在舰队界面上点击[GetBuildGrowCap]恒星基地，然后左键点击一颗恒星。或者可以右键点击恒星然后点击[GetBuildGrowCap]恒星基地。

与其他轨道站不同的是，恒星基地可以在我们的边境之外建造
excerpt.en:
We can expand our borders by [GetBuildingGrowing] Starbases around alien stars. This secures the £system£ System, grants resource access, and blocks passage for contacts if borders are closed.

Select a £construction_ship£ Construction Ship, then click the [Ge

奖励：£influence£ 影响力或特殊项目

We need to learn more about the mysterious aliens we have code-named [Prev.From.GetName]. If they possess a language, we must decipher it and establish communications.

excerpt.zh: 虚空之低语渴求超越平凡思维局限的知识。给予我们[Owner.GetResearchers]们广泛的授权，专注于深奥的研究领域，就可以寻求满足低语的渴望。
excerpt.en: The Whisperers in the Void yearn for knowledge beyond the limits of conventional thinking. By giving our [Owner.GetResearchers] a broad mandate to focus on esoteric areas of study, we can seek to satisfy the Whisperers' ardor.
