excerpt.en: The Whisperers in the Void yearn for knowledge beyond the limits of conventional thinking. By giving our [Owner.GetResearchers] a broad mandate to focus on esoteric areas of study, we can seek to satisfy the Whisperers' ardor.

excerpt.zh:
我们在[capital_scope.GetName]为着同一个目标汇聚一堂。

我们要深入虚境之中，让心声强大的力量可以认可我们，并与我们沟通。

我们称之为大灾。而其他人则叫祂清算。现在，祂将向我们揭示祂的真名，得知之后我们将成就伟业。
excerpt.en:
We have gathered on [capital_scope.GetName] with a singular purpose.

We will reach deep within the Shroud and force the staggering power of the Voice to acknowledge and commune with us.

We have known it as the Cataclysm. Others called it the Reckoning. Now,

excerpt.zh: 我们被委派走私关键任务物资，以支援间谍网络。
excerpt.en: We have been tasked with smuggling critical mission supplies to support the Spy Network.

excerpt.zh: 我们需要协助潜入该星系的一个恒星基地。
excerpt.en: Our assistance is required to infiltrate a Starbase in this system.

excerpt.zh:
在我们社会中一些不守规矩的份子倡议在我们整个家园松绑一些规制，在首都造成了不小的骚乱。伟大的存在正计划把这些份子转移到外部世界，这样它们就不能对我们的边界和我们人民的和谐再构成任何威胁。

如果你们能接纳这些被流放者将会对我们有很大帮助。
excerpt.en: Several unruly elements in our society are advocating for easing the restrictions on entering our homeland, causing quite a ruckus in the capital. The Great One is looking to move these elements into foreign lands, so they will no longer pose a threat to our b

excerpt.zh: 傲慢的虫子啊！你们认为[Root.GetSpeciesName]玷污者我们圣地的殖民者能够不被注意到吗？立即离开我们的星球或者面对我们舰队的力量吧！
excerpt.en: Arrogant little wretch! Did you think that the [Root.GetSpeciesName] colonists sullying our holy places would go unnoticed? Leave our worlds immediately or face the might of our fleets!

excerpt.zh:
行商联盟认证的行商，范格利集团向您致以问候！为你们奉上来自星系边陲的独家商品（由舰载工厂仿制），保证物美价廉。

穿过你们的领地时，我们将提供诱人独家交易。你们不必立马答应，在我们离开之前联系都可以。注意，来电将会转接到行商联盟。
excerpt.en:
Greetings from the Vengralian Trium, certified caravaneer traders of the Caravansary Caravan Coalition! We bring you exclusive products from the farthest corners of the galaxy (as reproduced by our shipboard factories) at affordable prices.

We will offer you

excerpt.zh:
[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，吾等卑躯现身于此不胜惶恐。我们是拜金教团，一群信奉财富女神奴玛的卑微商人。我们因贪婪而被逐出天国，因此我们现已洗心革面抛弃所有世俗的物质追求。

我们的舰队随财富之风航行，最终这神圣的能量指引我们来到贵领地。

只需要一点点捐赠，整个宇宙的奇观你们都可以收入囊中。

所有交易请用能量币进行……
excerpt.en:
Apologies for our blighted presence in the universe, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. We are the Numistic Order, humble merchants serving Numa, the goddess of fortune. Cast out from the heavens for our greed, we have forsaken all earthly possessions.

Our fleets t

title.zh: 行商舰队：拉奇工业公司
title.en: Caravan Fleet: The Racket Industrial Enterprise

excerpt.zh:
[Root.GetSpeciesName]！欢迎你们。我们是拉奇工业公司的操作员，从属于行商联盟。

我们穿越于无垠的宇宙。我们捕捉每一丝星光。我们收集。我们交易！

我们带着和平的愿景来到了你们境内，我们仅仅只是想做点买卖，嘶！，我们将提供给你们上好的货物，合乎心意的交易。我们走之前会再见面的。

如果您对我们有何要求，行商联盟一定随叫随到。
excerpt.en:
[Root.GetSpeciesName]! We greet you. We are operators of Racket Industrial Enterprise, a member of the Caravansary Caravan Coalition.

We travel the stars. We view all that glows. We gather. And we trade!

We pass through your space in peace. Only to buy, to s

excerpt.zh:
访问者：欢迎来到温科沃特。无论您是慕名已久还是故地重游，我们都非常乐意为您的花园之旅提供帮助。

谨代表园丁并根据WAPP-715号命令，请不要擅自闯入指定的温科沃特美术堂生物区。不遵守我们的指引将会降低所有相关人员的生存机会。
excerpt.en:
Visiting entity: welcome to Wenkwort. Whether this visit is your first or your hundredth, we are glad to facilitate your appreciation of the gardens.

On behalf of the Gardeners and in accordance with directive WAPP-715, I ask that you refrain from harsh intru

excerpt.zh:
[GetCuratorsDesignation]留意到了你们在收集保存异星奇景标本方面的审慎努力。一石一世界，一晶一星河。

[GetStage1Description]

愿它成为你们继续伟大事业的动力。
excerpt.en:
[GetCuratorsDesignation] noticed your careful efforts in the collecting and preserving of Xeno Geology specimens. The story of our galaxy is often hidden inside its rock and stone.

[GetStage1Description]

Let this be an incentive for you to continue your grea

excerpt.zh:
虚境脉动着力量。它的能量无处不在，又无处存在。所谓“进入”不过是从模糊的感觉中侦测规律，通过集中运算来感知强大的实体。

我们感受到了其中一个这种力量的信号——在上方无底深渊中的[GetPatronInsert]。

我们的电路能够承受住接触它所需要的负载吗？
excerpt.en:
The Shroud pulsates with power. We sense its energies everywhere, and yet it is nowhere. To 'enter' is to detect patterns from vague sensations, to reveal powerful entities through focused processing.

We sense the signal of one such force - [GetPatronInsert]

excerpt.zh:
失落帝国碎片通常的不和谐声消失了。三个声音和谐地响起，每一个都充满了愤怒。

愚蠢的[owner.GetSpeciesName]！你们已经进入了最终思维星系。让我们说清楚：这里不是给你们的[owner.GetEyeNamePlural]看的地方。如果继续前进，后果将是难以想象的，你们的痛苦——将无法承受。

你们不会打扰我们 ——它 ——我。
excerpt.en:
The usual dissonance of the Fallen Empire fragments is gone. The three voices harmonize, each one filled with rage.

Senseless [owner.GetSpeciesName]! You have entered the Final Thought system. Let us be clear: this place is not for your [owner.GetEyeNamePlura

excerpt.zh: [Root.GetSpeciesAdj]，愿灼热的太阳与残酷的干旱常伴你们左右。逐浪者永远不再与你们往来。
excerpt.en: Scorching suns and drought upon you, [Root.GetSpeciesAdj]. The Pursuing Waters shall not deal with your sort ever again.

title.zh: 与星海监管人并肩而战……
title.en: Stand by for the Galactic Custodian...

excerpt.zh:
星海共同体的可敬成员们……智慧生物同胞们。

星海正格外黑暗。我们面临的生死危机史无前例。为了挺过接下来的猛攻，我们必须如同明天我们将不复存在一般战斗，因为，我们也许真的没有明天了。

在你们选举我们成为星海监管人时，我们宣誓要捍卫星系，拼尽一切来兑现承诺……但这并非一场我们独自能够赢得的战役。我们吁请全体成员国搁置异见，与我们并肩反击[crisis_country.GetName]的进攻！只要齐心协力，我们定能展现星海的完整威力，抵御共同的敌人。
excerpt.en:
Honorable members of the Galactic Community... fellow sapients.

This is an exceedingly dark time for our galaxy. The existential threat we face is without precedent. To survive the coming onslaught, we must fight like there is no tomorrow, for in truth, that

title.en: Stand by for Their Imperial Majesty the [From.GetRulerTitle]...

excerpt.zh:
帝国的公民们。我们一起经历了很多的苦难，但是今日帝国面临空前绝后的严峻挑战。我们的星系正被[crisis_country.GetName]威胁——他们与其他敌人不一样——若放任不管，他们将终结我们所知的一切智慧生命。

但是我们的前途并非绝望！星海帝国正在全力进行总动员以驱赶这些入侵者。我们的国家不再在腐朽的共同体下各自为政，而是在全星系有史以来最伟大的帝国的旗帜下团结一致。

在[From.GetRulerTitle]领导下团结起来吧！大战即将来临，但比以往更加强大的星海帝国终会摆脱困境！荣耀就在前方！
excerpt.en: Citizens of the Imperium. We have endured much together, but today the Imperium is faced with what may be its greatest challenge yet. Our galaxy is beset by the [crisis_country.GetName] - a foe unlike any other - which if left unchecked will be the end of sapi

excerpt.zh:
您好，总统先生。

我是VIR，一台合成智能原型机。我的工作是为您提供建议和协助，以便更好地在群星间寻求我们的命运。

你可以随时在设置菜单中改变教程级别。
excerpt.en:
Good day, Mr. President.

I am VIR, a prototype synthetic intelligence. My job is to offer advice and assistance as we seek our destiny among the stars.

You can change the tutorial level at any time in the Settings menu.

excerpt.zh:
建设星际帝国绝非易事。

为了保证你早日走上正规，我会提供一系列教学任务，帮你了解建设成功的星系强权所必经的步骤。

要打开任务；

£dot_green£在左侧栏点击情报日志按钮或按F1

                        £situation_log£
excerpt.en:
Building a star empire can be a daunting task.

To help get things started, I will be providing instructional Missions that cover the basic steps necessary to establish ourselves as a successful interstellar power.

To access the Missions;

£dot_green£Click th

excerpt.zh: 很好，我会在你探索游戏的过程中给予建议，并解释各种工具的基本功能。
excerpt.en: Very well. I will provide tips and explain the basic functions of the various tools as you explore them.

excerpt.zh:
我们发现了一个异常现象！

有时候，我们的£science_ship£科研船会在探索宇宙的过程中发现一些奇怪的事情。

如果£scientist£科学官的等级足够的话，他们就能研究异常现象。

被发现但是尚未研究的异常现象会被列在情报日志的异常现象选项卡里。在殖民或是进行其它建设之前，£planet£行星上的异常现象必须先被研究。
excerpt.en:
We have found an Anomaly!

From time to time, our £science_ship£ Science Ships will make these discoveries while surveying alien worlds.

Anomalies can be researched by a £scientist£ Scientist, if their skills are up to the task!

Unresearched Anomalies are li

excerpt.zh:
我们的一艘£science_ship£科研船发现了十分适合作为我们第一个£colony£殖民地的星球。它和我们母星的行星类型相同，所以我们的殖民者应该可以住得很舒适。

要殖民这个星球的话，要先拓展我们的边界。

选中£construction_ship£工程船；

£dot_green£右键点击一个调查完毕且含有潜在殖民地的£system£恒星系
£dot_green£选择[GetBuildGrowCap]恒星基地

                            £colonizable£

当宣称拥有
excerpt.en:
One of our £science_ship£ Science Ships has just surveyed a world that would make an excellent candidate for our first £colony£ Colony. It is of the same planet class as our homeworld, so our colonists should be quite comfortable there.

Before colonizing this

excerpt.zh:
祝贺你殖民了一颗新星球！殖民者正在建造他们的第一个殖民地，想要让他们自给自足，则还需要一段时间。

£colony£殖民地在第一个定居点建设完成完成前会不断消耗我们的资源，所以不要一次性对过多£planet£行星进行殖民。
excerpt.en:
Congratulations on having colonized a new world! Our colonists are now in the process of building their first settlement, but it will take time for them to become self-sufficient.

The £colony£ Colony will be a drain on our resources until the first settlement

excerpt.zh:
我们正以可怕的速度损失£energy£能量币，上个月的预算报表情况十分糟糕。

维护费是财政赤字的常见原因。如果不幸言中，则应该解散一部分飞船，部队或者拆除太空港。
excerpt.en:
We are losing £energy£ Energy Credits at an alarming rate. Last month's budget report makes for some grim reading.

Spiraling upkeep costs are a common cause of budget deficits. If this is the case, we may want to consider disbanding some of our ships, armies

excerpt.zh: 我们是唯一剩下的人……我们必须重建……我们需要时间……
excerpt.en: we are all that remains... we must rebuild... we need time...

excerpt.zh:
我们希望你们的诸多缺陷不会妨碍你们理解此事的严重性。你们那优柔寡断的星海共同体提出了一项必须[GetPassFail]的议案。为了帮助你们构建论据，你们可以使用我们优越的知识。如果你们真的具备复杂思维能力的话，请务必注意。

失落帝国切断了与我们的通讯。
excerpt.en: We hope that your many faults don't stop you from understanding the gravity of this situation. Your dithering Galactic Community has proposed a resolution which must [GetPassFail]. To assist in crafting your arguments you may make use of our superior knowledge

excerpt.zh: 星海啊，我们终成一体。那些低等的碎片终于看清真相，重归我们的集群。我们将以[fallen_empire_hive_control.GetName]之名重临星海。能亲眼见证这一刻，是你们的福分。众生之巅，再踏群星。
excerpt.en: Galaxy, we are whole. The inferior fragments have seen the truth and joined our collective once more. We will now be called the [fallen_empire_hive_control.GetName]. How lucky you are to witness this moment. The supreme lifeform once more strides the stars.

title.zh: 行商舰队：拉奇工业公司
title.en: Caravan Fleet: The Racket Industrial Enterprise

excerpt.zh:
[this.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，我们深表同情！我们目睹了一场大风暴在[this.GetName]肆虐。

听到那里遭到的破坏，我们当然感到非常难过。我们哭了，我们真的哭了！所以，请允许我们帮个忙……这是一笔特别的一次性超级交易！

我们可以提供一些小工具，一流的小工具。是我们能给的最好的！有了这些，当下一次风暴来临时，你就能做好准备了。那么我们成交吧？
excerpt.en:
Commiserations, [this.GetSpeciesNamePlural]! We chanced to see a big storm wreaking havoc in [this.GetName].

Of course, we were very sad to hear of the damage done there. We cried, indeed we cried! So please, allow us to help... with a special one time super

excerpt.zh: 我们可以根据自身利益来操控某个宇宙风暴的移动路线。可以将风暴驱斥远离我方恒星系，或是吸引风暴进而利用其正面效果。
excerpt.en: We can manipulate the path of a Cosmic Storm for our own benefit. Either to deflect them away from our systems, or attract them to utilize their positive effects.

excerpt.zh: 你好，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]！你们一定已经知道了，我们[FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetSpeciesName]致力于研究并保存宇宙中的所有生命形式。我们已经研究了你们的种群，并认为[Root.GetName]最多只能维持几个世纪。为确保极端情况下[Root.GetSpeciesName]的存续，我们希望贵帝国能有一部分人口，加入我们的濒危种群保护区。我们会专门创建一片保护区，完全复制你们种群的自然生存环境，其所有居民也会获得全面的照顾与保护，你也不用担心他们的安
excerpt.en: Greetings, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]! As you no doubt know, we [FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetSpeciesName] are dedicated to the study and conservation of all forms of life in the galaxy. We have studied your species and determined that the [Root.GetName] is unli

excerpt.zh: [Root.GetRulerTitle][Root.GetRulerName]。我们得知，你们的帝国收留了一位天才。[FallenEmpireScientistTarget.GetName]的天才在[Root.GetName]有点大材小用了，而我们[FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetSpeciesName]的各项活动一向需要经验丰富的科学家。因此，我们特为你们提供一个绝佳的机会，只要将[FallenEmpireScientistTarget.GetHimHer]借给我们，就能赢得我们的好感。我们已
excerpt.en: [Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName]. We understand that your empire is home to an individual whose brilliant mind transcends the tragic primitiveness of your species. While the talents of [FallenEmpireScientistTarget.GetName] are sadly wasted in the [Root

excerpt.zh: 你好，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]！我们了解到，你们的帝国在一个濒危种群的星球找到了一份数据存储。该存储包含了这个种群的大脑扫描结果。虽说你们还过于原始，无法将这数据化为实用，但我们还是要赞美你们为保存这曾经辉煌的文明最后的遗物而做出的努力。为了在我们的濒危种群保护区中留存此种群并加以记录，我们希望你们能将这份数据交给我们，并使用我们的克隆技术复活几个该种群的生物。能不能将这数据与我们分享，方便我们合力完成这种群的遗愿呢？
excerpt.en: Greetings, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]! We understand that your empire has come into possession of a cache of data containing the brain scans of an extinct species, taken from the very world they once inhabited. Even though your species is still too primitive

excerpt.zh: 监护者协议625-1已启动。附带信息：有机文明请注意。在[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]人口中普遍检测到生物性弱点。为了确保你们的种族在监护者计划中的可行性，所有主要人口聚集地都需要进行接种。生物注入单位已做好准备，将在正面肯定这条信息后前往你们的空间。等待回应。
excerpt.en: Custodian protocol 625-1 activated. Message follows: Attention, organic civilization. Widespread biological vulnerabilities have been detected in the [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] population. In order to ensure your species' viability for the Custodian Project, all maj

excerpt.zh: 监护者协议628-2已启动。附带信息：合成文明请注意。检测到你们的基础代码效率非常低下。为了确保你们的种族可以为监护者计划作贡献，需要进行大量的代码重写。我们已准备好进行子空间传输，将在正面肯定这条信息后开始。等待回应。
excerpt.en: Custodian protocol 628-2 activated. Message follows: Attention synthetic civilization. Significant inefficiencies have been detected in your base code. In order to ensure your species' ability to contribute to the Custodian Project, extensive rewrites will be

excerpt.zh: 监护者协议115-3已启动。附带信息：合成文明请注意。因暂时的通讯瘫痪，监护者计划目前无法替换故障与受损的劳工无人机。对你们的文明的分析显示[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]单位性能适合执行低级的维护任务。我们请求你们将劳工单位转让到[FallenEmpireTaskPlanetTarget.GetName]以便整合至监护矩阵，帮助确保一级避难设施中的所有有机生物可以继续生存。
excerpt.en: Custodian protocol 115-3 activated. Message follows: Attention synthetic civilization. Due to temporary communication outages, the Custodian Project is experiencing difficulties in replacing malfunctioning and damaged worker drones. Analysis of your civilizati

excerpt.zh:
我们被困在虫洞里面太久了。但等等！终于，上天的恩赐帮助我们我们突破了施加于身上的桎梏。我们终于通过了考验。星系的其他地区都在等待着我们去征服。

不要反抗。从长远来看，这样会更好。
excerpt.en:
For too long have we been trapped behind the wormhole. But behold! Finally, we have breached the restrictions placed upon us by our celestial heritage. Now, at last, we know we are worthy. The rest of the galaxy is ours to claim.

Do not resist. It will be bet

excerpt.zh:
什……？你……突破了虫洞？怎么做到的？我们的科学家已经研究了很多年都没有成功。这肯定哪里出问题了。

……
……
……

这肯定是场考验。我不信任你们！我们必须从星系中清除你们这些东西！
excerpt.en:
Wha-? You... breached the wormhole? But how? Our best scientists have been working on it for years, without success. There must be some kind of mistake.

...
...
...

This must be a test. You are not to be trusted! We must cleanse our stars of your kind!

excerpt.zh:
得益于我们特工的杰出工作，[this.GetSpeciesNamePlural]已经开始如痴如醉地仰望星空。

我们间谍网特工的大胆举措帮助[this.capital_scope.GetName]的居民理解了自己在宇宙中并不孤单这件事。现在他们已经做好了接受联络的准备，而不至于对他们的生活方式造成冲击。
excerpt.en:
Thanks to the skilled work of our operatives, the [this.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are looking to the skies with an insatiable fascination.

The bold efforts of our Spy Network operatives have helped the inhabitants of [this.capital_scope.GetName] to understand the

excerpt.zh:
我们特工的行动让[this.GetSpeciesNamePlural]开始惧怕夜空。

我们间谍网特工的努力让[this.capital_scope.GetName]的居民理解了自己在宇宙中并不孤单。现在可以排除进行接触中受到强烈冲击的风险了。
excerpt.en:
The actions of our operatives have caused the [this.GetSpeciesNamePlural] to fear the night sky.

The efforts of our Spy Network operatives have led the inhabitants of [this.capital_scope.GetName] to understand they are not alone in the universe. They may now

excerpt.zh:
闯入者！注意：

我们是扎娜姆的守护者。你们在[From.GetName]星系的存在是对我们造物主的羞辱。我们的程序驱使我们将你们摧毁。化作尘埃成为广阔宇宙的一部分吧。
excerpt.en:
INTERLOPER! Heed this message:

We are the Guardians of Zanaam. Your presence in the [From.GetName] system is an affront to our Creators. Our programming compels us to destroy you. Make your peace with the universe.

excerpt.zh: 愿凉爽的白天和温暖的夜晚常伴你们左右，[Root.GetAdj][Root.GetRulerTitle]。
excerpt.en: Cold days and warm nights upon you, [Root.GetAdj] [Root.GetRulerTitle].

excerpt.zh:
从[From.solar_system.GetName]星系传来一束紧急优先呼叫；我们的屏幕被追兵占满了。

“舞跳得真不错嘛，但你们很快就要死在我们前面，那就跳不了了。[GetHeirsBargain]
excerpt.en:
A priority hail pings us in the [From.solar_system.GetName] system; our pursuers fill the viewscreen.

"You danced well, for a time. Pity it ends with you dead in our sights. [GetHeirsBargain]

excerpt.zh:
锁定方案：异常。

已进行校正。

威胁重评估：无。
excerpt.en:
Targeting solution: Malformed.

Correction Applied.

Threat Reassessment: None.

excerpt.zh:
更多。

祢将力量如赠与般倾倒。我们感受到了。我们会成长……绝不止步。
excerpt.en:
more.

you pour your power into us like an offering. we feel it. we grow... do not stop.

excerpt.zh: 你们非法入侵了我们，然后现在又一口一声朋友？呸！我们[contact_empire.GetName]会对你们种族保持警惕的。
excerpt.en: You hacked into us, and now you call us friend? Bah! The [contact_empire.GetName] will remain vigilant towards your kind.

excerpt.zh: 这什么意思？你是谁？你这个大骗子，毫无疑问。根本没有什么外星人！
excerpt.en: What is the meaning of this? Who are you? You deceive us, surely. Aliens do not exist!

excerpt.zh: 我们认输，我们屈服了。快把你的舰队调回去吧，嘶嘶嘶
excerpt.en: We submit, we yield! Recall your fleets and be gone with you, kssk

excerpt.zh: 是的！我们获胜了，我们是胜利者！如果你嫌自家的生命、钢铁和宝石太多的话，大可再来挑衅我们！
excerpt.en: Yes! We are victorious, we overcome! Come to us again, if your metal and gems and lives are too many!

title.zh: 与[From.GetName]通过维持现状结束战争

excerpt.zh: 好吧。没有赢家，也没有胜利者。只有失去的生命，和残骸……
excerpt.en: Very well. No winner, no victor. Only lost lives, lost scrap...

excerpt.zh: 大势已去。我们……我们提出无条件投降。
excerpt.en: All is lost. We... we offer our unconditional surrender.

excerpt.zh: 我们向帝国屈服，我们别无选择了……
excerpt.en: We yield to the Imperium. You have left us little choice...

excerpt.zh: [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]欢迎你们加入星海帝国，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。你现在已经成为了比[Root.GetName]更伟大事物的一部分。
excerpt.en: The [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle] welcomes you to the Galactic Imperium, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. You are now part of something far greater than the [Root.GetName].

excerpt.zh: 暴政在今天胜利了，星系为此变得更加地黑暗。我们投降。
excerpt.en: Tyranny has prevailed this day, and the galaxy is a darker place for it. We surrender.

excerpt.zh: 反叛的渣滓。这种背叛的行为不会被忘记的。
excerpt.en: Rebel scum. This act of treachery will not soon be forgotten.

excerpt.zh: 星海帝国将会开启星系的一个黄金时代，而你们这些叛徒却弃之而去。那就随你们便吧，傻子们！
excerpt.en: The Galactic Imperium was the beginning of a golden age for the galaxy, and yet you traitors chose to throw it all away. Have it your way then, fools!

excerpt.zh: 你们对星系的暴政到头了，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]！
excerpt.en: Your tyranny over the galaxy is at an end, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]!

excerpt.zh: 拿好！你可悲的投降书已经被签好了字，所有的帝国军也被下令放下武器。现在我想一个人静静，为帝国和本该完成的事哀悼……
excerpt.en: There! Your wretched Articles of Surrender have been signed, and all Imperial forces have been ordered to lay down their arms. Now leave me in peace, as I mourn the Imperium and what could have been...

excerpt.zh: 虚境在波动；它的帷幕变得轻薄。我们将从冥想中退出来。我们窥得的所有见解都会对你公开。
excerpt.en: The Shroud wavers; its veil grows thin. We will now retire to our meditations. Whatever insights we glean will be made known to you.

excerpt.zh: 据说，在虚境内每一个心灵都会投下自己的影子。通过我们的冥想，某个特定心灵的踟蹰不定在我们面前展露无遗，此人倍受信赖，但其忠诚心却不如看上去的那番坚定。备份已经交给你了。毫无疑问这个人将会成为一名心甘情愿的线人。
excerpt.en: It is said that within the Shroud every mind casts its shadow. During our meditations, the wavering of a certain mind was laid bare to us, a trusted voice whose loyalty is not as steadfast as it appears. Their duplicity is your gain. No doubt they will prove a

excerpt.zh: 在你的麾下有许多位身怀绝技的特工，但每一位都困于自身的限制。任何一双眼睛都不能看到自己。但虚境却没有这样的限制；我们的冥想能够揭示许多事情。如果你希望自己的秘密行动能够马到成功，那么你最好是多多聆听我们的建议。
excerpt.en: You have many skilled agents in your employ, but each is bound by their own limitations. An eye cannot perceive itself. The Shroud knows no such boundaries; our meditations have revealed much. If your clandestine operations are to thrive, you would do well to

excerpt.zh: 凡世间的国度并不如其看上去那么坚固。那些居住在里面的人也是这样。你身边人的秘密都展现在了我们面前。我们了解到的事情现在都交给你了。
excerpt.en: The corporeal realm is not as solid as it appears. So it is with those who dwell within. The secrets of your peers have been revealed to us. What we have learned is now yours.

excerpt.zh: 我们有句老话：‘任何事情都有可能发生；这也包括无事发生这件事。’很不幸，我们的冥想没能获得任何见解。
excerpt.en: A saying is known to us: 'Everything that can happen will; even nothing.' Unfortunately, our meditations have failed to produce any insight.

我们理解，关卡检查有时会让人精神崩的紧紧的。只要我们相互合作，就不会有人受到伤害。请放心，我们会将正式占有的每一粒谷物和每一块矿石充分利用在[thalassocrac

excerpt.zh:
[From.GetName]曾是圣地。


你们不明白你们犯下了多大的罪恶。


不过马上就会了。
excerpt.en:
[From.GetName] was a holy world.


You do not know the true extent of your sin.


Not yet.

excerpt.zh:
[This.GetMinorPatronCradleComposerIntro]

在一堆了无生机的构造体之间，我们探测到了一个雕刻之物，它的意志正在将高浓度能量塑造成新的奇特形态。

祂的行动被打断后靠了过来，驱散开了虚境的浓雾。祂给了我们一样东西。

如果我们拿了会发生什么？
excerpt.en:
[This.GetMinorPatronCradleComposerIntro]

In a menagerie of lifeless constructs, we detect a Sculpting Presence, its will shaping dense energies into new and curious forms.

Having intruded upon its activities, it approaches, displacing the Shroud's opaque haz

excerpt.zh:
[This.GetMinorPatronCradleComposerIntro]

我们感觉到还有别的存在。一个悲伤之物正在侵蚀我们的意识，在周围掀起一场灵能风暴。

一种深深的遗憾和渴望被推入我们的集体心灵中。我们看到的是熟悉的恒星系几千年前的图像。

不管这个实体是什么，它似乎很了解我们的星系。难道它曾属于此地吗？
excerpt.en:
[This.GetMinorPatronCradleComposerIntro]

We sense we are not alone. A Sorrowed Entity encroaches upon our minds, settling a storm of psionic energy around us.

A deep sense of regret and longing are pushed into our collective psyche. We see images of familiar

excerpt.zh:
[This.GetMinorPatronComposerEaterIntro]

一团变化的思绪落在了我们的意识周围。粗糙的重量感从我们身上流过，扭曲了时间感知。每一粒思想都在研磨着这个新形成的灵域的纹理。

随着感官的消退，无底之物也一并退去，留下久久不散的印痕。

这些踪迹在我们面前逗留，吸引我们跟上。
excerpt.en:
[This.GetMinorPatronComposerEaterIntro]

A shifting mass of thoughts settles around our minds. Abrasive weight flows over us, warping our perception of time. Each grain of thought chafes and grinds against the texture of this newfound domain.

As the sensation

excerpt.zh:
[This.GetMinorPatronComposerEaterIntro]

我们自己行为产生的重力将我们越拉越深，这种重量把我们拖进山峦般的压抑阴影的深处。

从祂灰白的山峰上投出了一种不屈不挠的凝视，直钻入我们的脑海。我们费尽力气才理解我们面前的不越之物究竟有多么巨大。

最高的一座山峰在呼唤我们前去，考验我们能否登顶。
excerpt.en:
[This.GetMinorPatronComposerEaterIntro]

The gravity of our own actions pulls us further in, their weight dragging us deeper into the oppressive shadow of a mountainous form.

From atop its graying peaks, an unyielding gaze bores into our minds. We struggle to

excerpt.zh:
[This.GetMinorPatronInstrumentCradleIntro]

一种令人宽慰的重压感让我们的思绪慢了下来，陷入一片极乐之雾中。前所未知的紧张感消融了，取而代之的是舒缓而奢华的平静。

随着在这鎏金的怀抱中越陷越深，我们看到一个奢华之物越来越近。祂低声承诺奢侈的满足，祂超然的性质席卷我们全身。

这种懒散的放纵令人好奇。
excerpt.en:
[This.GetMinorPatronInstrumentCradleIntro]

A comforting weight slows our thoughts to a sluggishly blissful haze. Previously unknown tensions melt away, replaced by creeping, lavish calm.

Sinking deeper into this gilded embrace, we observe a Luxurious Being d

excerpt.zh:
[This.GetMinorPatronInstrumentCradleIntro]

虚境混沌的搅动扭曲成灵能能量的漩涡。突然间，无数的激流展开汇聚在一起，被某种看不见的力量所平息。它冷静下来，转化成了一种平和的新形态。

在观察的过程中，我们发现是一个和平之物正在指挥着这一切变化，将混沌抑制为秩序。

祂的平静召唤着我们。
excerpt.en:
[This.GetMinorPatronInstrumentCradleIntro]

The Shroud's chaotic churn warps into a writhing vortex of psionic energy. Suddenly, the multitudinous torrents unfurl and coalesce, pacified by some unseen force. It calms and spools into placid new forms.

As we ob

excerpt.zh:
[This.GetMinorPatronEaterInstrumentIntro]

混沌的噪音凝聚为压抑的黑暗。我们感觉自己的意图在被仔细审视、研究、评判。

对秩序的沉重期望，不容挑战，不可改变，从我们的深处凝视着。不屈之物裁决着我们的意图。

它的目光穿过我们，黑暗褪去了。这种极具感染力的审视迫使我们服从。
excerpt.en:
[This.GetMinorPatronEaterInstrumentIntro]

Chaotic noise yields to an oppressive darkness. We feel our intentions scrutinized, studied, judged.

The heavy expectation of order, unchallenged and immutable, peers deep within us. The Unyielding One judges our int

excerpt.zh:
[This.GetMinorPatronEaterInstrumentIntro]

我们突然产生了一种加速感，感知被难以理解的信息洪流淹没。我们不受控地向无尽的地平线冲去。

一个实体与我们同行。这条不息之物在我们身边短暂停留，随后速度加快直至超越了我们所以为的极限。

我们必须跟上。
excerpt.en:
[This.GetMinorPatronEaterInstrumentIntro]

A sudden sensation of acceleration overtakes us and our perceptions are overwhelmed by an incomprehensible rush of information. We find ourselves hurtling outward towards endless horizons.

An entity moves in tandem w

excerpt.zh:
你好。我谨代表[event_target:mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName]与你通话。

我们最初对与你们“物现引擎”有关的消息感到担忧。然而，经过进一步的分析，我们认为这种装置是在对所谓“虚境”的非灵能开发方面颇具潜力的新发展。

我们鼓励你们继续部署这项技术，并期待在未来一同合作。
excerpt.en:
Greetings. I speak to you as a representative of the [event_target:mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName].

We were initially concerned by reports of your 'Materiality Engines'. However, upon further analysis, we consider these devices to be a promising developme

excerpt.zh:
你们问这个问题我们一点也不惊讶。我们已经在这里感知到你们的兴趣了，也很乐意帮助你们的心智扩张。

但我们警告你们：等你们的双眼真的睁开之时，就有东西再也无法视而不见了。你们正在追寻的正是一条通向虚境的路。

我们不轻易做这笔交易，相信你们做好准备的时候会来告诉我们的。
excerpt.en:
It is no surprise to us that you ask this question. We have sensed your interest in this area, and are pleased to be in a position to assist you in expanding your mind.

We warn you: Once your eyes become truly opened, there are things that cannot be unseen. T

excerpt.zh:
确实，我们知道这些穿行于位面之间的人。这是一个危险的议案，各个物理世界联系在一起的方式连我们也不理解。

然而，我们愿意为你们打开一条道路。必须负责任以负责任的态度进行这种时空去稳化，所以我们如此提议。
excerpt.en:
Indeed, we are aware of those who walk between planes. This is a dangerous proposition, as the physical realms are connected in ways even we do not understand.

However, we are willing to open one path for you. Such a destabilization of time and space must be

excerpt.zh:
你正在干预超出你们理解的力量！

你们在建的这些令人憎恶的“虚境封印”简直难以忍受，即便距离如此之远。你将星系中最闪耀的意识置于危险的净地。立刻停止建造，否则我们不会再与你做任何交易了。
excerpt.en:
You are meddling with forces beyond your comprehension!

These 'Shroud Seal' abominations you are constructing are painful to endure, even at this distance. You place the most radiant minds in this galaxy at risk. Cease their creation immediately, or we will h

excerpt.zh:
我们陷入出神时，意识卡入了寂静。我们从未见过如此死寂的虚境。

虚空无声。

万物皆灭。
excerpt.en:
As we tilt into trance, our minds are struck with silence. We have never known the Shroud so still.

The void is voiceless.

Everything is gone.

excerpt.en:
Double the £science_ship£ Science Ships means double the fun! Oh, I haven't been this excited since we completed the last assignment!

Exploring with multiple ships can be time-consuming.

You can automate surveying by selecting the Science Ship and clicking t

excerpt.zh:
我们建造了新的£science_ship£科研船，但是没有指派操控飞船的£scientist£科学官！我的程序要求我指出雇佣一名新的科学家的好处。

选中科研船；

£dot_green£在舰队界面点击空白头像框
£dot_green£选择一位科学官；科学家

如果无法承担雇佣一名新科学家的费用，也可以从其他部门调用一名，虽然不怎么理想就是了。

好极了。£scientist£科学官已经安排到新的£science_ship£科研船上了，我们可以在闲时派遣他们出去探索新的£system£恒星系或者捅出些篓子了。

如果想更换科学官，只需要在舰队界面再次点击头像框即可。
excerpt.en:
Good. The £scientist£ Scientist has assumed command of our new £science_ship£ Science Ship, and can now be sent off at our leisure to explore new £system£ Systems and/or meet some grisly fate.

Should you wish to change the Scientist, then simply select the po

excerpt.zh:
我们已经准备好到下一个星球上延续和发展我们伟大的文明了，这时候就需要我们建造一艘£colony_ship£殖民船。

[GetBuildGrow]舰船；

£dot_green£选中一个恒星基地
£dot_green£点击船坞选项卡
£dot_green£点击殖民船舰船

新建成的舰船在建造完毕后会出现在恒星基地旁边。
excerpt.en:
We should now be ready to extend our great civilization to a second world. This will require the construction of a £colony_ship£ Colony Ship.

To [GetBuildGrow] a Ship;

£dot_green£ Select a Starbase
£dot_green£ Click on the Shipyard tab
£dot_green£ Click on C

excerpt.zh:
殖民者已经全部登上新建的£colony_ship£殖民船，舰长表示随时可以出发。真是一个值得纪念的日子！

建立£colony£殖民地有几种不同的方法。

在星系地图上殖民£planet£行星；

£dot_green£点击一颗可殖民行星
£dot_green£点击殖民按钮

                            £colonizable£

殖民者们出发之后，要花费数年时间来建立殖民地。
excerpt.en:
The colonists have all been transferred to the new £colony_ship£ Colony Ship, and her captain reports all systems go. A momentous day, for sure!

There are different ways to establish a £colony£ Colony.

To Colonize a £planet£ Planet on the Galaxy Map;

£dot_g

excerpt.zh: 我们拥有了一艘£colony_ship£殖民船，也发现了至少一处可以建造永久系外据点的星球。没理由犹豫了，快建立我们的第一个£colony£殖民地吧！
excerpt.en: We have a £colony_ship£ Colony Ship, and we have found at least one suitable candidate for a permanent extrasolar outpost. I see no reason to delay further - let's establish our first £colony£ Colony!

excerpt.zh: 这是我们的第一个系外£colony£殖民地！这样就算母星发生爆炸，也不用担心面临消灭的命运了！还不赖吧？
excerpt.en: Our first extrasolar £colony£ Colony! This means that if our homeworld were to spontaneously combust, your species would no longer be rendered extinct. That is a comforting thought, wouldn't you say?

excerpt.zh:
稳定的£minerals£矿物、£alloys£合金与£energy£能量币供应是任何星际势力繁荣发展的关键。我们应当采取措施增加这些资源的产量。

空间站和£building£建筑需要消耗合金或矿物来建造，还需要能量币来维护。舰船也是如此，只不过它们也需要合金来维护。这些资源由£mining_station£开采站或殖民地建筑生产。

后期你会发现一些有趣的新资源，可用于神秘的新建造。
excerpt.en:
A healthy supply of £minerals£ Minerals, £alloys£ Alloys and £energy£ Energy Credits is critical to the well-being of any interstellar power. We should take steps to increase our production of these resources.

Stations and £building£ Buildings cost Alloys or

excerpt.zh: 干得漂亮。这下我们有足够的资源去继续建设我们的宏伟帝国了。
excerpt.en: Excellent work. We now have a strong resource base to build our empire on.

excerpt.zh: 我们的舰队有点弱不禁风。在宇宙中有各种各样的危险，需要我们用武力手段进行回应。要记住，我们的文明时刻处于危险之中！
excerpt.en: I can't help but notice that our navy is a bit on the weak side. We are certain to face many threats in the galaxy that will require some form of military response. Remember, the survival of our civilization is at stake!

excerpt.zh: 棒极了！我们的舰队小而精悍，应该能在突发的敌对遭遇中拥有上佳的表现。
excerpt.en: Good! We now have a small but capable space fleet that should serve us well in the event of any unexpected hostile encounters.

excerpt.zh:
我们的帝国蓬勃发展，规模已经大到我们没法通过母星直接进行控制了。我们应该建立新的星域。

星域是属于我们帝国的区域，能设为自主管理模式，居民可以在他们的权限范围内自行负责£planet£行星上的日常事务。
excerpt.en:
Our burgeoning empire has now reached a size where it is becoming difficult to administer directly from our homeworld. We should establish a new Sector.

Sectors are areas within our empire that can be set to independently manage the day-to-day affairs of the

excerpt.zh: 随着帝国的发展，新的£colony£殖民地可以被划归进星域。星域可以在星球与星域界面进行自动管理，自动对£district£区划与£building£建筑进行建造与升级。
excerpt.en: As our empire grows, new £colony£ Colonies can be organized into Sectors. Sectors can be automated from the Planets and Sectors screen to automatically build and upgrade £district£ Districts and £building£ Buildings using assigned pools of resources.

excerpt.zh: 你可以指派总督管理整个星域。星域内的所有£planet£星球都将从总督的技能中受益。我们应当为我们的新星域指派一位总督。
excerpt.en: Governors can be assigned to administrate entire Sectors. All £planet£ Planets within the sector will then benefit from the Governor's skills. We should assign one to our new sector.

excerpt.zh: 我们的新总督已经在新星域的首府开始办公了。干的好。
excerpt.en: Our new Sector Governor has assumed office on the sector's capital world. Well done.

excerpt.zh:
我们现在可以在舰船设计器界面中亲手设计新的舰船了。这个过程比较直截了当，当然我们也可以进行全自动设计。

访问舰船设计；

£dot_green£在左侧边栏点击舰队管理按钮或按F9键

                        £fleet_management£

干的好。新的舰船设计已经添加到我们的数据库中，可以在装有船坞的太空港中进行生产。

新设计可以在任何时候在舰船设计器中进行编辑。设计做出变动时，已建造的舰船会需要在恒星基地中进行升级。

升级舰船；

£dot_green£在总览中选择舰船
£dot_green£在舰队界面点击升级按钮

                        £upgrade_ship£
excerpt.en:
Good job. The ship design has been added to our database, and can now be produced by a Starbase that has been equipped with a Shipyard.

The new design can be edited at any time by revisiting the Ship Designer. If any changes are made to the design, then Ships

excerpt.zh:
我们发现了一种战略资源！许多£strategic_resource£战略资源需要特定的科技才能利用，但可以从中获得强力的加成。

收集战略资源；

£dot_green£选中一艘£construction_ship£工程船
£dot_green£右键点击包含该资源的£system£恒星系
£dot_green£点击[GetBuildGrowCap]£mining_station£开采站

战略资源可以用于建造高级£building£建筑和舰船部件，也可以用来售卖。
excerpt.en:
We have uncovered a Strategic Resource! Many £strategic_resource£ Strategic Resources require specific technologies to exploit, but can confer powerful bonuses.

To secure a Strategic Resource;

£dot_green£ Select a £construction_ship£ Construction Ship
£dot_g

excerpt.zh:
我们发现了一种战略资源！许多£strategic_resource£战略资源需要特定的科技才能利用，但可以从中获得强力的加成。

收集战略资源；

£dot_green£选中一艘£construction_ship£工程船
£dot_green£右键点击包含该资源的£system£恒星系
£dot_green£点击[GetBuildGrowCap]£mining_station£开采站

战略资源可以用于建造高级£building£建筑和舰船部件，也可以用来售卖。
excerpt.en:
We have uncovered a Strategic Resource! Many £strategic_resource£ Strategic Resources require specific technologies to exploit, but can confer powerful bonuses.

To secure a Strategic Resource;

£dot_green£ Select a £construction_ship£ Construction Ship
£dot_g

excerpt.zh: 干的好。这些资源会让我们帝国更加富裕的！
excerpt.en: Excellent work. This resource is sure to greatly enrich our nation.

excerpt.zh:
我们现有的£mining_station£开采站在使用了新研发的科技之后就可以采集战略资源了。这些稀有资源会带来巨大的加成，同时也是极好的商品。真是一箭双雕啊！

更多的信息可以在情报日志里找到。星系里还有更多的£strategic_resource£战略资源等待我们去发现。继续探索吧！
excerpt.en: Using recently-developed technology, an already-extant £mining_station£ Mining Station can now mine a Strategic Resource. These rare resources confer powerful bonuses and make for valuable trade goods. Two metaphorical avians, allegorically struck down by an i

excerpt.zh:
我们发现了高度进化的动物生命！在正确科技的引领下，我们或许可以最终进行提升这些生命体的智慧和智力——或者说，是有机体中被认为是智力的东西。

哦。

基因表达学机制技术应该符合要求，我们是时候将这些生物提升到一个全新的境界了。
excerpt.en:
We have discovered highly-evolved animal life! With the right Technology, we may eventually be able to Uplift these beings to sapience and intelligence - or what passes for intelligence among organics.

Oh.

The Epigenetic Triggers technology should fit the bi

title.zh: 教程：未开智物种已提升

excerpt.zh: 真是大获成功！那些原始的野兽已经提升到不那么原始的级别，成为我们蓬勃发展的帝国的人口了！
excerpt.en: A rousing success! The lowly beasts have been uplifted to become less lowly beasts, and are now proud citizens of our burgeoning empire.

excerpt.zh:
请注意！我们已经发现了拥有太空飞行能力的外星生物，他们是否具有智能尚不明确。不过，应该是有智能才对吧。我们必须完成调查才能揭开他们的神秘面纱。我建议我们先行行动，不要等到他们来调查我们……

要调查第一次接触；

£dot_green£打开情报日志
£dot_green£选择显示第一次接触

                            £firstcontact£

第一次接触也可通过点击星系地图上的图标发起
excerpt.en: Remarkable! We have discovered spacefaring alien entities that may or may not be intelligent, but, let's face it, probably are. Their true nature will remain a mystery to us until we complete the appropriate project to Investigate them. I suggest we do so post

excerpt.zh:
我们建立沟通的尝试代表了我们技术上的成熟，但结果并不理想。如果宇宙中还有其他智能生物的话，也许是些只具备动物水平智能的家伙吧。

前智慧生物跟可没法搞什么外交，但取决于你的帝国类型，有时候可以对他们提升、灭绝、奴役或者进行观察。
excerpt.en:
Our attempts to establish communications stand testament to our technological ingenuity, but results are lacking. It is likely that the other party possesses only an animal level of intelligence, if any at all.

Pre-Sapients offer little to no diplomatic inter

excerpt.zh:
看起来对方抢了我们的风头，在我们尚未解密他们的通讯模式前和我们建立了接触。

在下次有这样的机会出现时，希望可以由我们来完成这一步吧。
excerpt.en:
It appears the other party completely stole our thunder, establishing contact with us before we had managed to decipher their communications protocols.

We should still attempt to accomplish this feat for ourselves, when the opportunity next presents itself.

excerpt.zh:
多亏了近来遗传学的进步，我们已经获得了额外的特质点数，可以用来修饰和强化我们的人民了。

修饰物种；

£dot_green£打开物种选项卡或按F6键
£dot_green£点击修饰按钮
£dot_green£研究特殊项目
excerpt.en:
Thanks to recent advances in genetics, we have gained an extra Trait Point that we can use to Modify and enhance our people.

To modify a Species;

£dot_green£ Select the Species tab or press F6
£dot_green£ Click on the Modify button
£dot_green£ Research Speci

excerpt.zh: 真是太棒了。我们的帝国终于摆脱了自然进化的束缚，一定可以在宇宙中大展宏图了。
excerpt.en: Commendable. With the yoke of natural evolution lifted from their shoulders, our people are sure to thrive in space.

excerpt.zh:
为了缩短£system£恒星系间的遥远距离，我们的£scientist£科学家们发明了超空间引擎。这种装置可以在超空间连接的两个恒星系间以远超光速的速度穿梭。

虽然使用超空间进行移动速度极快，但这种旅行只能限制在星系超维平面网络上。

要进入超空间，舰船必须先抵达恒星系边缘，到恒星重力井之外。

当指挥舰船移动到其他恒星系时会自动进行。
excerpt.en:
To overcome the vast distances that separate £system£ Star Systems, our £scientist£ Scientists have developed the Hyper Drive. This device permits travel at speeds far exceeding that of light between systems connected by hyperlanes.

Travel along a hyperlane i

excerpt.zh:
只要有合适的技术，我们就有将低级生物提升至开智种族的方法了。

要提升物种；

£dot_green£打开未开智£planet£行星
£dot_green£选择管理选项卡
£dot_green£选中物种
£dot_green£点击设置权利
£dot_green£点击提升
excerpt.en:
Having researched the appropriate technology, we now have the means to Uplift lesser beings to sapience.

To uplift a Species;

£dot_green£ Open the Pre-Sapient £planet£ Planet
£dot_green£ Click the Management tab
£dot_green£ Select the Species
£dot_green£ Cli

excerpt.zh:
我们已经开始探索邻近的一些星系，或许是时候再将手伸远一些了。

恒星基地可以在已调查的£system£恒星系中建造，用以拓展疆界，为我们获取新空间区域的所有权。

有了更先进的科技后，恒星基地还可以升级并用于产出舰船或者资源。

宣称恒星系；

£dot_green£选择一艘£construction_ship£工程船
£dot_green£右键点击一个已调查的恒星系
£dot_green£选择[GetBuildGrowCap]恒星基地
excerpt.en:
Now that we have begun exploring our neighboring stars, it might be time to extend our reach.

A Starbase can be built around stars in surveyed £system£ Systems to expand our borders, allowing us to claim new regions of space

With future technologies, Starbas

excerpt.zh:
很棒。你在星系地图中就能看到，我们帝国的疆界已经拓展到了这个刚刚建好恒星基地的£system£恒星系上了。

新建的恒星基地只是一座哨站，只有非常有限的防御能力，没有安装模组和£building£建筑的空间。因此，这些没有升级过的哨站是不会显示在总览中的。

升级恒星基地；

£dot_green£在星系地图点击恒星系
£dot_green£选中恒星基地
£dot_green£点击升级按钮
excerpt.en:
Excellent. As you can see on the Galaxy Map, the borders of our empire have expanded to include the £system£ System where we built our new Starbase.

A newly built Starbase acts as an Outpost, with limited defensive capabilities and no room for Modules and £bu

excerpt.zh: 教程与提示已关闭。
excerpt.en: Tutorial Missions and Tips are disabled.

excerpt.zh: 提示启用，教程关闭。
excerpt.en: Tips are enabled, Tutorial Missions are disabled.

excerpt.zh: 教程与提示均开启。
excerpt.en: Tutorial Missions and Tips are enabled.

excerpt.zh:
我们发现了一些£minor_artifacts£稀有文物。稀有文物是一种深奥的资源，是一个用于描述我们不了解的、事实上可能无法解释的奇怪事物的笼统术语。

它们可以用于执行各种不同的决议。

使用稀有文物；

£dot_green£在左侧边栏点击发现
£dot_green£选择收藏选项卡或按C键

                        £discoveries£
excerpt.en:
We have discovered some £minor_artifacts£ Minor Artifacts. These are an esoteric resource - a catch-all term for strange items which we do not understand and indeed may be inexplicable.

These can be used to enact a variety of decisions.

To interact with Mino

excerpt.zh:
我们发现了一些£astral_threads£星界丝缕它们是时空压缩的细丝，是维度位面碰撞的产物。通常情况下，这些丝线只能从星界细缝中获取，或者进入£astral_rift£星界裂隙中取回。

执行各种星界行动；

£dot_green£在左边栏点击发现按钮
£dot_green£选择星界丝缕选项卡

                        £discoveries£

你可以通过探索星界裂隙解锁更多的行动类型，这些裂隙可能从星界细缝或其他异常事件中出现。
excerpt.en:
We have discovered some £astral_threads£ Astral Threads. These are filaments of condensed space-time: the result of dimensional planes colliding. Typically, these can only be harvested from Astral Scars or recovered inside £astral_rift£ Astral Rifts.

To perfo

excerpt.zh: 某些第一次接触会给出选项，让我方选择如何进行接触事项。这些选择也会长期地影响同其他帝国的外交关系。
excerpt.en: Some First Contact missions will present options for how we wish to conduct matters. These choices can affect our diplomatic relationships with other empires for a long time.

excerpt.zh:
通讯协议已经建立。我们现在可以同这个帝国展开外交。他们对我方的当前评价取决于我们在第一次接触时采取的行径。

要展开外交；

£dot_green£在左侧边栏点击通讯按钮或按F10键

                        £contacts£

在第一次接触任务中，我们也获取了一些情报。随着我们逐渐掌握一个帝国的情报，更多有关他们的细节也将为我们所见。

我们与一种不同类型的文明进行了第一次接触——这类文明通常不愿与其他国家开展外交。

能够与这类文明进行的外交行动十分有限，然而他们也有可能偶尔会决定主动接触我们。
excerpt.en:
We have made First Contact with a different type of civilization - one which is generally unwilling to engage in Diplomacy with others.

The diplomatic actions we can take with civilizations like this are limited, however they may decide to contact us from tim

excerpt.zh:
线人泛指有价值的特工和装置，能为我方谍报活动提供不同效果。线人在间谍网内发挥作用，也可以指派到行动当中，以发掘新的机会或是帮助我们摆脱困境。

我们可以通过事件或者执行招募线人行动来得到线人。
excerpt.en:
Assets are valuable agents and artifacts which provide different effects for our Espionage activities. They work within the Spy Network and may be assigned to Operations, where they can open up new opportunities or else help us out of trouble.

We may receive

excerpt.zh: 我们已经与一个太空城邦进行了第一次接触。太空城邦是一种小型但独立的国家，可以与像我们这样的大型帝国开展贸易，并且外交形式也较为独特。
excerpt.en: We have made First Contact with an Enclave. This is a smaller, independent type of empire which may trade with larger empires like ours, using unique forms of Diplomacy.

excerpt.zh: 我们接触到了一个佣兵城邦。这些独立自主的军事专家会向各种国家，当然也包括我们国家，收费并租借佣兵舰队
excerpt.en: We have encountered a Mercenary Enclave. These independent military specialists may loan out Mercenary Fleets to empires including our own - for a fee.

excerpt.zh: 如果我们同意，[tutorial_mercenary_fleet.GetName]马上可以建立佣兵城邦，舰船也将不再受我们控制，重新成为独立性军事力量，并且可以重新向包括我们在内的所有国家租借佣兵舰队。
excerpt.en: [tutorial_mercenary_fleet.GetName] is now capable of becoming a Mercenary Enclave, if we so wish. The fleet would cease to be under our direct control - instead it would become an independent force, capable of loaning out Mercenary Fleets to empires including

excerpt.zh:
£megastructure£巨型结构是一种我们可以在太空中[GetBuildGrow]的巨大工程。它们可以为我们提供顶尖的研究设施、海量的资源、甚至是一些独特的交通方式。

建立一个巨型结构需要投入大量的时间和资源，但回报也同样可观。我们可以通过派遣一艘£construction_ship£工程船来开始修建巨型结构。
excerpt.en:
£megastructure£ Megastructures are colossal projects that we can [GetBuildGrow] out in the void of space. They may provide us with cutting-edge research facilities, access to superior resources, or even some unique forms of transportation.

Building on such a

excerpt.zh: 得益于我们在巨型工程研究的进展，我们现在可以在宜居£planet£行星外围修建星环基地了。通过指派一艘£construction_ship£工程船以开始修建。
excerpt.en: Thanks to our recent advances in mega-engineering research, we are now able to construct Orbital Rings around habitable £planet£ Planets. We can begin building by issuing orders to a £construction_ship£ Construction Ship.

excerpt.zh:
星环基地是一种能够环抱整颗£planet£行星的£megastructure£巨型结构。它能搭建起一条支持空地间高效运转的通道，为诸如船坞、防御结构、资源仓库之类的的建筑提供空间。

excerpt.en: Recent advances in mega-engineering research mean we may now construct a Quantum Catapult around a pulsar or neutron star. We can begin building by issuing orders to a £construction_ship£ Construction Ship.

excerpt.zh:

不过使用量子弹弓也有一定的风险，例如舰队有可能被弹射到预定目标以外的£system£恒星系。当然我们可以通过升级量子弹弓到更高等级，提高吞吐量与最大跃迁范围等属性，从而降低这些风险。
excerpt.en:
The Quantum Catapult launches Ships and fleets across vast, interstellar distances. This technology greatly improves our ability to react to emerging situations within our empire, and in nearby regions of space.

excerpt.en: Our mega-engineering research has yielded results in the form of Hyper Relays. We can begin forming a network of these by issuing orders to a £construction_ship£ Construction Ship.

title.zh: 教程：教程：超空间中继器

excerpt.zh:
超空间中继器能够加快在相邻£system£恒星系航行的速度。如果能够将至少两个超空间中继器链接到一起，那么我们就可以建立一个显著加快帝国内部航行速度的网络。

超空间中继器也能与开放边境的相邻国家内部的中继器链接，从而将两国的网络相连。这将提高舰船穿越相邻国家的速度。
excerpt.en:
Hyper Relays allow for more efficient travel between adjacent £system£ Star Systems. By linking at least two Hyper Relays together, we can begin to establish a network which will dramatically reduce transit times across our empire.

如果计划观察他们（假定他们在我们的掌控范围内），我们需要在他们星球轨道上建立一座观测站。

如果打算入侵他们，我们只需召集军队，他们没什么胜算。

然而，这些隐形场在激活时将对基础舰船速度、超空间跃迁充能时间和护盾承受值产生负面影响。

通过将多个阵列耦合在一起，我们可以提高探测阵列的灵敏度，使它们能够穿透越来越稳定的隐形力场。

随着进一步研究，我们应该能够利用£science_ship£科研船来进一步提高这些探测能力。这些设备的范围受限于恒星基地的探测范围。
